tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi rnam bshad tshig don rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mkha' khyab spros dang bral ba'i chos sku brnyes/ /kha sbyor yan lag bad
༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi rnam bshad tshig don rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mkha' khyab spros dang bral ba'i chos sku brnyes/ /kha sbyor yan lag bad

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/19_KHEZ/KHEZ022_mdzod kyi rnam bshad tshig don rab gsal.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi rnam bshad tshig don rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mkha' khyab spros dang bral ba'i chos sku brnyes/ /kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan longs skur bzhengs/ /dpag med sprul sku'i grangs med smin grol mdzad/ /don gnyis mthar phyin thub pa'i dbang po bstod/ /skye ba lnga brgyar paṇḍi tar 'khrungs shing / /'bum sde dgu bcu rtsa dgu thugs la mnga'/ /brgyad stong pa la rgyun du zhal 'don mdzad/ /dbyig gnyen mkhas pa'i dbang po de la 'dud/ /phun tshogs sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel mdzad cing / /mdo rgyud kun la rab dga'i mkhyen pa rgyas/ /chos kyi spyan gyis 'gro drug bu ltar gzigs/ /bzang po'i 'phrin las phyogs bcur rab 'phro ba'i/ /sgrib med gzigs pa'i spyan ldan rnam gnyis rgyal/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i chu gtsang las 'khrungs 'jam dbyangs pad ma dkar po'i zhal/ /'phrin las bcud kyis kun nas bltams pa'i thugs rje'i ge sar bzhad pa'i mtshor/ /bdud rtsi nus pas rnams dpyod lus grib lung rigs gshog yangs cher brgyas pa/ /ngang pa'i ded dpon siddhi'i ming can bla ma'i legs bshad spel la spro/ /blo ldan don gnyer chu bya'i tshogs/ /dad brtson 'dun pa cher bskyed de/ /rnams dpyod lus stobs brgyas phyir du/ /lung rigs bdud rtsi'i bcud 'di 'thung / /'dir dam pa'i chos mngon pa sde bdun gyi don phyin ci ma log par phyogs gcig tu bstan la 'bebs par byed pa/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig don rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di la/ /bsdus don gyis khog phub pa dang / /tshig don lhug par phral ba gnyis/ /dang po ni mtshan don 'gyur phyag klad kyi don/ /'gyur ba'i gzhung don dngos nyid bshad/ /bshad pa mthar phyin mjug gi don/ /'gyur ba'i gzhung don dngos nyid la/ /rtsom la 'jug pa'i yan lag dang / /rtsom pa'i gzhung gi brjod don bshad/ /rtsom pa mtha' tu phyin pa'o/

/rtsom la 'jug phyir mchod par brjod/ /rtsom par dam bca' mtshan don bshad/ /dam chos mngon pa gsungs pa yi/ /dgos pa bzhi yi rtsom la 'jug /brtsam bya gzhung gi brjod don la/ /lus kyi tshul gyi mdor bstan dang / /yan lag tshul gyis rgyas par bshad/ /lus la zag bcas zag med pa/ /gnyis pa/ yan lag tshul gyi brgyas bshad la/ /brjod bya'i gtso bo'i bsdu ba dang / /gnas brgyad so sor bshad pa gnyis/ /gtan la dbab bya'i yul dang ni/ /nyams su blang ba'i spyod pa dang / /thob bya'i 'bras bu gsum gyis ni/ /gzhung 'di'i brjod don mtha' dag bsdus/ /yul la kun byang thun mong dang / /kun byang so sor bshad pa gnyis/ /thun mong khams dang dbang po bstan/ /'dus byas spyi yi mtshan nyid dang / /chos gsum gyi ni rnam bzhag dang / /khams kyi rnams pa'i rab dbye yi/ /sgo nas khams kyi gnas nyid bshad/ /dbang po nyer gnyis rang bzhin dang / /'dus byas chos kyi skye tshul dang / /rgyu rkyen 'bras bu 'byung tshul gyi/ /sgo nas dbang po bstan pa bshad/ /kun byang so sor bshad pa la/ /dor bya sdug kun bden pa dang / /blang bya 'gog lam bden pa gnyis/ /dor bya sdug kun bden pa la/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa dang / /rgyu ni kun 'byung bden pa'o/ /bcud dang snod dang khyad chos kyi/ /sgo nas sdug bsngal bden pa nyid/ /ston byed 'jig rten bstan pa bshad/ /skye bo 'gro ba'i dbye ba dang / /skye tshul rten 'brel rang bzhin dang / /skyes pa gnas pa'i thabs dang ni/ /'chi 'pho'i sems dang tshogs gsum bsdu/ /lnga yis bcud kyi 'jig rten bstan/ /skye bo 'gro ba'i dbye ba la/ /khams gsum 'gro ba lnga dang ni/ /skye gnas bzhi ru dbye ba'o/ /gnyis pa snod kyi 'jig rten la/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsum ngos bzung / /brten pa ri mtsho gling gsum bshad/ /tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas dang ni/ /'dod dang gzugs khams lha yi gnas/

/stong gsum ngos bzung lus tshe'i tshad/ /tshad de gzhal ba'i thabs dang dgus/ /snod kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag bstan/ /brten pa ri mtsho gling gsum la/ /ri dgu rgyu dang tshad dbyibs kyis/ /sgo nas bshad cing mtsho brgyad dang / /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad po rnams/ /dbyibs dang tshad kyi sgo nas bshad/ /khyad par 'dzam gling yon tan gyis/ /sgo nas bye brag nyid du bshad/ /'dod dang gzugs khams lha gnas la/ /sa dang 'brel dang ma 'brel dang / /zhar byung sems can khyad chos dang / /bar gyi thag tshad ngo yi bzung / /sa dang 'brel ba'i lha gnas la/ /gzhal med khang la brten pa dang / /ri rab la ni rten pa gnyis/ /gzhal med khang la brten pa la/ /nyi zla'i thag tshad nyi ma yis/ /gling la bya ba byed tshul dang / /dus tshigs rnam gzhag zhar las byung / /zla ba'i 'phel 'grib rgyu bstan to/ /brgyad pa'i lus tshe'i tshad la ni/ /mi dang lha yi lus tshad bshad/ /tshe tshad bde 'gro ngan 'gro gnyis/ /bde 'gro mi dang 'dod lha dang / /gzugs khams gzugs med tshe tshad do/ /ngan 'gro tsha dmyal dud 'gro dang / /yid dwags grang dmyal tshe tshad bshad/ /dgu pa tshad de gzhal thabs la/ /lus tshad gzhal ba'i ched du ni/ /dpag tshad rgyang grags ngo yi bzung / /tshe tshad gzhal phyir lo dang ni/ /bskal pa ngo yi bzung ba gnyis/ /dang po 'jog bzhi ngo yi bzung / /de las dpag tshad rgyang grags su/ /'jog pa'i 'jog tshul dang gnyis yin/ /gnyis pa tshe tshad gzhal thabs la/ /'dod khams tshe tshad rtogs phyir du/ /lo nyid ngo yis bzung ba dang / khams gong tshe tshad rtogs phyir du/ /bstan bshad gnyis kyis sgo nas ni/ /bskal pa ngos bzung bskal chen la/ /'byung ba'i gang zag rnams gsum bshad/ /gsum pa snod bcud khyad chos la/ /dang po'i tshe lo dpag med nas/ /bcu pa'i bar du 'grib tshul dang / /'jig bskal bye brag bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung bden pa la/ /las dang nyon mongs kun 'byung gnyis/

/las kyis 'bras bu 'grub tshul gyi/ /sgo nas mdor bstan las nyid kyi/ /rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa dang / /las kyi rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa'i/ /sgo nas las kyi gnas nyid bshad/ /nyon mongs kun 'byung bden pa la/ /spang bya phra rgyas nyon mongs dang / /spong byed gnyen po spangs pa yis/ /'bras bu yongs shes gsum gyis ni/ /phra rgyas bstan pa'i 'jig rten bshad/ /lnga pa phra rgyas bstan pa yi/ /spong byed gnyen po lam bden dang / /'bras bu yongs shes 'gog bden du/ /bshad pas blang bya 'gog lam gnyis/ /phra rgyas bstan pa'i zhar las grub/ /gnyis pa nyon mongs spyod pa la/ /lam dang gang zag rnam gzhag dang / /lam gyi khyad chos gzhan bshad pa'i/ /sgo nas lam dang gang zag gi /gnas nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa thob bya'i 'bras bu ni/ /ye shes bstan pa'i mdzod dang ni/ /snyoms 'jug bstan pa gnyis kyi bstan/ /ye shes rang bzhin gtan la phab/ /ldan pa'i tshul dang thob pa'i tshul/ /khyad chos bzhi yi sgo nas ni/ /ye shes bstan pa'i gnas nyid bshad/ /snyoms 'jug rang bzhin gtan la phab/ /de yi khyad chos ting nge 'dzin/ /gsum gyi dbye ba snyoms 'jug la/ /brten pa'i yon tan bshad pa yi/ /sgo nas snyoms 'jug bstan pa bshad/ /gnyis pa tshig don lhug par phral ba ni/ /mtshan don 'gyur phyag klad kyi don/ /'gyur ba'i gzhung don dngos nyid bshad/ bshad pa mthar phyin mjug gi don/ zhes pa ltar/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don dang gsum/ /dang po la mtshan gyi don dang / 'gyur gyi phyag gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na skad rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pa'i nang nas legs par sbyar ba saṃskri ta lha'i skad du/ bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la/ a bhi dharma ko ṣa ka ri ka zhes pa 'byung / de bod skad du bsgyur na/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa zhes 'byung / de yang so sor bsgyur na/ a bhi ni/

mngon pa la 'jug dharma ni chos la 'jug ko ṣa ni/ mdzod la 'jug ka ri ka ni tshig le'ur byas pa la 'jug go /mtshan don 'og nas 'chad/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'gyur ba'i gzhung don dngos nyid la/ rtsom la 'jug pa'i yan lag dang / rtsom pa'i gzhung gi brjod don bshad/ rtsom pa mtha' ru phyin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsom la 'jug phyir mchod par brjod/ rtsom par dam bca' mtshan don bshad/ dam chos mngon pa gsungs pa yi/ dgos pa bzhi yis rtsom la 'jug ces pa ltar/ rtsom la 'jug pa'i ched du mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba/ chos mngon pa'i mtshan don bshad pa/ chos mngon pa gsungs pa'i dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang zhig ces sogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /gang la na/ don gnyis phun tshogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang zhig la'o/ /gang gis na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ dus nam gyi tshe na/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dang por ro/ /dgos pa ni rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i ched du'o/ /'o na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la don gnyis kyi yon tan ji ltar ldan zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos can/ rang don phun tshogs kyi yon tan dang ldan te/ ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya kun la sgrib pa'i nyon mongs dang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i 'dun pa sa bon dang bcas pa gtan nas bcom shing rtsa ba nas spangs pa'i spangs pa phun tshogs dang / shes bya ma lus pa rtogs pa'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang ldan pa'i phyir/ 'dir spangs pa dngos su bstan/ rtogs pa shugs las ston no/ /yang de chos can/ gzhan don phun tshogs kyi yon tan dang ldan te/ 'dam dang chos mtshungs pa'i 'khor ba las 'gro ba rnam drangs par mdzad pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba 'dam dang chos mtshungs te/ 'dam la bying ba'i gang zag skam sar thar dka' ba bzhin du/ 'khor bar bying ba'i gang zag thar par 'dren dka' ba'i phyir/

yang de chos can/ 'khor ba'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i yon tan dang ldan te/ gdul bya so so'i blo dang ldan pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston par mdzad pa'i sgo nas gdul bya rnams/ gnas skabs mngon mtho dang / mthar thug nges legs la 'god par mdzad pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir/ 'o na yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod nas las su bya ba ci byed ce na/ chos mngon mdzod kyis bstan bcos rab bshad bya/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ spyir chos mngon pa la don dam pa'i chos mngon pa dang / brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i dri med kyi shes rab mtshungs pa dang bcas pa la byed cing / rjes su 'brang bcas na phung po lnga ka yod/ gzugs kyi phung po ni/ zag med kyi sdom pa lta bu'o/ /des na don dam pa'i chos mngon pa bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ 'bras bu mngon pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs so/ /brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa la/ lam mngon pa dang / gzhung mngon pa gnyis pas/ dang po ni/ nyan thos tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyis bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i shes rab chos can/ lam mngon pa yin te/ 'bras bu mngon pa de thob phyir zhugs pa'i bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhung mngon pa ni/ 'bras bu mngon pa dang lam mngon pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i lung rnams la byed do/ /bstan bcos 'di la mngon pa mdzod ces bya te/ don dam pa'i mngon pa dang / brdar btags pa'i mngon pa gnyis brjod bya'i don yang dag par chud pa'i phyir ram/ yang na bstan bcos 'di gang nas byung ba'i gnas ni mngon pa sde bdun yin la/ de chos mngon pa mdzod dngos yin zhing / bstan bcos 'di yang de las byung ba'i don gyis na de skad ces brjod/ bzhi pa ni/ chos rnams zhes sogs la/

slob dpon dbyig gnyen chos can/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba las bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir du bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa yin te/khyod kyis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos 'dir/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab brjod bya'i gtso bor bstan pa gang zhig de med par nyon mongs pa rnams nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs med la/ nyon mongs ma zhi bas kyang 'jig rten pa rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho 'dir 'khyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs la mngon pa sde bdun po 'di ni ston pas gsungs pa'i bka' dgra bcom pa bdun gyis bsdus pa'i bstan bcos yin no lo zer/ lo zhes pa'i tshig ni ma rangs pa'i tshig te/ mdo sde pa dang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi lugs la/ mngon pa'i don ston pas gsungs shing / sde bdun ni/ dgra bcom pa bdun gyis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos yin par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa brtsam bya gzhung gi don la/ lus kyi tshul gyis mdor bstan dang / yan lag tshul gyis rgyas par bshad/ ces pa ltar gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus la zag bcas zag med pa/ gnyis su dbye dang zag bcas dang / zag med gnyis rnams 'di yi lus/ zhes pa ltar zag bcas zhes sogs la/ bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo'am thams cad bsdu na/ zag bcas dang zag med kyi chos gnyis su 'dus te/ bstan bcos 'dir de gnyis bstan pa gang zag gi chos thams cad bsdus na de gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir/ lam ma gtogs zhes sogs la/ lam bden ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams chos can/ zag bcas yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gis phyir na/ dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan ci rigs pa'i sgo nas zag pa rnams kun tu rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dir lam bden yin na shes pa yin pa'i khyab pa ni khas mi len te/ zag med kyi sdom pa dang / lam bden gyis thob pa lam bden yin zhing / zag med kyi sdom pa gzugs kyi phung po dang /

/lam bden gyi thob pa ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed yin pa'i phyir/ lam bden gyis thob pa lam bden yin te/ dge ba'i thob pa dge ba yin pa'i phyir te/ dge la sogs kyis dge la sogs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zag med sogs la/ lam bden dang 'dus ma byas rnam gsum chos can/ zag med yin te/ dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan ci rigs pa'i sgo nas zag pa 'byung ba mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nam mkha' sogs la/ nam mkha' dang so sor brtags 'gog dang so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa gsum yod pa de la/ 'dus ma byas nam mkha' chos can/ mi sgrib pa zhes bya ste/ rang yod pa'i gzhir gzugs can gzhan 'byung ba la gegs mi byed pa'i bar snang stong pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi nyon sgrib spangs pa'i 'gog pa chos can/ so sor brtags 'gog yin te/ zag med bar chad med lam gyis rang gi ngos skal gyis nyon sgrib spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ des na sdug bsngal mthong spang sogs bzhi spangs pa'i spangs pa bzhi po rdzas so so yin pa'i phyir te/ de dag ldan par byed pa'i rdzas de dag kyang rdzas so so yin pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs mngon 'gyur ba dang bral ba'i bral ba chos can/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa yin te/ zag med bar chad med lam gyi stobs kyis rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya spangs pa ma yin par rgyu ma tshang ba'i dbang gis re zhig nyon mongs mngon 'gyur ba rgyun chad pa'i 'gog pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yan lag rgyas bshad ni/ gtan la phab bya'i yul dang ni/ /nyams su blangs ba'i spyod pa dang / /thob bya'i 'bras bu gsum dang ni/ gzhung 'di'i brjod don mtha' dag bsdus/ zhes pa ltar/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul/ nyams len gyi spyod pa/ thob bya'i 'bras bu dang gsum/

dang po la/ kun byang thun mong du gtan la dbab pa dang / de so sor gtan la dbab pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ khams kyis gnas dang / dbang po'i gnas gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dus byas spyi'i mtshan nyid/ chos gsum gyi rnam gzhag khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye dang gsum/ dang po la/ dbye ba dang / ming gi rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dus byas sogs la gong du bshad pa'i lam bden ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams zag bcas yin zhes bya ba'i 'dus byas te gang la byed ce na/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams bsdu na phung po lngar 'dus te/ de dag la gzugs can yin pa/ gtso sems yin pa/ sems 'byung yin pa/ ldan min 'du byed dang bzhi yod la/ dang po ni/ gzugs kyi phung por 'dus/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam par shes pa'i phung por 'dus/ gsum pa ni/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ de las gzhan sems chung dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ tshor ba'i phung po/ gnyis pa ni/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ gsum pa dang ldan min 'du byed rnams/ 'du byed kyi phung por 'dus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'dus byas spyi'i ming gi rnam grangs dang / zag bcas kyi ming gi rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po ni/ de dag nyid/ ces sogs 'dus byas/ dus/ gtam gzhi/ nges par 'byung bcas/ gzhi dang bcas pa ming gi rnam grangs so/ /'dus byas chos can/ dus zhes bya te dus gsum 'jog pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ gtam gzhi zhes bya ste/ rjod byed kyi sgra 'jug pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ nges par 'byung pa zhes bya te/ mthar khyod dor nas lhag med myang 'das mngon du byed dgos pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ gzhi dang bcas pa zhes bya ste/ skyed par byed pa'i rgyu dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gang dag sogs la/ zag bcas kyi ming gi rnam grangs la/ nyer len/ 'thab bcas/ sdug bsngal/ kun 'byung / 'jig rten/ lta gnas/ yang srid dang bdun yod/ zag bcas chos can/ nyer len zhes bya ste/ nyon mongs pa las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/

de chos can/ nye bar len pa zhes bya ste/ nyon mongs kyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ dper na me tog skyed par byed pa'i shing la me tog gi shing zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /de chos can/ nye bar len pa zhes bya te/ nyon mongs pa la rag las pa'i phyir/ dper na rgyal po la rag las pa'i mi la rgyal po'i mi zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /de chos can/ 'thab bcas zhes bya ste/ khyod la brten nas lus ngag gi 'thab mo rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ste/ sdug bsngal gsum ci rigs pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ kun 'byung zhes bya ste/ sdug bsngal phyi ma skyed par byed pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'jig rten zhes bya ste/ ('dir tshig 'bru drug mi gsal ) skad cig gis 'jig pa'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ lta gnas zhes bya ste/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba sogs lta ba ngan pa 'byung ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ yang srid ces bya ste/ sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas yang srid phyi ma yang yang du 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos gsum gyi rnam gzhag la/ chos gsum so so'i rang bzhin/ chos gsum gyi khyad chos/ chos gsum gzhan gyis bsdus tshul dang gsum/ dang po la/ gzugs can gyis bsdus pa'i chos gsum/ gzugs sems gnyis las gzhan pa'i bsdus pa'i chos gsum/ sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos gsum mo/ /dang po la/ gzugs phung gi rang bzhin dang / de las byung ste khams dang skye mched du 'jog tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan dang / rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs phung la/ dbang po lnga/ don lnga/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs phung dang bcu gcig bcu gcig po 'di chos can/ gzugs kyi phung po yin te/ blo'i yul du du ma spungs pa lta bur snang ba'i gzugs can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dbang po lnga/ don lnga/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bshad pa dang gsum/

dang po ni/ rang 'bras gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs dam pa la mig dbang du 'jog des dbang po phyi ma bzhi la rigs 'gres gnyis pa don lnga bshad pa ni/ gzugs 'dzin mig shes kyis gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi'i skyed mched kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ kha dog dang / dbyibs kyi gzugs gnyis/ dang po la rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi dang / yan lag gi kha dog brgyad de bcu gnyis/ gnyis pa dbyibs kyi gzugs la brgyad te nyi shu yod/ rtsa ba'i kha dog la sngon po la sogs pa bzhi/ yan lag gis kha dog brgyad ni/ sprin dang / du ba dang / rdul dang / khug sna dang / snang ba dang / mun pa dang / nyi ma dang / grib ma ste brgyad du mchims ṭīka las bshad/ don phyi ma bzhi la mtshan nyid rigs 'gre/ sgra la dbye na brgyad yod te/ rtsa ba'i sgo nas sems kyis zin ma zin gnyis/ de re re la yang brjod bya ston mi ston gnyis gnyis/ de re re la'ang snyan mi snyan gnyis gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ ro la dbye na/ rnam pa drug yod te/ mngar ba/ skyur ba/ kha ba/ bska ba/ tsha ba/ lan tshwa ba dang drug tu yod pa'i phyir/ 'ga' zhig tu ro brgya zhes bshad pa ni/ ro brgya dang brgyad du yod la/ de yang rtsa ba'i sgo nas mngar ba'i mngar ba sogs drug drug tu phye bas/ sum cu rtsa drug tu yod cing / sman gzhung du ro re re la rab 'bring tha gsum du phye bas brgya dang brgyad du bshad kyang mi 'thad de/ zas gcig la ro brgya dang brgyad tshang ba mi srid pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ des na sum cu so drug po re re la lce dbang gis myong ba'i tshe lce shes la phan 'dogs pa'i phyir ro/ /'ju ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe/ lus la mi gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhu ba'i tshe lus sems la phan 'dogs pa'i ro de/ gsum gsum du phye bas brgya dang brgyad/ dri zhim mi zhim gnyis/

de re re la mnyam mi mnyam gnyis gnyis te bzhi yod do/ /reg bya la dbye na bcu gcig ste/ 'byung ba bzhi'i reg bya bzhi dang / 'byung 'gyur gyi reg bya bdun rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma bdun ni/ 'jam rtsub/ lci yang / bkres skom grang ba dang bdun no/ /gsum pa la/ dngos dang / zhar byung gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs la rig byed min pa'i gzugs su 'jog khyad chos bzhi ni/ gnas skabs kyi/ ngo bo'i/ rgyu mtshan gyi/ rgyu'i khyad chos dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ ma g.yengs sems bcas kyi gnas skabs su 'byung ba ma zad/ sems g.yengs pa dang / sems med pa'i gnas skabs su yang 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ dge mi dge gang rung gis bsdus pa/ gsum pa ni/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma rjes su 'brel ba'i rgyun dang bcas pa la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi rnams rgyur byas pa'i 'bras gzugs yin no/ /'dir kha cig so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs gtso che zhing / rnam par rig byed kyi gzugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa dang gnyis yod te/ rnam rig min rnam gsum zhes pa/ sdom dang sdom pa min dang gzhan/ sdom pa so sor thar zhes bya/ de bzhin zag med bsam gtan skyes/ zhes dang / 'chal ba'i tshul khrims mi dge'i gzugs/ de spong tshul khrims rnam gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ de ni shin du mi 'thad de/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs yod de/ so thar gyi sdom pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhes bya pa'i rtags gsal la 'brel ba med de/ de la so thar gyi sdom pa yin na rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs yin pa'i ma khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ 'phel dang ma byas lam sogs phyir/ zhes pa'i sogs khongs kyi sgrub byed dang / rang 'grel du rnam par rig byed ma yin pa med na/

so sor thar pa'i sdom pa yang med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang 'gal/ gzhan yang dge slong gi sdom pa thob ma thag gi gang zag gi rgyud la/ ngag gi rig byed kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod par thal/ dge slong gi sdom pa yin na/ spong ba bdun ldan yin pa'i khyab pa mngon 'dul gyi mdo bstan bcos mtha' dag nas bshad cing / rig byed kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ dge slong gi sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i slob dpon gyi ngag gi rig byed kyang med/ dge slong gi sdom pa skyes ma thag pa'i slob ma'i ngag gi rig byed du gyur pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yang med pa'i phyir/ dang po med de/ yod na slob dpon gyi ngag gi rig byed slob ma'i rgyud kyi sdom par 'gyur ba sogs ha cang thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa med de/ dge slong gi sdom pa skyes ma thag pa'i bsgrub bya'i rgyud la ngag gi rnam par rig byed bstan med pa'i phyir te/ dge slong gi sdom pa skye bzhin pa'i skabs su slob dpon gyi sdom pa 'bogs byed kyi cho ga'i tshig la bsgrub bya rna ba gtod pa tsam ma gtogs/ bsgrub bya rang gi ngag smra brjod dang bral ba'i phyir/ thal 'gyur 'di la/ rig byed kyi gzugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa yod par 'dod pa'i gangs ri'i khrod kyis mngon 'dul ba dag phyogs gcig tu 'dus la lan thob cig ji skad du/ dang po'i rnam rig rnam rig min/ zhes pa'i 'grel par/ sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa'i rnam par rig pa rig byed ma yin pa dang po dag ni so sor thar pa zhes bya ste/ des sdig pa'i sa las thar ba'i phyir te/ spangs pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa zhes kyang bya ste/ lus dang ngag sdom pa'i phyir ro/ /las kyi lam zhes kyang bya la/

skad cig ma gnyis pa la sogs pa ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa kho na yin gyi/ so sor thar pa ni/ min pas 'jug yin gyi/ las kyi lam dngos ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa min nam zhes na/ de ltar gsungs mod/ de dus kyi rig byed dang po ni sbyor ba'i skabs yin la/ rig byed min pa dang po ni sbyor ba'i dus su 'byung ba'i nges pa med cing / dngos gzhi'i dus su ni nges par skye ba'i khyab pa de nyid kyis phyir/ rig byed min pa'i gzugs skad cig dang po ni/ so sor thar pa dang / de'i sdom pa gnyis ka dang / de'i skad cig gnyis pa yan chad ni sdom pa kho na dang / rig byed kyi gzugs dang po ni/ so sor thar pa kho na dang de'i skad cig gnyis pa sogs ni gnyis ka ma yin no/ /rig byed dang rig byed ma yin pa'i bsdus pa'i tshul khrims la/ so thar dang sdom pa'i mu bzhi bshad pa yin gyi/ rig byed kyi gzugs dang sdom pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i ston pa ni min no/ /sdom pa zhes kyang bya ste/ zhes pa'i rig byed kyang bsdu na/ skad cig gnyis pa zhes sogs su'ang de bsdu dgos par mtshungs pa'i lung don la zhib tu dpyad dgos so/ /yang gal te dge ba bdun rnam gnyis zhes pa'i rang 'grel du yang dag par bslangs pa las byung ba'i tshul khrims ni/ rnam par rig byed la rag las pa'i phyir/ las kyi lam gzugs can bdun ni/ gdon mi za bar rnam par rig byed dang rig byed ma yin pa gnyis ka yod do/ /ces gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhe na mi 'gal te/ de'i don ni/ lus ngag dge ba bdun po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rig byed ma dang rig byed ma yin pa gnyis/ lam gyi dngos gzhi'i dus su yod par bshad kyang / de dus kyi rig byed de las lam gyi dngos gzhis bsdus pa'i sdom pa yin par mi 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi dgongs pa rdzogs par gyur cig gnyis pa la/

'byung ba'i dbye ba/ byed las/ ngo bo/ /'phros pa'i dogs dpyod dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sa'i khams/ chu'i khams/ me'i khams/ rlung gi khams dang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa'i 'dzin par byed/ chu'i sdud par byed/ me'i smin par byed/ rlung gis rgyas par byed/ gsum pa ni/ sra shing 'thas pa sa'i mtshan nyid yin/ rlan zhing gsher ba chu'i/ tsha shing sreg pa me'i/ yang shing g.yo ba rlung gi mtshan nyid yin/ bzhi pa ni/ 'dir bshad pa dang / 'jig rten na grags pa'i 'byung ba bzhi la khyad par ci yod zhe na/ khyad par yod de/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du 'byung ba'i kha dog dang dbyibs la 'byung ba bzhir brjod pa'i phyir/ de yin te/ sa dkar po gru bzhi/ chu sngon po zlum po/ me dmar po gru gsum zhes brjod cing / yang shing g.yo ba la rlung du grags pa yang yod la/ 'byung ba snga ma gsum po de dang 'dra bar rlung nag po dang gzhu'i dbyibs can du brjod pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de las byung ste khams dang skye mched 'jog tshul ni/ dbang don bcu po de dag kho na la skye mched du 'jog pa'i tshe/ gzugs can gyi sems skye mched bcu dang khams su 'jog pa'i tshe gzugs can gyi khams bcu ru yang 'dod do/ /'dir kho na zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pa gzugs can gyi skye mched dang khams ni/ dbang byed bcu po kho na'i steng nas 'jog rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs de gnyis yin pa bkag par mchims ṭīka las bshad do/ /mdzod pa ltar na/ mig gi skye mched/ mig gi khams/ mig dbang gsum don gcig du 'dod/ kun las btus pa ltar na/ mig dang mig gi khams la mu bzhir 'dod te/ dang po yin la gnyis pa min pa'i mu/ gnyis pa yin la dang po min pa'i mu/ gnyis ka yin pa'i mu/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu dang bzhir 'dod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ lhag med mya ngan las 'das kha ma'i dgra bcom pa'i mig dbang lta bu/ gnyis pa ni mig gi sa bon lta bu/

gsum pa ni/ da ltar gyis rten bcas kyi mig dbang lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ der mtshungs kyi mig dbang lta bu'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa gzugs sems gnyis las gzhan pa'i bsdus pa'i chos gsum la/ ngo bo dang / de las khams dang skye mched du 'jog tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang stobs kyis nyams su myong ba'i sems byung de tshor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na bde ba sogs lnga/ rang stobs kyi yul gyi spu ris sam mtshan ma mi 'dra bar 'dzin pa'i sems byung 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ rtog bcas/ rtog med gnyis/ phung po gzhan bzhi las don gzhan du gyur pa'i 'dus byas 'du byed kyi phung po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mtshungs ldan 'du byed/ ldan min 'du byed gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sems gnyis las gzhan pa'i chos gtan la phab pa'i chos kyi skye mched/ chos kyi khams kyang gtan la dbab par 'gyur te/ de gsum rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs 'dus ma byas dang bcas pa rnams skye mched du 'jog pa'i tshe/ chos kyi skye mched/ khams su 'jog pa'i tshe chos khams su 'jog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos gsum la/ chos gsum gyis rang bzhin/ chos gsum kyis gtso bo ngos bzung / zhar la khams kyi grangs nges la rtsod pa spang ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rnam shes tshogs drug chos can/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po yin te/ blo yul du spungs pa lta bur snang zhing / don gyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis so sor rig pa'i gtso sems yin pa'i phyir/ de drug gtan la phab pas yid kyi skye mched kyang gtan la phab par 'gyur te/ de rnams tshogs drug las don gzhan min te/ rang gi bdag 'bras kyi dus na 'das ma thag gi rnam shes tshogs drug gang yin pa de yid kyi khams yin pa'i phyir/ yid khams de rnam shes tshogs drug las logs su smos pa la dgos pa yod de/ drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen du sgrub pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/

khams la ldog pa'i sgo nas bco brgyad du grangs nges te/ bdag rkyen dbang po'i khams drug dmigs pa yul gyi khams drug 'bras bu rnam shes kyi khams drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ rdzas kyi sgo nas bsdu na bcu gnyis su 'dus te/ rnam shes tshogs drug yid kyi khams su 'dus pa'i phyir/ cung zad phye na bcu bdun du yod de/ yid kyi khams rnam shes tshogs drug las don gzhan du med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos gsum gyi gtso bo ngos bzung ba ni/ gzugs kyi phung po yid kyi skye mched chos kyi khams gsum po de/ chos gsum gtso bo yin te/ de gsum gyis chos thams cad bsdu na/ gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i chos/ sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos/ de gnyis las gzhan pa'i chos dang gsum du 'dus shing / dang po gzugs kyi phung pos bsdus/ gnyis pa yid kyi skye mched kyis bsdus/ gsum pa chos kyi khams kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ bsdu tshul de yang rang gi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i tshul gyis bsdus te/ gzugs phung las gzhan pa'i chos de'i bsdu bya'i dngos por mi ldan pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma gnyis la'ang 'gre/ gsum pa khams kyi grangs nges la rtsod pa spang ba ni/ khams la bco brgyad du grangs nges pa mi 'thad de/ mig la yang g.yas g.yon gyi khams gnyis/ rna ba la yang de gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ zhes na ma khyab te/ mig g.yas g.yon gnyis mig tu rigs gcig pa dang / spyod yul gzugs la dmigs pa dang / 'bras bu rnams skyed par 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis khams gcig tu gzhag pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang gang zag gcig la mig gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rten mdzes par byed pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ mi 'thad de dbang rten gyis rten mdzes par byed pa'i phyir/ zhe na khyab pa med de/ nang du dbang po med na phyi rol du dbang rten mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dper na gdugs nam mkha' la ma phub na grib ma sa la mi 'byung ba bzhin no/

/gnyis pa chos gsum gyi khyad chos la/ chos gsum gyi sgra don/ chos gsum gsungs pa'i dgos pa/ chos gsum gyi go rim dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phung po lnga chos can/ phung po zhes bya ste/ blo'i yul du du ma spungs pa lta bur snang ba'i phyir/ skye mched bcu gnyis chos can/ skye mched ces bya ste/ rnam shes skye ba'i sgo 'byed pa'i phyir/ khams bco brgyad chos can/ khams zhes bya ste/ 'bras bu 'byung ba'i rgyu'am rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la dgos pa dngos dang dogs dpyod gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos gsum gsungs pa la dgos pa yod de/ sems byung la ril po gcig tu rmongs pa/ gzugs can la ril po gcig tu rmongs pa/ gzugs sems gnyis ka la ril po gcig tu rmongs pa gsum ldog pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ de yang phung po lnga bshad pas rmongs pa dang po ldog nus te/ phung po lnga'i skabs su sems byung gi phung po gsum du phye ba'i phyir/ skye mched bcu gnyis bshad pas/ rmongs pa gnyis pa ldog nus te/ skye mched bcu gnyis kyi skabs su gzugs can gyi skye mched la bcur phye ba'i phyir/ khams bco brgyad bshad pas rmongs pa gsum pa ldog nus te/ khams bco brgyad kyi skabs su gzugs can gyi khams la bcu dang / rnam shes kyi khams la bdun du phye ba'i phyir/ yang chos gsum gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum du rjes su bzung ba'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ yang chos gsum gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ tshig bsdus pa 'bring rgyas pa 'dod pa gsum rjes su bzung ba'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sems byung nang nas tshor 'dus gnyis phung po logs su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshor 'dus gnyis rtsod pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ 'khor ba'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir dang / 'og nas 'byung ba'i phung po'i go rims 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de gnyis phung po logs su gzhag pa'i phyir/

'o na 'dus ma byas phung por mi 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'dus ma byas ni du ma spungs pa'i don du mi rung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa go rim la/ phung po'i go rim/ khams dang skye mched kyi go rims/ zhar byung dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phung po lnga'i go rim ni rags pa dang por bstan nas/ phra ba mjug tu bstan pa'i go rim yin te/ snga ma rnams rtogs sla/ phyi ma phyi ma rnams rtogs dka' ba'i phyir/ yang na kun nas nyon mongs skye ba'i go rim yin te/ 'jig rten pa rnams dang por gzugs mthong ba la brten nas nyon mongs skye/ de nas tshor ba bde ba thob 'dod kyi nyon mongs skye/ de nas 'du shes phyin ci log pa'i nyon mongs skye/ de la brten nas 'du byed log pa'i nyon mongs skye/ de bzhi la brten nas rnam par shes pa nyon mongs can gyi ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ yang na snod dang / zas dang / bya na dang / byan po dang / zas la longs spyod pa dang lnga'i go rims dang mthun par bstan te/ gzugs ni snod dang chos mtshungs/ tshor ba zas dang / 'du shes bya na/ 'du byed byan po dang / rnam par shes pa zas la longs spyod pa po dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de yin te/ snod kyis zas kyi rten byed pa bzhin du/ gzugs kyis tshor bas rten byed/ zas de longs spyod pa po'i longs spyad bya yin pa de bzhin du/ tshor ba yang rnam par shes pa'i longs spyad bya dang / bya na des zas zhib par byed pa bzhin du/ 'du shes kyi tshor ba bde sdug gi tha snyad 'dogs par byed/ byan pos zas 'dren par byed pa bzhin du/ 'du shes kyis rnam par shes pa'i yul du tshor ba bde sdug skyed par byed/ za pa pos zas la longs spyod pa bzhin du/ rnam par shes pas kyang tshor ba bde sdug la longs spyod pa'i phyir/ yang na khams gsum gyi rim pas bstan te/ 'dod khams gzugs kyis phye ba dang / bsam gtan bzhi tshor bas phye/

gzugs med dang po gsum 'du shes kyis phye/ srid rtse 'du byed kyis phye zhing / rnam par shes pa thams cad khyab byed du yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs kyi phung po lnga dang por bstan nas/ yid kyi dbang po phyis 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dbang po rang yul da ltar ba kho na la 'jug yid dbang dus gsum ka la 'jug pa'i don can yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs can gyi dbang po lnga'i nang nas lus dbang phyis 'chad pa la dgos pa yod de/ dbang po dang po bzhi 'byung 'gyur kho na'i yul can dang / lus dbang 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur gnyis ka'i yul can yin pa'i phyir/ mig dbang rna dbang gnyis kyis nang nas mig dbang dang por 'chad pa la dgos pa yod de/ mig dbang de ches ring ba'i yul la 'jug pa'i phyir/ sna dbang dang lce dbang gnyis kyis nang nas sna dbang dang por 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de yul la myur bar 'jug pa'i phyir/ yang na/ dbang rten lus la ji ltar gnas pa bzhin gyi rims pas bzhag go /gsum pa zhar byung ni/ gzugs can bcu char yang gzugs yin pa la/ mig gi yul kho na la gzugs kyi skye mched du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ spyi ming bye brag la btags pa'i don yin pa'i phyir dang / de gzugs kyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas 'dus ma byas thams cad kyang chos yin pa la yid kyi skye mched kho na'i yul la chos khams su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ yid kyi skye mched de'i 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi chos mang po dang / chos kyi mchog mya ngan las 'das pa yang yul du bsdus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa chos gzhan gyi bsdu tshul la/ chos phung gis bsdu tshul dang / khams dang skye mched gzhan gyi bsdu tshul gnyis/ dang po la dngos dang / zhar byung gnyis/ dang po ni/ thub pa'i dbang pos/ chos kyis phung po brgyad khri gsungs pa yin te/

'dod chags la spyod pa'i gnyen por nyi khri/ zhe sdang / gti mug dug gsum cha snyoms pa gsum re re la spyod pa'i gnyen por nyi khri nyi khri gsungs pa'i phyir/ thub pas dbang pos gsungs pa'i chos phung brgyad khri po 'di chos can/ mdo sde pa ltar na gzugs kyi phung po'i nang du 'dus te/ brjod byed kyi tshig yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ bye brag tu smra ba ltar na/ 'du byed kyi phung por 'dus te/ ming mtshan ldan min 'du byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ zhar byung ni chos phung gi tshad gang la byed ce na/ kha cig na re/ shā ri'i bus nye ba bsdus pa'i bstan bcos chos kyis phung po'i tshad dang mnyam pa de la shlau ka drug stong yod/ de chos phung gi tshad yin zhes zer/ kha cig ni/ phung po khams/ skye mched la sogs pa don mtshan re re rdzogs par ston pa'i gtam tshogs la 'dod/ slob dpon rang gis bzhed pa la/ 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa sna re 'dul ba'i gnyen po rdzogs par ston pa'i gtam gyi tshogs la chos phung du bzhed de/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri la spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri grangs mthun par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa khams dang skye mched gzhan gyis bsdu tshul la/ dngos dang dogs dpyod gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos phung chos gsum gyis bsdus pa de bzhin du/ mdo sde gzhan nas bshad pa'i phung po/ skye mched/ khams rnams ni rang rang gi mtshan nyid la legs par dpyad de/ 'dir ji skad bshad pa'i chos gsum du bsdu bar bya ste/ der ma 'dus pa'i chos med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dogs dpyod ni/ tshul khrims kyi phung po/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi/ rnam par grol ba'i/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po rnams 'dir bshad pa'i chos gsum du ji ltar bsdu zhe na/ dang po ni gzugs kyi phung pos bsdus/ phyi ma la sems dang sems byung gnyis su yod cing /

dang po ni/ rnam shes kyi phung pos bsdus/ phyi ma la yang tshor ba/ 'du shes/ de las gzhan pa'i sems byung dang gsum yod/ dang po tshor ba'i phung pos bsdus/ gnyis pa 'du shes kyi phung pos bsdus/ gsum pa 'du byed kyi phung pos bsdus so/ /zad par gyi skye mched dang / zil gnon gyi skye mched ji ltar bsdu zhe na de la sems sems byung gi cha gnyis su yod cing / dang po ni yid kyi skye mched kyis bsdus/ gnyis pa chos kyi skye mched kyis bsdus/ 'byung ba bzhi'i khams/ rnam shes kyi khams/ nam mkha'i khams drug po 'dir ji ltar bsdus snyam na/ 'byung ba bzhi'i khams ni/ reg bya'i khams kyis bsdus te/ reg bya'i skye mched yin pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' ni/ bu ga nam mkha'i khams la bya ste/ nyin par snang ba dang / mtshan mo mun par snang ba'i phyir/ zag bcas kyi rnam shes ni khams drug gi bzlas phye ba'i/ rnam shes kyi khams la bya ste/ khams drug gi bzlas phye ba'i rnam shes ni/ zag bcas dang / yang srid du skye ba'i rten byed la/ zag bcas kyi rnam shes kyis yang srid du skye ba'i rkyen byed kyi/ zag med kyi rnam shes kyis de ltar mi byed pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ mdo las/ khams drug la brten nas ma'i mngal du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar du 'jug snyam na/ rnam shes ni ma'i mngal du 'jug par byed/ 'byung ba bzhis ni gnas par byed/ nam mkha'i rgyas pa'i grogs byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye la/ gnyis tshan gyi sgo nas dbye/ gsum tshan gyi sgo nas/ bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas/ gzugs sogs kyi sgo nas/ byung sogs kyi sgo nas/ lta sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang drug dang po ni gzugs kyi skye mched gcig pu chos can/ bstan yod yin te/ mig gi yul du bstan du yod pa'i gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs can bcu char yang thogs pa dang bcas pa yin te/

'ga' zhig ni rang yod pa'i sar gzugs gzhan 'byung ba la thogs/ 'ga' zhig ni rang yul re 'dzin pa la thogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po'i dpe ni/ gzugs kyi skye mched gnyis pa'i dpe ni/ nyi ma dang snang ba lta bu'o/ 'dir yul la thogs pa/ dmigs pa la thogs pa/ sgrib pa la thogs pa dang gsum yod/ yul can rnams ni yul la thogs/ sems sems 'byung rnams ni dmigs pa la thogs/ 'di gnyis la khyad par ci yod snyam na khyad par yod te/ mu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de yang mig dbang lta bu ni/ dang po yin gyis gnyis pa min/ zla ba gcig snang gi dbang shes lta bu ni/ gnyis pa yin gyi dang po min/ mig gi rnam par shes pa ni gnyis ka yin pa'i mu yin/ yul la thogs na yul de yod dgos/ dmigs pa la thogs na dmigs pa yod pa'i ma khyab bo/ /dang po la/ mu bzhi yod te/ skam sar thogs la blon sar mi thogs pa'i mu/ rlon sar thogs la skam sar mi thogs pa'i mu/ gnyis kar du thogs pa'i mu/ gnyis kar du mi thogs pa'i mu dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mi'i mig tu/ gnyis pa ni nya'i mig tu/ gsum pa ni sram gyi mig du/ bzhi pa go sla/ gsum pa sgrib pa la thogs pa ni/ mig dbang lta bu/ 'o na mig dbang gi rdul dang lus dbang gi rdul dang ji ltar gnas pa yin zhe na/ gnyis ka yang shin tu dwangs ba'i gzugs can yin pas/ gcig yod pa'i sar gcig shos 'byung ba la mi thogs pa'i tshul du gnas/ dper na sgron me'i 'od yod pa'i sar/ nyi ma'i 'od 'byung ba la thogs pa med pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa gsum tshan gyis sgo nas dbye ba la/ dge sogs gsum du dbye ba dang / khams gsum gyis sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sgra ma gtogs pa'i gzugs can brgyad mtha' gcig tu lung ma bstan yin/ gzugs sgra gnyis rnam par shes pa'i khams bdun/ chos khams dang bcu po 'di dag la gsum ka yod de/ gzugs la sdom pa ni/ dge ba'i gzugs/

ltung ba ni mi dge ba'i gzugs/ sgra la brdzun phra ma sogs ni mi dge ba'i sgra/ de'i log phyogs bden par smra ba sogs ni dge ba'i sgra yin/ gzhan rnams rtogs sla/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i sar gtogs pa la khams bco brgyad ka yod/ gzugs kyi sar gtogs pa la bcu bzhi yod/ dri ro sna'i rnam par shes pa/ lce'i rnam par shes pa bzhi ni gzugs kyi rnam par ma gtogs so/ gzugs med kyi sar gtogs pa yid chos yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams gsum ka yin/ gsum pa la zag pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas dbye/ rtog pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas/ dmigs pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni khams tha ma de gsum la zag bcas dang zag med kyi cha gnyis ka yod/ lhag ma bco lnga ni zag bcas yin/ gnyis pa rtog pa dang bcas ma bcas la/ dngos dang / rtsod spong gnyis las/ dang po ni sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa lnga po rgyun gyi dbang du byas na rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa yin de/ de'i dbang du byas na/ gzhan 'gyur gyi nang mtshan rtog dpyod gnyis ka yang / sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi 'khor du byung ba'i phyir/ khams tha ma gsum la rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa/ rtog pa med cing dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ de gnyis ka spangs pa dang gsum yod de/ 'dod pa dang / bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po ba'i/ khams tha ma gsum ni dang po yin no/ /bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi khyad par can gyi khams tha ma gsum ni gnyis pa yin/ bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad kyi khams tha ma gsum dang / khams lhag ma bco lnga ni gnyis ka spangs pa yin/ gnyis pa rtsod spong ni/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes rtog bcas yin par mi 'thad de/ rtog bral du gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med te/ 'di'i rtog bcas ni gzhan 'gyur gyi nang tshan gyi rtog bcas yin la/ mdo las/ rtog bral du gsungs pa ni/ nges par rtog pa dang / rjes dran gyi rtog pa dang bral ba la dgongs pa'i phyir/

de gnyis ji lta bu yin zhe na/ dang po ni grogs yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa/ g.yeng ba rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su 'byung ba/ ngo bo rang yul don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i shes rab la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa/ mnyam rjes gnyis char du 'byung ba/ ngo bo dran shes la 'jog gsum pa ni/ sems kyi khams bdun dmigs pa dang bcas pa yin te/ rang gi dmigs pa la dmigs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ chos khams kyi phyed sems byung yang dmigs bcas yin te/ de'i phyir/ bzhi pa gzugs sogs kyi dbye ba la/ zin ma zin gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ bsags ma bsags kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ gcad bya gcod byed kyi sgo nas dbye ba bzhi/ dang po ni gzugs can nang phan tshun 'phrad pa'i phan gnod las/ tshor ba bde sdug skyed par nus pa la zin pa dang de mi nus pa la ma zin pa zhes 'jog rnam par shes pa'i khams bdun sems byung dang brgyad po de dag rnams dang / sgra dang dgu la ma zin pa zhes bya ste/ gzugs can nang phan tshun 'phrad pa'i phan gnod las/ tshor ba bde sdug skyed par mi nus pa'i phyir/ gzugs can gzhan dgu la zin ma zin gnyis ka'i cha yod/ gnyis pa ni/ reg bya la 'byung ba 'byung 'gyur gnyis ka yod/ lhag ma gzugs can dgu dang / chos khams kyi phyogs gcig rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs ni/ 'byung 'gyur kho na yin/ gsum pa bsags ma bsags kyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ gzugs can bcu chos can/ bsags pa yin te/ bem po yin pa'i phyir lhag ma brgyad ni ma bsags pa zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gcod byed sta gri lta bu dang / gcad bya shing lta bu ni/ phyi rol gyi khams sgra ma gtogs pa bzhi la 'jog de bzhin du bsreg bya bud shing lta bu dang / 'jal byed srang lta bu yang de bzhi'i steng nas 'jog

sreg byed dang gzhal bya gnyis la mi mthun pa smra ba yod de/ sreg byed reg bya kho na'i steng nas 'jog gzhal bya mar lta bu yang / reg bya lci ba lta bu'i steng nas 'jog kha cig phyi rol gyi khams bzhi'i steng nas 'jog lnga pa byung sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ byung ma byung gis sgo nas dbye ba/ phyi nang gis sgo nas dbye ba/ rten bcas de mtshungs kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ spang bya yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi/ dang po la/ byung ba spyir bstan/ ma byung ba dmigs bsal/ dbang po dang rnam shes kyi sa mtshungs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ spyir 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu ste/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i rgyu/ rgyas byung gi rgyu/ rgyu mthun gyi rgyu dang gsum/ dang po la rnam smin gyi rgyu/ de yi ngo bo/ /de'i 'bras bu dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mi dge ba dang / dge ba zag bcas la byed/ gnyis pa de gnyis kyis tshor ba bde sdug skyed pa'i nus pa la byed/ gsum pa ni/ tshor ba bde sdug go /gnyis pa ni khams zas/ gnyid/ legs spyad/ ting nge 'dzin/ tshangs spyod dang lnga la byed/ gsum pa rgyu mthun ni/ rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma la byed/ gzhung dang sbyar ba ni/ nang gi dbang po lnga rnam par smin pa las byung ba yin te/ ngan 'gro'i dbang po lnga ni/ mi dge ba dang / bde 'gro'i dbang po lnga ni/ dge ba zag bcas las byung ba'i phyir/ dbang po lnga ni rgyas pa las byung te/ khams zas gnyid legs spyad sogs kyis nang gi dbang po rgyas par byas/ des dbang rten khog pa rgyas par byed pa'i phyir/ sgra ni rnam smin las skyes pa min te 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur du yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na tshangs pa'i dbyangs de tshig rtsub spangs pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs ni byung ba gsum ldan yin pas/ 'dir rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ma bshad pa'i phyir/

byung ba gsum ldan yin te/ tshig rtsub pa'i mi mthun phyogs snyan par smras pa las/ mgrin pa'i gnas su 'byung ba khyad par can gcig byung / de las tshangs dbyangs 'byung ba'i phyir/ /sgra de rgyu mthun las byung ste/ rang gis rigs 'dra las snga ma'i lam las ma byung yang / 'byung ba skad cig ma las byung ba'i phyir/ thogs med rnam shes bdun sems byung dang brgyad ni rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yin te/ mi dge ba dang dge ba zag bcas ci rigs pa las byung ba'i phyir/ gzugs dri ro reg bya bzhi ni rgyu gsum ka las byung ste/ gong gi sgrub byed de rnams kyis phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtag pa'i rdzas 'dus ma byas gsum ni/ rgyu gsum ka las ma byung te/ gong gi sgrub byed de rnams las log pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal chos bzod skad cig ma dang po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i khams tha ma gsum ni/ rgyu mthun las byung ba ma yin te/ zag med kyi khams sngon song ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ mig dbang dang mig gi rnam par shes pa ni/ thob tshul ji ltar du thob pa yin zhe na/ de gnyis so so ba dang lhan cig tu yang thob pa yod de/ /de gnyis kyi thob tshul la mu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de yod de mig dbang gsar du thob la rnam shes gsar du ma thob pa'i mu/ rnam shes gsar du thob la mig dbang gsar du ma thob pa'i mu/ de gnyis ka gsar du thob pa'i mu/ gnyis ka gsar du ma thob pa'i mu dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med khams nas bsam gtan bzhi par skye ba'i tshe mu dang po yin te/ /gzugs med khams na gnyis ka med/ bsam gtan bzhi'i sa bsdus kyi mig yod kyang mig shes med pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi pa nas bsam gtan dang por skyes pa'i tshe mu gnyis pa yin te/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sa bsdus kyi mig yod kyang mig shes med la/ dang po'i sa bsdus kyi de gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med nas bsam gtan dang por skyes pa'i tshe/

mu gsum pa yin te/ gzugs med kyi sa bsdus kyi mig dang mig shes gnyis ka med/ dang po'i sa bsdus kyis de gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang po nas gzugs med du skyes pa'i tshe/ mu bzhi yin te/ gong gi sgrub byed de'i phyir/ gnyis pa phyi nang gi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ nang gi dbang po bcu gnyis sems byung dang bcas pa ni nang du gtogs la/ gzugs sogs lhag ma rnams ni der ma gtogs pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni khams gang zhig rang gi las byed pa la rten bcas dang / mi byed pa'i der mtshungs yin/ de yang dbang po drug ni/ rang 'bras rnam shes kyi bdag rkyen byed pa la rten bcas dang / de mi byed pa la de mtshungs/ yul drug ni/ rang 'bras rnams kyi dmigs pa byed pa rten bcas dang / de mi byed pa la de mtshungs/ rnam shes drug ni yul la dmigs ma dmigs la rten bcas dang de mtshungs su 'jog go /de gzhung dang sbyar ba ni/ chos khams ni/ mtha' gcig tu rten bcas yin te/ /rang 'bras rnam shes kyi yul du mi 'gyur mi srid pa'i phyir/ lhag ma rnams la rten bcas dang de mtshungs gnyis gnyis yod/ dbang po lnga ni rtogs sla/ da ltar kyi yul lnga ni/ rten bcas dang skye rung mi skye ba'i chos can/ ma 'ongs pa'i yul lnga ni/ de mtshungs yin/ des sgo lnga'i rnam shes la'ang rigs 'gre/ bzhi pa spang bya yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ gzugs can bcu chos can/ sgom spang yin te/ spang bya gang zhig mthong spang ma yin pa'i phyir/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes yang sgom spang yin te de'i phyir/ khams tha ma gsum la/ sgom spang yin pa/ mthong spang yin pa/ de gnyis ka ma yin pa'i cha gsum yod/ kha cig so so skye bo mthong spang yin te/ mthong lam skyes stobs kyis ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ de chos can/ /mthong spang ma yin te/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs can bcu chos can/ mthong spangs ma yin te/

gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa yid shes ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa las skyes pa'i sgo lnga'i rnam shes chos can/ de ma yin te/ yul bden pa la phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs byed min pa'i phyir/ drug pa lta ba sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ lta ba yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rnam shes kyi yul du gyur tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rtag mi rtag gi sgo nas dbye ba/ dbang po yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ lta ba'i dbye ba spyir bstan/ mig lta bar sgrub/ zhar byung gi don gzhan bshad pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni mig dang chos khams kyi phyogs gcig nyon mongs can kyi lta ba lnga dang / yan lag gi lta ba gsum ste/ brgyad ni lta ba yin/ de yang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du byung ba'i shes rab kyi steng nas 'jog gi sgo lnga'i rnam shes dang / mtshungs par skyes pa'i blo shes rab ni/ lta ba ma yin te/ nyon mongs can kyi lta ba yang min/ yan lag gi lta ba yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po min te/ yul bden pa la phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs pa min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang min te/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa'i sgo nas rang yul nges pa'i blo ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mig lta ba yin te/ gzugs mthong byed yin pa'i phyir/ de'ang rten bcas dang de mtshungs gnyis kyi nang nas rten bcas kho na mthong ba yin te/ mig gis gzugs mthong ba'i grogs su rnam shes nges par dgos pa'i phyir/ de la brten pa'i rnam shes kho nas mthong ba ni ma yin te/ de mthong na bar du chod pa'i gzugs rnams kyang mthong dgos pa las de mthong ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ de'ang mig gnyis kas mthong ba yin te/ gcig gi mthong ba la gnyis kas mthong ba gsal bar mthong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dbang po'i yul 'dzin tshul/ dbang po rten du 'gyur tshul/ sa gang rtogs tshul dang gsum/

dang po ni/ dbang po rnams kyis yul phrad nas 'dzin nam/ ma phrad par 'dzin/ tshad mnyam pa 'dzin nam/ mi mnyam pa 'dzin zhe na/ mig dang / yid dang / rna ba gsum po des yul dang ma phrad par 'dzin te/ mig gis thag ring po'i gzugs mthong / rna ba'i thag ring po'i sgra thos/ yid kyis dus gsum gis gzugs yul du byed pa'i phyir/ sna sogs gsum gyis yul dang phrad nas 'dzin cing / rang dang mnyam pa'i yul 'dzin par 'dod de/ lce dbang gis rang gi rdul dang mnyam pa'i ro'i rdul 'dzin pa yin gyis/ de las che ba mi 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ tha ma yid kyi rnam par shes pa rang dus na 'das pa'i bdag rkyen dbang po kho na la rten gyi rang dang mnyam pa'i rnam par shes pa la mi rten/ rnam shes snga ma lnga ni/ rang dus na 'das pa dang / rang dang lhan cig pa'i bdag rkyen la skyes pa yin no/ /mig shes de bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa las kyang skyes par mtshungs pa las/ bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbang shes/ zhes brjod/ dmigs rkyen kyi sgo nas yul shes zhes mi brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ dang po bdag rkyen du sgrub pa ni/ mig dbang gzugs can pa de/ mig shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yin te/ de dag gzhan dang gzhan du gyur pa'i stobs kyis/ mig shes kyang de dang der 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzugs de mig shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yul ma yin te/ gong gi sgrub byed las log pa'i phyir/ des na bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbang shes zhes brjod yul kyi sgo nas yul shes zhes ma brjod/ dbang po gzugs can pa dbang shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dang / gzugs de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni dbang rten khog pa/ de la brten pa'i dbang po/ de la brten pa'i rnam shes/ yul dang bzhi las/ dbang rten lnga dang / dbang po lnga ni/ sa lnga pa can yin te/

'dod pa dang bsam gtan sa bzhi te lngar gtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ mig gi rnam par shes pa/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa/ lus kyi rnam shes gsum ni/ sa gnyis pa can yin te/ 'dod pa dang / bsam gtan dang por gtogs pa yod kyis/ gnyis pa yan chad du gtogs pa med pa'i phyir/ sna'i rnam shes/ lce'i rnam shes/ dri ro bzhi ni sa bzhi pa can yin te/ 'dod khams kho na'i sar gtogs pa'i phyir/ yul gzugs sgra gnyis/ reg bya gsum ni bsam gtan sa bzhi 'dod pa dang lngar gtogs pa yod do/ /rten tshul ji lta bu yin zhe na/ de gzhung dang sbyar ba ni/ gong ma'i lus la 'og ma'i mig rten pa min te/ gong ma'i lus la 'og ma'i mig las mchog du gyur pa'i rang sa'i mig rten pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i shugs las/ 'og ma'i lus la gong ma'i mig brten pa yod te/ bsam gtan dang po'i rten can gyi bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi bsgrubs nas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i mig dbang mngon du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ sa 'og ma'i mig gis sa gong ma'i gzugs mthong ba min te/ 'og ma'i mig dman gong ma'i gzugs mchog yin pa'i phyir/ de'i shugs las/ sa gong ma'i mig gis sa 'og ma'i gzugs mthong ba yod te/ bsam gtan dang po'i rten la bsam gtan bzhi pa'i mig dbang mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ de'i mig gis bsam gtan dang po'i gzugs mthong ba yin pa'i phyir/ sa 'og ma'i mig gis gong ma'i rnam shes kyi rten mi byed/ 'og ma'i mig dman gong ma'i rnam shes mchog yin pa'i phyir/ de'i shugs las/ gong ma'i mig gis 'og ma'i rnam shes kyi rten byed pa yod te/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i mig dbang gis bsam tan dang po'i sas bsdus kyi mig shes kyi rten byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i yul du gyur pa'i yul 'og sa rang sa/ gong sa gsum kar du rtogs pa yod ste/ bsam gtan dang po'i rten can gyi bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi bsgrubs nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sas bsdus kyi mig dbang thob pa'i tshe/

mig dbang de la brten pa'i rnam shes kyis rang sa bsam gtan dang po/ 'og sa 'dod pa/ gong sa bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sas bsdus kyi gzugs gsum ka mthong ba yod pa'i phyir/ dper na rgyal po stobs ldan la brten pa'i mi phal pas kyang bya ba rgya chen po 'grub pa bzhin no/ /lus kyi mig shes kyi rten dang mig shes kyis gzugs mthong ba'i rten gnyis ka rang sa/ 'og sa gong sa gsum gyi rten byed pa yod de/ rna ba yang de bzhin du sbyor ro/ /lce'i rnam shes/ sna'i rnam shes/ lus kyi rnam shes gsum spyir bstan du rang gi yul gsum dang sa mtshungs pa kho na yin/ dmigs bsal du lus kyi rnam shes 'og sar gtogs pa yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rten can gyis lus kyi rnam shes bsam gtan dang po'i sar gtogs/ de'i yul reg bya dang por gtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ yid kyi rnam shes rang gi yul dang sa mtshungs par ma nges te/ des sa gong 'og thams cad kyi gzugs sogs yul du byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ phyi'i skye mched lnga/ rnam shes gnyis gnyis kyi yul du gyur te/ gzugs de mig shes dang yid kyi rnam shes gnyis ka'i yul du 'gyur cing / de gzhan bzhi la'ang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'dus ma byas mtha' dag rtag pa yin zhing / de las gzhan rnams mi rtag pa'o/ /bzhi pa dbang po yin min gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ chos khams kyis phyed tshor ba bde sogs lnga dang / 'du byed la dad pa'i dbang po sogs lnga te bcu dang / nang gi dbang po bcu gnyis ni dbang po yin la/ de las gzhan pa rnams ni dbang por ma bshad do/ /khams bstan pa'i gnas bshad zin to/ /gong du bcu gnyis nang gir ces sogs su/ nang gi bcu gnyis la sogs pa dbang por bshad pa dang / 'dus byas chos rnams de dag kyang zhes sogs su/ 'dus byas thams cad phung po lngar 'dus par bshad pa la/ 'o na dbang po'i ngo bo ji lta bu/ dbye na du yod/

'dus byas chos kyi skye tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ de dag 'chad par byed pa la dbang po bstan pa'i mdzod 'di byung / de la dbang po'i rang bzhin gtan la phab pa dang 'dus byas chos kyi skye tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ dbang por 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dbang po'i grangs nges/ skabs su bab pa'i dbang po'i ngo bo/ /dbang po'i rab dbye dang bzhi las/ dang po la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs/ mdo sde pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ mig dbang sogs lnga ni/ don bzhi bzhi la dbang byed de/ lus srung ba/ lus mdzes pa/ yul la dmigs pa/ rang 'bras rnam shes skyed pa dang bzhi la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub pa ni/ mig dbang gis gnod byed kyi dgra bo mthong ba'i dang / sna dbang gis gnod byed kyi sgra thos pa'i sgo nas lus srung bar byed/ phyi ma gsum gyis khams zas la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas lus rgyas par byed pa ste/ srung bar byed pa'i phyir/ pho dbang / mo dbang / srog dbang / yid dbang / bzhi ni don gnyis gnyis la dbang byed de/ dang pos rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag pho nyid du mtshon pa dang / skad gzengs mtho ba sogs pho'i rang bzhin la dbang byed/ gnyis pas rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag mo nyid mtshon pa dang / nga ro zhan pa sogs mo'i rang bzhin la dbang byed/ gsum pas phung po'i rigs 'dra snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba dang / byung ba gnas pa'i rten byed/ bzhi pas snga ma nas 'dir nying mtshams sbyor ba dang 'di nas phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor ba sogs/ lus ngag gis las yid dang mthun pa la 'jug pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba'i dbang po lnga dang / rnam byang gi dbang po brgyad po rnams ni/ kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang la dbang byed de/ tshor ba'i phung po lnga'i dang po la dbang byed/ rnam byang gi dbang pos rnam byang la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni mig sogs dbang po drug la/ dbang po zhes bya te/

dang po lnga'i rang rang gi don gzugs sogs la dbang byed/ yid dbang gis chos thams cad la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ pho mo'i dbang po gnyis kyis pho'i rang bzhin la dbang byed pa dang / mo'i rang bzhin la dbang byed pas na/ de gnyis la dbang po'i sgra bshad du yod/ de gnyis po de lus dbang yin te/ rang 'bras lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi rdul dwangs ba yin pa'i phyir/ srog dbang la dbang po'i sgra bshad du yod te/ phung po'i rigs 'dra gnas pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba'i dbang po la dbang po'i sgra bshad du yod te/ kun nas nyon mongs rgyas pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba bde ba la brten nas 'dod chags/ sdug bsngal la brten nas zhe sdang / btang snyoms la brten nas gti mug 'byung ba'i phyir/ dad sogs dbang po lnga la/ dbang po'i sgra bshad du yod de/ rnam byang gi chos gong 'phel du 'gyur ba la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po/ kun shes pa'i dbang po/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po gsum la dbang po'i sgra bshad du yod te/ de gsum gyis lhag med myang 'das sogs gong nas gong du thob pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grangs nges la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs dang / mdo sde pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbang bskur bya ji snyed pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dbang po'i grangs dag kyang de snyed du bstan te/ sems rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug gi rten byed pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dbang po drug bzhag sems can re re'i bye brag pho dang mo la dbang byed pa'i dbang du byas nas pho mo'i dbang po gnyis bzhag kun nas nyon mongs pa la dbang byed pa'i dbang du byas nas tshor ba'i dbang po lnga bzhag rnam byang gi tshogs la dbang byed pa'i dbang du byas nas rnam byang gi dbang po brgyad bzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni gang zag gcig 'khor bar skye ba'i dbang du byas nas/

kun nas nyon mongs kyi dbang po bcu bzhi bshad de/ 'khor bar 'jug pa'i rten gyi dbang du byas nas mig sogs dbang po drug bzhag der skye ba'i dbang du byas nas pho mo'i dbang po gnyis bzhag der gnas pa'i dbang du byas nas srog dbang bzhag des tshor ba bde sdug nye bar spyod pa'i dbang du byas nas tshor ba'i dbang po lnga bzhag pa'i phyir/ zag med du 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dbang po phyi ma brgyad bzhag pa yin te/ der 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dad sogs dbang po lnga bzhag der skye ba'i dbang du byas nas/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po bzhag der gnas pa'i dbang du byas nas kun shes pa'i dbang po bzhag gnas na zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod pa'i dbang du byas nas/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po bzhag pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dbang po'i go don ni/ 'dir nang gi dbang po drug dang pho mo'i dbang po gnyis kyi mtshan nyid mi 'chad de gong du bshad zin pa'i phyir/ dad sogs dbang po lnga srog dbang 'dir mi 'chad de/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i phyir/ des na tshor ba'i dbang po lnga dang / dri med kyi dbang po gsum las dang po ni/ sim pa ma yin par rang stobs kyis gdung ba nyams su myong ba'i lus tshor la/ tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi dbang por 'jog sim pa nyams su myong ba'i lus tshor dang / bsam gtan gsum pa'i sems bde gang rung gis bsdus pa la/ bde ba'i dbang por 'jog bsam gtan gsum pa'i sems bde las gzhan pa'i sim par nyams su myong ba'i yid shes su gyur pa'i sems byung la yid bde bar 'jog sim pa min par rang stobs kyis gdung ba nyams su myong ba'i yid shes 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung la yid mi bde bar 'jog sim gdung bar ma tsam du nyams su myong ba'i sems byung la btang snyoms kyi ngo bor 'jog te/ de sim gdung gnyis ka'i mi rtog pa'i phyir/ de la dbang shes dang yid shes gnyis ka'i cha yod/

gnyis pa dri med kyi dbang po gsum ni/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam gsum ka'i dbang du byas nas bzhag te/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po ni/ mthong lam gyis bsdus/ kun shes pa'i dbang po ni/ sgom lam gyis bsdus/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po ni mi slob lam gyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ de re re la yang dbye na dgu dgu yod de/ dang po la mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs dbang po lnga dang / yid dbang / tshor ba bde ba/ yid bde/ btang snyoms dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre/ bzhi pa dbang po'i dbye ba la/ dbang po yin min gyi sgo nas/ dbang po rnyed gtong gi tshul/ dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu dbang po dus thob la dpyad/ dbang po'i ldan tshul la dpyad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po la/ gnyis tshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang / gsum tshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ zag pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas dbye/ rnam smin yin min gyi sgo nas dbye/ rnam smin dang bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i dri med kyi dbang po gsum ni mtha' gcig tu zag med yin te/ 'phags lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dbang po yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs can gyi dbang po bdun dang / srog dang / tshor ba sdug bsngal/ yid mi bde ba dang bcu ni zag bcas yin/ dad sogs dbang po lnga/ tshor ba bde ba/ yid bde/ btang snyoms/ yid dbang dang dgu la/ zag bcas zag med gnyis ka yod/ gnyis pa ni/ srog ni rnam smin yin byas pa la/ kho na re/ dgra bcom pa 'ga' zhig gis tshe 'dor len la dbang thob pa ma yin par gyur ram zhe na/ 'di'i lan la/ tshe la rnam smin gyi khyab par 'dod pa'i lugs dang / ma khyab par 'dod pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni dgra bcom pa 'chi khar gyur pa na longs spyod rnams sbyin par btang nas/ 'di dag tshe yis mthud du gyur cig

ces brjod pa las/ snga ma'i tshe lhag rnams tshe 'di'i mthud du gyur pa dang / yang longs spyod rnams skye ba phyi ma'i tshe mthud du gyur cig ces brjod pa las tshe 'dor ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ma khyab pa'i lugs ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' thob pa'i dgra bcom pa 'ga' zhig gis 'byung ba byin gyis brlabs pas/ de dang dus mnyam du gyur pa'i srog kyang rgyas par byed/ 'di ni dbyangs sgrogs gi lugs so/ /gzugs kyi dbang po bdun/ yid dbang / tshor ba yid bde ba ma gtogs gzhan bzhi dang / bcu gnyis la rnam smin yin min gnyis ka yod/ tha ma rnam byang gi dbang po brgyad dang yid mi bde ni/ rnam smin du ma gtogs so/ /gsum pa ni bshad ma thag pa'i yid mi bde gcig pu ni/ rnam smin dang bcas pa yin/ yid dbang / tshor ba/ yid mi bde ma gtogs gzhan bzhi/ dad sogs dbang po lnga/ de bcu la rnam smin dang bcas ma bcas gnyis ka'i cha yod/ gnyis pa gsum tshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ dge sogs gsum gyi sgo nas/ khams gsum gyi sgo nas/ mthong spang sogs gsum gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni rnam byang dbang po brgyad ni/ mtha' gcig tu dge ba yin/ yid mi bde la dge mi dge gnyis ka'i cha yod/ yid dbang / tshor ba/ yid mi bde ma gtogs pa gzhan bzhi ste lnga la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ka'i cha yod/ gzugs can gyi dbang po bdun dang srog dbang dang brgyad ni mtha' gcig tu lung ma bstan yin/ gnyis pa ni/ dri med kyi dbang po gsum ma gtogs pa 'dod pa'i sar gtogs pa yod/ de'i steng nas pho mo'i dbang po tshor ba sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde bzhi ste bdun ma gtogs pa'i bco lnga la gzugs kyi sar gtogs pa yod/ de'i steng nas gzugs can rnams dang / bde ba'ang ma gtogs pa'i lhag ma brgyad/ gzugs med kyi sar gtogs pa yod/ gsum pa ni/ yid dbang / tshor ba bde ba/

yid bde/ btang snyoms rnams la mthong spang sgom spang de gnyis ka ma yin pa'i cha gsum yod/ yid mi bde la mthong spang dang sgom spang gnyis ka'i cha yod/ gzugs kyi dbang po bdun/ srog tshor ba sdug bsngal te/ dgu ni sgom spang yin/ lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs lnga ni/ spang par bya ba ma yin yang / lam gyi ngo bor ma gyur pa'i de lnga la sgoms spangs kyi cha gnyis yod/ yid kyi dbang po tha ma gsum ste/ 'di nas yig phreng phyed chad pas bya thabs bral/ dbang du byas pa dang / khams gong gis dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mngal skyes kyis dbang du byas pa dang / rdzus skyes kyis dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod par srog yid btang snyoms lus dbang dang bzhi/ dang por cig char du rnyed kyang / rnam smin skyes kyis dbang du byas nas/ srog dbang lus dbang cig char du rnyed/ gnyis pa ni/ rdzus skyes kyis dbang du byas na/ de ltar nges pa min te/ rnam smin skyes la mtshan gtan med/ mtshan gang rung gcig dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka dang ldan pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ mig sogs dbang po lnga/ srog dbang dang drug cig char du rnyed/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas na/ gong gi drug dang / pho mo'i mtshan gang rung gcig dang bdun cig char du rnyed/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas na pho mo'i mtshan gnyis ka dang brgyad cig char du rnyed/ gnyis pa khams gong gis dbang du byas pa ni/ gzugs khams su rnam smin skyes kyis mig sogs dbang po lnga dang / srog dbang dang drug cig char du rnyed/ de'i gong ma gzugs med du rnam smin skyes srog gcig pur skye ba yin/ gnyis pa gtong ba'i tshul ni/ khams gong gi dbang du byas pa dang / 'dod pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs med du 'chi ba'i tshe/ srog yid btang snyoms gsum cig char du 'gag par 'gyur/ gzugs khams su mig sogs dbang po lnga dang gong gi gsum ste brgyad cig char du 'gag

gnyis pa la cig char ba'i dbang du byas pa dang / rim gyis pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan gnyis char dang ldan pa/ gang rung gcig dang ldan pa/ gtan med dang gsum las/ dang po'i dbang du byas na mig sogs dbang po lnga/ srog yid/ btang snyoms gsum/ pho dbang mo dbang gnyis te bcu cig char du 'gag gnyis pa'i dbang du byas na/ pho mo'i dbang po gang rung cig ma gtogs dgu cig char du 'gag gsum pa'i dbang du byas na pho mo'i dbang po gnyis ma gtogs pa brgyad cig char du 'gag gnyis pa ni/ rim kyi 'chi ba dag la/ srog yid btang snyoms gsum lus dbang dang bzhi cig char du 'gag de rnams ni lung ma bstan gyi 'chi ba'i dbang du byas la/ dge sems dang bcas te 'chi ba'i dbang du byas na/ de rnams kyi steng du dad sogs dbang po lnga gcig char du 'gag gsum pa dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu dbang po dus thob ni/ 'bras bu tha ma rgyun zhugs dang / dgra bcom pa'i dbang po 'bras bu dbang po dgu dgus thob ste/ lam rjes bzod kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs dbang po lnga/ mig dbang / btang snyoms/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po lam rjes shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i kun shes pa'i dbang po dgu'i rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob/ sgom lam skad cig tha ma'i ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs dbang po lnga/ yid dbang / tshor ba bde ba yid bde/ btang snyoms gsum gang rung gcig dang kun shes pa'i dbang po mi slob lam gyis ngo bor gyur pa'i kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po dang dgus dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob pa'i phyir/ rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong gnyis ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis thob pa'i tshe/ dbang po bdun gyis thob ste/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs dbang po lnga/ yid/ btang snyoms dang bdun la brten nas thob pa'i phyir/ de gnyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis thob pa'i tshe/

dbang po brgyad la brten nas thob ste/ sgom lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs dbang po lnga/ btang snyoms/ kun shes pa'i dbang po dang brgyad la brten nas thob pa'i phyir/ ཾrgyun zhugs thob byed kyi dbang po dgu la brten nas thob ཾste/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu yang dbang po dgus thob ste/ lam rjes bzod kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i kyang dad sogs dbang po lnga/ yid dbang / tshor ba bde ba/ yid bde ba/ btang snyoms dang gsum gang rung gcig dang / mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po/ lam rjes shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i kun shes pa'i dbang po dang dgus thob pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos rab tu byed pa las dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu dbang po bcu gcig gis thob par bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/ dbang po bcu gcig gis dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu 'ga' zhig gi thob pa srid pa la dgongs nas de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ ji ltar srid snyam na/ dang por tshor ba btang snyoms la brten nas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ de las nyams nas de nas bsam gtan dang po dang gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi sgrub pa nas/ tshor ba yid bde la brten nas de yi 'bras bu thob/ slar yang de las nyams nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi sgrubs te/ tshor ba bde ba la brten nas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob pa srid pa'i phyir/ slar de las nyams nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas sgrub pa med dam snyam na/ de 'dra srid kyang dbang po bcu gcig du ma 'dus pa'i skyon med de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa man chod tshor ba btang snyoms kyi sa pa yin pas/ gong gi btang snyoms las logs su bgrang du med pa'i phyir/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong la mtshungs snyam na/ mi mtshungs te/ de ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam kyi bstan par byas pas/ de'i 'bras bu la nyams pa mi srid pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa dbang po'i ldan tshul la/ nges ldan kyi dbang du byas pa dang / srid ldan kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po la phan tshun nges ldan kyi dbang du byas pa dang / dbang po de la dbang po gzhan nges ldan kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis las/ dang po ni btang snyoms/ srog yid gsum po de phan tshun nges ldan yin te/ gang rung gcig dang ldan na gzhan gnyis dang ldan pa'i khyab/ 'gog pa la mnyam par gzhag bzhin pa'i gang zag de btang snyoms dang yid gnyis dang ldan par thal/ srog dang ldan pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud la de gnyis yod par thal/ de la de ldan pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir la khyab te/ de gnyis kyis thob pa ldan pa la/ de gnyis dang ldan par 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bde ba dang ldan na dbang po bzhi dang ldan te/ de dang ldan na nges ldan gsum bde ba dang bzhi ldan pa'i khyab pa'i phyir/ lus dbang dang ldan pa la dbang po bzhi dang ldan te/ de la nges ldan gsum/ lus dbang dang bzhi ldan pa'i phyir/ mig dbang dang ldan pa la dbang po lnga dang ldan te/ de la nges ldan gsum/ lus dbang mig dbang lnga ldan pa'i phyir/ yid bde dang ldan pa la yang dbang po lnga ldan te/ de la nges ldan gsum/ lus dbang / yid bde lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal dang ldan pa la dbang po bdun dang ldan te/ de la nges ldan gsum/ lus dbang / tshor ba sdug bsngal/ bde ba/ yid bde dang bdun ldan pa'i phyir/ pho mo'i dbang po gang rung dang ldan na dbang po brgyad ldan te/ de ldan na gong gis bdun pho mo'i dbang po gang rung gcig dang brgyad ldan pa'i phyir/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po ldan pa la/ dbang po bcu gcig ldan te/ gdags gzhi dbang po dgu/ srog kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po dang / bcu gcig ldan pa'i phyir/ kun shes pa'i dbang po dang ldan pa la/ dbang po bcu gcig ldan te/ kun shes ldan dbang ma gtogs/ gong gi dbang po bcu dang / kun shes pa'i dbang po te bcu gcig ldan pa'i phyir/

mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po dang ldan pa la/ dbang po bcu gsum ldan te/ gdags gzhi dbang po dgu/ srog lus dbang tshor ba sdug bsngal kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po (ma dper rgyab mdun gnyis mi tshang /)byung rnams la skye tshul lnga yod te/ sems kyi sa mang po pa/ dge ba'i sa pa/ nyon mongs pa chen po'i sa pa/ mi dge ba'i sa pa/ nyon mongs pa chung ngu'i sa pa sogs tha dad pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la lnga las/ dang po ni/ tshor ba sogs bcu po 'di la sems kyi sa mang po pa zhes bya te/ yid sngon song gi gtso sems kun kyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dad pa la sogs pa bcu po 'di la/ dge ba'i sa pa zhes bya te/ dge ba'i gtso sems kun kyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rmongs sogs drug po la 'di nyon mongs chen po'i sa pa zhes bya te/ dbang shes yid shes mthong spang sgom spang su gyur pa'i nyon mongs can kyi gtso sems nyon mongs can kun kyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ khrel med dang / ngo tsha med pa gnyis la/ mi dge ba'i sa pa zhes bya te/ gtso sems mi dge ba kun kyis 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ khro ba sogs bcu la nyon mongs pa chung ngu'i sa pa zhes bya te/ yid shes dang sgom spangs kho na gyur pa'i nyon mongs gyi gtso sems kun kyi 'khor du 'gro bar nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa nges ldan ma yin pa ni/ 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal thams cad de bzhi dang / gzhan 'gyur bzhi te/ brgyad ni ma nges pa zhes bya te/ gong gi lnga po gang du yang ma nges pa'i phyir te/ gong gis de rnams las log pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ 'dod pa'i dbang du byas pa dang / khams gong gi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dge ba'i dbang du byas pa/ mi dge ba'i dbang du byas pa/ lung ma bstan gyi dbang du byas pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i gtso sems dge ba'i 'khor du sems byung nyer gnyis 'byung te/

sems kyi sa mang po pa bcu/ dge ba'i sa pa bcu/ rtog dpyod gnyis rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ma rig pa la/ ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa dang / 'dres pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs bzhi gang rung dang mi ldan pa'i ma rig pa la ma 'dres pa dang / de bzhi gang rung ldan pa'i ma rig pa la 'dres pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya/ des na ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa dang ldan pa'i gtso sems mi dge ba'i 'khor du sems byung nyi shu 'byung te/ sems kyi sa mang po pa bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa pa drug mi dge ba'i sa pa gnyis/ rtog dpyod gnyis rnams 'byung nges yin pa'i phyir/ lta ba dang ldan pa'i gtso sems mi dge ba'i 'khor du nyi shu 'byung te/ gong gis de rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'dir lta ba zur du smos mi dgos ste/ shes rab kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i phyir/ gong du ma rig pa zur du mi 'grang te/ rmongs pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i phyir/ gti mug med pa dge ba'i sa par mi 'grang te/ shes rab kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i phyir/ brjed ngas zur du mi 'grang te/ rang yul mi gsal ba'i dran pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i phyir/ rnam g.yeng zur du mi 'grang te/ ting nge 'dzin nyon mongs can yin pas ting nge 'dzin kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i phyir/ shes bzhin min pa yang zur du mi 'grang te/ shes rab kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod chags 'khor du ldan pa'i gtso sems mi dge ba'i 'khor du sems byung nyer gcig 'byung te/ gong gis nyi shu dang 'dod chags 'byung ba'i phyir/ des khong khro sogs gsum dang / khro ba sogs bcu dang / 'gyod pa rnams rigs 'dre/ gsum pa lung ma bstan kyi dbang du byas pa ni/ sgribs lung ma bstan kyi gtso sems kyis 'khor du bco brgyad 'byung te/ sems kyi sa mang po pa bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa pa drug rtog dpyod rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/

ma sgribs lung ma bstan du gyur pa'i gtso sems kyi 'khor du bcu gnyis 'byung te/ sems kyi sa mang po pa bcu/ rtog dpyod gnyis rnam 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyid ni gang la yod pa de la bsnan te/ de kun dang mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ la la dag du 'gyod pa bsnan/ zhes pa la/ gang la yod pa de la bsnan te/ 'gyod pa la yang dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ka yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa khams gong gi dbang du byas pa la/ spyod bya'i sems 'byung ngos bzung ba/ de ji ltar byung tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gyod pa/ gnyid mi dge ba rnams/ bsam gtan dang po dag la med/ de'i dngos gzhi khyad par can rtogs pa yang med/ gnyis pa ni/ dang po rtsam kyi dge sems la/ dang po'i dge ba'i sems la ni/ khyad par can kyi dge sems la/ gnyis pa yan kyi dge sems la/ zhes sogs su sgyur ro/ gsum pa sems byung 'ga' zhig gi khyad par la/ sems byung brgyad kyi khyad par/ sems byung gi ming gi rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po ni/ ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med pa la khyad par ci yod snyam na/ ngo tsha med pa ni/ yul khyad paracan la ma gus pa'i sems byung yin/ khrel med pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi kha na ma tho ba la 'jigs par mi lta ba'i sems byung yin/ bri ba gsal byed du sbyar du sbyar nas/ dga' ba la nyon mongs pa can kyi dga' ba dang / yang dag pa'i dga' ba gnyis/ dang po ni bu dang chung ma la chags pa'i sred pa la byed/ gnyis pa ni gang zag yon tan can la dang bas dad pa/ gus pa ni ngo tsha shes pa yin/ de gnyis 'dod pa dang gzugs su gtogs kyi gzugs med du ma gtogs te/ de gnyis yul gzhan la dmigs nas byung la/ gzugs med khams pa rnams phan tshun gcig gi gcig dmigs yul du mi rung ba'i phyir/ rtog pa ni/ sems rtsing ba'i rnam pa can yin/ nga rgyal ni rang stobs kyis sems khengs par byed pa'i sems byung rdzas yod/ rgyags pa ni/ rtags yod du gyur pa'i rang gis rigs dang chos la chags pas yongs su gtugs pa dga' ba'i rnam pa can yin/

gnyis pa ni/ sems dang / yid dang rnam shes gsum don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/ sems sems byung gi ming gi rnam grangs la rten bcas zhes bya ste/ bdag rkyen la rten pa yin pa'i phyir/ dmigs bcas zhes bya ste/ rang yul la dmigs pa'i phyir/ rnam bcas zhes bya ste/ rang yul kyi gtso bo 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed pa'i phyir/ mtshungs ldan zhes bya ste mtshungs ldan rnams pa lnga mtshungs pa'i phyir/ lnga mtshungs ni/ rten/ dmigs pa/ rnam pa/ dus/ rdzas mtshungs pa lnga'o/ /gzhan rnams sla la/ rnam pa mtshungs ldan ni/ mig gi rnam shes dang / de'i 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung gnyis ni/ rnam pa mtshungs te/ gzugs 'dzin stang kyis yul du byed par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ldan min 'du byed la/ dbye ba'i sgo nas mdor bstan/ so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ chos gzhan kyis khyad par bstan pa'i sgo nas bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ldan min 'du byed la bcu gcig ste/ rten thob pa/ ma thob pa/ skal mnyam/ 'du shes med pa/ de'i snyoms 'jug 'gog snyoms/ srog skye ba/ rga ba/ gnas pa/ mi rtag pa/ ming gi tshogs/ tshig yi ge'i tshogs pa sogs bcu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la thob sogs gsum bshad/ 'du shes med pa sogs gsum bshad/ srog sogs lnga bshad/ ming sogs bzhi bshad pa dang / dang po la/ thob ma thob bshad pa dang / skal mnyam bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ thob ma thob kyi ngo bo dang / khyad chos gnyis/ dang po ni/ thob bya'i chos de rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag gi rgyud la ldan par byed pa'i rdzas gcig la thob par 'jog de la dbye na/ rnyed thob dang / ldan thob gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor lam ba'i rgyud la mthong lam gsar du ldan par byed pa'i rdzas gcig la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ so so skye bo'i rgyud la nyon mongs rgyun du ldan par byed pa'i rdzas la byed/ ma thob pa ni/ thob bya'i chos de nyid rten kyi gang zag de'i rgyud la ldan pa la gegs byed pa'i rdzas gcig la 'jog

de la gnyis ste/ snyed pas ma thob pa dang / ldan pas ma thob pa'o/ dang po ni/ sbyor lam pa'i rgyud la mthong lam ldan pa la gegs byed pa'i rdzas gcig la 'jog thob ma thob de yang / rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i 'dus byas la 'jog gi rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i 'dus ma byas la mi 'jog de yang rgyud du gtogs pa gcig dgos so zhes spyir bstan nas dmigs bsal ni/ rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i 'dus byas ma yin yang / 'gog pa gnyis kyis thob pa yod/ gnyis pa khyad chos la/ thob pa'i khyad chos dang / ma thob pa'i khyad chos gnyis/ dang po la spyir bstan dang / dmigs bsal gnyis/ dang po ni/ thob bya'i chos la dus gsum ka yod/ de'i dpe ni/ kha sang gi dge slong gi sdom pa de ring gi sdom pa la ltos te/ 'das pa'i chos de ma thob pa dus gsum ka yod/ de'i mtshan gzhi ni/ kho rang gi snga rol du kho'i rigs 'dra snga ma las/ phyi ma ldan par byed pa'i rdzas gcig la/ de'i thob pa sngar skyes su 'jog thob bya'i chos de'i phyir nas kho rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma las/ phyi ma ldan par byed pa'i rdzas gcig la de'i thob pa phyi skyes su 'jog kho rang gi dus su kho rang gang la ldan pa'i rten kyi gang zag gi rgyud la ldan pa'i rdzas gcig la/ kho'i thob pa da ltar bar 'jog thob bya'i chos la/ da ltar ba dang / ma 'ongs pa gnyis la kho'i thob pa dus gsum gsum yod pa de snga ma la dpag ste shes par bya/ dge ba'i thob pa yin na dge ba dang / mi dge ba'i thob pa yin na mi dge ba yin pas khyab byas pa la/ lam bden kyis thob pa la lam bden yin pas khyab par thal/ khas blangs pa de'i phyir/ zhe na 'dod de/ lam bden yin na shes pa yin pas ma khyab par gong du bshad zin pa'i phyir/ thos bya'i chos de 'dod pa'i bsdus na de'i thob pa yang 'dod pa'i bsdus/ yang de gzugs kyi sas bsdus na/ de'i thob pa gzugs kyis sas bsdus/ de gzugs med kyi sas bsdus na/
