/mtha' skor dgu 'bum drug khri'o/ /gnya' shing 'dzin gyi ngos gcig la/ /dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri yod/ /mtha' skor du ni sa ya gcig /nyis 'bum brgyad khri yod pa yin/ /rol mtsho gnyis pa'i ngos gcig la/ /bzhi 'bum yod cing khor yug tu/ /sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum yod/ /gshol mda' 'dzin gyi ngos gcig la/ /bzhi 'bum bzhi khri mtha' skor du/ /sa ya gcig dang bdun 'bum dang / /drug khri dag ni yod pa yin/ /rol mtsho gsum pa'i ngos gcig la/ /bzhi 'bum brgyad khri mtha' skor du/ /sa ya gcig dang dgu 'bum dang / /nyi khri dag ni yod pa yin/ /seng ldeng can gyi ri yis ni/ /ngos gcig la ni lnga 'bum yod/ /mtha' skor du ni sa ya gcig /rol mtsho bzhi pa'i ngos gcig la/ /lnga 'bum nyi khri mtha' skor du/ /sa ya gnyis dang brgyad khri yod/ /blta na sdug gi ngos gcig la/ /lnga 'bum lnga khri mtha' skor du/ /sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum dang / nyi khri dag ni yod pa yin/ /rol mtsho lnga pa'i ngos gcig la/ /lnga 'bum bzhi khri mtha' skor du/ /sa ya gnyis dang gcig 'bum dang / /drug khri dag ni yod pa yin/ /rta rna ri yis ngos gcig la/ /lnga 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong yod/ /mtha' skor du ni sa ya gnyis/ /chig 'bum brgyad khri yod pa yin/ /rol mtsho drug pa'i ngos gcig la/ /lnga 'bum lnga khri mtha' skor du/ /sa ya gnyis dang gnyis 'bum yod/ /rnam 'dud ri yi ngos gcig la/ /lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong dang / /lnga brgya dag ni yod pa yin/ /mtha' skor du ni sa ya gnyis/ /gnyis 'bum dang ni chig khri yod/ /rol mtsho bdun pa'i ngos gcig la/ /lnga 'bum lnga khri lnga stong yod/ /mtha' skor du ni sa ya gnyis/ /nyis 'bum nyi khri yod pa yin/ /mu khyud 'dzin ri'i ngos gcig la/ /lnga 'bum lnga khri drug stong dang / /nyis brgya yod cing mtha' skor du/ /sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum dang / /nyi khri lnga stong yod pa yin/

/'dzam bu gling dang bcas pa yis/ /phyi'i rgya mtsho'i zheng tshad du/ /'bum phrag gsum dang stong phrag ni/ /nyi shu gnyis su gzhung na gsal/ /rgya mtsho rang gi zheng du ni/ /dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum dang ni/ /stong phrag gnyis ni ngos la yin/ /phyi yis rgya mtsho de nyid kyi/ /mtha' skor du ni dpag tshad grangs/ /sa ya gsum dang drug 'bum dang / /bdun brgya nyi shu tham pa yod/ lcags ri'i mtha' skor dpag tshad grangs/ /sa ya gsum dang drug 'bum dang / /nyis stong lnga brgya go lnga yod/ /khor yug gi ni phyi rol du/ /chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis/ /phyogs rer dpag tshad gcig stong dang / /nyis brgya dang ni brgya bcu tswa/ /phyed dang brgyad brgyad lhag pa yin/ /lho byang lta bu'i zheng gnyis so/ /sdoms na dpag tshad nyis stong dang / /lnga brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga lhag /ces pa ltar go bde bar sbyar ro/ /mtsho bdun gyi lhag ma mu khyud 'dzin dang / khor yug gi bar gyi mtsho ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho yin te/ de ba tsha dang ldan pa'i chu'i gang zhing srog chags dang / rin po che'i rigs du ma dang ldan pa yin no/ /de nyid kyi zheng du 'dzam bu gling dang bcas pa la dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum dang / stong phrag dang ni nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod/ 'o na rgya mtshor chu bo chen po rnams dang / klu'i char phab pas chu dpag med babs kyang gnyis las mi 'da' ba ci zhe na/ phal po cher klu'i char babs pas rgya mtsho srid rtse las 'da' bar 'gyur ba la chu dang gser gyi sa gzhi'i mtshams kyi rin po che nyi ma'i snying pos chu rnams 'o ma dang zho byed la/ rin po che rlan dang bral ba zhes pas mar gyi nying khur byed cing / rin po che me'i 'od ches bya bas mer 'bar bar byed/ rin po che ma lus pas mthar thug pa zhes pas ci yang snang bar mi byed de/ de bzhin du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsags pa rnams mi snang bar byed pa'i ye shes ting nge 'dzin bzhi bka' rtsal to/

/mdzangs blun du/ dmyal ba'i tshe tshad kyi skems pa dang / gzhan du rgod ma kha'i me'i skems pa dang / gzhag par de'i sems can gyis spyad cing / rlung bzhi nyin mtshan kyis zad pa dang / lan tsha'i ro ldan pa'ang de'i sems can gyi lus kyi dri ma dang / lan tsha'i ro zhu ba dang / gling gi rtsi shing sogs chu'i khyer ba rtul ba sogs yin par bshad cing / baṃs sa ya niṃ/ srin gyi chu ni mang blangs kyang / rgya mtsho'i chu ni zad mi 'gyur/ zhes te/ rgya mtsho chu nyid 'khor bar bzhed par mngon no/ /phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po de la ni gling bzhi gling phran brgyad chags shing / de dag gi tshad dang dbyibs kyi khyad par ni/ ri rab kyi lho phyogs na gnas pa'i gling ni 'dzam bu gling ste de'i ngos gsum la dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis su nges so/ /rnam pa ni/ shing rta'i dbyibs dang mtshungs la lcags ri'i phyogs kyis ngos gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi yod do/ /dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi ni/ lcags ri'i phyogs na yod par mdo gdags par bshad cing / sar/ phyed dang bdun stong par bshad do/ /byams pa byon pa'i dus/ de tshe 'dzam bu gling 'di yang / 'chu zheng tha gru mnyam par ni/ dpag tshad stong phrag bcu pa te/ zhes de lung bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /gling 'di na ni shing 'dzam bu brikṣa yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi/ 'dzam bu'i gling zhes bya ste/ 'og tu rgyas par 'chad do/ /ri rab kyi shar phyogs kyi gling ni/ lus 'phags kyi gling ste/ dbyibs zla gam 'dra ba la shin tu rgu ba/ lcags ri'i phyogs nas cung zad spyad pa'i rnam pa can/ ngos gsum 'dzam bu gling 'di dang tshad 'dra bar dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis yod cing / lcags ri phyogs kyi ngos gcig la dpag tshad sum brgya dang lnga bcu yod pa'o/ /gling 'di lus khyad par du 'phags pa can yin pas lus 'phags zhes bya/ sa sder ni/ bdun stong par bshad do/ /nub phyogs kyi gling ni ba glang spyod pa'i gling yin pa la/

dbyibs ni zlum po ste/ de'i mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang brgyad yod pa yin/ de'i dbus thad kyi zheng du dpag tshar stong phrag phyed dang gsum yod/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs kyi gling ni/ sgra mi snyan te/ gling de'i mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad yod pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi/ ngos re re la dpag tshad gnyis stong re yod par mnyam mo/ /gling 'dir 'chi khar sgra mi snyan pa 'byung bas na sgra mi snyan zhes bya'o/ /gling de dag gi dbyibs dang de dag na yod pa'i mi rnams kyi gdong pa'i dbyibs 'dra'o/ /bzhag par 'dzam bu'i gling na gser dngul la nyo tshong byed cing / shar na ras be'u ras dang nub na ba glang dang / nor bu la nyo tshong byed/ byang na med do/ /'dzam gling 'di na kha zas 'bras chen dang / mkhur ba dang / zan dang phye dang sha chang yod pa ltar/ shar nub na'ang yod cing / byang na ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sa lu za'o/ /'di na char 'bab mkhas mi mkhas dang / lo legs nyes dang / mu ge dang / yid bde mi bde dang / 'jigs pa dang / tsha grang dang / nyo tshong dang / kha dog du ma dang / khang pa ched du byas ma byas dang / bal gos dang / gos bstan dang / lci ba dang / bag ma gtong len dang / rje khol dang / de rnams la zhen pa yod pa ltar/ shar nub na'ang yod la/ byang na med de/ kha dog dkar mo ched du ma byas pa'i sa khang dang / dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos srang gcig pa yod cing / gang la'ang yong 'dzin med de/ bu tsha rnams kyang skyes ma thag las 'dor shing / rang gi mthe bong las nu zho 'byung bar bshad do/ /gling bzhi ka na bkres skom dang pho mo'i dbang po tha dad dang / nyin mtshan dang / dus bzhi dang / bshang gci dang / zla mtshan dang / sbrum ma dang bu btsas ba yod do/ /de yang dran pa nyer bzhag tu/ blun po'i dge ba byas pa sgra mi snyan tu skye/ zhes dang / mdo myang 'das su/ mi 'dod bzhin du tshul khrims bsrung du bcug pa shar nub gnyis su skye bar bka' rtsal to/

/zhes gsungs so/ /gling phran brgyad tshad dbyibs kyi sgo nas bshad pa ni/ gling bzhi po de'i bar gyi gling brgyad ni/ gling phran zhes bya ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i gling rang rang gi nub dang shar du rim bzhin du gnas te/ shar du lus dang lus 'phags/ byang du/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi bzla dang ni/ de bzhin du lhor/ rnga yab dang ni rnga yab gzhan/ nub du/ g.yo ldan dang ni lam mchog 'gro'i gling rnams gnas so/ /gling 'di rnams kyi che chung gi tshad gling phran yin pas/ rtsa ba'i gling bzhi las chung ba 'dod pa yod kyang / de la shes byed ma mthong zhing / rtsa ba'i gling bzhi'i tshad dbyibs/ 'jig rten bzhag pas mdo las/ gsal por gsungs shing / gling phran brgyad kyi tshad ma smos pas/ de rnams kyi tshad/ rang rang gi rtsa ba'i gling dang 'dra bas/ dngos su ma gsungs par mngon no/ /gling zhes pa ni/ mtha' chus skor shing / nang skam par gnas pa te/ thams cad kyang rtsa ba gser gyi sa gzhi la thug cing / rngams su dpag tshad brgyad khri par yod do/ /'dzam gling yon tan gyi sgo nas bye brag du bshad pa ni/ 'phags pa'i yul 'di nas byang du ri nag po gsum mtshan gsum de dgu 'das pa'i pha rol na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba'i gangs ri'o/ /de nas kyang pha rol na ni/ spos ngad ldang ba'i ri yod cing / de'i dpag tshad bcu bzhi'i tshu rol lho phyogs na/ mtsho ma dros pa zhes bya ba chu zheng dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa'i mtsho yod cing / de yang yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang la/ de la shar du chu bo gaṅga/ lhor sidhu/ nub tu pakṣu/ byang du sī tā rnams chu rlung lnga brgya lnga brgya dang bcas te/ ma dros pa las lan grangs bdun g.yas bskor du bskor nas rim kyis shar sogs su 'bab par bshad cing / spos ngad ldang kyi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na gser gyi bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos bya ba/ zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcur mtshungs pa/

'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug pa sogs kyi khyad chos du ma dang ldan pa/ yon tan de dang tshul mtshungs pa'i gser gyi bya skyibs brgyad stong gis skor ba/ brag bya skyibs de yi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ shing sa la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa zhes bya ba/ sa la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun gyi bskor ba/ shing sa la'i rgyal po rab brtan gyi shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ rdzing bu dal 'bab zhes bya ba/ gru bzhi pa zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu pa/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya pa/ sbrang rtsi lta bu'i chus gang ba/ utpal la sogs me tog gi khyab cing / sdong bu gshol mda' tsam/ me tog shing lo'i 'phang long tsam/ lo ma ba glang gi ko ba tsam/ rtsa ba skyes bu chen po'i bla tsam te/ sbrang rtsi ltar ro mngar ba/ rdzing bu dal 'bab kyi phyi rol na/ yon tan de dang mtshungs pa'i rdzing bu brgyad stong gi yongs su skor ba dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum lha rnams kyi glang po che g.yul ngor spyod pa rab bstan yon tan du ma dang ldan pa/ 'khor glang po brgyad stong gi skor ba/ dgun zla ba bzhi brag bya skyibs/ lha ma yin gyi ngos kyi nang na gnas shing / dpyid zla ba bzhi shing sa la'i rgyal por rab tu bstan pa'i nang na 'khod pa sogs rgyas par gsungs te/ 'jig rten gzhag pa'i mdo las/ 'di nas byang phyogs na ri nag po gsum yod de/ ri nag po gsum po de dag gi byang phyogs na ri nag po gsum yod do/ /ri nag po gzhan gsum po de dag gi byang phyogs na yang ri nag po gzhan gsum yod de/ ri nag po gzhan gsum po de dag gi byang phyogs na/ ri'i rgyal po gangs can zhes bya ba yod do/ /ri'i rgyal po gangs can gyi byang phyogs na/ ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang zhes bya ba yod do/ /ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang nas dpag tshad bcu'i tshu rol na/ mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba gcig yod de/

ma dros pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba de la chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu yod do/ /mtha' skor du ni dpag tshad nyis brgya yod de/ dbyibs legs shing lta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ chu bsil zhing chu sbrang rtsi lta bu'i gang la/ me tog utpal dang / pad ma dang / ku mu ta dang / padma dkar po'i shin tu khebs par 'dug go /de'i nang nas chu klung chen po bzhi 'di lta ste/ gaṅgā dang / sin dhu dang / sī tā dang / pakṣu dang / 'di rnams 'bab te/ gaṅgā shar phyogs nas/ glang po che'i kha nas 'bab te/ de ni mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba la/ g.yas phyogs su skor nas/ chu klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig du shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /sin dhu ni/ lho phyogs nas khyu mchog gi kha nas 'bab ste/ de ni mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba g.yas phyogs su skor nas/ chu klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu/ lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /pakṣu ni/ nub phyogs nas rta'i kha nas 'bab ste/ de ni mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba la g.yas phyogs su skor nas 'bab par/ klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /sī tā ni/ byang phyogs nas seng ge'i kha nas 'bab ste/ de ni mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba la g.yas phyogs su skor te/ klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /'di skad du/ byang kha ཾguraṃ 'gyur ba yi/ chu mtsho yod gzhan dag kyang / de ni mtsho chen chu zhes bya/ /tha dad rgyun rnams 'byung gnas yod/ /chu klung gaṅgā sin dhu pakṣu dang / /sī tā dpa' rlabs lbu ba'i 'phreng ba can/ /'bab cing thams cad bsil ba'i chu yin te/ /phyogs bzhi kho ra khor yug dag nas 'byung / /gaṅgā shar phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro ba ste/ /sin dhu lho phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro ba yin/ /pakṣu yang ni nub phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro/

/de yi byang phyogs sī tā rgya mtshor 'gro/ /chu klung rab mchog bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu bzang zhing so sor 'bab pa ste/ /re re zhing yang lnga brgya khyer nas ni/ /chu yi rgyun rnams rgya mtsho chen por 'gro/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /ri spos ngad ldang de'i byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ gser gyi brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos zhes bya ba/ chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod de/ de'i nang gi sa gzhi yang dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa gser gyi bye ma bdal shing / tsandan gyi chu'i chag chag btab pa ste/ der yid du mi 'ong ba'i shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na/ de mi ma yin pa rnams kyis rlung gi phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /de yis bskor bar khor yug na/ gser gyi brag bya skyibs brgyad stong yod de/ de dag thams cad kyang dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa ste/ de dag gi nang gi sa gzhi rnams kyang dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser gyi bye ma bdal cing tsandan gyi chus chag chag btab pa ste/ de dag du'ang yid du mi 'ong ba'i shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na/ de mi ma yin pa rnams kyi rlung gis mthus phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /de'i lam srid du dpag tshad nyi shu/ zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser gyi bye ma bdal shing tsandan gyi chus chag chag btab pa zhig yod de/ der yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na/ de mi ma yin pa rnams kyi rlung gi mthus phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos/ /de'i byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ shing sa la'i rgyal po chen por rab tu brtan pa zhes bya ba sa la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun gyis skor ba zhig yod de/

sa la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa de'i rtsa ba ni 'dom bzhi bcu thur du zug go /sa la'i phreng ba dang po'i rtsa ba ni 'doms bcu gsum thur du zug go /gnyis pa ni bcu gnyis so/ gsum pa ni bcu gcig go /bzhi pa ni bcu'o/ /lnga pa ni dgu'o/ /drug pa ni brgyad do/ /sa la'i phreng ba bdun pa'i rtsa ba ni 'doms bdun thur du zug go /sa la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa de'i yal ga dang / lo ma yal ga gang yin pa de ni/ sa la'i phreng ba dang po la thug go /sa la'i phreng ba dang po'i yal ga dang lo ma dang / yal ga gang yin pa de ni gnyis pa la'o/ /gnyis gang yin pa de ni gsum pa la'o/ /gsum pa'i gang yin pa de ni bzhi pa la'o/ /bzhi pa'i gang yin pa de ni lnga pa la'o/ /lnga pa'i gang yin pa de ni drug pa la'o/ /drug pa'i gang yin pa de ni bdun pa la'o/ /sa la'i phreng ba bdun pa'i yal ga dang lo ma dang yal ga gang yin pa de ni nam mkha' khyab par 'dug go /de'i nang gi sa gzhi yang / dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser gyi bye ma bdal shing / tsandan gyi chus chag chag btab pa ste/ der yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na/ de mi ma yin pa rnams kyis rlung gi mthus phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /de'i lam srid du dpag tshad nyi shu/ zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod de/ der yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na/ de mi ma yin pa rnams kyis rlung gi mthus phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /sa la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa'i shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ rdzing bu dal gyi 'bab ces bya ba/ chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad lnga bcu ste/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug pa mdzes pa/ chu bsil shing chu sbrang rtsi lta bu'i gang ba/

me tog utpal dang / pad ma dang ku mu ta dang / padma dkar po'i khebs pa zhig yod de/ rdzing bu dal kyis 'bab kyi/ nang gis padma'i lo ma che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ ba glang gi ko ba tsam mo/ /padma'i sdong po rnams che zhing mchog du che ste/ 'di lta ste/ gshol mda' tsam mo/ /padma'i me tog rnam che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam mo/ /padma'i rtsa ba rnams che zhing mchog tu che ste/ skyes bu chen po'i bla tsam mo/ /ro mngar zhing mchog tu mngar te/ 'di lta ste/ sbrang bu'i sbrang rtsi ma skol ba bzhin no/ /spyad na yang 'o ma 'dzag go /rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi khor ra khor yug na rdzing bu brgyad stong yod de/ de dag thams cad dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa chu bsil zhing sbrang rtsi lta bu'i gang ngo / /de dag gi nang gi padma'i lo ma rnams kyang mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ ba glang ko ba tsam mo/ /padma'i sdong bu rnams kyang che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ shol mda' tsam mo/ /padma'i me tog rnams kyang che shing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam mo/ /padma'i rtsa ba rnams che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ skyes bu chen po'i bla tsam mo/ /ro mngar zhing mchog tu mngar te/ 'di lta ste/ sbrang bu'i sbrang rtsi ma skol ba bzhin no/ /spyad na yang 'o ma 'dzag go /de'i lam srid du dpag tshad nyi shu/ zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ dbyibs legs zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser gyi bye ma bdal cing / tsandan gyi chus chag chag btab pa zhig yod de/ der yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing 'am/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na/ de mi ma yin pa rnams kyis rlung gi mthus phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyis/ glang po che g.yul ngor spyod pa/ rab tu brtan pa zhes bya ba/ gzugs bzang shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod de/

me tog ku mu ta'i mdog ltar thal dkar du 'dug la/ yan lag bdun shin tu legs par gnas pa ste/ de'i mgo yang dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa ste/ sngo shing srog chags 'dam bu chu shel gyi mdog ltar/ dbus dmar la mche ba drug yod de glang po che rab tu brtan pa'i srid du/ dpag tshad phyed dang gsum/ 'phang du/ dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad bdun yod do/ /de'i 'khor glang po che brgyad stong yod de/ de dag thams cad kyang gzugs bzang shing blta na sdug pa mdzes pa/ me tog ku mu ta'i mdog ltar thal dkar du 'dug cing / yan lag bdun shin tu legs par gnas pa ste/ de dag gi mgo yang dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa ste/ sngo shing srog chags lta bu dkar shel gyi mdog ltar dbus dmar la mche ba drug yod pa sha stag ste/ glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa 'khor dang bcas pa dgun zla ba bzhi ni/ brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos kyis nang na gnas shing / dpyid zla ba bzhi ni/ shing sa la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa'i nang na gnas shing 'khod do/ /gang gis tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos kyi nang na gnas shing 'dug pa de'i tshe ni/ glang po che brgyad stong po rnams 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa byung ba dang / sba ba dang / mdzes par byed pa'i ri brag bya skyibs brgyad stong gi nang na nye bar gnas shing 'khod do/ /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa/ brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos kyi nang nas/ shing sa la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa'i nang du 'gro ba na/ res 'ga' ni tha mal gyi tshul gyis 'gro'o/ /res 'ga' ni 'di lta ste/ lha'am lha yi rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba gang yang rung ba dang 'dra bar bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas/ glang po de dag thams cad kyi nang na/

dbang che bar grags pa de nyid gyi mgo bo'am/ rgyab tu zhon te sil snyan dang / phog stob pa dag bya shing / sa la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun po de dag gi nang na/ kha nang du lta zhing 'khod de/ shing sa la'i phreng ba dang po'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang / kha nang du ltas te 'khod do/ /gnyis pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /gsum pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /bzhi pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /lnga pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /drug pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /bdun pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du ltas te 'khod de/ gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab du brtan pa/ shing sa la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa nas/ rdzing bu dal gyi 'bab par rab tu 'gro ba na/ res 'ga' ni tha mal pa'i tshul gyis 'gro'o/ /res 'ga' ni 'di lta ste/ lha'am lha'i rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba/ gang yang rung ba dang 'dra bar bdag nyid mngon sprul nas glang po che de dag thams cad kyi nang na dbang che bar grags pa gang yin pa/ de nyid gyi mgo bo'i rgyab tu zhon te/ sil snyan dang / pheg stob pa dag rgya che bar byed cing 'gro'o/ /gang gi tshe glang po'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa rdzing bu dal gyi nang du zhugs nas rtse shing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa de'i tshe/ glang po che brgyad stong po de dag 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa de bsrung ba'am/ sba ba dang mdzes par bya ba'i phyir/ rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi mtha' kho ra khor yug nas skor te/ kha nang du blta shing 'khod do/ /gang gi tshe/ glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa/ rdzing bu dal gyi 'bab kyi nang na/ rtse shing dga' la dga' mgur spyad nas/ phyir byung ba de'i tshe/ de'i nang nas glang po che dbang che bar grags pa gang yin pa de'i rdzing bu dal gyi 'bab kyi nang du zhugs nas/

padma'i rtsa ba rnams slangs te/ shin tu dkrus shing rab tu bshal nas/ glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa la 'bul lo/ /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pas zos shing 'thungs te/ 'grangs par gyur pa de'i tshe/ glang po che gzhan brgyad stong po de dag kyang rdzing bu brgyad stong dag gi nang du rdzing bu re rer zhugs nas/ rtse shing dga' la dga' mgur spyad de/ padma'i rtsa ba dag bslangs nas shin tu dkrus te shing rab tu bshal te za'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyis glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa'i mthu ni de tsam mo/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /mtsho ma dros pa de'i nang na/ shing 'dzam bu brikṣa zhes bya ba/ 'bras bu mngar po dang ldan pa yod cing / shing de'i 'bras bu mtshor lhung ba'i tshe/ 'dzam bu zhes pa'i sgra 'byung zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gling 'di 'dzam bu'i gling zhes bya'o/ /shing de nyid gyi rtse la nyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir skya rengs dang po shar ba'i tha snyad byed do/ /shing de'i 'bras bu mtsho der lhung bas/ 'dzam bu chu gser zhes bya ba 'byung ngo / /snga rabs pa kha cig na re/ 'bras bu de klus nyar sprul nas zos pas/ bdud rtsi 'gyur zhing ma zos pa'i lhag ma 'dzam bu'i chu gser du 'gyur zhes bshad/ kha cig na re/ 'bras bu de nyas zos pa'i dgun grum la/ 'dzam bu'i chu gser 'byung zhes kyang zer ro/ /mtsho 'di la ma dros pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ shan ti pa'i lugs la/ dmyal ba'i mes kyang dros par ma nus pas na ma dros pa zhes bya ba'am/ rgyal po tsam gyi 'bras khu blugs pas ma dros pa'am/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa gnas pa'i gnas yin pas/ de skad ces bya'o/ /zhes zer kyang / phyi ma 'thad par mngon no/ /'dir dgos pa 'di lta bu zhig 'byung ste/ chos mngon pa'i mdo 'grel rnams las ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar/

mtsho ma dros pa/ ri bo gangs can gyi byang phyogs na yod par gsungs la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa rnams las ni/ mtsho ma dros pa ri bo gangs can gyi lho phyogs na yod par gsungs pas/ ri bo gangs can rigs mi gcig pa gnyis las/ len pa'am/ yang na mngon pa'i mdo 'grel dang / dus 'khor gyi rgyud/ rgyud 'grel gang rung gcig ma dag pa yin par khas len/ zhes pa'i dri ba 'di gangs ri'i ljongs kyi mkhas pa rnams la dris na ci gsung / phal cher the tshom gyi phyang mo mo zhig tu mi 'gyur ram/ snga phyi'i dri ka mdzad pa dag gis ni/ tshul 'di la dogs pa tsam yang ma zhugs la/ kho bos ni sdom gsum gyi rab tu dbye bas bstan bcos ni rgya cher 'grel pa nges don rgya mtsho'i gnas bshad kyi skabs su gsal bar bshad yod pas/ don du gnyer ba dag gis der rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /'o na mtsho ma dros pa dus kyi 'khor lo las/ ri bo gangs can gyi lho na yod pa ji ltar bshad ce na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ lan tsha chang dang chu dang 'o ma zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho rnams dang ri bdun ni/ /'od sngon po dang man dha ra bas ri de rtsub ldan nor 'od chang ldan grang ba'i ri rdo rje/ /gling rnams bzla ba dang ni rab dkar rab mchog ku sha mi'am ci ste khrung khrung drag po rnams/ /longs spyod pa rnams nyid de 'dzam gling bdun pa las kyi sa rnams la ni mi rnams gnas pa'o/ /zhes ri rab la mtsho bdun dang / gling bdun gyi 'khor yug tu skor nas yod pas/ gling phyi ma 'dzam bu gling chen po yin zhing / de la dum bu bcu gnyis su byas pa'i/ lho'i cha ni 'dzam gling chung ngu yin la/ nge'i chu zheng che ba la chu bo sī tā yod/ de'i byang na ri bo gangs can yod cing / ri bo gangs can gyis skor ba'i dbus na sham bha la'i yul/ sa padma 'dab brgyad kyis rnam par gnas pa/

dbus kyis sum cha lte bar byas pa la/ kai la sha'i ri bor grags shing / de la rgyal po'i pho brang ka la pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang dang / ma la ya'i skyid mos tshal yod la/ 'dam ma brgyad po re la grong khyer bye ba bcu gnyis re yod cing / bye ba khrag re la rgyal po re yod pas/ rgyal phran dgu bcu rtsa drug tu yod de/ de ltar yang gangs ri mchog gi phyogs rnams ma lus kun nas skor ba dge dbus kai la sha sa la kai la sha ya dum bur gangs ri ldan pa de yi sum cha kun gnas shes bya ste/ phyi rol du yang yul rnams nyin phyed 'dam ma re re'i gling rnams kun gyis rgyan par brjod pa ste/ gangs kyi phyed du thub mchog nas grong sham bha la zhes bya ba grong khyer bye ba yang dag gnas/ zhes sogs gsungs/ bsdus pa'i don du na/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/ chu bo sī tā'i byang phyogs na/ /ri bo gangs can yod par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ ma dros pa'i byang phyogs su chu bo sī tā 'bab par bshad cing / sī tā'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs can yod par gsungs pas 'grub bo/ /des na 'dzam bu gling 'di gling gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ 'di'i lte ba na rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas ba'i gnas/ me chu rlung gsum gang gis kyang 'jig par mi nus pa/ skal pa zhig pa'i tshe zo ba cong la rtags pa ltar/ rgyu rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam las grub pa yod/ de'i shar phyogs na yid la bsam pa tsam gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab skye bar nus pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi gnas rgya nag ri bo'i rtse lnga'i zhes bya ba yod/ lho phyogs na gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis snying rje dang phrin las dpag tu med pa 'byung ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang / rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i gnas/ ri bo po ta la'am/ ri bo gru 'dzin zhes bya ba yod/

nub phyogs na gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis rgyud byin gyis rlobs par nus pa dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul zhes bya ba yod/ byang na rigs ldan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi gnas/ sham bha la zhes bya ba yod/ des na 'dzam bu'i gling 'di sa las sa pa zhes bya ste/ dge sdig gi las gang byed kyang nus mthu che ba'i phyir/ las 'bras kyi blang dor shes bzhin du khyad du gsad na ngan 'gror 'khyams pa/ 'gro ba gzhan las stobs che zhing / rten khyad par can thob pa'i dus 'dir/ las 'bras la blang dor tshul bzhin du byas na/ gnas skabs lha mi'i phun tshogs thob pa dang / mthar thug thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa myur du thob pa la sbyor nus pas thar pa don du gnyer ba dag gis/ bag yod par byed rigs so// ༈ //da ni tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas bshad par bya ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid kyi 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu na/ mnar med pa'i dmyal ba'i gnas yod la/ gnas de'i rngams dang / rgyar yang de tsam ste gru bzhi pa'o/ /de'i steng na tsha ba'i dmyal ba gzhan/ bdun yod do/ /tsha ba'i dmyal ba de dag gis sdug bsngal sogs kyi khyad par cung zad brjod na/ yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po tsha ba rab tu tsha/ mnar med pa ste tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ sdug bsngal khyad par ming gi nges tshig dang / skye ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i tshe yi tshad/ 'char sgo'i gnad kyi yid ches nges par skyed/ zhar byung nye tshe ba nyi 'khor ba dang gnyis kyis sdug bsngal gyi yang khyad par bshad/ ces pa ltar/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad po de dag gi gnas dang sdug bsngal sogs kyis khyad par ni/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag dang / sa sde sogs las/ spyi khyab tu gnas kyi khyad par lcags sregs kyi sa gzhi/ lcags sregs kyi me 'obs bsgal bar dka' ba/ me lce gcig tu 'bar ba/ me lce gcig tu 'khrug pa sgo bzhi dang bcas pa'o/

/sdug bsngal gyi khyad par ni/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi mes yang sos kyis me bzhi 'gyur kyis tsha zhing / de bas 'og ma 'og ma bzhi 'gyur gyi tsha la/ des lus po rnams mar mes sdong po ltar sregs pa na tshig chi li li zer zhing skang zhun sogs lhag lhag 'bar te/ sdug bsngal bzod stabs med pa yin/ de 'dra'i gnas na yang / bye brag gi sdug bsngal ni/ yang sos pa rnams phan tshun dgra mi sha bo'i 'du shes kyis lag du blangs tshad mtshon char gyur nas phan tshun bsnun pas brgyal te/ sa la 'gyel shing tshe'i dus byas pa na/ bar snang las rlung bsil ba dang bcas pa'i sgra las khyed rnams sos par gyur cig zhes pa'i sgra byung ba'i mod la/ yang sos par gyur te/ las ma zad kyi bar du/ snga ma bzhin du sdug bsngal myong ba yod do/ /des na nyi ma re la srog khri tsho re chad kyang yang sos ste sha yungs 'bru tsam las ma lus kyang / gtan 'chi ru mi 'dod pa yin/ thig nag ni/ dmyal srungs kyis thig bzhi'am/ brgyad dam du mar btab te/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar phug pas/ klad pa dang khrag 'thor shing so le'i dra ba dang / rta ri'i gzhog pa de'i tshe/ lung stod bshog cing dra ba na/ smad kyi sma ma tshor la/ smad kyi tshe stod ma tshor nas nyam thag pa yin/ bsdus 'joms ni/ lcags kyi ri ra dang / lug dang / rta'i gdong pa can lta bu gnyis kyis bar du dmyal bsrungs kyis bcings ma thag ris btsir bas sgo kun nas khrag rgyun 'bab cing / ri gnyis phyir gyes pa na lus sos nas yang sngar ltar byed pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa yin/ ngu 'bod ni/ nyam thag nas bde bas gnas tshol bar 'dod de/ lcags kyi khang par zhugs pa na/ sgo zub nas de'i nang du me 'bar bas bsregs pas/ ngu zhing sdug skad 'byung te/ pha 'bod ma 'bod byas kyang skyob mkhan bye'u thed ma gcig yang med pas/ sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa yin/

ngu 'bod chen po ni/ lcags khang snod med nyis rim me 'bar bas bsregs cing / sgo nang ma nas rgya la thar yang phyi ma la lo stong phrag mang po mi thar zhing / sngar bas nyis 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa yin/ tsha ba ni/ lcags kyi phru ba dpag tshad du ma yod pa/ me 'bar ba'i nang du sngar bzhin sregs pa dang / lcags kyi gsal shing 'bar bas bshang lam nas phug pa spyi bor byung te/ lus kyi bu ga kun nas me 'bar ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa yin/ rab du tsha ba ni/ lcags kyi phru chen sngar bas kyang tsha bar sreg pa dang / de'i khar thon pa na sha skye shing ring du song ba na rus par 'gro shing / der keng rus tsam lus pa na/ de nas 'byung nas sa la bkram pa'i/ sha lpags dang / klad khrag skyes pa na/ yang nang du 'jug pa sogs kyis sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa yin/ mnar med ni/ phyogs bzhi sa gzhi chen po me 'bar bar song bas/ de'i lus mar me'i sdong bu ltar sregs pa na/ sdug skad las sems can yod par shes pa ma gtogs/ me nyid kyi phung por snang ba dang / lcags kyi zhi mar lcags kyi me stag 'bar ba dang / lhan cig 'khrab pa dang / lcags sregs kyi ri chen po la 'bab 'dzeg byed du 'jug pa dang / lce rgyang nas lcags phur rgyas 'debs pa dang / lcags kyi tho ba lum me 'bar ba dang / zangs zhun khol ma khar blug pas/ kha lkog nang khrol kun tshig te/ ro smad nas phyir 'thon pa la sogs pa/ las ma zad bar du myong ba'i sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ming gi nges tshig ni/ yang sos par gyur cig zhes pa'i dgra las yang sos par gyur te/ snga ma bzhin du sdug bsngal myong bas na/ yang sos/ zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang / rang rang gi sdug bsngal gyis khyad par la/ rang rang gi nges tshig shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa skye ba'i rgyu ni/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum gtso bor byed pa la brten nas tsha dmyal dang po gsum du skye ba yin zhing /

lus kyi mi dge ba'i steng du/ ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi byed pa la brten nas/ ngu 'bod dang ngu 'bod chen po gnyis su skye ba len/ lus ngag gi mi dge ba gnyis kyi steng du/ yid kyi mi dge ba gsum byed pa la brten nas/ tsha ba rab tu tsha ba mnar med pa gsum du skye ba len pa yin no/ /bzhi pa gnas tshe'i tshad ni/ 'og du yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ des na de dag rnams kyi tshe/ 'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin/ zhes pa'i skabs su 'chad la/ lnga pa 'char sgo'i gnad kyi yid ches nges pa skyed pa yang / 'og tu grang dmyal gyi skabs su 'chad do/ /drug pa zhar byung nye 'khor ba dang / nyi tshe ba'i sdug bsngal gyi yang khyad par bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po nye 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ tsha dmyal brgyad pa kun te/ re re la'ang de nas thar yang sdug bsngal myong ba'i gnas lhag pa ste/ nye 'khor ba bzhi bzhi bcu drug de yod de/ de gang zhe na/ brgyad pa de rnams kyis ngos bzhi na me ma mur pus mo nub tsam la gnas tshol du 'gro ba na rkang pa 'degs 'jog gi sha skye 'jig byed pa dang / ro myangs phyi sa'i 'dam dri nga ba na/ 'bu mchu rnon gyi rus pa'i bar du 'bigs pa dang / spu gri bdal ba'i lam dang / sogs pas/ ral gri lo ma'i nags dang / lcags kyi shal ma ri'i nags dang / gsum mtshon char 'dra bas gcig tu byas la/ de'i dang por sngar bzhin rkang pa'i sha skye 'jig byed pa dang / gnyis pa des dri ma la 'khod pa na/ ral gri lhung bas spyod cing / 'gyel te khyi sre bo rnams kyi bshul sha za ba dang / gsum pa ni/ nags tsher ma rnon po sor bcu drug pa/ yar mar du kha lta bas 'dzeg pa dang / 'bab pa na/ lus 'bigs shing lcags kyi mchu can gyis mig 'byin pa dang / chu bo rab med 'gyur byed kyi chu khol bas gang ba la lhung te/ ngos gnyis nas skyes bu mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas bsrung shing 'tshed pa'o/

/'o na dmyal bsrung sems can yin nam min zhe na/ bye brag tu smra ba 'ga'/ sems can du smra la/ mdo sde pa'i/ las kyi mthus 'byung ba chen po sogs kyis bye brag tu 'dod cing / sar/ sprul pa lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa sems can lta bur snang bar de'i 'grel par bshad de/ theg chen pa rnams sdig pa'i bag chags kyi bslad pa'i sems kyi snang ba tsam du bzhed do/ /gnyis pa nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas ni/ chu bo dang ri bo sogs nges med na yod la/ gro zhun skyes dang / dge 'dun bsrungs kyis rtogs dpyod las/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang / tshe dang ldan pa dpal ldan gyi rtogs dpyod las/ rgyal po'i khab sogs na yod par bshad cing / de yang rdo'i nang na gnas pa'i 'bu dang / chu tshan gyi nang na gnas pa'i sems can/ 'chag sbubs kyi nang na yod pa'i 'bu sogs kyi la bshad do/ /gnyis pa grang dmyal ni/ chu bur can sogs brang dmyal brgyad ni/ tsha dmyal las gzhan te/ tsha dmyal rnams kyi thad ka na gnas so/ /gnas ni/ yang sos kyi thad dpag tshad khri'i pha rol na dang po dang de'i 'og gnyis stong gnyis stong na gzhan bdun yod par bshad do/ /de dag gi sdug bsngal sogs kyis khyad par cung zad bshad na/ chu bur chu bur rdol ba so tham dang / /a chu kyi hud utpal padma dang / /pad chen ltar gas grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ /sdug bsngal khyad par ming gi nges tshig dang / /skye ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i tshe yi tshad/ /'char sgo'i gnad kyis yid ches nges par bskyed/ /ces pa ltar/ grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad char nyi zla'i snang ba med pa'i 'khyags pa'i srubs na grang bas nyen nas chu bur byung ba dang / chu bur de rdol te rnag khrag gis rgyun 'dzag pa dang / grang nas so tham tham pa dang / a chu zer ba dang / kyi hud zer ba dang / utpal ltar gas pa lpags pa sngon po kha lnga'am drug tu gas pa dang / padma ltar gas pa lpags pa dmar po kha bcu'am de las lhag pa gas pa dang /

padma ltar gas pa chen po shin tu dmar ba kha brgya'am de las lhag par mang ba gas pa'o/ /zhes pas bshad de dang po gnyis dang phyi ma gsum lus kyi 'gyur ba dang gzhan gsum sgra'i 'gyur ba dang mthun pa'o/ /gnyis pa ming gi nges tshig ni/ sdug bsngal gyis khyad par las shes nus shing / gsum pa skye ba'i rgyu ni/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum byed pa la brten nas/ grang dmyal dang po gsum du skye ba len/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum gyi steng du ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi byed pa la brten nas/ utpal/ padma/ padma chen po ltar gas pa gsum du skye ba len no/ /bzhi pa gnas pa'i tshe'i tshad ni/ til sbyangs nang nas lo brgya zhing / /til gcig phyung pas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shur bsgyur/ /zhes pa'i skabs su 'chad do// ༈ //lnga pa 'char sgo'i gnad kyis yid ches nges pa skyed pa ni/ 'o na tsha grang gi dmyal ba de dag gi sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa la/ tshe'i tshad grang dmyal dang po la yang til gyi sbyangs pa ma ga ta'i khal brgyad cu shong ba nas mi lo brgya brgya nas til nyag re phyung bas til rnams zad par gyur pa tshe tshad yin pa dang grang dmyal 'og ma rnams la de nyi shu sbrel lo/ /tsha ba'i dmyal ba mnar med kyi tshe tshad/ bar bskal la bshad cing bar bskal gyi rgyun lcags kyi pha bong dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa la/ mi lo brgya brgya nas dar yug res phyis tsam cig byas pas lcags kyi pha bong dngos med du song ba'i yun tshad bar bskal gyi tshad du bshad cing / de ltar na ha cang thal che bas 'jigs pa dang skrag pa skyed pa tsam du zad kyis shin tu mi bden snyam pa'i log rtog 'di skye la de lta bu'i log rtog dgag pa'i phyir du/ 'char sgo'i gnad kyi yid ches skyed par bya ste/ 'di ltar/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyal po gcig la snying du rta sred zhugs yod pa na/

sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos der 'ongs pa la btsun mo rnams kyis/ rgyal po la sgyu ma ston cig byas pa la des rta spu yid du sdug pa/ bang 'gros 'joms pa spyad thams cad tshang ba gcig bstan nas/ rgyal po la/ rta 'di nyo 'am byas pas nyo zer/ rin ci 'dod byas pas rgyal srid phyed 'jal na 'tshong byas pas/ chags thogs med par 'jal nus pa byung / yang rtsa nas mi gcig byung nas/ rgyal po chen po/ rta 'di kho gcig pos bdag pa ma yin/ nga yang bdag pas sngar gyi de'i steng du btsun mo du yod kyi phyed 'jal nus na 'tshong byas pas kyang / chags thogs med pa 'jal nus pa byung / yang mi gcig byung nas rta 'di khong gnyis rkyang pa bdag rgyu min/ nga yang bdag pas sngar gyi de'i steng du sras du yod kyi phyed 'jal nus sam zer ba la/ cung ma nus par/ zhon la blta byas nas zhon pas/ bskal par phyin yang bsgrod par mi nus pa'i sar rta des khyer song nas/ thang chen po gcig 'dug pa la/ rgyal po bskyur nas/ phar phyogs na mtsho chen po gcig 'dug pa la rta de mchongs song / der sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byung / thang de'i 'gram de nas yar phyin pa na/ grog sbug gcig na du ba bun bun pa gcig tu phyin pas/ rgan rgon gnyis bu mo gcig dang gsum 'dug rgan mo na re/ rgyal po chen po khyed bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa yin yang rgyal srid du bskal par phyin yang 'gro mi nus/ bu mo 'di dang lhan cig khyim thab gyis zer ba la der khyim thab byas lo grangs mang bsdad/ bu tsha gsum tsam byung / chung shos de lkugs pa gcig skyes/ de nas rgan mo na re/ rgyal po chen po khyed bsod nams dang ldan pa yin pas/ lkugs pa 'di la byams par gyis shig zer nas sngar gyi mtsho de la mchongs song / de bzhin zer nas/ rgan mo nas rim pa bzhin du mchongs song / lkugs pa de la yang smra rgyu gcig byung nas/ rgyal po chen po khyed bsod nams dang ldan pa yin pas skyid par gyis shig zer nas mchongs song /

der sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byung ba la btsun mos sgyu ma mkhan la/ rgyal po thugs rlung 'jug pa 'dug pas/ sgyu ma bshig cig byas nas sgyu ma bshig pas na/ grib ma khru gang tsam las ma song bar 'dug go /dpe de bzhin du/ sdig pa can gyi sems snang la skad cig gi rgyun tsam la yang / bskal pa'i yun tshad du sdug bsngal myong dgos pa 'char te/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lhas/ /lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas/ /me tshog de dag ci las byung / /de 'dra de dag thams cad ni/ /sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /zhar byung yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ gnas kyi khyad par phal cher rgyal po'i khab kyi 'og na yod cing / kha 'thor ba rnams ni sa gzhi ri klung phal cher na yod do/ /mdo dran pa nyer bzhag tu/ yi dwags kyi rigs sum cu rtsa drug tu bshad cing / sa sder gsum du bsdus pa'i/ phyi'i sgrib pa can ni/ bkres skom gyis nyen zhing kha lus thams cad skam zhing / lus shin tu mi sdug pa/ skra ni zing zing du 'dzings pa/ mgrin pa ni gzhu rgyud ltar gyur/ yan lag ni sog ma ltar song ste/ yul kun tu rgyugs kyang bza' btung mi rnyed cing / bltas pa tsam gyis chu klung thams cad skam por gyur/ ljon shing thams cad 'bras bu med par gyur/ sos ka'i dus su zla ba yang me bas tsha/ dgun gyi dus su nyi ma yang chu bas grang / dpyid kyi dus su sprin yang me char du 'bab pa sogs sdug thag pas mi 'du ba yin te/ /ta la'i yang thog skam 'dra'i yi dwags gzugs/ /gang gis mthong na 'jigs rung skye ya g.ya'/ /bltas pa tsam gyis chu klung rgyun skem zhing / /ljon shing 'bras bu med pa de dag go /ces gsungs pa yin/ nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ lto ba ri rgyal tsam la/ kha khab mig tsam du song nas/ bza' btung cung zad kyang khog tu 'gro sa med pas/ rtag tu bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa yin te/

bshes spring las/ /kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ /lto ba ri yi ldog tsam bkres pas nyen/ /mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang / /'tshal pa'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can ni/ bza' btung ci zos ci 'thungs kyang me lce'i phreng bar gyur nas/ nang khrol sogs tshig nas sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa yin/ tshe tshad kyi khyad par ni/ bshes spring las/ /lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chi mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ 'o na dud 'gro la sdug bsngal ji tsam yod snyam na/ gnas kyi khyad par phal cher rgya mtsho'i bying na gnas pa rnams kyi ni/ che bas chung ba mid de za ba dang / chung bas che ba'i lus phug ste za ba dang / klu rnams ni nyin re bzhin bye tshan gyis sha rus la thug par sreg cing / mkha' lding gis za ba dang / kha 'thor ba rnams ni ri dwags sogs gcan gzan gyis za ba dang / mi rnams kyis rang dbang med par gsod pa dang / bkol spyod sogs kyis mnar te/ thun mong du glen cing gti mug blang dor mi shes pas sdug bsngal bar snang / de dag kyang bshes spring las/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang / /'ching dang rdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / /zhi gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni/ /gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad 'byung / /kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag /sha dang lpags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbang med gzhan ni rdog pa lag pa dang / /lcag dang lcags kyus dag gis btab ste bkol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ tshe tshad kyi khyad par ni/ tshe ring shos kyis bskal pa'i bar du sdug bsngal myong ba yin te/ gzhung las/ dud 'gro rnams mchog ring ba bskal pa'o/ /zhes bshad do// ༈ //de ltar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pas/ skyo shas kyis yid brnangs te/ bla ma thugs rje chen po la smre sngags su gsol ba ni/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus nas/

/dri med kun da ltar dkar dwangs ba'i sku/ /rang sems dag pa'i me long ltar shar ba'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /gdung shugs drag po'i smre sngags gsan du gsol/ /tsha grang bkres skom gsod dang bkol spyod dang / /'byor rgud 'du 'bral 'thab rtsod 'pho ltung gis/ /nyen pa'i ma rnams 'dun byus 'di ltar song / /nyam chung bdag la skyob pa'i nus pa med/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /ma rnams sdug bsngal gnas nas drang du gsol/ /lcags bsregs 'bar ba'i sa gzhir lus blangs te/ /dus mtha'i me las tsha ba'i me nang du/ /bzod med sdug bsngal drag pos rtag tu gzir/ /dmyal tshe 'khyol dus med pa su yis bzod/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /ma rnams sdug bsngal gnas nas drang du gsol/ /'khyag sbubs gcong rong nang du lus blangs te/ /grogs med gcig pur mun khrod skyo shas dang / /grang bas nyes pas sha rus tshal par gas/ /dmyal tshe 'khyol dus med pa su yis bzod/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /ma rnams sdug bsngal gnas nas drang du gsol/ /sdig can las ngan bsags pa'i sems snang la/ /bzod med sdug bsngal myong ba'i yun tshad ni/ /skad cig bskal par 'char ba sgyu ma'i dpes/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs phyir yid ches gnas/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /ma rnams sdug bsngal gnas nas drang du gsol/ /zas skom mig gis mi mthong phyi sgrib can/ /mthong yang khong du mi thar nang sgrib can/ /song yang sdug bsngal skyed pa'i zas sgrib can/ /kye ma 'di 'dra'i sems can snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /ma rnams sdug bsngal gnas nas drang du gsol/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang glen lkugs dang /

/gcig la gcig za gsod spyod la sogs dang / /'ga' zhig nges med gnas su mi lag 'khyams/ /skol btsog sdug bsngal drag po sangs dus med/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /ma rnams sdug bsngal gnas nas drang du gsol/ /mi la 'byor rgud 'du 'bral skye 'chi dang / /lha min 'thab rtsod lha la 'pho ltung gi /'chi ltas shar tshe dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /ches cher che ba'i sems kyis sdug bsngal myong / /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /ma rnams sdug bsngal gnas nas drang du gsol/ /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang / /dkar nag las 'bras bde dang sdug bsngal des/ /sngon chad ji snyed bsags pa sdig pa'i las/ /bdag gi srid pa dmyal ba kho nar nges/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /las 'bras blang dor byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnyed dka' yon tan ldan pa'i dal 'byor 'di/ /don med tshe 'di'i ngang la mi tshe 'das/ /don chen byang chub sgrub pa shul du lus/ /tshe la stong log byed dam snying rul lo/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /dal 'byor snying po len par byin gyis rlobs/ /chu bur lta bu'i mi rtag lus srog 'di/ /nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi nges med la/ /de ring 'byung bzhi'i tshogs pa gyes gyur na/ /'di la 'chi grabs zin nam snying rul lo/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pas snying rlung langs/ /rnam smin lus kyi phung po'i tshugs ma thub/ /stab stag mig gi sgo nas smre sngags shor/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i yid kyi dran pa dor/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /re sa gzhan na med do thugs rje can/ /thogs med dus nas 'khor med drin nos pa'i/ /drin can pha ma 'khor ba'i me dong du/

/shor ba shes kyang rang nyid bde don gnyer/ /khrel med bdag gis ngang tshul 'di la gzigs/ /tshad med snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das chos kun rang gi sems su 'dus/ /gsal rig sems kyi gshis la ngos bzung med/ /med cing gsal la ma 'gags lta ba'i gnad/ /rang ngo 'phrod kyang rtogs pa'i go skabs bral/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /brjod bral lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba sna tshogs la/ /'dzin med gnyug ma'i gnas lugs skyong thabs mkhas/ /snang stong sgyu mar shes pa'i rol rtsed mkhan/ /theg mchog bsgrod gcig lam la kho bo mos/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /zung 'jug lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro rnams don du tshe tshad snying rje yis/ /lus srog ma chags dmyal bar 'jug nus pa'i/ /rmad byung rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs po ches/ /ci byas gzhan don kho nar 'gyur bar shog /thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /gzhan phan phyogs mthar rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang btsun pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gyis/ /rang gi nges 'byung gi gsal 'debs su sbyar ro// ༈ //da ni lha'i gnas bshad par bya ste/ drug pa/ 'dod dang gzugs khams lha gnas la/ /sa dang 'brel dang ma 'brel dang / /zhar byung sems can khyad chos dang / /bar gyi thag tshad ngo yis bzung / /sa dang 'brel ba'i lha gnas la/ /gzhal med khang la brten pa dang / /ri rab la ni brten pa gnyis/ /gzhal med khang la rten pa la/ /nyi zla'i thag tshad nyi ma yin/ /gling la bya ba byed tshul dang / /dus tshigs rnam gzhag zhar las byung / /zla ba 'phel 'grib rgyu bstan no/ /zhes pa'i don la/ gzhung don dang spyi don gyis gtan la phab pa gnyis las/ dang po nyi zla'i thag tshad ni/ nyi zla gnyis mtho dman gyi tshad ni lhun po'i chu mtshams yan gyi phyed gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse dang mnyam pa na'o/

/de dag gi dkyil 'khor che chung gi tshad kyang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa/ /mtha' skor du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis brgya/ rngams su dpag tshad lnga dang gcig gi dgu cha lnga yod cing / dbyibs legs shing lta na sdug la chu shel las grub pa/ gser gyi ra bas bskor shing ra ba'i 'phang du dpag tshad phyed yod pa/ rtsig skyabs gser dang dngul dang baiḍūrya dang shel las byas pa/ gyen dang thur du mda' yab kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi 'og bzhi mtshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bkra pas shing bal ltar 'jam pa/ rkang pa bzhag pa na nem byed cing / bteg pa na 'phar byed pa/ me tog man ta ra bas pus mo nub pa tsam du khebs pa/ mi ma yin pa'i rlung gis me tog rnying pa rnams 'dor zhing / gsar pa rnams 'grems par byed pa/ lam srang gi chur dpag tshad lnga bcu zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon na rin po che las grub pa'i them skas dang / pha gu la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ chu sbrang rtsi lta bu'i gang zhing / me tog sna tshogs pa dang / bya skad snyan par sgrogs pa/ de dag gi nye 'khor na me tog dang 'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs skyes pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing sngon po dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi las de dag gis kha dog dang mthun pa'i gos 'byung ba/ rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang / 'khar rnga dang / hab shang rnams dang / rgyan sna tshogs/ lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dang / rgyan snang ba dang / mi snang ba rnams 'byung ba'i shing yod de/ lha'am/ lha'i bu mo rnams kyi ji lta bu'i 'dod pa'i sems skyed ma thag tu gang 'dod pa de lta bu rang gi lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa bzhi dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sbrang chang gi btung ba dag kyang yod do/ /yang thog rnams dang khang pa brtsegs pa rnams dang / khyim rnams dang /

khang bzangs rnams dang / bsil ba'i khang pa rnams dang / zam pa rnams bud med kyi tshogs kyis mdzes par byas shing / lha'i bu mang po'i rten pa dang / sil snyan dang pheg rdog dag gis sgra snyan par sgrogs pa dang / dri sna tshogs kyi legs par bsgos pa dang / kha zas dang btung ba dang ldan pa dag yod de/ de ltar lha'i bu zla ba 'khor dang bcas pa rtse zhing dga' mgur spyod pa rang gi las kyis 'bras bu nyams su myong bar byed do/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgya lnga bcu gsum dang bcas shing / rngams su/ mdo bzhag par/ dpag tshad lnga dang dpag tshad gcig gi dgu cha lnga yod par bshad/ rgyu me shel las grub pa/ gser gyi ra bas kun nas skor ba/ lam 'phrang gi chur dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa ra bas rtsigs skyabs nang gi sa gzhi dang / me tog gi sa gzhi dang / dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor pa rnams ni/ zla ba la ji ltar yod pa bzhin yod la/ longs spyod de dag la lha'i bu nyi ma 'khor dang bcas pas rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong bar byed de/ snga ma bzhin no/ /'di pa'i lugs la nyi zla gnyis ka dbyibs maṇḍal/ kha gyen du bstan pa lta bu yin shing / sa sde pa'i lugs la/ dbyibs zlum por yod tshul 'og nas 'chad do/ /skar ma che ba la rgyang grags bco brgyad/ chung ba la 'di ba'i lugs la rgyang grags gcig sa sde pa'i lugs la/ chung ba rgyang grags bzhi pa/ 'bring rnams bcu dang bcu gnyis pa yin/ grangs ni dung phyur gnyis/ bye ba brgyad/ sa ya lnga yod do/ /de ltar yang / dung gnyis bye brgyad sa ya lnga/ /skar ma'i grangs su shes par bya/ /che ba rgyang grags bco brgyad nas/ /chung ba rgyang grags bzhi'am gcig /phal cher bcu dang bcu gnyis pa/ /zhes pa ltar sbyar ro/ /skar ma thams cad dbyibs legs shing lta na sdug pa/ chu shel las grub pa/

gser gyi ra bas skor ba la sogs pa yon tan gyi rnam pa zla ba dang mtshungs so/ /gnyis pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gling la bya ba byed tshul ni/ 'degs byed kyi rlung gis bteg cing / 'phul byed kyis rlung gis skyod pas/ zhag re la nyi ma'i gling bzhi 'khor bar byed de/ de'i tshul yang / sgra mi snyan du nam phyed pa dang / lus 'phags por nyi ma nub pa dang 'dzam bu gling du nyi ma phyed pa dang / ba glang spyod du nyi ma 'char ba rnams dus gcig pa'o/ /gsum pa dus tshigs kyi rnam gzhag ni/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa khrum kyi zla ba yi tha ma mar ngo sngon du song ba'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la dbyar nyi ldog nas/ tshes dgu nas mtshan mo ring du 'gyur la/ de nas dgun zla rnams kyi bzhi pa dbo zla ba'i mar ngo sngon du song ba'i tha ma/ yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la dgun nyi zlog ste/ tshes dgu nas mtshan mo thung du 'gyur ro/ /nyin mo de dag las zlog ste/ mtshan mo ring la tshe thung ste/ thung bas tshe ring ngo / /'di'i skabs kyis rang 'grel sogs su/ dgun zla tha chung yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la dgun nyi zlog pa lta bur bshad kyang / dbyar nyi zlog pa'i tshig grogs kyi dbang gis bshad kyis/ don la mar ngo'i tshes brgyad la dgun nyi zlog srid kyang / yar ngo tshes brgyad la dgun nyi zlog pa mi srid pa'i rgyu mtshan 'og tu 'chad do/ /'o na nyi ma ji tsam gyi ring thung du 'gyur zhe na/ nyin mo'am/ mtshan mo ring bar 'gyur ba ni/ thang gcig re re dag go /des na nyin mtshan mnyam pa na/ yud tsam bco lnga dang / thung ba na bcu gnyis dang / ring ba na bco brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /de yang nyi ma lhor bgrod pa'i tshe mtshan mo ring zhing / byang du 'gro ba'i tshe nyin mo ring ste/ rim gyis 'char ba je dmar gyur pas mthong yun je thung dang / 'char ba je mthor gyur pas mthong yun je ring 'gyur bar dus 'khor bas so/ /kha cig thur la 'gro ba mgyogs shing /

gyen la 'gro ba bul ba yin par 'chad do/ /bzhag par/ dgun grang ba ni/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi dngos gzhi/ lho'i rgya mtshor babs pas te/ de'i dbang gis gting chu dro'o/ /sos ka tsha ba ni/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi dngos bzhi gling du babs pas te/ de'i dbang gis rgya mtsho grang bas gting chu grang bar bshad do/ /bzhi pa zhar byung zla ba 'phel 'grib kyi rgyu mtshan bstan pa ni/ 'o na zla ba mar ngo la 'grib yar ngo la 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ gdags par/ mar ngo la nyi ma dang je nye je nyer gyur pa las/ zla ba rang gi grib ma 'bab pas rim gyis 'grib cing / gnam gang gi tshe shin tu nye bas rang gi grib mas ril po 'grib par snang la/ yar ngo la nyi ma dang je ring du gyur pas grib ma je chung du gyur nas 'phel shing / nya'i tshe shin tu ring bas sgrib byed kyi dri ma med pa'i phyir ril po mthong bar bshad de/ sgron me la nye ring gi ka ba bzhin no/ /zhes pa ni/ chos 'di pa'i lugs yin la/ sa sde ltar na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyed nor bu chu shel las grub/ phyed baiḍūrya las grub pa de nyid steng 'og tu 'gyur ba'i dbang gis 'phel 'grib tu snang ste/ tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar la/ nor bu chu shel gyi phyogs de nyid 'og tu je che je cher cher song nas/ tshes bco lnga la nor bu chu shel gyi phyogs de nyid 'og tu gnas shing baiḍūrya'i phyogs de nyid steng du gnas/ bcu drug nas gnam gang gis bar la/ baiḍūrya'i phyogs de nyid 'og tu rgya ji cher song nas gnam gang la baiḍūrya'i phyogs de nyid 'og tu gnas/ nor bu chu shel gyi phyogs de nyid steng du gnas pa'i phyir/ sa sde las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni yud tsam gyi steng du 'dzur nas zla gam du snang ste/ de'i pha rol gyi ngos des bsgribs pas phyir mi snang ste/ ji lta ji ltar 'dzur ba de bzhin du/ de lta de ltar shin tu gang bar snang ngo /

/mar gyi ngo la ji lta ji ltar 'thur du 'dzur ba de lta de ltar 'grib pa snang ngo / /zhes bshad shing / nyi zla gnyis ka dbyibs zlum por bzhed do/ /'o na zla ba steng 'og tu 'dzur na/ lha'i bu zla ba mgo 'jug zlog pa'i skyon yod ce na/ skyon med de/ nyi ma dang zla ba ni lha'i bu de gnyis kyi 'og gzhi'i rten tsam yin la/ gzhal yas khang dngos ni/ 'og gzhi la ma reg pa'i tshul du yod pa'i phyir zhes zer/ zla ba'i nang gi nag po ra ri ni rgya mtsho'i nang gi nya dang rus sbal sogs kyi gzugs brnyan snang bar sa sder bshad cing / mdo gzhag par/ gling snang bas dbus rnyog cing / rgya mtsho snang bas mtha' dwangs par bshad/ skye rabs las/ brgya byin gyis ri bong gi gzugs bris pa ni 'thad par mngon no/ /'di'i skabs su dogs pa'i gzhi che ba 'di lta bu gcig 'byung ste/ sngon pa 'og ma pa'i lugs kyis zla ba 'phel 'grib kyi tshul 'di la/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir tshes bcu drug gi nam phyed yol tsam la zla ba la 'grib cha cung zad yod pa ste/ dus de'i tshe byang sgra mi snyan pa'i nyi ma phyed yol tsam gyi nyi ma'i 'od zer zla ba la phog par khas len dgos shing / de ni ha cang thal te/ ri rab ni shin tu rgya che ba'i dkyil nas nyi ma shin tu rgya chung bas 'od zer 'dzam bu gling gi dkyil du mi 'phog pa'i phyir/ mngon pa gong ma ba'i zla ba'i 'phel 'grib kyi tshul de yang mi 'thad de/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir zla ba'i mar ngo la/ nam mkha'i bai ḍūrya'i kha dog dang / zla ba'i bai ḍūrya'i kha dog 'dres pas mar ngo la zla ba 'grib cing / yar ngo la kha dog ma 'dres pas zla ba 'phel bar khas len na/ shar lus 'phags por yar ngo la zla ba 'grib cing mar ngo la zla ba 'phel bar khas len dgos te/ shar gyi nam mkha'i kha dog dkar po yod pa'i phyir dang / nub byang gnyis su ni kha dog gi khyad par tsam ma gtogs/

yar ngo mar ngo gnyis ka la zla ba rang so mthong ba ha cang thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ dogs pa 'di gnyis ni/ dang por skye dka' zhing / skyes nas chod dka' bas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa dag gis dpyod dgos la/ kho bos ni dogs pa gting nas bslangs te bkod pa yin no/ /nges pa'i don du ni/ 'di lta ste/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lhas/ /rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod/ /ces pa ltar/ zab mo'i rgyud sde dag gi dgongs pa ltar/ /nang gi khams dkar dmar 'phel 'grib kyi byed pas/ phyi rol du zla ba la 'phel 'grib byung bar nges so// //gnyis pa spyi don la/ don bshad kyis khog phub pa dang / tshig bshad kyis lhug par phral ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dus nyid ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ byung ba'i dus kyi dbye ba bshad/ /dus kyi thog ma ngo yis bzung / /dbyar dgun ston dpyid gzer bzhi dang / /dus bzhi ji ltar 'khor ba'i tshul/ /lo zla zhag gsum rnam gzhag dang / /de las shol nyid mdor tshul ni/ /rnam bshad 'di yis lus su gnas/ /dbye ba bzhi gsum lnga dang drug /bzhi ni dgun dpyid dbyar dang ston/ /mgo rgyal rta pa gsum po dgun/ /dbo dang nag pa sa ga dpyid/ /snron dang chu stod gro bzhin dbyar/ /khrums dang tha skar smin drug ston/ /gsum ni dgun dpyid dbyar dang gsum/ /gsum du dbye ba sngon 'dul gnyis/ /dbye tshul mi mthun mngon pa ba/ /smin drug mgo rgyal rta pa dgun/ /dbo dang nag pa snron pa dpyid/ /chu stod gro bzhin khrums tha dbyar/ /'dul bar gsum du dbye ba ni/ /mgo rgyal chu dang dbo ni dgun/ /nag pa snron dang chu stod dpyid/ /gro bzhin khrums tha smin drug dbyar/ /lnga dang drug tu dbye ba ni/ /gsum du dbye ba'i nang tshan no/ /de ltar dus tshigs rnam gzhag gi /ston dpyid gnyis po nges par 'gal/ /dbyar dgun gnyis la mu bzhi ste/

/mgo rgyal mchu dang dbo bzhi po/ /dgun zla yin gyi dbyar zla min/ /snron dang chu stod gro bzhin khrums/ /tha skar lnga ni dbyar kho na/ /yin gyi dgun zla min gyi mu/ /smin drug dbyar dgun gnyis ka'i mu/ /nag pa gnyis ka min pa'i mu/ /dus kyi thog ma ngos bzung ba/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las ni/ /dus mgo'i 'dzin tshul ma gsungs kyang / /'dir ni mngon 'dul dus 'khor dang / /rgya nag rtsis kyi lugs bzhi 'chad/ /'chad tshul dgag bzhag gnyis las ni/ /gzhan 'dod rnam grangs mang yod kyang / /rags pa tsam gcig 'dir brjod na/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po mchims la sogs/ /hor zla brgyad pa'i bcu drug nas/ /dgun zla brgyad pa'i mgo bzung ste/ /de nas mngon 'dul gnyis ka yis/ /dus mgo 'dzin par mthun zhes gsungs/ /de la dbyar gos btsal bzhag dang / /dbyar gyi khas len snga phyi dang / /dgag dbye srab rkyang gting dbyung gi /lag len bdun po zla res sngas/ gzhan yang mngon sum dag dang ni/ yid ches lung dang 'gal bas gnod/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug bu ston sogs/ /hor zla dgu pa'i bcu drug nas/ /bcu pa'i bco lnga'i bar la ni/ /smin drug ston zla tha chung dang / /dgun zla dang po'i mtshan gzhir bzung / /de nas mngon 'dul gnyis ka yis/ /dus mgo mthun par 'dzin zhes gsungs/ /de las zla ba'i ming 'dogs 'khrul/ /dbyar dgun nyi ma'i zlog mtshams la/ /khas blangs snga phyi'i 'gal bas gnod/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i skyes chen 'ga'/ /hor zla bcu pa'i bcu drug nas/ /bcu gcig pa yi bco lnga'i bar/ smin drug zla bar bzung nas ni/ /de nas mngon 'dul gnyis ka yi/ /dus mgo mthun par 'dzin zhes gsungs/ /deng sang gangs ri'i ljongs kyi ni/ /mngon 'dul smra ba phal mo che/ /lugs 'di'i rjes su 'brang bar byed/ tshul de rigs pas brtag pa na/ /dbyar gos btsal bzhag la sogs pa'i/ /lag len bdun po thams cad ni/

/zla ba re res nges par phyis/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po dbyig gnyen gyi/ /dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / /dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ thung du 'gyur ro nyin mo zlog /de skad gsungs phyir khyed la ni/ hor zla gnyis par dgun nyi zlog /hor zla brgyad par dbyar nyi zlog /dpyid kyi nyin mtshan dbyar la mnyam/ /ston gyi nyin mtshan dgun la mnyam/ /bab col khas len dgos pa de/ /mngon sum dag dang 'gal ba dang / /ha cang thal ba'i gnas su'ang mthong / /mkhas pa'i chig bgad khong nas 'chor/ /gal te mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi/ /lung gi dgongs pa dbyar dgun gyi/ /bgrod gnyis mtha' thug ma yin gyi/ /ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa yi/ /dus la nges par sbyor zhes gsungs/ /legs par bshad pa yin no zhes/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyis gyer por sgrog /de lta na ni bzhag pa yi/ /mdo dang gdags pa'i bstan bcos sogs/ /yid ches lung las sngar bshad kyis/ /dus gnyis dbyar dgun mthar thug la/ /sbyor tshul gsal por gsungs dang 'gal/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i skyes chen khyed/ /'jig rten rmongs pa'i grags pa la/ /brgal ma nus pa'i zur 'gros kyis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yi/ /yid ches lung la ma bsnyon cig /phyis kyi mngon 'dul smra ba yis/ /mkhas pa kha cig 'di skad lo/ /mngon 'dul gnyis ka mthun pa yi/ /dus mgo ston zla tha chung nas/ /'dzin par gsungs kyang tha chung de/ /gang la byed kyi nges med de/ /re 'ga' smin drug zla ba dang / /re 'ga' dbyug pa'i zla ba la/ /ston zla tha chung 'byung ba ni/ /rags pa'i rtsis kyi rnam gzhag yin/ /zhib mor brtsis na ston gyi ni/ /nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i phyi de nas/ /ston tha'i mgo ni 'dzin no zhes/ /skad gzengs mthon pos sgrog par byed/ /de lta na ni dus kyi mgo /'dzin pa'i mngon 'dul gzhung lugs rnams/ /mtha' gcig tu ni ma nges pas/

/lag len bdun po la sogs pa/ /thams cad 'chol bar 'gyur phyir dang / /rang lugs yid bstan thub pa yi/ /dus mgo ma rnyed the tshom gzhi/ /khyad par khyed 'dod zhib rtsis kyi/ /ston zla tha chung zla gcig la/ /mar ngo gnyis ni byung bas na/ /'di ni mkhas pa'i bzhad gad gnas/ /blun po'ang ha las gtam du byed/ /lugs 'di rna ba'i bdud rtsi min/ /sngar bshad phyogs snga smra ba po/ /thams cad mthun par mngon 'dul gnyis/ /dus mgo gcig tu 'khrul ba 'dis/ /mi mthun grub mtha' 'dres pa yi/ /kun brtags thag gu'i 'ching thag gis/ /dgun ra dgun zla dang po dang / /dgun zla gnyis pa'i gzhi mthun du/ /'gal ba 'dus pa'i khur chen ni/ /khyer bas a thang ma chad dam/ /phyogs 'dzin g.ya' dang bral ba yi/ /kho bo'i rnam dpyod me long la/ /lugs bzhi grub mtha'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal zhing / thun mong ma yin ma 'dres pa/ /gsal por shar tshul 'di lta ste/ /sngon 'dul dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /rgya nag rtsis kyi dus mgo rnams/ /'dzin tshul mi gcig so sor nges/ /sngon 'dul mar ngo sngon 'gro yi/ /sgo nas hor zla brgyad pa dang / /dgu pa'i bcu drug dag nas ni/ /rim bzhin dus mgo 'dzin par gsungs/ /dus 'khor rgya nag rtsis lugs la/ /yar ngo sngon 'gro'i sgo nas ni/ /bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i/ /rim bzhin yar tshes dang po nas/ /dus kyi mgo ni 'dzin par gsungs/ /rtsis kyi mdo byang chen mo na/ /kong jo 'khrul gyi bang mdzod las/ /hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas/ /dus mgo 'dzin zhes bshad pa'ang yod/ /rang lugs mngon pa'i dus kyi mgo /'dzin tshul bshad pa'i dam bca' la/ /yid ches khungs kyi sgrub byed bdun/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i sgrub byed gsum/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dus kyi mgo /'dzin tshul bshad pa'i dam bca' la/ /yid ches lung gi sgrub byed lnga/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i sgrub byed brgyad/

/kun brtags rmongs pa'i rtsod pa gsum/ /spangs te lugs gnyis dus kyi mgo /'dzin tshul ma 'dres 'khrul med grub/ /de nas gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul ni/ /dam chos mngon pa'i sde snod las/ /tha chung bzhi la gzer bzhi gsungs/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs las/ /'bring po bzhi la gzer bzhi gsungs/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /rgya nag rtsis kyis rgyud 'grel las/ /ra ba bzhi la gzer bzhi po/ /'byung bar gsungs kyang ra ba yi/ /ngos 'dzin mi gcig so sor nges/ /khyad par can gyis dogs pa'i phyir/ /lugs mchog bzhi po gzer bzhi yi/ /'byung tshul ming la ma mthun yang / /nges pa'i don du thams cad mthun/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid gzer bzhi po/ /dus tshigs gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ /rnam dpyod ldan pa'i blo gros can/ /rgya chen thos pas mi ngoms pa'i/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi mdo rgyud dang / /dgongs 'grel bstan bcos legs par mthong / /rgya chen gsung rab dpyod pa yi/ /spros pa'i tshogs kyis sgyid lug ste/ /tha snyad tshig dang ri mo la/ /ltos med tshig nyung don rgyas gnad/ /mkhas pa'i man ngag len 'dod na/ /byed grub phyi nang mthun pa yi/ /'bras bu gdan du bting nas ni/ /lhag chad 'phel 'grib ri bong can/ /dus kyi ma la 'grengs pa'i bu/ /'byung bas dbyar dgun slu med dang / /me me'i 'khor lo skor byed pa'i/ /rgyab rten ye shes las rlung gi /'phel 'grib dag la brten nas ni/ /gzer bzhi'i byung tshul 'khrul med 'grub/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /kun gyis shes na mkhas pa su/ /brda grol mkhas pa'i ngag la long / /don bshad khyung chen ldang thabs kyis/ /brjod bya'i gtso bo khog phub ste/ /dbang rnon blo gros mkha' la spyod/ /tshig bshad sbal pa'i nur 'gros kyis/ /zhib mo'i cha shas phral byas nas/ /dbang rtul 'dzin pa'i khyon la bgrod/ /gang 'dod lta ba'i me long gi

/bar ma la yang 'tshams pa 'dis/ /thar 'dod yongs kyis dga' ston gyis/ /zhes pa gzhon nu rol bas sdeb sbyor gyis go bde bar sbyar ba'o// ༈ //gnyis pa tshig bshad kyi lhug par phral ba la bdun las/ /dang po dus ji ltar du byung ba'i tshul ni/ sngar byung sems can gzugs can bzhin/ /des nas rim gyis ro la chags/ /zhes pa'i skabs su 'og nas 'chad pa ltar/ sngar bskal pa dang po'i sems can rnams gzugs can gyi lha bzhin lus rang 'od kyis 'tsho ba sogs yod pa las/ mi rkam chags can zhig gis sa'i zhag la longs spyad pa/ gzhan rnams kyis kyang de ltar byed pa byung bas/ lus kyi rang 'od nyams te mun par gyur zhing / smre sngags 'don pa las/ spyi mthun gyi las kyis nyi ma dang zla ba byung ste/ de nas dus kyi mgo brtsams so/ /gnyis pa dus kyi dbye ba la/ /dbye ba bzhi gsum lnga dang drug /ces pa ltar/ bzhi las dang po bzhir dbye ba la/ zla ba'i mtshan gzhi/ gsungs pa'i dgos pa/ shes byed kyi lung dang sbyar ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mgo rgyal rta pa gsum po dgun/ /dbo dang nag pa sa ga dpyid/ /snron dang chus stod gro zhun dbyar/ /khrums dang tha skar smin drug ston/ /zhes pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten pa dang mgo mthun par bya ba'i ched yin te/ 'jig rten pa la dus tshigs bzhir grags pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dbyar gyi skabs su dbyar gnas par khas blang bar bya'o/ /zla ba gsum du'o/ /tshes bcu drug la'o/ /dbyar zla 'bring po nya'i phyed de nyin bar gyi'o/ /dbyar zla tha chung nya'o zhes sogs kyis ston/ gnyis pa gsum du dbye ba la sngar ltar gsum las dang po ni/ gsum ni dgun dpyid dbyar dang gsum/ /gsum du dbye ba mngon 'dul gnyis/ /dbye tshul mi mthun mngon pa ba/ /smin drug mgo rgyal ta pa dgun/ /dbo dang nag pa snron pa dpyid/ /chu stod gro zhun khrums tha dbyar/

/'dul bar gsum du dbye ba ni/ /mgo rgyal mchu dang dbo ni dgun/ /nag pa snron dang chu stod dpyid/ /gro zhun khrums tha smin drug dbyar/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dman pa phyags dar khrod kyi gos ngos zin pa'i ched du dus tshigs gsum du gsungs pa yin te/ bzang kyang rung / ngan yang rung / zla ba bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi dus tshigs gcig tu longs spyad pa'i gos ni/ dman pa phyags dar khrod kyi gos yin par go ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni zla mchog gi spang ba 'chad pa'i skabs su/ dus tshigs su spyad pa las ni nyis 'gyur du 'ong / phyags dar khrod las byas pa dag ni nges pa med do/ /ces dang / mdzod du/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / /dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ /thung du 'gyur ro nyin mo bzlog /ces pas bstan no/ /gsum pa dang bzhi pa ni/ lnga dang drug tu dbye ba ni/ /gsum du dbye ba'i nang tshan yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ gsum du dbye ba'i nang tshan la/ lngar dbye ba dang / drug tu dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ zla ba'i mtshan gzhi sogs gsum las/ /dgun gyi dus zla ba bzhi/ dpyid kyi dus zla bzhi/ dbyar tsam zla ba gcig dbyar thung ngu nyin zhag gcig dbyar ring po nyin zhag gcig gis ma tshang ba'i zla ba gsum mo/ /dang po gnyis ni/ mgo rgyal mchu dang dbo ni dgun/ /nag pa snron dang chu stod dpyid/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /gro zhun gyi zla ba ni/ dbyar tsam gyi dus khrums kyi zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig ni dbyar thung ngu'i dus zhag gcig ma tshang ba'i khrums la sogs pa gsum ni/ dbyar ring po'i dus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbyar phyi ma khas len gyi dus ngo shes pa'i ched yin te/ dus tshigs lngar phye ba la brten nas dbyar thung ngu shi ba'i ro dang 'dra ba'i nyin zhag gcig po de dbyar phyi ma khas len gyi dus su go nus pa'i phyir/ dbyar thung ngu 'di la shi ba'i ro dang 'dra ba zhes bya ste/

shi lus la sems slar mi 'jug pa bzhin du/ dbyar snga ma khas ma blangs pa'i gang zag gis dbyar thung ngu nyin zhag gcig po de la dbyar phyi ma khas ma blangs na dbyar gzhan khas blang du med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de dag ni lnga'o/ /dgun gyi dus dang zhes sogs dang / 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa las/ /dgun dus dang ni dpyid ka dang / /dbyar dang thung ngu de bzhin du/ /ring po'i ming can du yang shes/ /'di dag dus ni rnam pa lnga/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug tu dbye ba la/ gsum las/ dang po ni/ mgo dang rgyal ni/ dgun stod kyi zla ba yin pa nas/ tha skar dang smin drug ni/ dbyar smad kyi zla ba gnyis pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni gso sbyong bzhag mi thub pa shes pa'i phyir dus tshigs la drug tu phye ba yin te/ dus tshigs re la zla ba gnyis gnyis yod pa'i zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das/ phyed lus pa'i tshe gso sbyong bzhag mi thub 'byung ba'i dus go nus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'dir nyin zhag gcig gis mi chog par bya'o/ /dus tshigs rnams kyi zla ba phyed lus pa nyid la'o/ /zhes dang / mdzod 'grel las/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi zhes sogs dang / rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga bcas/ zhes sogs kyis bstan no/ /de dag gi zhar byung ni/ de ltar dus tshigs rnam gzhag gis/ ston dpyid gnyis po nges par 'gal/ dbyar dgun gnyis la mu bzhi ste/ zhes sogs ni go sla'o/ /gsum pa dus kyi thog ma ngos bzung ba ni/ dus kyi thog ma ngos bzung ba/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las ni/ dus mgo'i 'dzin tshul mang gsungs kyang / 'dir ni mngon 'dul dus 'khor dang / rgya nag rtsis kyi lugs bzhi 'chad/ zhes pa ltar/ spyir mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las dus mgo'i 'dzin tshul dang / lugs bzhi'i dus mgo ji ltar du 'dzin tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jig rten lugs kyi dbang du byas pa/ mdo rgyud gzhan las gsungs tshul/

mngon 'dul las gsungs pa'i lugs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ hor rgyal po'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams dgun zla tha chung rta pa zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas dus mgo dang lo mgo 'dzin par bzhed/ bod rgyal po'i rjes 'brang ba rnams/ dgun zla 'bring po rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes gcig nas lo mgo 'dzin par bzhed/ gnyis pa ni/ gser 'od dam pa las/ dbyar zla ra ba snron gyi zla ba nas dus mgo 'dzin par bshad de/ zla gsum dbyar te zla gsum ston du shes/ /gsum ni dgun yin/ gsum ni dpyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ dgun zla 'bring po nas lo mgo dang / dus mgo 'dzin par bzhed de/ dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams nas/ nyi ma byang du bgrod pa'i dus/ zla ba rnam pa bcu gnyis ni/ rim bzhin rim pa bzhin du bzhag ces dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las kyang / de dang mthun par bshad/ gsum pa mngon 'dul nas gsungs tshul 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa lugs bzhi'i dus mgo ji ltar 'dzin tshul la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po mchims la sogs/ /hor zla brgyad pa'i bcu drug nas/ /dgun zla ra ba'i mgo bzung ste/ /de nas mngon 'dul gnyis ka yis/ /dus mgo 'dzin par mthun zhes gsungs/ /de la dbyar gos btsal bzhag dang / /dbyar gyi khas len snga phyi dang / dgag dbye srab rkyang gding byung gi /lag len bdun po zla res sngas/ /gzhan yang mngon sum dag dang ni/ /yid ches lung dang 'gal bas gnod/ /ces pa ltar/ /'dul ba snga rabs phal cher dang / mchims rjes 'brang dang bcas pa na re/ brgyad pa'i bcu drug nas dgun zla ra bar byas nas dus mgo 'dzin pa yin te/ rgyal sras ma las/ sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi dus kyi dang po ni/ dgun no zhes bshad la/ dgun gyi dang po ni de yin pa'i phyir te/ dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ thung du 'gyur ro nyin mo zlog

ces dgun zla bzhi pa la dgun nyi zlog par bshad la/ de zla ba bcu gcig pa'i bcu gcig nas bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga pa'i bar la zlog par nges pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ brgyad pa nas mgo bzung ba'i dgun zla bzhi pa de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang lo mgo de rigs te/ ston zla ra ba dang / dpyid zla ra ba la/ dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma zlog par bshad pa'i phyir te/ gdags pa las/ ston zla ra ba yar gyi tshes brgyad la nyin mo yud tsam bco brgyad/ mtshan mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis so/ /ces dang / mdo las/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yis/ tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / zhes dang / rgyal sras ma las/ de la ston zla ra ba'i yar gyi ngo'i tshes dgu nas mtshan mo ring bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ des na lugs ji ltar gzhag pas/ dgun zla bzhi pa dang / dpyid zla ra ba dang / dgun nyi zlog pa'i zla ba gsum don gcig dbyar zla gnyis pa/ ston dang / dbyar gyi nyi ma zlog pa'i zla ba gsum don gcig go /zhes 'dod do/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ lugs de la dbyar gyi gos ras chen btsal ba dang 'jog pa/ dbyar snga phyi khas len/ dgag dbye bya ba/ srab rkyang gding ba dbyung ba'i lag len bdun po/ zla ba re res sngas pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir dang / mngon sum dang 'gal ba dang / yid ches pa'i lung dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de khyed kyi lugs la/ dbyar khas len zla ba bzhi pa la byed dgos pa'i/ ras chen de'i gong zla ba gcig nas btsal dgos la/ zla ba gsum pa la char skyobs mi dgos pa dang / dbyar sgang zla ba lnga par 'dod dgos pas/ de char sgang gi dus ma yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du/ chu stod la dbyar snga ma khas len dang / gro zhun la phyi ma khas len dgos pas blangs na/ gro zhun zla ba'i tshes gcig nas/ /snga ma'i dbyar de gtso bo yin/ /de nyid khrums kyi zla ba yi/ /tshes gcig la ni phyi mar grags/ /zhes pa dang 'gal ba dang /

rgyu mtshan des na dgag dbye zla ba gcig gis sngas pa dang / srab rkyang gding ba dang / dbyung ba tha skar nas mchu'i bar byed par khas len dgos la/ blangs na/ smin drug nas ni khra yi bar/ /srab rkyang gding bar rjes su gnas/ /zhes pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ mngon sum du yang 'gal te/ rtsi shing me tog gi dus dpyid/ char sgang la dbyar/ 'bras bu rnams rgyas pa la ston/ grang ba'i dus la dgun du 'jog pa gang zhig khyed 'dod pa'i dpyid zla'i nang du me tog dang / dbyar zla'i nang du char sgang 'byung ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /lung dang yang 'gal te/ rgya cher rol pa las/ dpyid zla tha chung gi tshe skar ma sa ga ma bab pa'i dus kyi tshes la shing rnams kyi lo ma dang me tog rgyas shing / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'grel pa rgyal sras ma'i 'gyur ma dag pa'i tshul 'og nas 'chad do/ /gzhan yang / mkhyen rab dbang phyug bu ston sogs/ hor zla dgu pa'i bcu drug nas/ /bcu pa'i bco lnga'i bar la ni/ /smin drug ston zla tha chung dang / /dgun zla dang po'i mtshan gzhir bzung / /de nas mngon 'dul gnyis ka yis/ /dus mgo mthun par 'dzin zhes gsungs/ /de la zla ba'i ming 'dogs 'khrul/ /dbyar dgun nyi ma'i zlog mtshams 'chugs/ /khas blangs snga phyi 'gal bas gnod ces pa ltar/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug bu ston rjes 'brang dang bcas pa na re/ hor zla dgu pa'i bcu drug nas/ mngon 'dul gnyis ka'i lugs kyis dus mgo 'dzin te/ ston zla tha chung nas dus mgo 'dzin par gsungs pa gang gis/ dgu pa'i bcu drug nas/ bcu pa'i bco lnga'i bar ston zla tha chung yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ ston zla 'bring po'i ngo la ni/ /lo skor bdag gis brjod par bya/ /zla ba bcu gnyis bshad pa yin/ /zhes ston zla 'bring pos lo snga ma rdzogs par bshad pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ dgu pa'i bcu drug nas bcu pa'i bco lnga'i bar/

smin drug gi zla ba yin zhing / zla ba de ston zla tha chung du bshad pa'i phyir te/ mdo de nyid las/ bdag gis rgyu skar smin drug brjod/ /zla ba nya tshe zla grangs gyur/ /ston zla tha chung zhes bya ba/ /'di ni rab tu brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar rtsis pas dbo'i zla ba la dgun nyi zlog ste/ mdo nyi snying las/ zla grangs tshes bco lnga la dbo/ /'dir ni dpyid zla ra ba yi/ /rang bzhin yang ni brjod par bya/ /byang phyogs su ni kha bltas nas/ /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /'o na khyed rang gi lugs la/ hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu drug nas gnyis pa'i bco lnga'i bar dbo'i zla ba yin la/ de la dgun nyi zlog pa mi srid pas 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ drang srong rnga bong nas/ sangs rgyas byon gyi bar la dgun nyi zlog pa zla ba gcig gis snga bar song zhing / sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar la zhag bcu gsum gyi snga bar song ba'i phyir/ 'on kyang dbyar nyi ston ra dang / dgun nyi dpyid ra la zlog pa mthun te/ mdo nyi snying las/ bdag gis ston ra'i rims spyod bya/ /lho phyogs nyi ma'i 'khor lo zlog /ces dang / mdo las dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / /dgu rnams kyis ni bzhi pa las/ /thung du 'gyur ro nyin mo zlog /ces dang / gdags par/ ston zla ra ba'i yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad la/ nyin mo yud tsam bco brgyad mtshan yud tsam bcu gnyis so/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dgag pa ni/ khog phub ltar skyon gsum las/ dang po ni/ khyed kyi lugs de la smin drug gi zla ba'i ming 'dogs 'khrul te/ brgyad pa'i bcu drug nas/ dgu pa'i bco lnga'i bar la smin drug gi zla bar mdo las gsungs tshul 'og nas 'chad pa'i phyir/ skyon gnyis pa/ dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma'i zlog mtshams yang 'chugs pa'i skyon yod ste/ dgun nyi zlog pa rim bzhin snga ru 'gro na/

nam zhig dbyar dus su dgun nyi zlog par khas len dgos pa'i phyir/ skyon gsum pa khas blangs na'ang 'gal ba'i skyon yod de/ sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar dgun nyi zlog pa zhag bcu gsum gyis snga bar song na/ rnga bong nas sangs rgyas kyi bar zla ba gcig gi snga bar song na/ rnga bong nas sangs rgyas kyi bar dgun nyi zlog pa zla gcig gis snga bar song ba 'gal ba'i phyir/ des na gdags pa'i lugs de 'gyur ma dag pa yin te/ dbyar zla tha chung la dbyar nyi zlog par bshad pa'i phyir/ de ni rang lugs su lta bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang mdzod gzhung ltar/ dgun zla bzhi pa la dgun nyi zlog par khas len na/ khyed rang gi dgun zla dang po/ zla ba bcu pa'i bcu drug nas/ bcu gcig pa'i bco lnga'i bar yin pas/ dgun zla bzhi pa/ zla ba dang po'i bcu drug nas/ gnyis pa'i bco lnga'i bar yin par khas len dgos la/ de la dgun nyi zlog pa shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir/ skyon med de/ da ltar mi srid kyang sangs rgyas kyi dus su srid pa gang zag gi mdzod las bshad pa de sangs rgyas kyi dus kyi dbang du byas pa'i phyir snyam na/ 'o na khyed rang gis sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar la zhag bcu gsum gyi dgun nyi zlog pa sngar song bar khas blangs pas/ sangs rgyas kyis dus su zla ba dang po'i mar ngo'i tshes brgyad tsam la zlog la/ de nas zhag bcu gsum gyis snga bar song na/ zla ba dang po'i zla stod du zlog cing / khyed rang gis dpyid ra la zlog par bshad pa dang nang 'gal lo/ /des na mkhyen rabs kyi dbang phyug dag legs par brtags nas gsung 'tshal lo/ /phyogs snga ma gzhan yang / skad gnyis smra ba'i skyes chen 'ga'/ /hor zla bcu pa'i bcu drug nas/ /bcu gcig pa yis bco lnga'i bar/ /smin drug zla bar bzung nas ni/ /de nas mngon 'dul gnyis ka yis/ /dus mgo mthun par 'dzin zhes gsungs/ /deng sang gangs ri'i ljongs kyis ni/ /mngon 'dul smra ba phal po che/
