/lugs 'di'i rjes su 'brang bar byed/ /ces pa ltar/ spang lo chen po lo grags/ da lta'i mngon 'dul ba phal che ba hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug nas bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar/ smin drug gi zla bar bzung nas/ de nas mngon 'dul gnyis ka mthun par dus mgo 'dzin par bzhed de/ de yang spang lo na re/ der 'jig rten pa dang mi 'dra bar lo gcig la dus tshigs gsum ste/ smin drug gi nya nas bzung nas/ mgo rgyal mchu dbo'i bar ni dgun no/ /de'i nya nas nag pa sa ga snron chu stod kyi nya'i bar dpyid/ de'i nya nas gro zhun khrums tha skar smin drug gi nya ba'i bar ni dbyar yin/ de la dbyar gyi gnyis pa'i tha ma khrums smad kyi yar ngo'i tshes dgu la ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam shing / de nas mtshan mo ring ngo / /de nas zla ba gsum song ba mgo'i yar ngo'i tshes dgu la dgun nyi zlog la/ dgun gyi bzhi pa'i tha ma/ dbo'i yar ngo'i tshes dgu la dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam ste/ de nas mtshan mo thung zhing / de nas zla ba gsum song ba snron gyi tshes dgu la dbyar nyi zlog ste/ mdzod las/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ zhes sogs bshad pas so/ /des na 'di nyi zlog la sbyor ba mi rigs so gsung / de dang mthun par lo grags kyis kyang bshad do/ /de 'gog pa ni de tshul rigs pas brtag pa na/ smin drug zla ba'i mtshan gzhi nor/ dbyar gos btsal bzhag la sogs pa'i/ lag len bdun po thams cad ni/ /zla ba re res nges par phyis/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po dbyig gnyen gyis/ /dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / /dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ /thung du 'gyur ro nyin mo zlog /de ltar gsungs phyir khyed la ni/ /hor zla gnyis par dgun nyi zlog /hor zla brgyad par dbyar nyi zlog /dpyid kyi nyin mtshan dbyar la mnyam/ /ston gyi nyin mtshan dgun la mnyam/ /bab col khas len dgos pa ste/

mngon sum dag dang 'gal ba dang / ha cang thal ba'i gnas su'ang mthong / mkhas pa'i chig bgad khong nas 'chor/ /gal te mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi/ /lung gi dgongs pa dbyar dgun gyi/ /bgrod gnyis mthar thug ma yin gyi/ /ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa yi/ /dus la nges par sbyor zhes gsung / /legs par bshad pa yin no zhes/ /rje 'jug rnams kyis gyer por sgrog /de ltar na ni bzhag pa yi/ /mdo dang gdags pa'i bstan bcos sogs/ /yid ches lung la sngar bshad kyi/ /dus gnyis dbyar dgun mthar thug la/ /sbyor tshul gsal por gsungs dang 'gal/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i skye chen khyed/ /'jig rten rmongs pa'i grags pa las/ /brgal ma nus pa'i zur 'gros kyis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yi/ /yid ches lugs pa ma bsnyon gcig /ces pa ltar/ smin drug zla ba'i mtshan gzhi nor tshul 'og nas 'chad cing / dbyar gos btsal bzhag sogs kyi lag len bdun po zla ba re res nges par phyis pa ral ba'i skyon yod de/ khyed kyi lugs la hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug nas/ bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba la/ dbyar zla tha chung ngu khas len dgos shing / khas blangs na dbyar snga ma dbyar zla tha chung la khas len par 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs nas shin tu gsal bar gsungs pas/ khyod kyi lugs kyis lag len bdun po de/ /zla ba re res nges par phyis pa'i phyir/ /gzhan yang khyed kyi lugs la/ hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu drug nas gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba de la dgun nyi zlog par thal/ dgun zla bzhi pa la dgun nyi zlog par mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen sogs kyis gsungs pa gang zhig khyed kyi lugs la dang po'i bcu drug nas gnyis pa'i bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba de dgun zla bzhi par khas len dgos pa'i phyir/ mdor na dgun gyi nyi ma dpyid dus su zlog pa khas len dgos pa dang / rigs pa gzhan yang /

hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug nas brgyad pa'i bco lnga'i bar la dbyar nyi zlog par thal/ zla ba de khyed kyi lugs la/ dbyar zla gnyis pa yin pa gang zhig dbyar zla gnyis pa la dbyar nyi zlog par/ mngon pa'i mdo bstan bcos rnams las gsal por gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs pa gzhan yang / hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu drug nas lnga pa'i bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba la dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam par thal/ zla ba khyed kyi lugs kyi dpyid zla tha chung yin par gang zhig dpyid zla tha chung la dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung ba mngon pa'i gzhung lugs nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs pa gzhan yang / hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug nas bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba 'di la ston nyin mtshan mnyam par 'byung bar thal/ zla ba de khyed kyi lugs la ston zla tha chung yin pa gang zhig ston zla tha chung la ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung bar mngon pa'i gzhung lugs las gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma ston dpyid kho na la zlog ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan dbyar dgun kho na la mnyam par khas len/ dgos pa sogs babs bcol du khas len dgos pa dang / mngon sum dang 'gal zhing ha cang thal ba'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /gal te dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi lung gi don/ dbyar zla gnyis pa dang dgun zla bzhi pa la dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma zlog pa ma yin gyis/ zla ba gnyis po de la ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung ba la dgongs pa'i phyir zhe na/ de ni shin tu yang mi 'thad de/ nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo/ 'jig rten bzhag pa'i mdo/ 'jig rten gdags pa'i bstan bcos sogs/ yid ches kyi lung shin tu mang ba las/ dbyar zla gnyis pa dbyar zla tha chung gi zla ba la dbyar nyi ring ba'i mthar thug dbyar nyi zlog pa 'byung ba dang / dgun zla bzhi pa dgun zla tha chung gi zla ba la dgun nyi thung ba'i mthar thug dgun nyi zlog pa 'byung ba shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir te/

nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las mchu'i zla ba rab rdzogs byed/ /dgun zla tha chung rang bzhin yin/ mtshan mo bco brgyad shes par gyis/ /nyin bar yang ni bcu gnyis yin/ /zhes dang / zla ba rang la gro bzhin no/ /de la dgun zla tha chung dang / dbyar nyi gang la zlog pa'i zla ba de la/ zla ba gang las byung yang dbyar zla tha chung yin par byed dgos te/ gdags pa dang / mdzod kyi rang 'grel dang / phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rnams su dgun gyi zla ba bzhi pa dang / dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa la dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma zlog pa dang / de gnyis kyang dbyar dgun gyi tha chung gnyis la bshad pa dang / ston dpyid kyi tha chung gnyis la nyin mtshan mnyam par bshad pa'i phyir dang / zhes bshad pa dang / yang 'o na ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa de/ zla ba gang la 'byung zhe na/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa med la/ phal cher hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad nas hor zla dgu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyi ma gang yang rung ba gcig la 'byung bar nges pas/ res 'ga' hor zla brgyad pa khrums kyi nya ba la ston zla chung dang / res 'ga' hor zla dgu pa dbyug pa'i nya ba la ston zla tha chung 'byung ba'ang srid te/ dus de dag tu ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung srid pa'i phyir/ zhib mor brtsis na ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa byung ba'i nyi ma de phan chad ston zla 'bring por byed cing / de'i phyi nyin nas/ ston zla tha chung du byed dgos zer ba bris so/ /de 'gog pa ni/ de lta na ni dus kyi mgo /'dzin pa'i mngon 'dul gzhung lugs rnams/ /mtha' gcig tu ni ma nges pas/ /lag len bdun po la sogs pa/ /thams cad 'chol bar 'gyur phyir dang / /rang lugs yid brtan thub pa yi/ /dus mgo ma rnyed the tshom gzhi/ /khyad par khyed 'dod zhib rtsis kyi/ /ston zla tha chung zla gcig la/ /mar ngo gnyis ni byung bas na/ /'di ni mkhas pas bzhad gad gnas/ /blun po'ang ha las gtam du byed/

/lugs 'di rna ba'i bdud rtsi min/ /zhes pa ltar/ lugs de la dbyar gos btsal bzhag sogs kyi lag len bdun po rnams mtha' gcig tu dus 'di la 'byung gi nges pa med pas/ dbyar gnas pa khas blang bar bya'o/ /zla ba gsum du'o/ /tshes bcu drug la'o/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya'i phyi de'i nyin bar gyi'o/ /zhes sogs lag len bdun po zla ba dang tshes grangs nges pa can du ston pa'i 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs thams cad mtha' gcig tu nges med yid brtan mi thub pa'i lung du thal ba'i phyir/ des na khyed rang gi lugs la/ zla ba 'di zhes bya ba'i tshes grangs 'di zhes bya ba nas dus mgo 'dzin zhes pa'i mtshan gzhi dang rgyab rten gyi lung ma rnyed pas/ rang lugs kyi grub mtha' the tshom gyi dpyad gzhir song ngo / /gnod byed gzhan yang khyed 'dod pa'i zhib rtsis ltar na hor zla brgyad pa'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu'am/ 'jig rten pa ltar gyi nyer lnga la ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa byung dus/ de'i phyi de nas bzung ste/ hor zla dgu pa'i nyer lnga'i bar khyed 'dod pa'i ston zla tha chung yin la/ de lta na ni zla ba gcig la mar ngo gnyis 'byung dgos te/ bshad ma thag pa'i khyed kyi ston zla tha chung de la/ hor zla brgyad pa'i mang ngo gcig dang / hor zla dgu pa'i mang ngo gcig ste mar ngo gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /hai/ mkhas pa chen po dag thugs la skyengs kha byung ba bzod par bzhes 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang gong gi phyogs snga smra ba po de dag la/ thung mong du 'jug pa'i skyon ni 'di ltar/ sngar bshad phyogs snga smra ba po/ /thams cad mthun par mngon 'dul gnyis/ /dus mgo gcig tu 'khrul pa 'dis/ /mi mthun grub mtha' bsres pa yi/ /kun btags thag gu'i 'ching thag gis/ /dgun ra dgun zla dang po dang / /dgun zla gnyis pa'i gzhi mthun du/ /'gal ba 'dus pa'i khur chen ni/ /khyer bas a thang ma chad dam/ /ces pa ltar/

sngar bshad pa'i phyogs snga smra ba po thams cad zhal 'cham par/ mngon 'dul gnyis ka dus mgo 'dzin tshul mtha' gcig tu mthun par khas len na/ dgun zla ra ba de dgun zla dang po dang / dgun zla gnyis pa'i gzhi mthun du thal/ mngon pa ba'i lugs la dgun zla ra ba de dgun zla gnyis pa dang / 'dul ba'i lugs la/ dgun zla dang po yin pa gsal por gsungs shing / khyed kyi lugs la mngon 'dul gnyis ka dus mgo 'dzin tshul mthun par khas blangs pa'i phyir/ mngon 'dul gnyis las de ltar gsungs tshul ni/ 'og tu lung dang sbyar te 'chad do/ /gnyis pa rang gi lugs ni/ phyogs 'dzin g.ya' dang bral ba yi/ /kho bo'i rnam dpyod me long la/ /lugs bzhi grub mtha'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal shing / /thun mong ma yin ma 'dres pa/ /gsal por shar tshul 'di lta ste/ /mngon 'dul dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /rgya nag rtsis kyi dus mgo rnams/ /'dzin tshul mi gcig so sor nges/ /mngon 'dul mar ngo sngon 'gro yi/ /sgo nas hor zla brgyad pa dang / /dgu pa'i bcu drug dag nas ni/ /rim bzhin dus mgo 'dzin par gsungs/ /dus 'khor rgya nag rtsis lugs la/ /yar ngo sngon 'gro'i sgo nas ni/ /bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i/ /rims bzhin yar tshes dang po nas/ /dus kyi mgo ni 'dzin par gsungs/ /rtsis kyi mdo byang chen mo dang / /kong jo 'khrul gyi bang mdzod las/ /hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas/ /dus mgo 'dzin ces bshad pa'ang yod/ /rang lugs mngon pa'i dus kyi mgo /'dzin tshul bshad pa'i dam bca' las/ /yid ches lung gis sgrub byed bdun/ /dngos stobs rigs pas sgrub byed gsum/ /'dul ba rgya mtshos dus kyi mgo /'dzin tshul bshad pa'i dam bca' la/ /yid ches lung gi sgrub byed lnga/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i sgrub byed brgyad/ /kun brtags rmongs pa'i rtsod pa gsum/ /spangs te lugs gnyis dus kyi mgo

/'dzin tshul ma 'dres 'khrul med grub/ /ces pa ltar/ rang gi lugs hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug nas/ dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar ston zla tha chung smin drug gi zla ba/ dgun zla dang po gsum gyi mtshan gzhir bzung nas/ /de nyid nas dus mgo 'dzin pa la/ /yid ches lung gi sgrub byed bdun yod de/ /nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo/ /'jig rten bzhag pa'i mdo/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos/ /phyogs glang gi 'grel pa/ mdzod rtsa 'grel gnyis/ 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma sogs las gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar gsungs na/ mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ smin drug gi zla ba de/ ston zla tha chung yin pa/ zla ba de'i nang du ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung ba/ nyi ma'i 'khris la grib ma gom drug 'khor ba/ tha skar gyis mtshan skyel ba/ nyi ma skar ma lha mtshams dang / 'grogs shing gdong mig dmar la lta ba ste/ khyad chos lnga ldan du gsungs shing / de lta ba'i khyad chos lnga ldan du zla ba de/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug nas/ dgu'i tshe bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba kho na la 'byung gi zla ba kun la 'byung ba'i mi srid pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ mdo nyi snying las/ bdag gis rgyu skar smin drug brjod/ /zla ba nya tshe zla grangs gyur/ /ston zla tha chung zhes bya ba/ /'di ni rab tu brjod pa yin/ /zhes dang / zla nya zla ba dwangs pa'i tshe/ /smin drug kyang ni 'gro bar gyis/ /lha dang lha min drang srong rnams/ /byed pa gang gis sngar bstan bzhin/ /zhag ni sum cu zla ba dang / /nyin dang mtshan ni mnyam pa de/ /yud tsam bco lnga bco lnga yin/ /grib ma gom drug 'dir kun 'khor/ /tha skar gyis ni mtshan mo thob/ /nyi ma'i mdun na lha mtshams te/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor mig dmar yin/ zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ ston zla 'bring po'i ngo la ni/ /lo skor dag gis brjod par bya/ /zla ba bcu gnyis bshad pa yin/ /zhes/ ston zla 'bring po'i lo snga ma'i zla ba bcu gnyis po rdzogs pa dang /

ston zla tha chung lo phyi ma'i zla ba dang por gsungs pa'i phyir/ lung gnyis pa 'jig rten bzhag pa'i mdo las/ ston zla tha chung la/ ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa sogs kyis gzer bzhi gsungs pas kyang 'grub ste/ mdo bzhag pa las/ ston zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad la/ mtshan mo yang yud tsam bco lnga/ nyin mo yang yud tsam bco lnga yod do/ /zhes gsungs shing / ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i zla ba de smin drug gi zla ba ru/ mdo snga mas bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir/ lung gsum pa gdags pa'i bstan bcos/ lung bzhi pa kha che 'dus pa bzang po'i lung / lung lnga pa dang / drug pa/ mdzod rtsa 'grel gyi lung / lung bdun pa/ 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma/ lung brgyad pa phyogs glang gi 'grel pa rnams las kyang sngar gyi mdo gnyis dang mthun par gsungs shing gsung tshul 'og tu gzer bzhi'i skabs su 'chad do/ /gnyis pa rigs pa'i sgrub byed gsum ni/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug nas mngon pa lugs kyi lo mgo 'dzin tshul 'thad de/ dus de nas grang du 'gro ba'i 'go rtsom zhing / grang dus la dgun du 'jog pa dang / dus de nas bzung ba'i dgun zla bzhi pa/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga yan gyi rdzogs shing / de nas drod skye ba'i mgo rtsom pa dang / tha chung bzhi la gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul gsungs pas kyang 'grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'dul ba'i lugs ni/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dus kyi mgo /'dzin tshul bshad pa'i dam bca' la/ /yid ches lung gi sgrub byed lnga/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i sgrub byed brgyad/ ces pa ltar/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu drug nas bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba de/ dgun zla dang po/ dgun zla ra ba/ mgo'i zla ba gsum gyis mtshan gzhi bzung nas/ de nyid nas 'dul ba'i lugs kyi lo mgo dang dus mgo 'dzin pa la yid ches kyi lung lnga yod de/ so thar gyi 'grel pa/ dge slong gi lo dri/

bam po lnga bcu pa/ rgya cher 'grel/ phran tshegs kyi ṭika sogs las gsal por gsungs pa'i phyir lung dang po ni/ so thar 'grel pa las/ dus kyi mgo ston zla tha chung nya la zug pa nas/ mtha' lhag ni bcu gnyis pa'i gso sbyong ste/ de'i phyi de'i lo'i ston zla tha chung nya la thug gi bar du'ang / de bzhin du ni rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / lung gnyis pa ni/ dge slong gi lo dri las/ dus du yod ce na lnga'o/ /lnga po dag gang zhe na/ dgun dang / sos ka dang / dbyar dang / thung ngu dang / dbyar ring po zhes bya'o/ /de la dgun gyi dus ji tsam zhe na zla ba bzhi'o/ /bzhi po gang zhe na/ dgun zla ra ba dang / dgun zla 'bring po dang / dgun zla tha chung dang / dpyid zla ra ba zhes bya'o/ /sos ka'i dus ji tsam zhe na zla ba bzhi'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ dpyid zla 'bring po dang / dpyid zla tha chung dang / dbyar zla ra ba dang / dbyar zla 'bring po dag go /dbyar gyi dus ji tsam zhe na zla ba gcig ste/ dbyar zla tha chung ngo / /dbyar thung ngu'i tshad ni ji tsam zhe na nyin zhag gcig ste/ nyin zhag gcig po gang zhe na/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin zhag go /dbyar ring po'i tshad ji tsam zhe na/ nyin zhag de ma tshang ba'i zla ba gsum mo/ /zla ba gsum po de gang zhe na/ ston zla ra ba/ ston zla 'bring po/ ston zla tha chung ngo / /zhes dgun zla ra ba dang / dgun zla dang po don gcig tu gsal por gsungs pa dang / lung gsum pa ni bam po lnga bcu pa las/ dgun stod kyi dus tshigs ni/ ston zla tha chung nya nas dgun zla ra ba'i nya'i bar dang / dgun zla ra ba'i nya nas dgun zla 'bring po'i nya'i zla ba gnyis so/ /dgun smad kyi dus tshigs ni/ dgun zla 'bring po'i nya nas dgun zla tha chung gi nya'i bar dang / dgun zla tha chung gi nya nas dpyid zla ra ba'i nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis po zhes dgun zla ra ba nas 'dul ba'i lugs kyi dgun zla dang po'i mgo bzung ba dang /

lung bzhi pa dang / lnga pa ni/ de ji lta ba bzhin du rgya cher 'grel las kyang / dus tshigs drug po dgun dang dgun smad dang / dpyid dang sos ka dang / dbyar dang ston rnams la zla ba gnyis gnyis yod de/ ston zla tha chung nya nas/ dgun zla 'bring po'i nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni/ dgun gyi dus tshigs so/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i nya nas dpyid zla ra ba'i nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni dgun smad kyi dus tshigs so/ /zhes dang / phran tshegs kyi ṭīka las kyang / de dang mthun par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lugs 'di la dngos stobs kyi rigs pa'i sgrub byed brgyad yod de/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen btsal ba dang bzhag pa/ dbyar snga ma dang phyi ma khas len/ dgag dbye/ srab kyang 'dings ba dang / dbyung ba'i dus 'bring po bzhi la 'dul ba'i gzer bzhi 'byung tshul rnams mthong ba rgyud pa'i lag len dang mthun par 'grig pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ lugs gnyis bsres pa'i rtsod pa gsum/ spangs te lugs gnyis dus kyi mgo /'dzin tshul ma 'dres 'khrul med grub/ ces pa ltar/ rtsod pa dang po ni/ mngon 'dul gnyis dus mgo so sor 'dzin pa mi 'thad de/ mkhas pa phal cher gyi de gnyis dus mgo gcig tu bshad pa dang / sngar zla ba brgyad pa nas dus mgo 'dzin pa'i phyogs la/ skyon brjod pa thams cad rang la'ang mtshungs pa dang / rang gis khas blangs nang yang 'gal ba'i skyon gsum yod pa'i phyir/ nang 'gal gyi skyon yod de/ mdzod 'grel las/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das kyi/ zla ba phyed ni lus pa na/ mkhas pas zhag mi thub pas dor/ zhes dgun stod kyi zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das phyed lus pa'i skabs su/ dgun stod kyi gso sbyong zhag mi thub 'byung bar gsungs shing / khyed ltar na brgyad pa'i bcu drug nas dgun stod kyi mgo bzung bas/ hor zla dgu pa'i gnam gang la/

dgun stod kyi gso sbyong zhag mi thub 'byung bar khas len dgos la/ khas blangs na/ rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga bcas/ /chu stod khrums smad smin drug bcas/ /'di rnams kyi ni nag po'i phyogs/ /zla phyed gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa/ /zhes bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir zhe na/ rtsod pa dang pos mi gnod de/ de ni mngon 'dul gyi grub mtha' mi mthun pa gcig tu bsres pa'i rtsod pa yin pas/ gong du 'gal ba'i khur chen gyi skabs su bkag zin to/ /rtsod pa gnyis pas mi gnod de/ nged kyi lugs la/ mar ngo sngon 'gro'i hor zla brgyad pa nas mngon pa'i lugs kyi dus mgo 'dzin yang / de ston zla tha chung du 'dod pas/ dus bzhi 'chugs pa'i skyon med pa/ mchims sogs kyis zla ba de dgun zla ra bar mdzad pas/ zla ba re res dus bzhi 'chugs pa'i skyon 'byung ba'i phyir/ rtsod pa gsum pas mi gnod de/ nyan thos sde ba'i grub mtha' mngon pas 'chad/ lag len 'dul bas 'chad ces snga rabs mkhas pa dag gsung ba ltar/ gso sbyong sogs gzhi gsum gyi lag len cha lag dang bcas pa byed pa'i dus 'dul ba nas gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin du mngon pa bas kyang zhal gyis bzhes cing de'i tshe 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs las/ dgun zla ra ba dang 'bring po'i phyed 'das/ 'bring po'i phyed lus pa'i skabs su dgun stod kyi gso sbyong zhag mi thub 'byung ba mngon 'dul gnyis ka nas gsal po gsungs pa'i phyir te/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das shing / zla ba phyed ni lus pa na/ mkhas pas zhag mi thub par 'dor/ ces pa'i 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma las/ 'di la phyed lhag pa yod pas na/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis so/ /phyed dang gnyis po de 'das nas te/ dgun zla ra ba dgun zla 'bring po phyed dang bcas pa 'das nas/ lhag ma zla ba phyed ni lus pa nas te/ dgun zla 'bring po phyed lus pa mar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi la/

mkhas pa sangs rgyas pa rnams kyis zhag mi thub pa de zhag gi shol dor bar bya'o/ /ces dang / de bzhin du dgun zla tha chung dpyid zla ra ba'i phyed dang bcas te/ 'das nas dpyid zla ra ba'i phyed lus pa nas/ yang zhag gi shol gzhan dor bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'dul ba'i gzhung / bam po lnga bcu pa las kyang / dgun stod kyi dus tshigs ni/ ston zla tha chung nya nas dgun zla ra ba'i nya'i bar dang / dgun zla ra ba'i nya nas dgun zla 'bring po'i nya'i zla ba gnyis so/ /zhes sogs dang / rgya cher 'grel sogs las kyang / de dang mthun par gong du drangs pa ltar gsal por gsungs pa'i phyir/ lugs gsum pa/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs la lo mgo dang dus mgo 'dzin tshul mi gcig te/ lo mgo ni yar ngo sngon du 'gro ba'i nag pa zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas 'dzin/ dus mgo ni/ dgun zla ra ba/ mgo'i zla ba'i tshes gcig nas 'dzin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ nag pa'i zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga la/ dpal 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis rgyal po zla ba bzang po la dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs pa shes byed du mdzad nas/ zla ba de'i tshes gcig nas lo mgo 'dzin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ dgun zla ra ba/ gzhu'i khyim gyi mthar dgun nyi zlog pa gcig 'byung ba shes byed du mdzad nas dus de nyid nas dus mgo 'dzin pa'i phyir/ lugs bzhi pa rgya nag rtsis kyi lugs la/ yar ngo sngon du 'gro ba'i dpyid zla ra ba stag gi zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas/ lo mgo dang dus mgo gnyis ka 'dzin par rtsis pa rnams thams cad mthun yang / dpyid ra stag gi mtshan gzhi la mi mthun pa mang ste/ hor zla bcu gcig pa la/ zla ba de'i mtshan gzhir 'dod pa dang / hor zla bcu gnyis pa la zla ba de'i mtshan gzhir 'dod pa dang / hor zla dang po la zla ba de'i mtshan gzhir 'dod pa dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/

de ltar lugs gsum las/ thog mtha' gnyis mi 'thad de/ lugs dang po la yid ches kyi lugs rnam dag med cing / phyi ma la phyogs mthun gyi lugs cung zad yod kyang / zla ba'i dag pa dang ma mthun pa'i phyir/ des na lugs gnyis pa yar ngo sngon du 'gro ba'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa ni/ dpyid zla ra ba stag gi zla ba'i mtshan gzhi yin cing / de nyid nas/ rgya nag rtsis kyi dus mgo dang lo mgo gnyis ka 'dzin pa 'thad de/ de la shes byed kyi lung rnam dag yod cing / zla ba'i dag pa sbyar tshul yang shin tu 'grig pa'i phyir/ de la yid ches kyi lung yod de/ gsal sgron las/ lnga pa lo la zla ba ni/ bcu gnyis dag tu gnas pa yin/ /dpyid zla ra ba stag yin te/ /rim pa bzhin du lo zla sbyar/ zhes dpyid zla ra ba stag nas dus mgo bzung zhing / dpyid ra stag gi zla ba rgyal gyi zla ba la bshad de/ 'byung ba kun 'dus las/ dgun gyi nyi ma dpyid ra stag la zlog rgyal nya spen pa dar bas tshes pa yin/ dbyar gyi nyi ma ston ra sprel la bzlog khrums nya dmag dpon dar bas tshes pa yin/ zhes dang / skol bu chung las kyang / lo gsar zla ba gang yin pa/ nga la ma dri rgyal la dris/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ lugs 'di la/ zla ba'i dag par sbyor tshul shin tu 'grig ste/ mdo sde sna sogs las/ rgyal gyi zla ba la ma rig pa'i zla bar bshad cing / ma rig pa ni/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi thog ma yin pa/ gsung rabs kyi spyi lugs yin pa'i phyir/ tshul 'di dag ni 'og tu rim bzhin du rgyas par 'byung ngo / /'o na lugs phyi ma la phyogs mthun gyi lung ji ltar du yod/ ce na/ yod med rgya nag gi rtsis gzhi mdo byang chen po las/ dpyid zla ra ba'i bcu gsum la/ nyi ma stag la zhon nas ni/ gza' ni phur bu'i sna drangs nas/ skar ma rgyal gyis skyom bar byed/ zhes pa shes byed du byas nas/ tshes bcu gsum la skar ma rgyal yod pa hor zla dang po yin pa 'os med du bzung nas shes byed du byas pa'i phyir/

lugs de hor lugs kyi lo mgo 'dzin pa dang phyogs mthun yang yid brtan thub pa'i lung du mi snang ngo / /bzhi pa gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul ni/ de nas gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul ni/ dam chos mngon pa'i sde snod las/ tha chung bzhi la gzer bzhi gsungs/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs las/ 'bring po bzhi la gzer bzhi gsungs/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang / rgya nag rtsis kyi rgyud 'grel las/ ra ba bzhi la gzer bzhi po/ 'byung bar gsungs kyang ra ba yi/ ngos 'dzin mi gcig so sor des/ khyad par can gyi dgos pa'i phyir/ lugs mchog bzhi po gzer bzhi yi/ 'byung tshul ming la ma mthun yang / (nges pa'i don la thams cad mthun/ zhes pa ltar ngam mngon pa'i sde snod rnams las/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi tha chung bzhi la/ gzer bzhi 'byung bar gsungs te/ dgun zla tha chung la/ dgun nyi thung ba'i mthar thug dgun nyi zlog pa'i dus dang / dbyar zla tha chung ba dbyar nyi ring ba'i mthar thug) dbyar nyi zlog pa'i dus dang / dpyid zla tha chung la/ dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang / ston zla tha chung ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam par 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar gsungs na 'jig rten bzhag pa'i mdo las lo gcig dus gcig tu mtshan mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/ nyin mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod de/ lo gcig la dus gcig tu mtshan mo yud tsam bco brgyad/ nyin mo yud tsam bcu gnyis po de gang zhe na/ dgun zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad la mtshan mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/ nyin mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod do/ /tshes dgu phan chad ni mtshan mo 'bri/ nyin mo skye ste/ mtshan mo ni thang re res 'bri'o/ /nyin mo ni thang re res skye'o/ /lo gcig la dus gcig tu nyin mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/ mtshan mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod de/ lo gcig la dus gcig tu nyin mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/

mtshan mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis pa de gang zhe na/ smras pa/ dbyar zla tha chung dbyar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad la/ nyin mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/ mtshan mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod de/ tshes dgu phan chad ni nyin mo 'grib/ mtshan mo skye ste/ nyin mo ni thang re res 'grib ngo / /mtshan mo ni thang re res skye'o/ /lo gcig la dus gnyis su mtshan mo yang yud tsam bco lnga/ nyin mo yang yud tsam bco lnga pa yod de/ lo gcig la dus gnyis su mtshan mo yang yud tsam bco lnga/ nyin mo yang yud tsam bco lnga de gang zhe na/ smras pa dpyid zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad dang / ston zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad la/ mtshan mo la yang yud tsam bco lnga/ nyin mo yang yud tsam bco lnga yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mdo nyi ma'i snying po las kyang / tha chung bzhi la gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul khyad chos lnga lnga'i sgo nas gsungs shing / ston tha khyad chos lnga ldan du gong du bshad zin pa dang / dgun nyi thung ba'i mthar thug gi gzer ni mchu'i zla ba la 'byung zhing / zla ba de dgun zla tha chung yin pa/ mtshan mo yud tsam bco brgyad/ nyin mo yud tsam bcu gnyis pa'i dus yin pa/ skar ma rgyal gyi nam skyel ba/ nyi ma skar ma mon gre dang 'grogs shing / grib tshod sor bcu bdun 'khor ba spen pa dang phur bu zhing bdag yin pa sogs khyad chos lnga ldan du gsungs te/ mdo nyi snying las/ mchu ni zla ba rab rdzogs byed/ dgun zla tha chung rang bzhin yang / mthar gyis kyang ni brjod par bya/ lho yi phyogs su phyin nas kyang / nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ mtshan mo bco brgyad shes par gyis/ nyin bar yang ni bcu gnyis yin/ rgyal yang mtshan mo thob par byed/ nyi ma'i mdun du mon gre yin/ grib tshod kyang ni sor bcu bdun/ nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ spen pa lha'i bla ma dag zhing der rab du brjod pa yin/ 'dir khyim bum pa mnyam pa med/

zhes gsungs so/ /dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i gzer ni sa ga'i zla ba la 'byung shing / zla ba de dpyid zla tha chung yin pa/ zla ba de las dpyid nyin mnyam pa 'byung ba/ nag pas mtshan skyel ba/ nyi ma skar ma smin drug dang 'grogs shing / pa ba sangs zhing bdag yin pa/ grib ma gom drug 'khor ba'i khyad chos lnga ldan du gsungs te/ mdo nyi snying las zla grangs tshes ni bco lnga la/ sa ga yin te sa ga yi/ /go rim brjod bya byang phyogs su/ /kha ltas nyi ma yongs su 'khor/ /mtshan mo mnyam mtshungs rnam pa ste/ /bco lnga bco lngar bshad pa yin/ /nag pas mtshan mo thob par byed/ /nyin mo yang ni smin drug yin/ /grib tshod dag kyang gom pa drug /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /lha min bla ma pa ba sangs/ /'dir yang zhing zhes gdags pa yin/ /khyim glang yin te mkhas rnams kyi/ /zla ba bdun po bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug gi gzer ni/ gro bzhin gyi zla ba la 'byung zhing / zla ba de yang / khyad chos lnga ldan du gsungs te/ zla ba de dbyar zla tha chung yin pa/ zla ba de'i nang du/ nyin mo yud tsam bco brgyad/ mtshan mo yud tsam bcu gnyis pa'i dus 'byung ba/ skar ma chu stod kyi mtshan skyel ba/ nyi ma skar ma mchu dang 'grogs shing nyi ma zhing bdag yin pa/ grib ma gom pa phyed 'khor ba rnams gsungs pa'i phyir te/ mdo de nyid las/ zla ba rang la gro bzhin no/ /bdag gis dbyar tha'i rim brjod bya/ /de ni byang gi phyogs su ni/ /nyi ma gdong phyed bltas te 'khor/ /nyin bar bco brgyad thob nas kyang / /mtshan mo yang ni bcu gnyis te/ /chu stod kyis ni mtshan mo thob/ /nyi ma'i mdun na mchu yin no/ /grib tshod gom pa phyed yin no/ /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /'dir zhing nyi ma ldan pa yi/ /sas kyang gser ni stong bar byed/ 'dir khyim seng ger shes par gyis/ /zla ba bcu po bshad pa yin/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na smin drug gi zla ba sogs bzhi po de/ hor zla gang dang gang la 'byung ba yin zhe na/ smin drug ni gong du bshad la/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug nas dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba ston zla tha chung smin drug gi zla ba dang / hor zla bcu drug pa'i tshes bcu drug nas/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba la/ dgun zla tha chung mchu'i zla ba dang / hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nas/ gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba la/ dpyid zla tha chung sa ga'i zla ba dang / hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu drug nas drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba la/ dbyar zla tha chung gro bzhin gyi zla bar 'jog pa yin te/ zla ba de dag gi khyad chos rnams/ nyi ma'i snying po nas gsungs pa ji lta bzhin/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug nas bzung ba sogs la 'grig gi dus gzhan nas bzung ba la 'grig pa'i skabs mi srid pa'i phyir/ shes ldan dag nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo la brtan bzhin du/ rang gis de nyid ma ston cig gal te lugs de mi 'thad de/ smin drug gi nya ba la smin drug gi zla bar grags pa dang / nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las kyang / dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma ston dpyid kyi ra ba gnyis la zlog par bshad pa'i phyir te/ nyi snying las/ bdag gis ston zla ra rim brjod/ lho phyogs nyi ma'i 'khor lo zlog ces dang / 'dir ni dpyid zla ra ba yi/ rang bzhin yang ni brjod par bya/ /byang phyogs su ni kha bltas nas/ /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon dang po med de/ nya skar gyi sgo nas zla ba 'jog pa ni/ grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lugs yin pa dang / kha che'i paṇa chen gyi gsung las kyang / rgya gar ba dang bod pa zla ba'i ming 'dogs mi mthun pa 'dug gsung pa mkhas pa dag gi gtam du byed pa 'byung ba'i phyir/

skyon gnyis pa med de/ nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo de'i don ni/ dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma log zin nas/ lho byang du 'khor ba la 'chad dgos kyi/ nyi ma zlog zhes pa'i tshig skam sgra ji bzhin du khas len na/ khyed rang la khas blangs nang 'gal 'byung ba'i phyir/ nang 'gal ji ltar 'byung na/ khyed rang gi lugs la dbyar zla ra ba la dbyar nyi zlog par thal/ nyi snying las/ dbyar zla ra ba'i rim brjod bya/ /byang phyogs kha bltas nyi ma zlog /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ston zla ra ba la zlog par khas blangs pa dang nang 'gal/ grogs po dag rtsing por spyod pa'i blos mdo don zab mo la bab col du ma smra zhig de bzhin du gdags pa'i ston zla ra ba'i yar gyi zhes sogs kyi 'phro de ma thag tu/ lo gcig la dus gnyis su mtshan mo yud tsam bco lnga/ nyin mo yud tsam bco lnga yin pa yod de/ de gang zhe na smras pa/ dpyid zla tha chung yar gyi tshes brgyad dang / ston zla tha chung yar gyi tshes brgyad la/ mtshan mo yang yud tsam bco lnga nyin mo yang yud tsam bco lnga yod do zhes dang / kha che 'dus bzang gis kyang / de la dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa/ dbyar zla tha chung gi yar ngo'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring ngo / /dgun rnams kyis ni bzhi pa la thung du 'gyur te/ mtshan de nyid dgun zla bzhi pa'i yar gyi tshes dgu nas thung bar 'gyur zhes bya ba sbyar te/ dgun zla tha chung yar ngo'i tshe dgu nas so/ /zhes dang / mdzod rtsa 'grel las/ dgun rnams kyis ni bzhi pa la/ /thung du 'gyur ro nyin mo zlog ces dang / /de nyid dgun rnams kyi zla ba bzhi pa'i tha ma'i tshes dgu nas thung bar 'gyur/ zhes bya ba sbyar te/ dgun zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes dgu nas so/ /zhes dang de'i 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma las kyang / dbyar gyi zla ba bzhi yi tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring zhes bya ba ni/

dbyar gyi zla ba ni dbyar zla 'bring po nas/ ston zla 'bring po'i bar bzhi yin la/ zla ba thams cad kyang mar gyi ngo lnga ste/ de la dbyar zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes dgu nas mtshan mo ring bar 'gyur ro/ /dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ thung du 'gyur zhes bya ba ni/ dgun gyi zla ba ni ston zla tha chung nas/ dgun zla tha chung gi bar bzhi yin te/ de la dgun zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes dgu nas/ mtshan mo thung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing phyogs glang gi 'grel pa las kyang de dang mthun par gsungs so/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs las/ 'bring po bzhi la gzer gzhi 'byung tshul dang / dus 'khor dang rgya nag gi rtsis lugs la/ ra ba bzhi la gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul ni/ lugs bzhi nges pa'i don du/ gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul mthun pa las rtogs nus so/ /de yang ji ltar zhe na/ zab mo'i man ngag gi sgo nas 'og tu gsal por 'chad pa ltar/ dgun nyi zlog tshul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i yar ngo'i tshes gsum nas/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer gsum gyi bar la/ dgun nyi zlog par nges shing / de yang / bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum dang / bcu gsum la/ dgun nyi zlog pa'i dus gnyis 'byung ba la dgongs nas/ dus 'khor las ra ba bzhi la gzer bzhi gsungs te/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas/ gnam gang gi bar la dus 'khor ba'i dgun zla ra bar 'dod pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dul ba pas dus de gnyis la dgun nyi zlog pa/ dgun zla 'bring po la dgun nyi zlog par dgongs te/ 'dul ba'i lugs la bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug nas bcu gcig pa'i bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba 'di dgun zla 'bring po yin pa bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir/ dgun nyi zlog pa'i 'chi dus hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer gsum la zlog cing / dus de la dgongs nas/ rgya nag pa'i dpyid zla ra ba stag la dgun nyi zlog pa'i gzer gsungs pa dang / mngon pa bas/

dgun zla tha chung la dgun nyi zlog pa'i gzer gsungs pa yin ste/ bcu gnyis pas nyer gsum te/ rgya nag pa'i dpyid zla ra ba'i dus dang / mngon pa bas dgun zla tha chung gi dus yin par gong du bshad zin pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ zla ba sum cu rtsa gnyis phyed bcas re nas/ zla ba'i shol re 'byung zhing / de'i dbang gis dgun nyi zlog tshul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum/ bcu gsum/ nyi shu gsum/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum/ bcu gsum/ nyi shu gsum la dgun nyi zlog pa snga phyi rim can du 'byung ba ngos zin pa'i sgo nas/ khyad par can gyi dgos pa'i ched du/ sngar bshad pa'i lugs mchog bzhi po/ gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul ming la ma mthun pa yin yang / nges pa'i don du ni lugs bzhi ka gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul mthun pa kho na yin no/ /zhes kho bo smra bar byed do/ /da ni don de dag las 'phros pa'i dka' ba'i gnas zab mo man ngag gi sgo nas lhug par bshad par bya ste/ ji skad du/ rnam dpyod ldan pa'i blo gros can/ /rgya chen thos pas mi ngoms pa'i/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis mdo rgyud dang / /dgongs 'grel bstan bcos legs par ltos/ /rgya chen gsung rab dpyod pa yi/ /spros pa'i tshogs kyis sgyid lug te/ /tha snyad tshig dang ri mo la/ /ltos med tshig nyung don rgyas gnad/ /mkhas pa'i man ngag len 'dod na/ /byed grub phyi nang mthun pa yi/ /'bras bu gdan du bting nas ni/ /lhag chad 'phel 'grib ri bong can/ /dus kyi ma la 'grengs pa'i bu/ /'byung bas dbyar dgun glu me dang / /me me'i 'khor lo skor byed pa'i/ /rgyab rten ye shes las rlung gi /'phel 'grib dag la brten nas ni/ /gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul 'khrul med 'grub/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /kun gyis shes na mkhas pa su/ /brda grol mkhas pa'i ngag la long / /zhes pa ltar/ gzer bzhi po 'di dus tshigs kyi gtso bo yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi/

dus tshigs ston byed kyi mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams la/ blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis legs par dpyod dgos shing / rgya chen gsung rab la spyod pa'i spros pas sgyid lug ste/ tha snyad tshig gi tshogs dang / ri mo la ltos med tshig nyung don rgyas kyi gnad/ zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i mkhas pa'i man ngag len par 'dod na/ brtse ba'i bsam pas go bde ba'i ngag gi sgo nas lhug par bshad par bya yi/ don du gnyer ba dag rna ba glags te nyon cig byed grub phyi nang mthun pa yi/ /'bras bu gdan du bting nas ni/ /zhes pa'i don/ byed rtsis rgyu mtshan rtsis kyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa'i rtsis 'bras dang / rnam dag grub mtha'i rtsis 'bras dang / phyi nang gi rtags mthun pa'i yid ches pa'i 'bras bu zhig gdan du bting nas/ de yan chad gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul/ tha snyad kyi tshig dang ri mo la ltos mi dgos pa'i man ngag zab mo zhig 'dir ston no/ /de gang zhe na/ byed grub mthun pa'i rtsis 'bras ni rang gis shes na mchog yin zhing rang gis mi shes na yid ches pa snga ma zhig gi rtsis 'bras bzung bas don 'grub la phyi nang gi rtags mthun pa ni/ shin tu gal che bas de la yid ches skyes na/ byed grub kyi rtsis 'bras med kyang / 'og nas 'chad pa'i 'khor lo skor tshul gyi man ngag yod na/ gzer bzhi'i byung tshul 'khrul med kyi don la nang byan chud par nus so/ /phyi nang gi rtags mthun pa ji lta bu zhe na/ phyi'i rtags kyi gtso bo/ sa khang mtho ba'i nyi bzhur ma 'chugs pa gcig bzung ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'khor lo skor bas/ don thams cad ston la/ gzhan yang phyi'i rtags/ dgun gyi dus su chu la sil li ma rgyug mi rgyug dang / sbubs su chug ma chug ra rtags kyi 'khor lo tshul dang / chang ma'i gzer 'khor sogs dang / nang gi rtags/ sems can gyi srog gcod pa'i skyes bu'i lag pa la/

dgun nyi ma log dus khrag 'gos shing / dgun nyi log 'phral khrag mi 'gos pa sogs mtha' yas pa dang / dbyar gyi dus su phyi rtags me tog dang 'bras bu 'ga' zhig gi 'char tshul dang / nang skyes bu'i rtags byi chung gi ro 'grim mi 'grim dang / dbyar gung phag gi dus/ zhag bdun la phag mo'i ngur skad 'phyag pa dang / sbal pa'i kha 'khrig pa sogs/ mtha' yas pa gcig 'byung mod/ rgyas par yi ge mang ba'i 'jigs pas ma bris so/ /de yang phag zhag bdun ni/ dbyar gyi snying po yin te/ dbyar nyi log nas/ chung gsum nyi shu gcig de rjes smal zla phyed/ de rjes nam bar zhag gsum/ de rjes phag zhag bdun/ de rjes nam bar zhag gsum/ de rjes wa zla phyed/ de rjes gzhung zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig 'byung bas/ log zhag brgyad cu rtsa lnga byed pa ni/ dag rtsis yin zhing / rgyu mtshan des na phag gi gong du zhag sum cu rtsa dgu phag gi 'og tu zhag sum cu rtsa dgu 'byung bas phag zhag bdun po dbyar gyi snying por grub pa'i phyir/ tshul 'dis dgun nyi zlog nas bya dus la yang / mtshon par bya ste/ bya'i gshog chen gnyis chung gsum dang gzhung zhag gi dus su'ang sbyor/ bya'i gshog chung gnyis smal dang wa'i dus gnyis dang sbyor/ bya sdong phag dus dang sbyor/ mjug sgro rtse gnyis nam bar gyi dus gnyis dang sbyor ba'i phyir ro/ /da ni man ngag gi 'khor lo skor tshul bshad par bya ste/ lhag chad 'phel 'grib ri bong can/ /zhes pa ni/ tshes lhag pa 'phel ba dang / chad pa 'grib tu bcug pa'i sgo nas/ ri bong can ni zla ba yin dus ni drug yin ma ni zla ba rangs po bu ni zhag 'byung ba ni lnga yin pas/ mdor na/ tshes kyi lhag chad legs par rtsis pa'i zla ba rangs po/ drug gi ma la/ bu zhag lnga 'grangs pa ste/ bsnan pas/ zla drug zhag lnga ni/ dbyar dgun gyi 'khor lo rtsis pa'i gzhi yin la/ ji ltar rtsi na 'byung bas dbyar dgun klu me dang /

me me'i 'khor lo skor byed pa'i/ zhes pa'i klu ni brgyad dang me ni gsum la 'jug pas/ dbyar brgyad gsum gyi 'khor lo skor/ dgun gsum gsum gyi 'khor lo skor ba yin zhing / de'i don yang dbyar hor zla lnga'i tshes brgyad/ bco brgyad/ nyi shu brgyad/ drug pa'i tshes brgyad/ bco brgyad/ nyi shu brgyad/ drug po gang rung kho na la/ dbyar nyi zlog gi de las gzhan pa'i tshes grangs la dbyar nyi zlog mi srid pa dang / dbyar nyi zlog pa de nas/ zla drug zhag lnga 'das ma thag dgun nyi zlog par nges pas/ dbyar nyi zlog pa snga phyi dang rim bzhin du sbyar te/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum/ bcu gsum/ nyi shu gsum/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum/ bcu gsum/ nyi shu gsum ste drug po gang rung kho na dgun nyi zlog par nges kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i tshes grangs la/ dgun nyi zlog pa mi srid pa ni nges pa'o/ /des dgun nyi log nas dbyar nyi ji tsam la log gi 'khor lo skor tshul yang mtshon te shes par bya'o/ /tshul 'di ni mkhas pa'i grub rtsis/ zhang zhung rgan po'i kha rtsis su sgrogs pa/ kha ni brgya kha stong du bsgyur kyang / nyi ma brgyad gsum kha la zlog zhes pa'i gnad grol shes na shin tu mthun no/ /'o na de lta bu'i 'khor lo skor tshul ni/ rtog pas brtags pa kho na yin gyi rgyab rten yid ches kyi lung med snyam na yod do/ /rgyab rten ye shes las rlung gi 'phel 'grib dag las brten nas ni/ gzer bzhi 'byung tshul 'khrul med grub/ e ma ngo 'tshar rmad kyis chos/ kun gyi shes na mkhas pa su/ brda grol mkhas pa'i ngag la longs/ ces smras so/ de'i don/ zab mo mchog gi bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ 'byung ba ri dang dus rnams dag gis grangs/ ces gsung pa ltar/ skyes bu nad sogs kyi skyon med pa zhig la/ nyin zhag phrug gcig gi rgyun la/ ye shes kyi rlung drug brgya bdun bcu rtsa lnga re 'phel/

las rlung drug brgya bdun bcu rtsa lnga re 'grib pa'i nang gi dag pa la brten nas/ phyi rol du gzer bzhi'i 'byung tshul 'khrul ba med pa ni/ gnad kyi don dang yid ches kyi gnas so/ /'o na dgun rnams kyis ni bzhi pa la/ zhes sogs kyi gzhung don la ma zhugs par 'gyur te/ dgun zla bzhi pa'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la/ dgun nyi zlog pa mi srid pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ nyi ma'i zlog mtshams la/ rags rtsis gzhung 'grel gyi dngos bstan dang / zhib rtsis man ngag gi gnas tshul 'di ni phyi ma'i dbang du byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhung 'grel gyi dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa khyed rang gis kyang khas len mi nus te/ dbyar zla gnyis pa dang / dgun zla bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad gnyis kho na la dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma zlog pa khyed rang gis kyang khas len mi nus shing / mngon sum dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa/ dus bzhi ji ltar 'khor ba'i tshul la/ gling bzhir dus gcig kho na 'dod pa'i lugs/ gling bzhir dus bzhi yongs rdzogs 'dod pa'i lugs/ 'thad phyogs ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ kha cig gling bzhi na dus gcig kho na yod de/ 'dzam bu'i gling na dgun yod pa'i dus gling gzhan gsum na'ang dgun/ 'di na dbyar yod pa'i dus/ gling gzhan gsum na'ang dbyar kho na yod pa'i phyir zer/ gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa/ nyin mtshan gyi yud tsam gyi khyad par bye brag tu bshad pa/ nyi ma dbyar dgun ring thung du 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gling bzhi na dus bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa gcig khor mo yug tu yod de/ 'dzam gling 'di na dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i dus su/ shar na ston nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam pa dang / byang na dgun nyi thung ba mthar thug pa'i dus su/ nub na dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus yod pa'i phyir te/ dbyar rjes su ston/ ston rjes su dgun/ dgun rjes su dpyid/

dpyid rjes su dbyar rnams gling bzhi la g.yas skor du rim can du 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni 'dzam gling 'dir nyi ma ring ba'i mthar thug yud tsam bco brgyad/ mtshan mo yud tsam bcu gnyis pa'i dus su/ byang na nyi ma thung ba'i mthar thug yud tsam bcu gnyis/ mtshan mo ring ba'i mthar thug yud tsam bco brgyad yod de/ 'di'i mtshan mo'i dus gang yin pa de/ byang na nyin mo'i dus su gnas 'di'i nyin mo'i dus gang yin pa de byang na mtshan mo'i dus su gnas pa'i phyir te/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na nyi ma yod pa'i dbang gis/ byang du ri rab kyi grib ma babs pa la/ mtshan mo'i tha snyad brtags pa'i phyir/ 'dzam gling 'dir dbyar nyi ma ring ba'i mthar thug yud tsam bco brgyad pa'i dus su/ shar na ston nyin mtshan yud tsam bco lnga par mnyam pa'i dus yod de/ dbyar rjes su ston 'byung ba'i phyir shar na ston nyin mtshan yud tsam bco lnga par mnyam pa'i dus su/ nub na dpyid nyin mtshan yud tsam bco lnga par mnyam pa'i dus yod de/ shar gyi mtshan mo'i dus gang yin pa de nub tu nyin mo'i dus/ shar du nyin mo'i dus gang yin pa de nub tu mtshan mo'i dus su gnas pa'i phyir te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar lus 'phags por gnas pa'i tshe/ ri rab kyi grib ma nub ba glang spyod du babs pa la/ mtshan mo'i tha snyad bzhag pa'i phyir/ de yang shar du ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus su/ phyi dro'i cha la yud tsam dgu yod de/ shar lus 'phags po'i phyi dro'i dus dang / 'dzam gling gi snga dro'i yun tshad mnyam pa gang zhig de'i dus su 'dzam gling gi snga dro'i cha la yud tsam dgu yod pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ shar lus 'phags por nyi ma phyed pa dang / 'dir nyi ma shar ba dus mnyam/ shar du nyi ma nub pa dang / 'dir nyi ma phyed pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ shar gyi ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus su/

'dzam bu'i gling du dbyar nyi ring ba'i mthar thug tu yud tsam bco brgyad pa'i dus yod pa'i phyir/ shar gyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i snga dro'i cha la yud tsam drug yod de/ de'i snga dro'i cha dang / byang sgra mi snyan gyi phyi dro'i cha yud tsam mnyam pa gang zhig shar gyi ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus su/ byang sgra mi snyan pa'i phyi dro'i cha la yud tsam drug yod pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ shar du nyi ma shar ba dang / byang du nyi ma phyed pa dus mnyam/ byang du nyi ma nub pa dang / shar du de phyed pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ shar gyi ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus su/ byang na dgun nyi thung ba'i mthar thug yud tsam bcu gnyis pa'i dus yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du nub na dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus su snga dro'i cha la yud tsam dgu dang / phyi dro'i cha la yud tsam drug yod pa'i sgrub byed kyang / snga ma la dpags te shes par bya'o/ /dus tshigs bzhi'i 'khor tshul 'di dag ni/ rong ston shes bya kun rig gis kun mkhyen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rgyun gyi legs bshad ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa yin no/ /mkhas pa gzhan dag ni/ 'dzam gling 'dir dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i tshe/ nub na ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa/ byang na dgun nyin thung ba'i mthar thug shar na dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa/ 'khor tshul yang g.yon 'khor du bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ dbyar gyi dus su nyi ma ring ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de'i dus su nyi ma byang du 'gro ba mthar thug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang gi rtar gyur pa'i rlung las lhag pa'i 'phul byed kyi rlung gzhan gyis snon pa med pa'i phyir/ dgun gyi dus su nyi ma thung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de'i dus su nyi ma lhor 'gro mthar thug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang gi rtar gyur pa'i rlung las lhag pa'i lcags ri'i rlung drag pos snon pa yod pa'i dbang gis nyi ma'i bgrod pa shin tu mgyogs pa'i phyir/

gsum pa la/ kha cig dus cig char ba'i phyogs 'di 'thad de/ 'dzam gling 'dir dgun zla dang po yod pa'i tshe gling gzhan gsum na'ang dgun zla dang po yod pa'i phyir te/ 'dzam gling 'di na mgo zla yod pa'i tshe/ gling gzhan gsum na'ang mgo zla yod pa gang zhig mgo zla dgun zla ra ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de yin te/ 'dzam gling 'dir dbyar nyi ring ba'i mthar thug byang bgrod kyi tshe shar nub gnyis na yang de ltar yod pa'i phyir te/ 'dzam gling 'dir dbyar nyi ring ba'i mthar thug byang bgrod kyi tshe/ byang bgrod mthar thug nas 'char ba dang / byang bgrod mthar thug tu nub pa gang zhig 'dir nyi ma shar ba dang shar du nyi ma phyed pa dus mnyam/ 'dir nyi ma nub pa dang nub tu nyi ma phyed pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang nub ba glang spyod du dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus su nyi ma phyed pa'i tha snyad med par thal/ de'i dus su snga dro la yud tsam dgu phyi dro la yud tsam drug las med pa'i phyir/ zer na/ thal 'gyur dang po'i lan ni/ khyab pa ma nges te/ mgo'i zla ba dgun zla dang po yin pa 'dzam bu gling pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ gling gzhan du de ltar ma nges pa'i phyir te/ mgo zla la 'dir dgun zla ra ba nub tu ston zla ra ba/ byang du dbyar zla ra ba/ shar du dpyid zla ra bar 'jog pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur gnyis pa'i lan ni/ spyir nyi ma 'char tshul la/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gling gi bar snang la 'char ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mig lam du 'char ba'i tshul gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ shar gling dbus ma'i dkyil gyi thad sor nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i tshe/ 'dzam bu gling du skya rengs dang po shar ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar gling phyed gnyis 'das nas rnga yab gzhan gyi gling gi thad sor sleb pa'i tshe/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mig lam du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba lta bu'o/ /nyi ma nub tshul yang /

nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi byed pa nub pa dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mig lam du nub pa gnyis/ dang po ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ba glang spyod pa'i gling gi dkyil gyi thad sor sleb pa'i tshe/ 'dzam bu gling du nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi byed pa nub nas/ rgyu skar gyi tshogs gsal bar byas pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lho nub rnga yab kyi gling las 'das nas/ nub gling gsum gyi shar ma'i thad sor sleb pa'i tshe/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mig lam du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mi snang ba lta bu'o/ /des na 'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma byang bgrod mthar thug gi tshe/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mig lam du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba dang nub pa ni/ byang bgrod mthar thug nas 'char ba dang nub par snang ste/ 'dzam bu gling na byang bgrod mthar thug gi tshe lho gling gsum ka na byang bgrod mthar thug khyad par med pa'i phyir/ nyi ma'i 'od zer bar snang du 'char ba dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi byed pa nub pa la de ltar du nges pa ma yin te/ shar gling dbus ma'i gling gi thad sor nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sleb pa'i tshe/ 'dir bar snang la nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba yin zhing / shar gling dang lho gling nyi ma'i bgrod pa mi gcig pa'i phyir/ de yang nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig ces pa ni/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin no/ /thal ba gsum pa'i lan ni/ khyab pa ma nges pa yin te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzam bu gling gi dkyil gyi thad sor sleb pa'i tshe/ nyi ma phyed pa yin gyi/ snga dro dang phyi dro'i yun tshad ring thung mnyam pa'i cha nas nyi ma phyed du 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na skyes bu 'ga' zhig gi dpag tshad bzhi bar na yod pa'i shar phyogs kyi grong khyer nas nub phyogs kyi grong khyer du bgrod pa'i tshe/ dang por lus ngal ba sogs med pa'i rkyen gyi dpag tshad gnyis myur bar bgrod nus/

phyis lus ngal ba la sogs pa'i skyon gyis/ dpag tshad gnyis bgrod pa la yun ring du thogs pa bzhin no/ /rang gi lugs ni/ gling bzhi na dus bzhi yongs rdzogs cig char du yod pa'i phyogs 'di nyid 'thad de/ 'di nyid lung rigs dri ma med pas grub cing / gling bzhi na nyin mo ring ba'i mthar thug cig char yod pa khas len pa la/ nyin zhag gcig la yud tsam sum cu so drug yod pa'i skyon dang / gling bzhi na dgun nyi thung ba'i mthar thug cig char du yod pa la nyin zhag gcig la yud tsam nyer bzhi las med pa'i skyon gnas pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ gling bcu gnyis su dus bzhi dang / zla ba bcu gnyis rim can du g.yon skor du bskor nas/ g.yas skor du 'khor bar gsungs pa'i phyir te/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel las/ lho'i dum bu 'dir lug la nyi ma gnas pas/ dpyid kyi dus sa ga'i zla ba byed do/ /me'i zur kyi dum bu gnyis pa la/ snron gyi zla ba byed do/ me'i zur gyi dum bu gsum pa la/ chu stod kyi zla ba byed do/ /shar gyi dum bu la lus 'phags por gro bzhin gyi zla ba byed do/ /lnga pa dbang ldan gyi phyed kyi dum bur khrums kyi zla ba byed do/ /dbang ldan gyi dum bu drug par tha skar gyi zla ba byed do/ /byang gi dum bu bdun par smin drug gi zla ba byed do/ /rlung gi zur gyi dum bu brgyad par mgo'i zla ba byed do/ rlung gi zur gyi dum bu dgu par rgyal gyi zla ba byed do /nub du dum bu bcu par chu'i zla ba byed do/ /bden bral kyi zur gyis dum bu bcu gcig par dbo'i zla ba byed do/ /bden bral gyi dum bu gzhan la nag pa'i zla ba byed do/ /de bzhin du zla ba gnyis kyi dum bu gnyis su dus su 'gyur ro/ /dum bu so sor dkar po dang / nag po'i phyogs kyi dbye bas phyogs gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na dus drug dang /

zla ba bcu gnyis dang / phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams/ dus bcu gnyis la 'khor lo'i rnam pa 'khor bar shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / g.yon skor du dbyug gu lnga lngas nyi ma 'char ba snga bar bshad cing / nyi ma ri rab la thag ring ba'i tshe mgyogs pa dang / ri rab la nye ba'i tshe bul ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / so ba 'chag pa'i ba glang ka ba la btags pa na thag ring ba dang thung ba'i dpe de yang gsungs so/ /'o na dus bzhi cig char ba la/ sngar bshad pa'i skyon ji ltar yod zhe na/ 'dzam bu gling du dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i tshe/ sgra mi snyan du mtshan mo'i cha la yud tsam bco brgyad yod par thal/ de'i tshe 'di'i nyin mo'i cha la yud tsam bco brgyad yod pa gang zhig 'di'i nyin mo'i dus su gang yin pa de byang du mtshan mo'i dus gnas pa'i phyir/ 'dod na 'dir dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i tshe/ sgra mi snyan pa'i nyin zhag gcig la/ yud tsam pa drug yod par thal/ 'dod pa de gang zhig de'i nyin mo'i cha la yud tsam bco brgyad yod par khas blangs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du dgun nyi thung ba mthar thug la sbyar te/ skyon gnyis pa yang shes par bya'o/ /drug pa lo zla zhag gsum gyi rnam gzhag la/ lo zla/ zhag gsum ji ltar du rtsom pa'i tshul dang / de ltar brtsams pa'i lo zla zhag gsum gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon pa ba ltar na/ se gol gtogs pa gcig gi yun tshad la dus mtha'i skad cig ma drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pas/ de'i drug cu rtsa bzhi cha gcig gam rdul phra rab gcig gol sa gcig nas gcig du 'gro ba'i yun tshad ni/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ rdul cig bgres dus chung ba yi/ /mthar thug dus ni skad cig 'dod/ /ces dang / mdzod las/ skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ de'i skad gcig de dag kyang / zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ dus 'khor ba ltar na skyes bu nad med kyi dbugs phyir 'gro ba dang nang du rngub pa'i dbugs khug pa bdun la chu srang gcig

chu srang drug cu la chu tshod gcig chu tshod nga dgu rjes 'brang dang bcas pa la tshes zhag gcig de sum cu la tshes zla gcig tshes zla bcu gnyis tshes zhag bcu gcig sogs la/ dngos btags phyed pa'i lo gcig tu 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la lo/ zla ba/ zhag gi rnam gzhag dang gsum/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ dngos btags kyi khyad par dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nyi ma'i bgrod pa gnyis 'dus pa'i yun tshad la/ dngos btags ma phye ba'i lo zhes pa'i tha snyad byed de/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ nyi ma 'gro zlog gnyis la ni/ lo gcig zhes ni brjod pa yin/ ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rgya gar ba'i lugs dang / rgya nag pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni rgya gar ba'i lugs la lo rgan drug cur bzhed de/ bde mchog bstod 'grel las/ /rab me mo yos byung rnam sa pho 'brug byung dkar sa mo sbrul po dang / /rab lcags pho rta myos skyes lcags mo lug bdag aṃ chu pho spre'u gi ra/ /dpal chu mo bya gdong dngos po shing pho khyi na tshod ldan/ shing mo phag /'dzin me mo byi byed dbang phyug me mo glang 'bru mang sa pho stag po/ sa mo yos myos ldan dpa' lcags pho 'brug bo khyu mchog lcags mo sbrul dang / chu pho rta sna tshogs nyi chu mo lug ma nyi sgrol shing pho spre'u byed/ /sa shing mo bya skyong mi zad me pho khyi thams cad 'dul/ me mo phag /kun sa pho byi ba 'dzin 'gal sa mo glang ba rnam lcags pho stag 'gyur dang / /bong bu lcags mo yos dga' chu pho 'brug ba rnam rgyal chu mo sbrul nyid/ /rgyal ba shing pho rta myos byed shing mo lug gdong ngan me pho spre'u dang / /gser me mo bya 'phyang rnam sa pho khyi 'phyang rgyur sa mo phag byed dang /

/kun lcags pho byi ldan 'phar lcags mo glang ba dge byed dang / chu pho stag /mdzes chu mo yos byed khro mo shing pho 'brug sna tshogs dbyig shing mo sbrul/ /zil me pho rta gnon spre'u me mo lug phur bu sa pho spre'u dang / /zhi ba sa mo bya thun mong lcags pho khyi 'gal byed lcags mo phag dang / /yongs 'dzin chu pho byi bag yod chu mo glang kun dga' shing pho stag dang / shing mo yos srin bu me me pho 'brug dang dmar ser me mo sbrul can/ /dus sa pho rta kyi pho nya sa mo lug don grub lcags pho spre'u drag /blo lcags mo bya ngan rnga chen chu pho khyi khrag skyug chu mo phag pa/ shing pho byi ba mig dmar shing mo glang khro bo zad byed pa'o me pho stag zhes gsungs la/ /de yang me mo yos nas/ me pho stag gi bar drug cu dang / rim pa bzhin du sbyar ro/ /rgya nag pa'i lugs kyi byi ba/ glang / stag yos/ 'brug sbrul/ rta/ lug spre'u/ bya/ khyi/ phag ces pa bcu gnyis po re re la/ shing me sa lcags chu zhes 'byung ba lnga lngar sbyar bas/ drug cur 'gyur la/ de yang shing pho byi ba/ shing mo glang zhes sogs pho mo spel mar sbyar ro/ /de ltar na byi ba lo la lo mi srid pa nas/ glang lo la pho mo srid pa sogs shes par bya'o/ /nag rtsis pa rnams ni/ drug cu skor gyi thog mar shing pho byi ba 'jog la/ de'i rgyu mtshan shing pho byi ba'i lo la/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis ri bo rtse lngar rtsis la sogs pa'i chos gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par 'dod la/ de nas lo bzhi pa me mo yos kyi lo la rgya gar du ston pa yum gyi lhums su zhugs pas/ rgya gar ba rnams/ rab byung gi lo drug cu skor gyi thog mar 'jog pa yin no/

/zhes dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams gsungs la/ jo bo chen po rje ni/ ston pa shing pho byi ba la lhums su zhugs nas shing mo glang la sku bltams par bzhed do/ /gsum pa dngos btags kyi khyad par ni/ spyir lo la 'jog tshul gsum yod de nyin zhag sum brgya lnga bcu nga bzhi la lor byas pa gcig nyin zhag sum brgya dang drug cu la lor byas pa gcig nyin zhag sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga la lor byas pa gcig dang gsum yod cing / dang po ni/ zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yis/ zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig zhes pa'i gzhung gis bstan pa yin la/ 'dul mngon las lo grangs rtsi ba phal che ba 'di'i dbang du byas so/ /'di la dus 'khor las tshes lo zhes pa'i tha snyad gsungs so/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten pa rnams la grags pa'i lo de/ 'di la nyin zhag gi lo zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad cing / dus 'khor las kyang / nyin zhag sum brgya dang drug cu lor 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ mngon 'dul ba la ma grags pa'i/ dus 'khor du gsungs pa yin la/ de yang drug cu skor gyi lo bdag re la byed cing / dus bzhi rdzogs pa la lo gcig tu byas pa yin te/ da lo'i dgun nyi log nas/ sang gi dgun nyi zlog pa'i bar gyi zhag grangs rnams 'di la tshang dgos so/ /lo 'di la khyi lo zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad cing / ston pa sku bltams nas lo du song rtsi ba dang / 'das lo rtsi ba dang / bstan rtsis byed pa rnams 'di'i steng nas rtsi ba yin no/ /de ltar lo'i 'jog mtshams gsum ka la yang / 'jig rten pa'i kha skad du/ lo gcig zla ba bcu gnyis/ zhag po sum brgya drug cu zhes grags pa ltar/ tshes lo la/ tshes zhag sum brgya dang drug cu'am/ tshes zla bcu gnyis tshang dgos/ nyin zhag gi lo la/ nyin zhag sum brgya drug cu'am/ nyin zhag gi dbang du byas pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis tshang dgos/ khyim lo la/ khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu'am/ khyim zla bcu gnyis tshang dgos te/

nyin zhag sum brgya lnga bcu nga bzhi dang / tshes zhag sum brgya drug cu don gcig nyin zhag sum brgya drug bcu re lnga dang / khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu don gcig pa'i phyir/ lo gsum gyi 'jog tshul/ gong du bshad pa de ltar gzhung lugs kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa yin gyi/ deng sang gi mngon 'dul ba phal cher/ zhag 'jog pa nyin zhag dbang btsan/ zla ba 'jog pa tshes zla dbang btsan/ lo 'jog pa khyim lo dbang btsan pas/ nyin zhag kho na zhag mtshan nyid pa dang / khyim lo kho na lo mtshan nyid pa yin zhes 'dod cing / zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi/ zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig zhes pa'i don/ zhag mi thub lhag pa la 'chad cing / zla ba bcu gnyis zhag mi thub kyi zhag drug dang bcas pa la lo gcig tu 'jog go zhes smras pa ni/ gzhung gi don la ma zhugs shing / khas blangs nang 'gal ba yin te/ khyed 'dod pa'i zla bcu gnyis/ zhag mi thub drug dang bcas pa'i lo de/ sngar bshad pa'i lo gsum po gang rung du ma 'dus pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir te/ tshes lo dang nyin zhag gi lor ni khyed rang yang mi 'dod cing / khyim lo las kyang nyin zhag gcig gi zhag grangs mangs ba'i phyir/ des na khyim lo dang nyin zhag gi lo gnyis po btags pa yin la/ tshes lo kho na lo mtshan nyid pa yin te/ 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa las/ /gang de nyi shu ma lon pa'i/ /lo'i bsnyen par rdzogs gyur na/ /zla shol mngal gyi 'phro rnams kyi/ /mkhas pa yis ni bskang bar bya/ /zhes khyim lo bco brgyad lon pa'i gang zag la mngal gyi zla ba dang shol gyi zla ba'i kha bskang nas/ lo nyi shu lon par mdzad de/ bsnyen par rdzogs par bya rung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa zla ba'i rnam gzhag la/ ngo bo dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshes zhag sum cu'i yun tshad la zla bar 'jog ste/ zla ba'i dkar nag gi 'phel cha sum cu'i yun tshad la zla bar 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rten 'brel gyi sgo nas/

skar ma'i sgo nas/ khyim gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ de dag gi khyad chos bsdus don gyis bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ ma rig pa'i zla ba dang 'du byed kyi zla ba sogs bcu gnyis yod de/ mdo sde rnams las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mgo'i zla ba sogs bcu gnyis su yod de/ skar ma'i sgo nas de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ lug gi zla ba sogs bcu gnyis yod de/ dbyangs sbyar las/ lug glang 'khrig pa karka ṭa/ seng ge bu mo srang dang sdig gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa de dag gi khyad chos bsdus don gyi tshul gyis bstan pa ni/ dgun ra mgo ni gzhu'i khyim/ rga shi'i zla ba rgya nag pa/ /dgun zla glang gi zla ba zer/ /nyin bar yud tsam bcu bzhi la/ /mtshan mo yud tsam bcu drug yin/ /dgun 'bring rgyal ni chu srin khyim/ /ma rig zla ba rgya nag pa/ /dpyid ra stag gi zla ba zer/ /nyin mo yud tsam mtshan bcu bdun/ /dgun tha mchu ni bum pa'i khyim/ /'du byed zla ba rgya nag pa/ /dpyid 'bring yos kyi zla ba zer/ /nyin mo bcu gnyis bco brgyad mtshan/ /dpyid ra o ni nya'i khyim/ /rnam shes zla ba rgya nag pa/ /dpyid tha 'brug gi zla ba zer/ nyin mo bcu gsum mtshan bcu bdun/ /dpyid 'bring nag pa lug gi khyim/ /ming gzugs zla ba rgya nag pa/ dbyar ra sbrul gyi zla ba zer/ /nyin mo bcu bzhi mtshan bcu drug /dpyid tha sa ga glang gi khyim/ /skye mched zla ba rgya nag pa/ /dbyar 'bring rta'i zla ba zer/ /nyin mtshan yud tsam bco lngar mnyam/ /dbyar ra snron ni 'khrig pa'i khyim/ /reg pa'i zla ba rgya nag pa/ /dbyar tha lug gi zla ba zer/ /nyin mo bcu drug mtshan bcu bzhi/ /dbyar 'bring chu stod karka ṭa'i khyim/ /tshor ba'i zla ba rgya nag pa/ /ston ra spre'u zla ba zer/ /nyin mo bcu bdun mtshan bcu gsum/ /dbyar tha gro zhun seng ge'i khyim/ /sred pa'i zla ba rgya nag pa/

/ston 'bring bya'i zla ba zer/ /nyin bar bco brgyad mtshan bcu gnyis/ /ston ra khrums ni bu mo'i khyim/ /len pa'i zla ba rgya nag pa/ /ston tha khyi'i zla ba zer/ /nyin mo bcu bdun mtshan bcu gsum/ /ston 'bring tha skar srang gi khyim/ /sred pa'i zla ba rgya nag pa/ /dgun ra phag gi zla ba zer/ /nyin mo bcu drug mtshan bcu bzhi/ /ston tha smin drug sdig pa'i khyim/ /skye ba'i zla ba rgya nag pa/ /dgun 'bring byi ba'i zla ba zer/ /nyin mtshan yud tsam bco lngar mnyam/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /tshul 'di dag ni/ kho bos rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdo rgyud kho na dpang du btsugs nas bshad pa yin pas/ shes ldan dag yid ches kyi gnas su gyis shig gsum pa la/ zhag gsum gyi dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang / de ltar bstan pa'i dgos pa gnyis/ dang po la khyim zhag nyin zhag tshes zhag dang gsum/ dang po la khyim gyi dbye ba dang / de dag gi yun tshad gnyis/ dang po ni nyi mas rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun la longs spyod pa'i nyi ma'i khyim bcu gnyis yod de/ gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya/ lug glang 'khrig pa kar ka ṭa/ seng ge bu mo srang dang sdig ces pa ltar ro/ /'di dag la dgun dus kyi khyim gsum/ dpyid dus kyi/ dbyar dus kyi/ ston dus kyi khyim gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gzhu chu srin bum pa'i khyim dang gsum mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ nya lug glang gi khyim dang gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ 'khrig pa karka ṭa'i seṅge'i khyim gsum mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ bu mo srang sdig pa'i khyim dang gsum mo/ /gnyis pa'i yun tshad ni/ nyi mas rgyu skar gnyis dang bzhi cha re la rang 'gros kyi tshul gyis longs spyod pa'i tshul gyi yun tshad la/ khyim re rer 'jog ste/ nyi mas rgyu skar nyer bdun la rang 'gros kyi tshul gyis longs spyod pa'i yun tshad la khyim bcu gnyis su phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ de dag gi sdom tshig ni/ rgyu skar nas bzung chu smad bzhi cha gzhu/

chu smad bzhi gsum mon phyed chu srin khyim/ mon phyed nas bzung khrums stod bzhi gsum bum/ khrums stod bzhi cha nam khrum rdzogs pa nya/ /tha skar nas bzung smin drug bzhi cha lug /mgo phyed glang dang nabs so'i bzhi gsum 'khrig /kag rdzogs kar ka dbo'i bzhi cha seng / /nag phyed bu mo sa ga'i bzhi gsum srang / /sa ga'i bzhi cha snron rdzogs sdig pa'i khyim/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /dper na nyi ma dgun zla ra ba gzhu khyim na gnas pa'i dus su skar ma snrubs chu stod chu smad kyi bzhi cha la longs spyod pa yin zhing / nyi ma dpyid 'bring nag pa lug gi khyim na gnas pa'i dus/ dbyug pa/ bra nye/ smin drug gi bzhi cha la rang 'gros kyi tshul gyis longs spyod pa dang / nyi ma ston zla tha chung sdig pa'i khyim na gnas pa'i dus su skar ma sa ga'i bzhi cha/ lha mtshams snron gsum la rang 'gros kyi tshul gyis longs spyod pa bzhin no/ /de yang khyim re re la/ khyim zhag sum cu sum cu/ khyim zhag re re la chu tshod drug cu dang chu srang lnga bcu re yod par bshad do/ /des na shing pho byi ba lta bu'i lo gcig la khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu yod de/ lo bdag gcig la khyim bcu gnyis rdzogs par tshang dgos la/ khyim re re la khyim zhag sum cu re yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na nyi ma'i gnas khyim bcu gnyis la lug glang sogs zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ shar phyogs na gnas pa'i khyim dang po la/ lug gi khyim zer pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri lug gi gdong pa can gnas shing / khyim der nyi ma'i khyim slebs pa dang / lug gi phru gu btsa' ba'i phyir/ byang shar gyi phyogs gcig na gnas pa'i khyim gnyis pa la/ glang khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri glang gi gdong po can gnas shing / khyim der nyi ma slebs pa dang / glang rnams gnya' 'og tu 'jug pa'i phyir/ byang shar gyi phyogs gcig shos na gnas pa'i khyim gsum pa la/

'khrig khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri pho mo snyoms 'jug gi rnam pa can gnas shing / khyim der nyi ma slebs pa na/ srog chags phal cher 'dod chags shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /byang phyogs na gnas pa'i khyim bzhi pa la/ karka ṭa'i khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri sbal pa'i mgo can gnas shing / khyim der nyi mas slebs pa na/ sbal pa rnams kog sgra 'byin pa'i phyir ro/ /nub byang gi phyogs gcig na gnas pa'i khyim lnga pa la/ seng ge'i khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri seng ge'i mgo can gnas shing / khyim der nyi ma slebs pa na/ seng ge rnams seng mo la 'jug pa'i phyir/ nub byang gi phyogs gcig shos na gnas pa'i khyim drug pa la bu mo'i khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri gzhon nu ma lang 'tsho dar la babs pa gru nang na bzhugs pa skya ba 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gnas shing / khyim der nyi ma'i slebs pa na/ bud med rnams sgeg pa shas che bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nub phyogs na gnas pa'i khyim bdun pa la/ srang gi khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod do/ /phyogs der brag ri bu mo srang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gnas shing / khyim der nyi mas slebs pa na/ mar dang 'bru mar la sogs pa srang la 'jal ba'i dus yin pa'i phyir/ lho nub kyi phyogs gcig na gnas pa'i khyim brgyad pa la/ sdig pa'i khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri sdig pa'i mgo can gnas shing / khyim der nyi mas sleb pa na/ sdig pa rnams 'og tu 'jug pa'i dus yin pa'i phyir/ lho nub kyi phyogs gcig shos na gnas pa'i khyim dgu pa la/ gzhu'i khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri gzhu'i dbyibs can gnas shing / khyim der nyi ma sleb pa na/ gzhu rnams sra bar 'gyur ba'i dus yin pa'i phyir/ lho phyogs na gnas pa'i khyim bcu pa la/

chu srin khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri chu srin gyi gdong pa can gnas shing / khyim der nyi ma sleb pa na/ chu srin rnams kyang grang ba'i stobs kyis rgya mtsho las phyi rol du nyi ma la 'dug pa'i phyir/ shar lho'i phyogs gcig na gnas pa'i khyim bcu gcig pa la bum pa'i khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der bud med chang bum 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gnas shing khyim der nyi ma sleb pa na/ chang bcud dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /shar lho'i phyogs gcig shos na gnas pa'i khyim bcu gnyis pa la/ nya khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyogs der brag ri nya'i mgo can gnas shing / khyim der nyi ma sleb pa na/ nya rnams gnas nas ldang ba'i phyir/ 'di rnams la khyim zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gnas bcu gnyis po de rnams su nyi ma khyim zla re rer gnas pa'i phyir/ dper na mi gnas pa'i khang pa la/ mi'i khyim zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /'di rnams la 'pho ba zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gnas bcu gnyis po de rnams su nyi ma rim gyis 'pho ba'i phyir/ 'pho ba bcu drug tu bshad pa'ang yod pa'i phyir/ sngar gyi bcu gnyis kyi steng du zla ba 'gog pa/ nyi ma 'gog pa/ thig le 'gog pa/ nam mkha' 'gog pa ste/ bcu drug go /gnyis pa nyin zhag ni/ nyi mas gling la bya ba byed tshul kyi sgo nas 'jog pa yin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir da nang skya rengs shar nas sang skya rengs ma shar gyi bar la/ nyin zhag gcig tu 'jog cing / de nyid la chu tshod drug cu'am/ yud tsam sum cu yod pa'i phyir/ des na khyim lo gcig la/ nyin zhag sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga yod de/ khyim lo gcig la khyim zhag sum brgya dang drug cu yod pa gang zhig khyim zhag sum brgya drug bcu la/ nyin zhag sum brgya drug cu rtsa lnga 'byung ba'i phyir te/ khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu 'das pa'i tshe/ nyin zhag sum brgya dang drug cu 'das steng /

chu tshod sum brgya lhag pa gang zhig chu tshod sum brgya la nyin zhag lnga bcu 'byung ba'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ khyim zhag re re nyin zhag re re las chu srang lnga bcu res lhag cing / chu srang lnga bcu tshan pa sum brgya dang drug bcu bsdoms pa la chu tshod sum brgya 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa tshes zhag ni/ zla ba 'phel 'grib kyi sgo nas 'jog pa yin te/ zla ba la yar ngo la 'phel cha bco lnga/ mar ngo la 'grib cha bco lnga yod cing / 'phel cha bco lnga cha gcig gam/ 'grib cha bco lnga cha gcig la tshes zhag gcig tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ de yang zla ba'i cha shas kyis/ dpag tshad gsum dang sum cha gcig 'phel ba'i yun tshad la/ chu tshod lnga bcu nga dgu yod cing / de la tshes zhag gcig tu 'jog te/ zla ba'i rgyar dpag tshad lnga bcu yod cing / de'i 'phel cha bco lnga cha gcig la/ tshes zhag gcig tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ des na khyim lo gcig la/ tshes zhag sum brgya bdun cu rtsa gcig rjes 'brang dang bcas pa yod de/ de la nyin zhag sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga yod cing / de la tshes zhag sum brgya dang bdun bcu rtsa gcig rjes 'brang dang bcas pa 'byung ba'i phyir te/ nyin zhag sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga 'das pa'i tshe/ tshes zhag sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga 'das steng / chu tshod sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga lhag pa gang zhig chu tshod sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga la tshes zhag drug 'byung ba'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ nyin zhag de tshes zhag las chu tshod re res lhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de ltar bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ zhag gsum gyi rnam gzhag phyin ci ma log par bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ gso sbyong zhag mi thub 'byung tshul dang / zla ba'i shol 'dor tshul bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ zla ba'i shol 'dor tshul ni 'og tu 'chad la/ gso sbyong zhag mi thub 'byung tshul cung zad brjod na/

dus nam gyi tshe 'byung / zla ba gang la 'byung / de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ zhag mi thub kyi sgra don dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dus tshigs la dgun stod dgun smad sogs drug tu phye ba'i zla ba phyed dang gnyis gnyis 'das/ phyed de lus pa'i skabs su 'byung ba yin te/ mdzod 'grel las/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das shing / zla ba phyed ni lus pa na/ mkhas pas zhag mi thub par 'dod/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mgo'i zla ba ril po rdzogs so/ /rgyal gyi zla ba'i phyed 'das pa/ rgyal gyi mar ngo'i nyin zhag bcu bzhi pa la/ dgun stod kyi gso sbyong zhag mi thub 'byung ba nas/ smin drug gi zla ba'i mar ngo'i nyin zhag bcu bzhi pa la/ dbyar stod kyi gso sbyong zhag mi thub 'byung ba'i bar du yin te/ lo dri las/ rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga bcas/ chu stod khrums smad smin drug bcas/ 'di rnams kyis ni nag po'i phyogs/ zla phyed gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ zla ba gnyis gnyis nas zhag mi thub re re 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshes zhag dang nyin zhag gi bar khyad la/ yud tsam phyed kyis nyin zhag yun ring / tshes zhag yun thung ba yin la/ de 'dra'i bar khyad yud tsam phyed pa de zla ba gcig tu bsags pas/ yud tsam bco lnga 'byung / de 'dra zla ba gnyis su bsags pas yud tsam sum cur 'gyur la/ des nyin zhag gcig tu longs pa'i zla ba gnyis gnyis nas/ nyin zhag re re 'dor dgos pa'i phyir/ zla ba gnyis gnyis kyi bar du nyin zhag re re 'dor ba'i gnad 'di ma shes par/ gso sbyong zhag mi thub lhag par 'dod pa rnams ni/ chad pa bsags pas lhag po byung ba bzhad bgad kyi gnas su 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa sgra don ni/ 'o na zhag mi thub zhes pa'i don gang yin zhe na/ tshes zhag gis nyin gyi dod ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis na zhag mi thub zhes bya ste/

de gnyis la yud tsam phyed kyi ring thung gi khyad par yod pa gong du bshad zin pa'i phyir/ bdun pa de las shol nyid 'dor ba'i tshul la/ zhag shol la brten nas zla shol 'dor tshul dang / zla shol la brten nas lo shol 'dor tshul gnyis/ dang po la tshes zhag gis nyin zhag gi dod ma thub pa'i 'dor tshul rags pa'i rnam gzhag tshes zhag gi khyim zhag gi dod ma thub pa'i 'dor tshul zhib mo'i rnam gzhag de nyid dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa dang yang 'byor te lag tu blangs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ de lta bas na/ lo re re bzhin shol ma dor bar lo lnga lnga nas shol dor gcig drug lnga sum cu ste/ de lta bu'i zhag dang zla ba phyed pa dang / zla ba dang lo 'dres nas mnyam por 'gyur te/ mu stegs can rnams kyis glags btsam yang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lo re la zhag mi thub drug drug 'byung bas/ drug lnga sum cu tham pa la/ zla gcig 'byung bas/ lo lnga lnga nas zla shol re yod par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lo gnyis dang zla ba phyed dang dgu 'das pa na zla shol re 'don te/ khyim lo gcig song ba'i tshe tshes lo gcig song rjes tshes zhag bcu gcig lhag pa'i phyir/ 'di ni rjes bcas dang zhib rtsis kyi rnam gzhag yin te/ ston pa 'khor bcas kyis lo lnga lnga nas zla shol re bton/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis lo gnyis dang zla ba phyed dang dgu nas zla shol re bton pa ma mthun pa'i tshe/ blon po rnams 'cha' bar gyur pa'i tshe/ nyan thos rnams kyis ston pa'i snyan du gsol bas zla shol dor ba rgyal po'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o/ /zhes rjes bcas zhib rtsis kyi rnam gzhag gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i nang tshan gzhung dam pa'i gleng gzhi las/ ston pa mnyan yod kyi rgyal byed kyi tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshe na/ dge slong rnams la lo lnga lnga nas shol dor cig zhes gsungs nas lo lnga lnga nas shol dor ro/

/rgyal po dag ni lo gsum nas shol 'dor bar byed do/ /dge slong dag gis rgyal po'i ltar ma byas pa dang blon po dag 'cha' bar gyur pa na/ de ltar gyur pa dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba dang / bka' bstsal pa/ dge slong dag blon po rnams 'cha' ba ni/ yul rtsis te de lta bas na/ rgyal po'i gzhung bzhin du yang gyis shig ces dang / mdo rtsa'i 'grel chung las kyang / lho phyed gsum lhag nas zla shol 'dor par gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhib rtsis kyi rnam gzhag 'di 'dul ba'i chos skad ma yin zer ba ni/ lung don la zhib du ma brtags so/ /gsum pa de nyid dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa dang sbyar te lag tu len pa'i tshul ni/ zhib rtsis kyi rnam gzhag 'di dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa mngon 'dul dang ma mthun zhing / da lta lag tu blang bar bya ba yin la/ de yang tshes kyi zla ba sum cu po phyed dang gsum gsum nas tshes kyi zla ba res shol bton dgos te/ de ma bton na khyim zhag gi zla ba phyed bcas sum cu po de mi rdzogs la/ de ma rdzogs na lo re bzhin gyi dus bzhi'i longs spyod mi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ de ltar byas pas zla ba drug cu re lnga na zla ba gnyis kyi shol 'byung la/ de 'gres pas tshes lo brgya nas/ tshes zla sum cu so bdun dang / zla ba phyed kyi shol 'byung / de la lo gsum dang phyogs gsum 'byung zhing / de dang tshes lo brgya po de bsres pas khyim lo brgyar 'gyur ba yin no/ /de dag gi shes byed kyang / tshes zhag gcig gis nyin zhag gcig tu dus kyi chu tshod gcig dang / chu srang lnga bcu rtsa gnyis dang dbugs gsum gyis ma longs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang nang gi nges pa'i dbang gis yin te/ rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba'i yun tshad gcig la zhag tu byas pa'i zhag sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga ni/

lo gcig gi nyi ma'i bgrod pa gnyis mthar thug gi yun tshad yin pa las zhag re'i rlung gi steng nas dbugs drug brgya dang bdun cu rtsa lnga re ye shes kyi char song zhing / las rlung chad pas chu tshod gcig dang / chu srang lnga bcu phyed bcas rtsa gsum ma longs pa des tshes kyi longs spyod rdzogs par 'jog la/ khyim gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa la nyi khri gcig stong drug brgya'i rlung rgyu ba'i tshad de rdzogs dgos pa yin no/ /de tsam re chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / 'pho chen bcu gnyis po re re'i mtshams su nga drug rkang bcas re chad par byed la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang 'pho chen re la 'pho chung lnga lnga yod pa'i mtshams su/ sa rlung sogs re re nas bcu gcig dang / rkang pa re'am 'chad par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan la thug go /gnyis pa lo shol la brten nas lo shol 'dor tshul ni/ zla ba sum cu po phyed dang gsum gsum nas/ zla shol re 'byung cing / de 'dra ba bcu gnyis bsdoms pas/ lo shol gcig 'byung ste/ zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'o na zhag shol dang zla shol 'don pa bden mod/ lo shol 'don pa mi 'thad de/ de ston na byi ba glang stag la sogs pa bcu gnyis po gang rung ma yin pa'i ming 'dogs can gyi lo gzhan zhig khas len dgos pa'i phyir snyam na/ skyon med de/ byi ba glang stag la sogs pa la lo shol 'don pa ma yin gyi/ de dag gi khyim lo yin la/ khyim lo dang tshes lo la ring thung shor ba'i khyad par snyoms pa'i phyir du/ tshes lo'i shol 'don dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na khyim zhag la khyim zhag gi shol mi 'don yang / khyim zhag dang nyin zhag dang / tshes zhag gi ring thung gi bar khyad snyoms pa la/ tshes zhag gi zla shol 'don dgos pa bzhin no/ /lo shol 'don pa'i tshul 'di ni dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa bla na med pa yin te/ rgyud las/ 'byung ba ri dang dus mnyam dag gi grangs zhes gsungs pa ltar/

nyin zhag re'i rlung gi steng nas/ dbugs drug brgya dang bdun cu rtsa lnga re ye shes kyi char song zhing / las rlung chad pas/ nyin zhag gi lo go drug dang / nyin zhag gi zla ba phyed dang bcu gcig nas/ nyin zhag gi lo gsum dang / zla ba phyed dang gnyis kyis shol 'byung ba la/ lo gsum phyogs gsum du gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang rje btsun khu dbon gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dag ldan dang / bde mchog bstod 'grel sogs las/ nang du rtsa gnas bco lnga dang / phyi rol du zhag bco lnga la/ nang du 'pho ba bcu drug bsgrod pas/ de'i shugs kyis nang du 'pho ba la lhag chad dang / dbugs la lhag chad 'byung la/ de'i dbang gis phyi rol du zla ba dang / lo la shol 'dor bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /shes ldan dag zla ba'i shol khas len bzhin du/ de bsags pa'i lo shol khas mi len pa'i gtam 'chal ma smra bar/ lung gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don la blo kha phyogs par gyis shig ༈ /da ni gong du bshad pa dag gi rgyu mtshan phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dag pa dang sbyar te/ yid ches kyi man ngag gi sgo nas bshad par bya ba 'di lta ste/ na ma shrī ka la ya tsakra/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo ngo bo nyid/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum mi 'gyur bde bar bkral/ /dpal ldan rgod tshang pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi dang nang dang gzhan dang de bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang gis rgyu mtshan gcig pa ru/ /bshad pa bdag gi gsal bar bkod bya yi/ /blo gros ldan rnams bsam pa dag pas nyon/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus su grub/ /'jig rten khams kyang rgyu mtshan de bzhin chags/ /dkyil 'khor lha dang lam gyi rim pa yang / /gtan tshigs de yis thams cad ston par byed/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i gdams pa yi/ /lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag pa la/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub bshad pa las/

/rtsa yi gnad kyis lus dang snod rnams 'chags/ /rlung gis ngag dang dus rnams 'chag par byed/ /dwangs mas yid dang rgyu skar gza' rnams skyed/ /rtsa la brten nas rlung gi rgyu tshul yang / /zhag gcig nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i grangs/ /lo gcig chu tshod grangs kyang de tsam yin/ /rgyu mtshan de yis phyi ru lo gcig dang / /nang gi zhag gcig yin par shes par bya/ /zhag gcig rlung la pho chen bcu gnyis te/ /lo'ang khyim dang zla ba bcu gnyis yod/ /'pho chen re la stong dang brgyad brgya'i srog /zla bar 'char bas chu tshod grangs kyang re/ /rgyu mtshan de yis phyi ru zla gcig dang / /nang du 'pho ba chen po gcig tu 'dod/ /ma rig la sogs 'pho chen re re yang / /'byung lnga'i bdud rtsi 'pho chung lnga lngar gnas/ /'pho chung re la sum brgya drug cu'i srog /phyi ru zhag drug 'pho chung yin pa'i phyir/ /sum brgya drug cu'i chu tshod gnas par 'dod/ /phyi ru chu tshod drug cur longs pa la/ /skar ma'am zhag tu 'jig rten yongs la grags/ /nang du zhag ni drug cu'i dbugs yin te/ /phyi ru dbyu gu mda' la 'pho chen te/ /nang du 'byung lnga'i grangs kyi srog la 'dod/ /phyi ru chu tshod re la 'pho chung yin/ /nang du dbyugs re 'pho chung yin no kye/ /'pho chung re la dbugs dang chu tshod ni/ /bcu gcig bzhi cha dbu ma'i rlung yin phyir/ /zla ba'i 'pho chen re la lnga bcu dang / /rtsa drug bzhi cha ye shes rlung 'jug 'dod/ /zhag gcig drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga'i rlung / /lo gcig chu tshod grangs kyang de tsam yin/ /de rnams lo brgya rgyu ba bsdoms pa la/ /lo gsum zla phyed gsum du shes par bya/ /de rnams rtsis kyi dus na shol du 'gyur/ /nang du brtan na rdo rje'i lus su 'grub/ /phyi ru shor na 'chi ltas skyed par byed/ /gza' rnams 'char ba'i skar ma de rnams yin/ /'pho chen zla ba de ni gnas gsum bzhag
