'khor lo phud pa'i lhag ma gza' gcig dang / /rags pa'i tshad ma bar pa po yi sgyur/ /zla ba drug nas re re bu lon du/ /'gyur bar gzung tshir rtsa ba drug gis bsgo/ /tshes la rgyu ba gza' bdun yod pa'i phyir/ /steng gi gnas la rgya gyis bgo bar bya/ /'pho chen zla ba de ni gnas gnyis gzhag /brgya phrag gcig dang nyi shu rtsa drug las/ /lhag ma cha shas gnas na med pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin dus dang nyi mas bgo bar bya/ /thob pa mnyam dang mi mnyam gtan tshigs dang / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi 'gros kyis 'byung ba'i phyir/ /ril po'i gnas la gnyis kyis bsgyur bar bya/ /bcu bzhi'i zla ba zad cing 'phel ba yang / /g.yas g.yon lho byang bgrod pa rgyu ba ste/ /rkang pa lan gnyis 'khor bas 'byung ba'i phyir/ /ril po brgyad dang gnyis kyis bgo bar bya/ /'pho chen zla ba gnas gsum gzhag pa la/ /zla ba gcig la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /rgyu skar gnyis dang chu tshod bcu gcig la/ /spyod phyir steng 'og mig dang grag po'i rgyur/ /zla ba sum cu rtsa dgu 'das pa dang / /re re lhag pa gzung ba'i don gyi phyir/ /'og ma sum cu rtsa dgu sgo bar bya/ /drug cu'i dbugs dang phyi rol zhag re la/ /rim pa bzhin du gza' re 'char ba'i phyir/ /gza'i gnas su tshes grangs byin par bya/ /dbugs dang chu tshod re re mi spyod pas/ /dbyug gu'i gnas nas re re bri bar bya/ /tshes re bzhin du re re 'da' ba'i phyir/ /ril po'i gnas su tshes grangs byin par bya/ /dbugs dang chu tshod bzhi la spyod pas na/ /tshes grangs stengs la me yis bsgyur bar bya/ /'og gi gnas lo de nyid kho nas sgyur/ /chu tshod bzhi dang chu srang nyi shu drug /nyin re bzhin du nyi mas spyod pa'i phyir/ /rtag par tshes re bzhin du byin par bya/ /skar ma re la chu tshod drug cu rung / /gnas phyir chu tshod drug cus bsgyur bar bya/ /grangs mthun phyir na dbyug gu steng du gzhug

/mda' yon zla ba'i khyim gyi chu tshod kyi/ /dgos pa thob pas nyi ma'i rkang pa sbyang / /rkang pa dang ni bgos pa las byung ba'i/ /chu tshod rnams kyang lho byang bgrod pa yi/ /snad kyi bri ba dang ni snon par 'gyur/ /skar ma re re zla ba'i zhag re la/ /spyod phyir skar ma'i gnas su tshes grangs byin/ /nyi mas zla ba spyod pa'i longs spyod rnams/ /ri bong 'dzin pas spyod par mi nus pa'i/ /tshes la drug gis sgyur la drug cus bgo /thob nor de ni gza' yi chu tshod kyi/ /sbyangs par gyur pa'i gza' yis longs spyod pa/ /rgyud rgyal mtshungs med dus kyi 'khor lo'i gnad/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum shes pa'i dkyil 'khor las/ /lung dang rigs pa bla ma'i man ngag gis/ /ma nor don rtogs o rgyan pa yis sbyar/ /'di don sems can kun gyis rtog par shog /phyi nang gzhan gsum gsal ba zhes bya ba'i rtsis rdzogs so// ༈ //de ltar nang rtsis zab mo'i gnad/ /dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro yis/ /rgod tshang rje la dngos su gnang / /o rgyan rgyal pos de rgyas spel/ /dngos grub dpal 'bar blo gros kyi/ /bai ḍūr dkar po'i bum bzang du/ /man ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gdam/ /don gnyer rkang drug ldan pa'i tshogs/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bcud la rol/ /de dag gis ni dus tshigs kyi bka' ba'i gnad spyi don gyi sgo nas bstan zin to// ༈ //da ni gnyis pa ri rab la brten pa la/ rgyal chen ris bzhi'i gnas dang ni/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi gnas/ /zhes pa ltar gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi ri rab 'di la chu mtshams nas brtsegs pas bang rim bzhi yod de/ de bzhi'i bar gyi thag ni dpag tshad stong phrag bcu bcu yod pas/ ri rab kyi phyed yan du phyin to/ /bang rim dang po dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug dang / gnyis pa brgyad dang / gsum pa bzhi dang / bzhi pa gnyis ri rab la 'phyar du 'phags so/ /de bzhi la gnod sbyin lag na gzhong thogs dang /

phreng thogs dang rtag tu myos pa dang / bzhi pa la rgyal chen bzhi rang nyid dang de'i 'khor gyi lha rnams gnas te/ gser gyi ri bdun la yang / de rnams kyis grong dang grong rdal gnas so/ /khor yug la'ang lung phran tshegs su/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can zhes pa rgyal chen ris bzhi gnas par gsungs shing / gzhan yang nyi ma zla ba skar ma dang / /ri dang chu rlung dang ljon shing dang / nags tshal dang sa bla dang / nam mkha' dang rgya mtsho rnams la'ang de rnams kyi lha gnas te/ 'grel par de nyid kyi phyir lha'i ris de ni/ thams cad pas che ba'o/ /zhes so/ /sar ni/ bang rims bzhi la rim pa'i lag na gzhong thogs pa dang / rtag myos dang / 'phreng thogs rnams gnas shing / rgyal chen bzhi ni gnya' shing 'dzin gyi ngos na te/ shar na yul 'khor srung gi pho brang / yul 'khor srung dang / lho na 'phags skyes po'i pho brang / 'phags par skyes dang / nub na mig mi bzang gi pho brang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / byang na rnam thos sras kyi pho brang lcang lo can yod par bshad la/ lcang lo can na gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje bzhugs par bka' bstsal lo/ /bzhag par yang / gnya' shing 'dzin la rgyal chen bzhi'i gnas ming sa dang 'dra ba ste/ chu zheng du dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu pa 'khor yug tu stong stong gis 'khor ba gru bzhi pa/ lam srang dang / skyed tshal dang / ljon shing dang / rdzing bu dang / gser gyi ra ba dang / zam pa rgyud ma dang / gser gyi bye ma brdal ba dang / tsandan gyi chus chag chag btab pa dang / tshon brgya rtsa gcig gis mig mang ris su bris pa sogs/ khyad par du ma can du bshad do/ /gnyis pa sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lhun po'i rtse na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha gnas so/ /lhun po'i rtse de'i ngos re re la dpag tshad brgyad khri re'o/ /phyogs mtshams dpag tshad lnga brgya'i tshad tsam brtsegs pa bzhi la/

gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gnas so/ /bzhag par ni/ de'i rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang lnga dang / chu zheng du brgya nyer lnga dang / mtha' skor du lnga brgya par bshad do/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ gnas tshal sa gzhi ljon shing dang / 'dun pa'i khyad chos rnam lnga bshad/ ces pa ltar/ lnga las/ dang po ni/ rtse de'i dbus na brgya byin gyi pho brang / grong khyer lta na sdug ces pa ngos re re la dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya pa/ rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis pa'i ra ba/ gser gyi rang bzhin te/ sa gzhi tshon brgyas bkra ba shing bal ltar 'jam pa/ rkang pa bzhag na ni nem dang bteg na 'phar ces byed pa'i mnyen pa yod do/ /bzhag par/ de gser gyi ra ba dpag tshad phyed dang gsum pas skor ba/ rtsig skyabs gser dngul bāai ḍūrya shel las byas pa/ ngos bzhi na mda' yab gyen thur du 'phyang ba gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ sgo stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba/ sgo la dpag tshad phyed dang gsum dang / zheng du phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ sgo re re la yang srung ma go mtshon thogs pa lnga brgya lnga brgya yod pa/ lam srang zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis dang / ring bar nyis stong lnga brgya bas mdzes pa/ sa las ni/ chu zheng du dpag tshad khri khri yod par bshad do/ grong khyer gyi dbus de na brgya byin gyi khang bzangs rnam par rgyal byed yod de/ ngos re re la dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu re'o/ /grong las dpag tshad phyed dang lnga 'phags pa/ rmang rin po che bzhi las byas pa/ them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ ka ba bzhi gser dang dngul dang bāai ḍūrya/ shel las byas pa/ ka rten dang ka gzhu dang bri phub dung la sogs pas byas pa/ ba gam brgya rtsa gcig pa/ ba gam re re la khang pa brtsegs pa bdun bdun dang / de re re la khang mig bdun bdun dang / de re re la lha'i bu bdun bdun dang / de re re la lha mo bdun bdun dang / de re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun dang /

de re re la sil snyan 'khrol ba bdun bdun yod de/ grong gis mngon par dga' ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ grong khyer de'i phyi'i ngos bzhi na lha rnams kyi brtse sa skyed tshal bzhi ste/ shing rta sna tshogs can dang / der phyin na shes pa rtsub par 'gyur ba'i tshal dang / lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams 'dres shing 'dod yon la spyod pa'i tshal dang / der phyin na yid dga' ba skye ba'i tshal dang bzhi'i brgyan te/ sum cu rtsa gsum brtsi tshul ni/ gdags pa dang / dkon mchog ta la'i gzungs su shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal na/ glang po che sa bsrung kyi bu gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa dkar ba yan lag bdun legs par gnas pa/ mgo dmar ba/ mche ba drug pa/ srid du dpag tshad gcig dang / khor yug tu bdun yod pa/ 'khor glang po che brgya stong dang ldan pa gnas te/ lha skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba na/ des mgo sum cu rtsa gsum du sprul zhing / mgo re re la mche ba drug drug dang / de re re la rdzing bu bdun bdun dang / de re re la padma'i sdong po bdun bdun dang / padma re re la lha mo bdun bdun dang / de re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun dang / de re re la sil snyan 'khrol ba bdun bdun du sprul te/ mgo'i dbus ma la dbang po dang / gzhan la nye dbang so gnyis dang / glang po che gzhan rnams la 'khor rnams zhon nas 'gro ba mi mngon pa lta bu'i mgyogs pa'i lha rnams drangs nas skyed mos tshal du skyel la/ de nas rdzu 'phrul de btang nas 'dod pa la spyod par gsungs so/ /des lha'i dbang po la tshal du gdan 'dren pa'i glang po che sa srung kyi bu lham yin dang 'thab pa la/ glang po che rab brtan bya ba gzhan gyi skabs su/ rta mchog sprin gyis shugs can la chibs nas 'byon zhing / lha ma yin la yang phun sum tshogs pa de dag dang 'dra ba yod par 'og nas 'chad do/ /gsum pa ni/ skyed tshal de rnams kyi phyogs bzhi dpag tshad nyi shu spyod pa na/

sa gzhi bzang po tshal de dag la 'gran pa lta bu yod/ bzhi pa ni/ grong khyer de'i phyi'i byang shar kyi mtshams na shing yongs 'dus sa brtol zhes bya ba/ dpag tshad lnga thur du zug pa/ brgya gyen du 'phags pa/ yal ga dang 'dab ma lnga bcur khyab pa/ me tog rgyas pa'i dri rdzi phyogs su dpag tshad brgya dang / de min du lnga bcu ldang ba'o/ /sar/ yal 'dab kyis brgyad cur khyab pa dang / de'i drung du dbyar zla bzhi 'dod pa la rtse bar bshad do/ /gzhan yang dbyar rtse ba dang / de'i drung du ar mo nig lta bu'i rdo leb dkar po/ chu zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu dang rngams su drug dang bco brgyad/ dbus na brgya byin gyi seng ge'i khri dang / nye 'khor na nye dbang rnams kyi khri yod/ lnga pa ni/ lho nub kyi mtshams na/ lha'i 'dun sa chos bzang ste/ der lha rnams bya ba dang byed pa ma yin pa bka' bgros 'o/ /bzhag par/ shar lho na dang / sar/ byang shar na dang / de'i 'dabs na rdo leb yod par bshad do/ /gnyis pa sa dang ma 'brel ba'i gnas ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa de'i steng nas steng du 'thab bral sogs 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams te/ nam mkha'i gzhal med khang rnams la gnas so/ /de yan chad kun 'thab bral yin yang spyi ming sger la btags nas dang po 'thab bral zhes bya ste/ lha 'og ma gnyis ni lha min dang 'thab pas so/ /de la lha ma yin gyi gnas ni/ sar/ ri rab chu la nub pa'i khong gseng na yod par bshad cing / 'di ltar dran pa nyer bzhag tu gsungs te/ dpag tshad sum khri na 'od ldan gyi khyim na sgra gcan dang / de nas bzhi stong na dkar phreng gi grong na mgu phreng dang / de nas bzhi stong brtan pa'i grong na rab rnon dang / de nas bzhi stong na zab pa'am gser ldan gyi grong na thags bzang ris gnas la/ de nas sma dma' shes bzang shing / bzhi pa'i gser gyi sa gzhi la lta na sdug gi dod gser ldan dang / rnam rgyal gyi dod sdom pa can dang /

chos bzang gi dod nor bzang dang / yongs su 'du ba'i dod tsi ṭa ba dra dang / zla ba dkar po'i dod/ rdo leb bzang po dang / tshal bzhi ni shar phyogs na kun dga' dang / rab dga' dang dga' ba dang kun dga' ra ba'o/ /sa gzhi bzhi ni/ kun dga' can nas/ kun dga' ra ba can gyi bar ro/ /glang po che rab brtan gyi dod/ bzod par dka' ba dang / sa srungs kyi bu'i dod ti se gangs brtsegs dang / rta sprin gyi shugs can gyi dod/ brag 'jing zhes pa'o/ /lha dang 'thab pa ni/ lha lha ma yin gyi bu mo 'dod pa dang / lha ma yin lha'i bdud rtsi bzang po 'dod pas zhe 'gras te/ lha ma yin rnams ri rab kyi khong gseng nas/ gser dngul shel man shel bāai ḍūrya'i mtshon thogs shing / go cha gyon te chas pa na/ dmag gi ber gyis brgya byin gyi gdan 'gul bas dmag 'ong bar shes so/ /de rnams klu dang 'thab pas pham na rang gi gnas su ldog la/ dkar po'i klu rnams pham na chu mtshams nas thon te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkha' la 'phags nas/ bang rim gyi lha dang 'thab bo/ /de'i tshe lha'i gnas mi gsal ba gsal ba'i ched du/ sgra gcan gyi nyi zla lag pas sgrib cing / rgyal pham dang skye dgu'i bde sdug 'dzam bu gling pa'i dge sdig la rag las pas/ lha rnams kyis gling 'di yang yang du myul lo/ /lha pham na pho nya rgyu zhing song ste/ lha'i dbang po mkhyen par mdzod cig lha ma yin gyi dpung rgyal chen ris bzhi pas ma thub pas sum cu rtsa gsum pas zlog par mdzod cig ces smras pas/ dbang po'i gzhan rnams la bsgo'o/ /g.yul ngor spyod pa'i glang po che rab brtan yang dbang po'i bsam pa shes te/ der phyin nas lha rnams rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal du phyin te 'thab par mos te/ ri rab kyi nub kyi steng nas 'thab bo/ /bzhag par/ lhor 'thab par bshad do/ /lha ma yin rnams ri 'phen zhing / de kun dbang po'i rdo rjes bcom pas dum bu rol mtsho sogs su lhung bas srog chags du ma shi ste mtsho dmar por 'gro'o/

/lha'i mgo dang sked pa chad na 'chi la yan lag bcad kyang skye ste/ sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ngo / /lha ma yin mi bzhin du gnad du phog na 'chi la/ de'ang gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ mtsho kun snang la shi ba dang / rkang lag chad pa sogs kyi gzugs brnyan shar te/ dmag ma log pa'i gong du mya ngan byed par bshad do/ /sar las/ lha ma yin yang / yan lag chad pas 'chi bar bshad la/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdor/ thags bzang ris kyi shing rta dpag tshad bdun brgya pa drag tu 'gro ba'ang / dbang po'i lag pa g.yon pas 'dzin nus par bka' bstsal to/ /de dag su pham pa/ rang gi grong khyer du zhugs nas zam pa bsdus sgo bcad de gnas pa na dngangs skrag 'byung bar phan tshun mi tshugs so/ /gsum pa zhar byung sems can gyi khyad chos la/ 'dod pa spyod pa dang / lha'i bu skye ba dang / 'dod pa de brten tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ lha de rnams la/ 'dod pa spyod pa ni dang po drug yin no/ /drug gi'ang ris 'og ma gnyis ni dbang po gnyis sprad de dang / gsum pa ma byung ba dang / bzhi pa lag bcangs dang / lnga pa dgod pa dang / drug pa bltas pa tsam gyis 'khrig pa'i bde ba myong ngo / /bye brag tu smra ba ni/ drug char gnyis kyis spyod kyang / gdags par de skad 'byung ba ni/ 'khrig pa'i dus kyis tshad ces smra'o/ /lha de drug gi 'dod yon gzhan ni gos srang phyed dang / bzhi cha dang / brgyad cha dang / bcu drug cha dang / so gnyis cha dang / re bzhi cha'o/ /rje khol dang / bag ma gtong len dang / pha ma dang / pho mo'i dbang po dang / bkres skom dang / dus bzhi dang / nyin mtshan rnams yod la/ mu ge dang nyo tshong dang nad dang rga ba med cing / tsha grang ni dang po na yod kyi/ de las gong du med ces bzhag par ro/ /sa las ni/ 'dod lha gong ma gsum la chung ma 'chang ba dang bag ma gtong len med par bshad la drug char lus kyi phyi nang gtsang zhing rngul dang dri ma dang rus pa dang rtsa rgyus dang /

nang khrol dang bshang gci med do/ /gser dngul shel bāai ḍūrya'i gzhal med khang dang / ba gam dang bsil khang dang / stegs bu dang / skar khung dra ba can nyams dga' ba nor bu sna tshogs pas spras shing / snang ba 'gyed pa mdzes pa yod do/ /bza' ba bdud rtsi sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi 'byung bas ljon shing dang / btung ba sbrang rtsi dang sbrang chang 'byung ba'i dang / zhon pa'i shing rta sogs 'byung ba'i dang / gos dang rgyan 'byung ba'i dang / dri bzang bdug pa dang / me tog phreng ba 'byung ba'i dang / bzhad gad dang / gar dang glu dang rol mo'i sgra 'byung ba'i dang / snod spyad yo byad sna tshogs 'byung ba'i ljon shing yod de/ ci 'dod pa bsam pa tsam gyis lag tu yong la/ sgra mi snyan na ni/ shing de dag la dpag bsam gyi shing zhes bya ste/ rang gis len gyi bsam pa tsam gyis lag tu yong pa yin no/ /chu yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rdzing bu dang / mtsho me tog sna tshogs dang / chu bya skad snyan pa 'byin pa can dang / dus dus su bag med pa las skul bar byed pa'i rnga sgra dang / lam srang kun nas sil snyan dang / pheg tob pa'i sgra sgrogs pa'i/ lha mo mdzes mas gang ba dang / sa la me tog man da ra ba pus mo nub pa tsam gyis khebs pa'i rnying pa rnams rlung gis 'dor zhing / gsar pa legs par 'grems te/ dran pa nyer bzhag tu/ lha rnams bsod nams dbang chen gyis/ lha yi grong du rlung chen ldang / me tog rnying pa 'dor byed cing / me tog gsar pa legs par 'grems/ zhes so/ /dga' ldan pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i dbang phyug gi drung na rtag tu theg pa chen po'i chos la spyod pas lhag ste/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi tshig le'ur bcas par/ thos pa mang dang chos 'dzin dang / /shes rab ldan zhing thar pa 'dod/ /yon tan ldan la dga' ba'i mi/ /de rnams dga' ldan nye bar 'gro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha mo rnams la mngal gyi gnas med ces par te/ pha dang ma'i pang du byis pa lo lnga lon pa tsam nas/

lo bcu lon pa lta bu'i bar la rim pa bzhin 'dod lha drug po de rnams su skye la/ gzhan rnams lus myur du rdzogs shing / brgya byin lus rdzogs pa skye bas snga phyi brje ba'ang gzhan gyis ma tshor ro/ /gzugs can gyi lha rnams ni lus kun rdzogs pa dang / gos dang bcas pa nyid du skye zhing / 'dod khams pa ni ngo tsha khrel yod shas chung bas gcer bur skye la/ rgyal bu don 'grub dang / dge slong ma dkar mo dang / dge tshul ma snar ma rnams ni gos dang bcas par ro/ /lha kun yang saṃ ṭi ta'i skad du smra'o/ /kha cig bden par smra ba'i dbang du byas pa zhes zer ro/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dod pa ji ltar gnas pa dang / rang gis sprul pa dang gzhan gyis sprul pa la dbang byed pas skye ba gsum po ni/ rim pa bzhin/ 'dod lha dang mir bcas pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'o/ /dben pa las skyes pa dang / ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa dang / dga' ba med pa'i bde ba can gyi skye ba gsum po ni rim pa bzhin bsam gtan dang po gsum gyis skye bas te/ de re re la sa gsum gsum te dgu'o/ /'on kyang tshangs chen ni spyod do/ /bzhi pa bar gyi thag tshad ni/ gnas de rnams kyi bar gyi thag tshad ni ji srid ce na/ gnas dang gnas nas 'og 'dzam gling ji srid pa de dang de'i gong du de srid de 'di nas rgyal chen bzhi'i pho brang la dpag tshad bzhi khri dang / de nas sum cu rtsa gsum la bzhi'o/ /'di nas rtsa gsum la brgyad khri dang / de nas 'thab bral la brgyad khri sogs te/ 'di nas shin tu mthong tsam/ de nas 'og min gyi bar du'o/ /gdags pa las ni gong ma gnyis la drug 'bum brgyad khri dang / gzhan rnams la bzhi khri par bshad do/ /ci 'og mas gong ma'i gong ma'i gnas su phyin nas mthong ngam zhe na/ rang gis sa gong ma'i rdzu 'phrul thob pa'am/ gzhan la brten te de na gnas pa'i lhas khrid na mthong gis de dag ma gtogs pa rnams kyis khams dang sa gong mar 'gro ba dang mthong ba med do/

/rgyal chen bzhi pa ni/ rtsa gsum par 'gro zhing mngon par dga' ba'i zhing na'ang gser dngul gyi skas la 'dzegs te mi rnams der 'gro bar bshad do/ /skyes rabs su tshangs pa mthong bar bshad pa ni/ 'dod pa'i lus su sprul pa'o/ /de rnams kyi tshad ni 'thab bral sogs bzhi ri rab kyi steng tsam zhes dang / gzhan ni gong ma nyis 'gyur du smra'o/ /bsam gtan dang po'i gling bzhi tsam dang / gnyis pa stong spyi phud tsam dang / gsum pa stong gnyis pa tsam dang / bzhi pa stong gsum tsam du smra ste/ gzhan ni dang po sogs gsum stong spyi phud sogs gsum tsam dang / bzhi pa tshad med du smra'o/ /bdun pa stong gsum ngos bzung zhing 'byung 'jig mnyam du bstan pa ni/ gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang / ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsam gtan dang po yan chad/ stong la ni/ stong spyi phud ces yin par 'dod de/ stong chen po 'jig rten gyi spyi phud lta bu yin pas so/ /spyi phud de stong la ni/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ba yin no/ /stong gnyis pa de stong la ni stong gsum gyi 'jig rten zhes bya ste gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya'o/ /de gsum la'ang lcags ri re re dang bdag byed pa'i tshangs pa re bshad do/ /de thams cad me sogs kyi mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba ste 'chags pa yin no/ /yang / slob dpon chos shes kyis/ dpal phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud du bka' bstsal ba ltar/ stong gsum bye ba khrag brgya la rab 'byams kyis mtshams sbyar ro/ /de bye ba khrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi rgyud gcig go /de bye ba khrag brgya la rab 'byam kyi rgyud bar ma gcig go /de bye ba khrag brgya la gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing gi skor ba gcig ste/ de ni longs sku rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par smin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yin zhing /

de'ang sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad de gangs can mtsho'i phyag gi rdul phra rab gcig la gnas par bshad do/ /'di dang / sa dang / gzhag par ni/ sems cung zad mi 'dra ba dang / 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel par/ mi'i 'jig rten la/ bha ra dha sogs dum bu dgur bshad pa sogs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams dpag tshad 'bum khrag bzhi pa sogs 'di dang mi 'dra bas skor pa dang / phal po cher/ stong gsum 'og min bye ba phrag brgya sogs bka' stsal pa ni/ sems can so so'i snang ba bzhin bkod pa ste/ der/ zhing rnams 'di kun sems kyis rnam par brtags/ /zhes so/ /yang bye brag tu smra ba ltar steng 'og na zhing med pa dang / zhing kun zag bcas ma yin gyi/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams phyogs bcu na yod la/ de rnams kyang nam mkha' dang nor bu'i rgya mtsho dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku byin la sogs la gnas shing / dbyibs ni zlum bu dang / zur gsum dang / gru bzhi dang / nor bu dang / padma dang / 'khor lo lta bu dang / zur brgyad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lta bu sogs te/ phal po cher lta'o/ /gling bzhi yang bde ba can na med cing / sangs rgyas ri rab 'od kyi zhing na/ 'dzam bu gling la dpag tshad bye ba dang / gzhan gsum la brgyad khri re dang / snang ba'i khyad par yang sems kun tu bzang po'i zhing na stong gsum ril po nyi zla zung gcig gis gsal ba dang / phal po cher/ zhing rnams la la 'od med de/ /mun pa'i 'jigs pa shin tu che/ /reg na sdug bsngal spu gri 'dra/ /blta na mi bzad ci yang g.ya'/ /zhing rnams la la lha 'od can/ /la la khyim gyi 'od can te/ /la la nyi zla'i 'od dang ldan/ /zhing rnam la la rang gi 'od/ /shing gi 'od can dri ma med/ /la la'i ri bo'i 'od can ste/ /zhing rnams la la nor bu'i 'od/ /la la mar me'i 'od can te/ /zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas 'od/ /zhing rnams la la padma'i 'od/

/spos chu'i 'od dang ldan pa'ang yod/ /smon lam dbang gis rnam par sbyangs/ /zhes dang / yang rgyan gyi khyad par yang / zhing gi rgyan mangs bye ba yi/ /zhing rnams la la rnam par bris/ /rgyan dang tshul rnams tha dad par/ /sna tshogs mig g.yor lta bur snang / /zhes dang / yang sangs rgyas 'od med kyi khyad par yang / /zhing rnams la lar sangs rgyas med/ /zhing rnams la lar sangs rgyas bcas/ /la la'i zhing na sangs rgyas gcig /la lar sangs rgyas mang po'o/ /zhes dang / yang gnas pa'i yun yang / zhing rnams la la bskal pa tsam/ /la la bskal pa bcu pa ste/ /zhing rnams la la sdug bsngal mnyam pa'i/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod pa yin/ /ces so/ /yang 'jig rten gyi khams thad ka ba 'di lta bu dang / snrel zhi la sogs la rkang pa btsugs pa dang / spyi bo btsugs su 'gro ba gsum du 'chad de/ rgya cher gzhan du lta'o/ /brgyad pa lus tshe'i tshad bshad pa la/ lus tshad dang tshe tshad gnyis/ dang po la/ mi'i lus tshad dang / lha'i lus tshad gnyis/ dang po ni spyir snod kyi tshad yod pa bzhin du/ de'i sems can gyi tshad yod dam zhe na/ chos mngon par/ ngan 'gro'i lus tshad sdig pa che chung gi dbang gis gcig du ma nges par bshad cing / yum du'ang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dmyal bar skye bas lus tshad bshad du mi rung bar bka' bstsal to/ /bzang skyong gi zhus par/ dmyal ba 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa la rang gi khru brgyad yod/ ces dang / dran pa nyer gzhag tu/ mtshams med gcig byas pa'i mnar med kyi lus dpag tshad gcig nas lnga byas pa la dpag tshad lnga'i bar yod ces dang / mdo myang 'das su/ mtshams med brgyad byas pa'i dmyal ba'i lus la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod kyang gcig la gcig mi thogs/ zhes dang / dkon mchog ta la'i mdor/ theg chen la skur ba btab pa'i dmyal ba'i lce la dpag tshad 'bum yod ces dang / nyi ma'i snying po'i mdor/ yid dwags chung ba la mtho gang dang / che ba la dpag tshad stong yod pa dang /

dud 'gro chung ba la skra rtse'i lnga bcu'i cha dang / glang po rab brtan dang sa srung kyi bu la/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad bdun dang / rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis de las lus ma 'phags par/ ro stod kyis sum cu rtsa gsum du phyin te thub pa la chos nyan/ zhes dang / las brgya par/ chu srin che ba la dpag tshad nyis stong bdun brgya yod ces dang / rnam par shes pa 'pho ba'i mdor/ klu dga' bo dang nye dga' bo'i lus kyis ri rab kyang g.yo zhing / dbugs kyi dug gis rgya mtsho'ang btung du mi rung bar byed ces dang / lung gzhir/ klu gnyis kyis ri rab la lan gsum dkris par bka' bstsal te/ klu'i lus rnams ni sprul pa yin pa'ang srid do/ /des na mi'i lus tshad ni/ 'dzam bu gling pa tshe lo brgya pa rnams kyi lus tshad ni/ kha cig khru bzhi pa dang phal cher phyed dang bzhi ste/ khru ni chos mngon pa bshad pa'i dus kyi mi yi khru yis brtsi'o zhes slob dpon rgyal po sras bshad la/ 'on kyang 'og nas 'chad pa 'gyur sgres pa'i khru'o/ /bskal pa dang po'i mi 'ga' zhig ni brgya byin dang mnyam ste/ yab sras mjal bas spyi bo skyes dang / brgya byin stan gcig la 'dug pa na mig 'byed btsum yod med ma gtogs pa khyad med par bka' bstsal pas so/ /shar lus 'phags po khru brgyad dang / ba glang spyod pa bcu drug dang / byang sgra mi snyan pa so gnyis pa zhes bya ba phyi ma nyis 'gyur du skyed do/ /sar/ lus 'phags po sogs kyang rang gi khru phyed dang bzhi par bshad do/ /gnyis pa lha'i lus tshad la/ 'dod lha'i lus tshad dang / gzugs kyi lha'i gzugs tshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod dang ldan pa'i lus tshad rgyal chen bzhi pa rgyang grags bzhi cha nas/ dga' ldan pa gnyis dang / gzhan 'phrul ba rgyang grags phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du rgyang grags bzhi cha re bskyed do/ /sar/ lha min gyi lus tshad dang / tshe tshad dang /

longs spyod sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang 'dra ba dang / brgya byin dang / 'thab bral ba rgyang grags phyed par bshad do/ /gnyis pa gzugs kyi lha'i lus tshad ni/ gzugs can dang po tshangs ris pa dpag tshad phyed dang / de'i gong ma/ phyed phyed skyed de/ 'od chung man chad kyi lus tshad dpag tshad gnyis/ de'i ltag tshad med 'od yan chad kyi lus ni/ 'og ma las gong ma nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur gyis che ste/ dge rgyas pa re bzhi dang / sprin med pa'i dpag tshad gnyis gsum dor bas brgya nyer lnga nas/ 'og min pa'i khri drug stong gi bar ro/ /gnyis pa tshe tshad la/ bde 'gro'i tshe tshad dang / ngan 'gro'i tshe tshad/ ma nges pa'i 'chi ba yod med dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po la mi'i tshe tshad dang lha'i tshe tshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir bong tshod tha dad pa rnams kyi tshe tshad kyang tha dad dam zhe na/ sgra mi snyan na tshe lo stong ste/ nub dang shar gnyis na de'i phyed phyed spangs pa ste/ rim pas lnga brgya dang / nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /'dzam gling 'di na ma nges te/ rim pa lnga brgya dang / res thung ste tha mar lo bcu dang / res ring ste skal pa dang po'i mi'i tshe lo dpag tu med do/ /dgongs rgyan du bar du ma nges shing thog mtha' nges par bshad do/ /gnyis pa la 'dod lha'i tshe tshad/ gzugs khams pa'i tshe tshad/ gzugs med tshe tshad dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mi lo lnga bcu la 'dod lha 'og ma rgyal chen bzhi pa'i nyin zhag gcig ste/ nyin zhag de yis grangs pa'i zhag sum cu la zla ba dang / de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rgyal chen bzhi pa'i tshe de ni rang rang lo lnga brgya'o/ /'dong lha gong ma lnga'i zhag dang lo yi tshad gnyis ka nyis 'gyur te/ rim pa bzhin mi lo brgya dang stong drug brgya la nyin zhag ste/ de yis grangs pa'i lo stong dang / nyis stong dang / bzhi stong dang / khri drug stong ni tshe tshad do/ /gnya' shing yan chad na nyi zla med kyang nyin mtshan ni ku mu ta dang /

pad ma me tog kha phye zum dang / bya rnams skad 'byin mi 'byin dang / gnyid gro ba sangs ma sangs te/ snang ba'i bya ba ni rang gis 'od kyis shes so/ /gnyis pa gzugs khams pa'i tshe tshad ni/ gzugs can rnams na nyin mtshan med kyang / tshe tshad ni rang gi lus gzhal ba'i dpag tshad kyi grangs kyis bskal pa yis 'jal te/ gzugs can dang po bskal pa phyed/ de yi gong ma phyed phyed bskyed/ 'od chung rnams kyi ltag yan chad/ tshe ni nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur te/ sprin med bskal chen gsum dor ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa gzugs med pa'i tshe tshad ni/ gzugs med dang po'i tshe tshad ni/ bskal pa stong khrag nyi shu/ gong ma gsum nyi shu re'i lhag pa'i lhag pa yin te/ gzugs med bzhi las bskal chen stong phrag brgyad cu thub bo/ /bskal pa de gang zhe na 'od chung nas bzung ste bskal chen te/ de'i 'og ma tshangs chen sogs gsum ni bskal chen phyed la bskal par byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ngan 'gro'i tshe tshad la/ tsha dmyal/ dud 'gro/ yi dwags/ grang dmyal gyi tshe tshad dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ yang sos la sogs pa drug rim pa bzhin/ 'dod lha rigs drug gi tshe dang / nyin zhag mnyam la/ rang gis nyin zhag des bgrangs pa'i drug po de rnams kyi tshe 'dod lha rigs drug dang lo grangs 'dra ba yin te/ rgyal chen ris bzhi pas tshe ni yang sos pas zhag gcig ste/ zhag de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub pa sogs so/ /rab tu tsha ba ni bar bskal phyed dang / mnar med ni bar bskal gcig go /gnyis pa ni/ dud 'gro rnams tshe mchog tu ring bas na bar bskal gcig ste/ dge slong dag klu brgyad po ni klu chen po ste/ bskal par gnas par 'dzin no/ /thung ba yud tsam pa nyi ma'i snying por ro/ /gsum pa yi dwags rnams kyi tshe ni mi'i zla ba gcig la nyin zhag gcig tu byas pas rang lo lnga brgya ste/ mi lo khri lnga stong ngo /

/mdo nyi snying du/ thung bas stong dang ring bas stong khrag brgyad cu thub par bka' bstsal to/ /bzhi pa grang dmyal gyi tshe tshad ni/ ma ga ddha'i til khal brgyad cu shong bas til gyis sbyangs nang byur bur bkang ba nas/ mi lo brgya re bzhin til nyag gcig phyung bas zad par 'gyur pa ni/ chu bur can gyi dmyal ba'i tshe tshad yin te/ ma ga dha'i phul lu'i nang du til nyag sum 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong sum brgya bdun no 'bum don lnga shong zhing / de drug la bre dang / bre nyi shu la khal du byas pas khal gcig la til nyag bye ba gcig dang nyi khri lnga stong yod cing / de ltar rtsis pas mi lo brgya re nas til nyag re phyung bas til zad pa chu bur can gyi tshe'i tshad yin no/ /grang dmyal gzhan rnams kyi tshe ni/ grang dmyal gnyis pa la dang po'i nyi shur gyur cing gsum pa man chad la rims bzhin til sbyang nyi shur sbrel bar bya'o/ /de ltar na grang dmyal gsum pa la bzhi bcu/ bzhi pa la drug cu/ lnga pa la brgyad bcu/ bdun pa la brgya dang nyi shu/ brgyad pa la brgya dang bzhi bcu'o/ /sbyang ba ni bang ba'am/ khyor gyi ming ngo / /grang dmyal 'di dag gi tshe tshad la/ mngon pa ba phal cher gong ma gong ma las 'og ma 'og ma nyi shu 'gyur gyis ring bar 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ tsha dmyal rnams las grang dmyal rnams tshe ring bar 'gyur bas ha cang thal ba dang / sa sde las kyang / grang dmyal rnams kyi tshe tshad dmyal gyi phyed du bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ chos kyis spyan ldan chen po kha cig gis bstan bcos su/ gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus bsgyur/ /zhes byung ba de ni yi ge ma dag pa la/ rjes 'jug rnams kyi gzhung dag par byed pa'i blo gros kyi nus pa med par zad pa ste/ mdo rgyud/ bstan bcos gang dang yang ma mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na/ kho bos bshad pa ltar 'thad de/ grang dmyal rnams kyis tshe tshad bstan pa/ 'jig rten bzhag par/

de man chad bdun char yang gcig las gcig nyi shur sbrel bas tshad du sbyor/ zhes sbrel tshig smos kyis/ 'gyur tshig ma smos pa'i phyir/ tshe tshad de dag mi lo'i grangs kyi zhib tu bstan la phab nas/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi yi tshe tshad la/ mi lo sa ya dgu yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum tshe tshad la/ /bye ba gsum dang sa ya drug /'thab bral tshe tshad dung phyur gcig /bye ba bzhi dang sa ya bzhi/ /dga' ldan tshe tshad dung phyur lnga/ /bye ba bdun dang sa ya drug /'phrul dga' tshe tshad ther 'bum gnyis/ /dung phyur gsum dang sa ya bzhi/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed tshe tshad la/ /ther 'bum dgu dang dung phyur gnyis/ /bye ba gcig dang sa ya drug /yang so sos tshe tshad mi yi lo/ /khrag khrig chen po gcig dang ni/ /khrag khrig drug dang ther 'bum ni/ /chen po gnyis te thig nag gi /tshe tshad rab bkram gcig dang ni/ /khrag khrig che gnyis khrag khrig dgu/ /ther 'bum chen po drug yin no/ /bsdus 'joms tshe tshad mi yi lo/ /rab bkram chen po gcig dang ni/ /khrag khrig che gsum khrag khrig drug /ther 'bum chen po brgyad yin no/ /ngu 'bod tshe tshad mi yi lo/ /rab bkram che brgyad rab bkram gnyis/ /khrag khrig che dgu khrag khrig bzhi/ /ther 'bum chen po bzhi yin no/ /ngu 'bod chen po'i tshe tshad la/ /gtams drug rab bkram chen po drug /rab bkram gsum dang khrag khrig ni/ /chen po lnga dang khrag khrig lnga/ /ther 'bum chen po gnyis yin no/ /tsha bas tshe tshad gtams chen lnga/ /gtams gsum rab bkram brgyad dang ni/ /khrag khrig che bzhi khrag khrig gcig /ther 'bum chen po drug yin no/ /chu bur can kyis tshe yi tshad/ /mi lo khrag khrig brgyad dang ni/ /ther 'bum chen po gcig yin no/ /chu bur rdol ba can gyi tshe/ /khrag khrig che drug khrag khrig bzhi/ /ther 'bum chen po brgyad yin no/ /so tham tshe tshad rab bkram gcig /khrag khrig che brgyad khrag khrig bzhi/

/a chu zer ba'i tshe'i tshad/ /rab bkram che bzhi rab bkram gnyis/ /khrag khrig che bzhi khrag khrig bdun/ /ther 'bum chen po gnyis yin no/ /kyi hud zer ba'i tshe'i tshad/ /sa gsum rab bkram chen po gsum/ /rab bkram drug dang khrag khrig ni/ /chen po dgu dag khrag khrig drug /utpal ltar gas tshe yi tshad/ /gtams chen gnyis dang gtams drug dang / /rab bkram che lnga rab bkram bzhi/ /ther 'bum chen po brgyad yin no/ /pad ma ltar gas tshe yi tshad/ /bar gyi bskal pa bzhi cha yin/ /pad chen ltar gas tshe'i tshad/ /bar gyi bskal pa phyed yin no/ /mdor na grang dmyal brgyad po rnams/ /tshe tshad grang dmyal brgyad po yi/ /rim bzhin phyed de yin par gsungs/ /tha snyad byung ba'ang legs sbyangs nas/ /mang po'i dbus su mkhas pa yis/ /go 'phang 'dod na legs bshad kyi/ /gnad kyi don po 'di longs shig /gsum pa nges pa'i 'chi ba yod med dpyad pa ni/ sgra mi snyan pa tshe nges pa'i stong thub par nges shing / de ma gtogs par dus ma yin par 'chi ba yod do/ /dgu pa tshad de gzhal thabs la/ 'jog gzhi ngos bzung de las ni/ /lus tshad gzhal phyir rgyang grags dang / /dpag tshad ji ltar 'jog pa'i tshul/ /tshe tshad gzhal phyir lo dang ni/ /bskal pa ngo yis bzung ba gnyis/ zhes pa ltar gsum las dang po ni/ gzugs can gyi chung mthar gyur pa'i rdul phra rab ni rags pa'i rtsom gzhi ming gi thung mthar gyur pa'i yi ge brjod byed kyi tshig gi rtsom gzhi yin/ dus kyi thung mthar gyur pa'i dus mtha'i skad cig ma ni rgyun gyi rtsom gzhi yin no/ /gnyis pa lus tshad gzhal phyir rgyang grangs dang dpag tshad ngos bzung ba ni/ phra rab rdul dang rdul phran dang / de bzhin du lcags rdul dang chu rdul dang ri bong gi rdul dang / lug rdul dang / glang rdul dang / nyi zer gyi rdul dang / sro ma dang / de las byung ba shig dang / de bzhin du nas dang / sor tshigs rnams ni gong nas gong du bdun du bsgyur bar byed bar bya'o/

/sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi la khru gang / khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ste 'dom gang ngo / /gzhu 'dom de dag lnga brgya rnams la rgyang grags te/ de tsam grong nas 'phags pa la dgon par 'dod la/ rgyang grags de brgyad la dpag tshad zhes bya'o/ /lung rnams 'byed las snga phyi rnams drug 'gyur dang / gdags par/ rdul phran bdun la nyi zer gyi rdul du bshad pa'ang yod/ dus 'khor du/ gzhu 'dom nyis stong la rgyang grags dang / de bzhi la dpag tshad du bka' bstsal to/ /gsum pa/ tshe tshad gzhal phyir lo dang ni/ /bskal pa ngo yis bzung ba la/ /'dod khams tshe tshad rtogs phyir du/ /lo nyid ngo yis bzung ba dang / /khams gong tshe tshad rtogs phyir du/ /bstan bshad gnyis kyi sgo nas ni/ /bskal pa ngos bzung bskal chen la/ /'byung bas gang zag rnam gsum bshad/ /ces pa'i dang po ni/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ de'i skad cig ma gcig go /de'i skad cig ma drug cu la thang gcig go /thang gcig sum cu la yud tsam ste/ de dang nyin zhag dang / zla ba gsum gong nas gong du sum cur bsgyur ro/ /zhag mi thub pa drug ma tshang ba bcas pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu 'dod do/ /gnyis pa bstan bshad gnyis kyi sgo nas bskal pa ngo yis bzung ba la/ dang po mdor bstan ni/ bskal pa la rnam pa mang du yod de/ bar bskal dang / 'jig bskal dang / stong bskal dang / 'chags bskal dang / gnas bskal dang / bskal pa chen po sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la lnga ste/ 'jig pa'i/ chags pa'i/ gnas pa'i/ zhig nas 'dug pa'i bskal pa/ bskal pa chen po'o/ dang po ni/ de la 'jig pa'i bskal pa ni/ dmyal ba'i srid pa/ gsar skyes med pa nas snod zad pa'i bar te/ sems can 'jig pa ni/ dmyal las zad pa rnams bde 'gror skye la/ ma zad pa rnams zhing gzhan gyi dmyal bar skye zhing / 'dir gcig kyang med par 'jig la/ dud 'gro dang yi dwags kyang de dang 'dra'o/

/rgya mtsho'i dud 'gro sngar 'jig ste/ mi yul ba rnams mi dang lhan cig pa'o/ /gling gsum gyi mi gang rung res/ chos nyid kyis thob pa'i bsam gtan dang por skye ste/ gnas rnams kyang de'i rjes su slob cing tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye la/ sgra mi snyan pa la chags bral gyi lam med pas 'dod lhar skye ste/ 'dod lha rnams bsam gtan dang po thob pa'i tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye la/ de rnams kyi bsam gtan gnyis pas chos nyid thob pas 'od gsal du skye'o/ /sa las ni/ 'dod pa'i lha mi'i de nyid la gnyis pa'i bar chos nyid kyis thob nas 'od gsal du skye bar bshad do/ /chus 'jig pa na bsam gtan gsum pa dang / rlung gis 'jig pa na bsam gtan bzhi pa thob ste/ de dag tu skye'o/ /de la bar bskal bcu dgu'o/ /snod 'jig pa ni/ char pa med pas rtswa shing dang sman rnams ri rab nyi ma 'di nyid kyis bsreg ste/ nyi ma gzhan drug ni 'di bas bzhi 'gyur gyis tsha zhing / gnyis pas lteng ka che chung dang / gsum pas chu bo che chung dang / bzhi pas mtsho ma dros pa dang / lnga pas phyogs kyis mtha'i mtsho chen po skem pa drug pa dang bdun pas ri rab dang sa chen po bsreg ste/ de me rlung gis khyer nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsreg la/ de'i tshe 'od gsal bas lha gzhon pa rnams me de byung bar dogs pas skrag pa la/ lha rgan po srid pa chags 'jig la mkhas pa rnams kyis/ grogs po rnams ma 'jigs shig me lce 'dis sngon yang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong ba sregs nas de nyid du med par gyur to/ /zhes dbugs 'byin to/ /lha de dag lus shin tu 'dra yang / de ltar 'du shes tha dad du gyur pas na/ lus gcig cing 'du shes tha dad pa'o/ /des na/ mdor/ sa chen po dang ri rab kyang sreg ste/ tshig pa na du ba yang med/ thal ba'i lhag ma'ang med de/ dge slong rnams 'du byed thams cad ni de ltar mi rtag pa/

mi brtan pa/ yid brtan du mi rung ba'o/ /zhes bka' bstsal to/ /chus 'jig pa na bsam gtan gsum pa nyid las byung ba'i chu'i snod lan tshwa chus zhu ba bzhin du bzhur nas chu de yang med par 'gyur ro/ /rlung gis 'jig pa na bsam gtan gsum pa nyid las byung ba'i rlung gis snod med par byed cing / rlung de yang med par 'gyur ro/ /des na gdags par/ de ltar lhun po rgya mtsho che dang sa/ /de bzhin mtho ris zad 'gyur shes nas ni/ /skye bo dam pa rnams kyis bsten pa yi/ /'phags pa'i gnas la rtag tu zhog cig ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'chags pa'i bskal pa ni dang po rlung 'chags pa nas/ dmyal ba'i srid pa 'chags pa'i bar du bar bskal nyi shu'o/ /de yang rlung gis zhig na bsam gtan gsum pa sogs dang / chus zhig na gsum pa sogs dang / mes zhig na dang po nas 'dod lha'i gzhal yas khang rnams sprul pa ltar 'chags so/ /de nas snod kyi snga ltas rlung 'jam po langs pa/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor du gyur cing / de nas gser gyi snying po can gyi sprin las char chen po babs pas chu'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng rlung gis 'thas shing sra bar byas pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng du sprin khams sna tshogs pa can las char babs pas rgya mtsho 'byung ste/ snying rje padma dkar por/ chu de'i nang na gser gyi padma 'dab ma stong snang nas/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis ci ltas yin brtag pas/ bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byung bas ltas su shes te/ bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o/ /zhes bsgrags so/ /zhes bka' bstsal to/ /de'i khams bzang po rnams rlung gis bsrubs pas ri rab dang / 'bring rnams bsrubs pas ri bdun dang / ngan pa rnams gling bzhi gling phran dang khor yug gi ri rnams byung ste/ de la bar bskal gcig go /de rnams kyang bye brag tu smra ba 'jig rten 'jig dus/ rdul phra rab rtag pa la zhig pa rnams skye'o zer te/

de dgag pa 'grel par lta'o/ /sa ston sde ba'i mdor/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas sa bon khyer te 'ongs so zhes 'byung mod/ las las skyes pas rlung nus pa khyad par can las 'byung ngo / /zhes gnas so/ /gong ma pa ni/ kun gzhi'i thun mong gi sa bon las skye bar bzhed do/ /sems can 'chags pa ni/ bzhi pa nas shi nas gsum par 'ang / de nas shi ba gnyis par skye ba'ang yod cing / bskal pa 'di la ni 'od gsal gyi lha tshe dang bsod nams dang las zad pa zhig shi ste/ tshangs pa chen por skyes pa la shed bdag tu rtog go /de skyo ste grogs skyes na ci ma rung snyam pa dang / yang 'od gsal nas tshangs par skyes pa la/ shed las skyes su rtog go /de bzhin du 'od gsal nas 'dod lha dang byang dang nub dang shar dang gling 'di'i mir rim gyis skye la/ sems can gang rung gcig bdag gis myong bas las nyon mongs can gyis dmyal bar gshin rje'i rgyal por skye zhing / yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang dmyal ba 'chags te/ de la bar bskal bcu dgu'o/ /'chags pa rdzogs pa dang gnas pa rtsom pa dang / mnar med gcig skyes pa dang / tshe lo dpag med nas 'grib pa rtsom pa dus mnyam mo/ /gsum pa la lnga ste/ bar bskal gyi tshad ya thog la bzhag bar gyi khug pa/ mtha'i ma thog yar 'phel bcu dgu'i mtshams/ de rnams gnas pa'i bskal par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bar gyi bskal pa ni dpag med nas 'grib pa nas brtsams nas tshe lo bcu par gyur pa'i bar du de ya thog ring mo zhes grags la/ 'grib tshul 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ yang de nas yar skye ba dang / mar 'grib pa zung re'i bskal pa ya thog ma thog las gzhan bco brgyad de/ snying rje pad dkar du/ tshe lo bcu pa'i tshe rje btsun byams pa khru gang ba gcig byon nas/ lus che ba'i rgyu mi dge ba spangs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lus kyi gsum spangs pas nyi shu pa dang / lnga bcu pa dang /

brgya pa dang / ngag gi bzhi spangs pas nyis stong pa dang / yid kyi gsum spangs pas khri pa dang / pha'ang mar bzung bas brgyad khri par 'phel te/ nyi ma re la bre bzhi bzhi dang / bu mo lo lnga brgya lon te/ bag mar gtong ba sogs du ma bka' bstsal to/ gsum pa ni/ yang skye zhing 'phel ba ni bar bskal gcig yin te/ ma thog ring mo zhes grags so/ /bzhi pa ni/ yar skye rnams ji tsam du skye zhe na/ yar 'phel bcu dgu po de rnams tshe lo brgyad khri'i bar skye'o/ /theg chen du ni/ ma thog tshe dpag med du bshad do/ /thog mtha'i rkyang pa dang / bar gyi khug pa re dus mnyam la/ lo ji snyed re la 'phel 'grib byed ce na/ kha cig lo brgya re bzhin gcig 'phel gcig 'grib ces dang / ngur mig pa/ rkyang pa la lo nyis brgya re bzhin lo re re'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni mi 'thad de/ yang sos kyi zhag gnyis ni/ mnar med kyi bar bskal bas ring bar thal te/ mi lo sa ya bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ de yang bar gyi khug pa la ni/ sa ya bcu drug la nyis stong chad pa las med par 'gyur bas so/ /des na lo ji snyed re la 'phel ba dang 'grib pa mi shes shing / dge sdig spyod pa stobs che chung gis lo 'phel 'grib stobs che chung du 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ tshul de ltar 'jig rten chags pa 'di ni/ bar gyi bskal pa nyi shu gnas pa yin no/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di'i gnas bskal la sangs rgyas stong 'byung ste/ de'i 'og tu rgyas par 'chad do/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / zhar la gang zag gsum gyi 'byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bar bskal nyi shu po de dag bsdoms pas brgyad cu la ni/ bskal pa chen po'o/ /'di ni bskal pa bzang po 'di'i dbang du byas kyis/ smon lam dang dge ba'i rtsa bas dbang gis bskal chen gcig la de bas rgyun ring ba yod de/ brgyad stong 'grel chen du bskal pa skar ma lta bu'i mar 'grib la'ang /

da lta'i bar bskal nyi shu yod par bshad la/ phal po cher/ mi mjed dang / bde ba can dang / dur smrig gi rgya mtsho dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo rab tu bsgrags pa dang / rdul dang bral ba dang / sgron me bzang po dang / 'od bzang po dang / 'da' bar dka' ba dang / rgyan dam pa dang / me long gi dkyil 'khor mdog dang / padma'i dpal zhes pa'i zhing rnams kyi snga ma'i bskal pa phyi ma'i zhag rer bka' bstsal to/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sangs rgyas dang / rang rgyal dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ tshogs kyi tshad/ 'byung ba'i dus so/ /dang po ni bskal chen de grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa las sangs rgyas 'byung ngo / /grangs med ni gtan med min gyi lung sil bur grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug cu gsungs pa'i tha ma ste/ de bsdus na/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang / /sa ya bye ba dung phyur rnams/ /rkyang pa yin par shes par bya/ /chen po'i zla dang bcas pa ni/ /ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram dang / /gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad phyin dang / /pang rten ded 'dren mtha' snang dang / /rgyu rig 'od mdzes dbang po dang / /legs phyin rtogs 'gro 'bying rtul dang / /rgya rtag stobs 'khor brda shes dang / /rnam 'byung stobs mig nyi shu gcig /bar du brgyad ni ma rnyed pas/ /rang gi ming dang gang mthun du/ /grangs med bar du bcur 'gyur 'gres/ /ces gsungs shing / bar du ma rnyed pa brgyad ni/ byams pa dang / byams pa chen po/ snying rje dang snying rje chen po/ dga' ba dang dga' ba chen po/ btang snyoms dang btang snyoms chen po/ zhes sbyor ro/ /grangs med de gsum nyan thos sde pa'i tshogs lam nyid du rdzogs par 'dod la/ theg chen pa ni/ rim pa bzhin/ mos spyod dang / ma dag sa bdun dang / dag pa sa gsum du rdzogs par bzhed do/ /gzhan ni gsum du chos mthun pa'i gsum zhes brjod kyis/

don so gsum gyis te/ dang pos tshogs kyi sa dang / gnyis kyis sbyor lam dang / de nas gsum gsum gyis sa bcu rdzogs par byed par smra'o/ /de lta na'ang dus sogs rtags tsam du zad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang thabs mkhas kyis myur du 'tshang rgya te/ dus gsum brtag par/ /rmi lam na ni lo gcig kun/ yud tsam gyis kyang dmigs pa ste/ /de nas dpag med dus rnams kyang / /skad cig nyid du 'du bar 'gyur ces dang / thabs la mkhas pas mdo sde sogs su/ ston pa 'di'i bskal pa mang po'i tshogs 'dums par gsungs so/ /byang sa dang 'bum ṭīka sogs su/ bskal pa mang po'i tshogs 'dums kyi grangs ni mi 'dum par bshad la/ 'on kyang ma skyes pas chos la bzod pa thob par 'dod na/ zhag bdun gyis 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa/ grangs med kyang 'dum par 'dod de/ de sa brgyad pa yin zhing de yan chad du grangs med gcig tshogs gsag dgos pa'o/ /a sa ya ka ra/ mthong thos sa drug pa la gnas pa bskal pa 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya bar bshad pas/ grangs med 'dums par 'chad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ci sangs rgyas yar 'phel dang / bar 'grib nam gyi tshe 'byung zhe na/ mar 'grib pa'i brgyad khri nas brgya pa'i yi bar la sangs rgyas 'byung gis/ yar 'phel ba la mi 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i dgos pa ni/ gdul bya dge bcu la 'god pa'i ched yin la/ yar 'phel ba'i dus su gdul bya dge tshul la rang gis spyod pa'i phyir/ mar 'grib pa la yang tshe lo brgya pa yan chad du 'byung gis/ de man chad du mi 'byung ste/ de man chad kyi sems can rnams ni/ snyigs ma lnga che bas sangs rgyas kyis don dngos su bya ba'i yul du mi rung ba dang / de dag sangs rgyas mngon sum du mthong ba'i yul can ma yin pa'i phyir/ brgya pa man chad la tshe dang dus dang nyon mongs pa dang lta ba dang sems can gyi snyigs ma lnga shin tu ches che bas so/

/theg chen pa ltar na snying rje pad dkar du 'jig rten gyi khams mthe bong can zhes bya bar mthe bong gi tshad tsam gyi mi rnams nang du tshe lo bcu pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas skar ma la dga' ba sogs dang / mdo bskal bzang du/ /mi yi 'dren pa snang mdzad pas/ /mi rnams tshe lo dpag tu med/ /sangs rgyas dgu brgya dgu bcu 'das/ /ji snyed mdzad kun de mdzad 'gyur/ /zhes kyang bka' bstsal to/ /gnyis pa la gnyis ste/ 'byung ba'i dus dang / tshogs gsog pa'i tshad do/ /rang rgyal dus gang du 'byung zhe na/ rang sangs rgyas yar 'phel mar 'grib gnyis ka la 'byung ngo / /rtsa shes las/ rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams ma byung zhing / /nyan thos rnams kyang zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni/ /rten pa med par rab tu skye/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyal bse ru lta bu ni bskal chen brgya ru byang chub kyi tshogs la spyod pa'i rgyu'i byang chub ste/ lam kun stan gcig la skyed pa'i rgyud bzhin smon dgos pas so/ /tshogs spyod ni lam lhag ma bskyed sla bas de tsam mi dgos so/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ 'byung ba'i dus dang / ji ltar 'khor los rgyur tshul/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ 'khor lo sgyur ba nam byung zhe na/ 'khor lo'i rgyal srid sgyur ba'i ngang tshul can 'byung ba ni tshe lo dpag med nas stong phrag brgyad cu'i bar la te/ de las mi 'phyi te/ de man chad du phun tshogs mi rdzogs pas so/ /stobs kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba ni/ de las phyis kyang 'byung ste/ chos rgyal mya ngan med bzhin no/ /snga ma la rin chen bdun phrag gsum las/ mchog gi rin chen sna bdun las/ /de tshes bco lnga la/ mgo dang bcas pa bkrus nas bsnyen gnas byas shing / blon pa'i tshogs kyis skor nas mdun na 'dug pa dang / shar phyogs nas lha'i 'khor lo brgya byin gyi tshig gis las thams cad pas byas pa rgyal po chen po bzhis/

rgyal po la bstan pa 'byung ngo zhes so/ /sa 'grel du yongs su grags pa na'o zhes dang / mdo dang / bzhag par/ de bzos pa min gyi/ las thams cad pa'i sprul par bshad do/ /dran pa nyer bzhag tu/ gser las byas pa dpag tshad lnga brgya rtsibs stong yod pa mdzes pa nam mkha' la dpag tshad 'bum du nyi ma gcig gis 'gro ba gling bzhi dang / lha'i rigs su'ang glang po sogs kun mkha' la 'gro ba rgyal pos mi thob pa des thob par byed pa 'gran pa su yang med par byed pa'o/ /rgyal po shi nas sgo khang du zug nas sdod de bu la mi phan no/ /nor bu ni mi chen po'i brla tsam pa zur brgyad pa ste/ mtshan mo dpag tshad brgyar 'od 'byung ba/ nyi ma tsha na bsil bar 'byung ba/ skom na chu yan lag brgyad ldan 'byung ba/ rgyal pos ci bsam pa 'byung ba/ dpag tshad brgyar nad med par byed cing / las kun la ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba/ klu ngan pas ser ba sogs 'bebs mi nus pa/ mya ngan dang / g.yang sa'i yul kun ljon pa dang mtshe'u sogs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba/ mi dus ma yin du mi 'chi zhing / dud 'gro gang gis kyang mi gnod pa/ sbrul dang ne'u le lta bu mi mthun pas kyang mi gnod pa zhig dbang pos ster ro/ /bzhag pa dang sa 'grel du ni/ klu'am rgyal chen bzhis 'bul bar bshad do/ /btsun mo ni lus las tsan dan dang / kha las utpal la'i dri 'byung ba/ reg na nyon mongs pa med par 'gyur ba/ gling de'i bkres skom dang myang ngan bral bar byed pa/ rgyal pos mthong na grang dus dro zhing dro dus bsil bar byed pa/ mi kun gyis ma dang sring mo ltar mthong ba/ bsam pa dang mthun zhing bu mang po btsas ba/ khyim thab bud med gzhan la 'gro na phrag dog med pa'am/ khyim thab med kyang 'dod yon lnga'i dbang du mi 'gyur ba zhig blon pos 'bul te de ni shi nas lhar skye'o/ /bzhag par ni/ bu mi 'byung shing rgyal po'i sngar 'chi bar bshad do/

/blon po ni/ bya ba rnams ma bslabs kyang shes nas byed pa/ mi dge ba spangs shing nyon mongs pa med cing sems can kun la pha ma ltar phan pa'o/ /glang po ni/ cang shes shing bka' nyan pas pha rol las rgyal bar byed pa/ glang po chen po stong gi stobs yod pa/ chu dang skam dang bar snang gsum la g.yul 'gyed pa/ nyin gcig la 'dzam bu'i gling lan gsum 'khor ba/ skud pas kyang dkrir rung zhing / rgyal pos zhon pa'i tshe skul mi dgos par dal gyis 'gro ba zhig dbang pos ster ro/ /sa 'grel du glang po rab brtan gyi bu tha chung ngo / /zhes so/ /rta mchog ni ku mu ta dang dung ltar dkar ba glang po dang yon tan mtshungs pa gcig dbang pos ster ro/ /sa 'grel du rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can gyi bu tha chung lus sngo la mgo nag pa'o/ /zhes kyang ngo / /mdog de dang dbang po 'dra zhing / nub phyogs kyi gling phran khams bu can na rta de rta'i rgyal po brgya stong gis skor ba yod pa la/ brgya byin gyis 'khor lo sgyur ba 'jig rten byung ba shes par gyis la rta rin chen thong cig ces bsgo bas/ bu thu bo stong zhing / de rgyal po'i sngar shi na des 'og ma stong la/ rgyal po sngar shi na rta rang gi gnas su ldog pa dang / glang po lus dkar la mgo sngo bas stong ldog kyang rta dang 'dra bas bshad do/ /khyim bdag gis ni bang mdzod gser dngul sogs kyis 'geng ba/ rgyal po'i bka' nyan pa/ skye bo kun la mi gnod pa'o/ /rgyal po sras su khyim bdag ni/ mdzod kyi spyan dang / blon po dpung gi spyan lta bu'o/ /zhes 'chad do/ /nye ba'i rin po che sna bdun yang / mdo de nyid du ral gri yang rgyal po dang 'gal ba byed 'dod pa der song ste/ ma btab kyang kun gyis 'dud pa'o/ /dmag dpon ni/ dgra'i tshogs ma lus pa 'joms pa'i nus pa yod kyang gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i skyes bu'o/ /lpags pa ni chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis zheng du lnga pa char gyis mi brlan zhing rlung gis mi bskyod la/

grang na dro zhing dro na bsil bar byed do/ /bud med ni mi sdug pa mi mthong ba nyi ma'i 'od snang ba/ klu'i lpags pa rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba/ gang 'gro sar blon pos khyer te/ khang pa'i bya ba byed pa zhig tshong pas 'bul lo/ /khang pa ni chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa/ zheng du bdun pa/ rin po che dang zla ba dang rgyu skar blta bar 'dod na khang pa der 'ong ba/ rmi lam dge bar mthong ba/ grang na dro zhi tsha na bsil ba'i rlung ldang ba/ der lha mo 'ongs nas rol mo byed pa'o/ /gos ni 'jam la dri mas mi gos pa/ gyon na tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub kyis mi gnod pa/ mes mi 'tshig cing mtshon gyis mi chod pa'o/ /tshal ni rgyal pos der phyin pa dang / tshal gyi mthus de rang / lha'i bu mo dang bya sogs 'ongs te/ 'dod yon la spyod pa'o/ /mal cha ni bsam gtan byed na blo gsal ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa mi skye ba'o/ /lham ni gyon na chu la mi 'bying ba yud tsam gyis dpag tshad brgyar 'gro ba la'ang ngal dub med pa'o/ /rin chen bdun ni/ gser/ dngul/ bāai ḍūrya/ shel/ spug rdo'i snying po/ mu tig dmar po'o/ /mi stong thub pa'i bu stong dang / dgra zil gyis gnon pa'i mda' gzhu'ang 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ de yang bzhi ste/ gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang / lcags kyi 'khor lo can no/ /de bzhi rnams/ gling gcig dang / gling gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa mas rim bzhin du dbang byed la/ mdor gtso bor smos pa'i phyir/ gser gyi 'khor lo can kho na gsungs so/ /lhan cig tu 'khor lo sgyur ba gnyis mi 'byung ste/ dper na sangs rgyas bzhin te/ 'di la bye brag smra ba/ zhing kun tu sangs rgyas re re las mi 'byung zer ro/ /phal chen sde ba sogs gcig tu mi 'byung ba 'dod de/ de theg chen gyi mdo chen dang mthun no/ /theg bsdus su/ gling bzhi pa gcig tu mi 'byung bar bshad la/ brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs su ni/

sangs rgyas gnyis sam mang po byon nas 'dul bas sems can yod na du ma 'byung ba mi 'gal bar bshad de/ phal po cher/ la lar sangs rgyas mang po'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de bzhi g.yul las ji ltar rgyal bar byed ce na/ gser 'khor can ni/ khams kyi rgyal phran rnams kyis phar 'du nas 'dud cing bka' nyan no/ /dngul 'khor can ni de rnams kyi thad du rang nyid 'gro bas 'dud la/ sar ni/ pho nya btang bas 'dud/ ces so/ /zangs 'khor can ni/ g.yul bshams pas 'dud do/ /lcags 'khor can ni/ phan tshun/ mtshon brtsams te/ gzas pas 'dud ste/ rgyal yang gnod pa med cing / rgyal nas sems can rnams dge ba bcu la 'god pas de rnams nges par lhar skye'o/ /bzhag par/ dang po 'khor lo'i rjes su dpung dang bcas pa byon nas bzhugs pa nas/ de thos ma thag rgyal phran rnams 'ong nas 'dud la/ gnyis pa la thos ma thag tu min par 'degs pa'i tshe 'ongs nas 'dud bar bshad do/ /sa gling 'di'i nye 'khor na 'khor lo sgyur ba'i lam gser gyi rang bzhin/ rgyal chen sde bzhi pa'i pus nub tsam/ rgya mtshor nub pa yod cing / de byung ba na chu skam par bshad do/ /gsum pa ni 'di rnams skyes bu chen po'i mtshan so gnyis kyis brgyan pas rgyal po gzhan las khyad zhugs te/ 'on kyang thub pa'i mtshan ni rang gi yul na ma 'grus par gnas pa dang / 'od gsal ba cha shas rdzogs pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /'di'i rgyu mtshan ni byams pa bsgoms pa dang / mchod rten la phyag gus pas btsal ba sogs gsungs so/ /'khor los sgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang / 'khor ba na ni yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ zhes bshad pas/ 'phags pa kho nar ni ma nges so/ /gsum pa snod bcud khyad chos la gsum las/ dang po la bskal pa dang po'i khyad par/ de ji ltar 'grib tshul/ 'grib pa'i mthar ji ltar 'byung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir bskal ba dang po'i mi rnams kyang rgyal po dang bcas pa zhe na/

min te/ sngar/ bskal pa 'chags ma thag gi sems can mi rnams gzugs can gyi lha bzhin te/ yid las byung ba/ yan lag dang / nying lag dbang po tshang ba/ rang 'od can/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ zas su dga' ba za ba/ tshe dpag med thub pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas rim gyis ro la chags te/ sa'i bcud kha dog mar gsar 'dra ba ro sbrang rtsi ma bskol ba ltar mngar ba sa'i steng chus khyab pa la rlung gis spris ma byas pa byung ste/ de sems can brkam chags can gcig gis sor mo'i rtse mos blangs te/ zos pas mi gzhan rnams kyang de ltar byas pa kham zas za ba'i dang po'o/ /de nas lus mkhrang ba lci la 'od nub nas mun pa byung ba dang / smre sngags bton pa'i spyi mthun gyi las kyi nyi ma shar bas/ phan 'dogs pa ma lta bu byung zhes nyi mar grags yang spyi mthun gyi las kyi zla ba shar bas sngar gyi de'i zla bo gcig byung zhes zla bar grags so/ /de nas sa zhag ser po sbrang rtsi'i ro can byung ba'ang myangs pas nub cing smre sngags ston to/ /de nas ldum po'i tshal dkar po sbrang rtsi'i ro can yang myangs pas nub bo/ /de nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras bu/ shun pa dang phub ma med pa byung ba zos pas/ rgyu mthun 'byung ba'i bshang gci'i lam pho mo'i dbang po dang bcas pa byung ste/ sngon goms pas tshul min yid byed kyis 'khrig pa byed cing / de la smad pa'i de'i ched du byed de/ mi tshangs spyod kyi las lam dang por byung / sa lu nang za na nang len/ nub za na nub len pa la/ gcig gis/ snga dro za rgyu yang phyi dro blangs te/ le los gsog 'jog byas nas ni/ /gzhan rnams kyis kyang thabs zab mo zhes de ltar byed pa byung / ma rmos ma btab pa'i sa lu nub/ de nas zhing rnams bgos te/ rang gi la bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bcas nas gzhan gyi la rku'o/ /de dag gi ched du 'dus nas de rnams kyis mi khyad par can zhing dpon du bskos nas/

rang rang gi ston thog gis drug cha bstabs ste/ de ni mang pos bkur ba zhes bya ba'i rgyal rigs kyi dang po'o/ /der mi kha cig gi yongs su 'dzin pa sdug bsngal gyi rtsa bar rig ste/ dgon par spyil bur 'dug cing / zan 'dod pa na grong du 'jug pa la phyi rol yod do/ /ces brjod pa bram ze dang / kha cig gis bsam gtan dang dben pa ma rtogs te/ sngags kyi gzhung dang rigs byed sbyor ba las mdun na 'don pa dang / de'ang ma rtogs nas grong du zhugs te/ khang pa sgo bzhi par 'khod nas sbyin pa sbyin no/ /zhes pa las grong mi 'byung ngo / /de nas rje rigs dang / dmangs rigs kyang byung ngo / /de nas mi rnams rkun ma mang du byung ba la/ rgyal pos brtsad bcad pas ma brkus so zer bas/ ma byin len dang rdzun smra ba'i las lam/ brkus pa 'ga' zhig gi srog bcad pas srog gcod kyi las lam byung / de nas mi dge ba'i las kyi lam lhag ste/ 'phel bas tshe khad kyis thung du song bas mthar tshe lo bcu par 'gyur ro/ /de'i dus su tshe rgud pa/ ring na lo bcu dang / lus rgud pa yin la mtho gang dang / chang gang dang / yo byad rgud pa zas kyi mchog khre rgod/ gos kyi mchog skra'i lwa ba dang / rgyan gyis mchog mtshon cha ste/ 'o ma dang zho yod kyang mar mi 'byung zhing / til yod kyang til mar mi 'byung / bur shing dang de'i khu ba yod kyang bu ram mi 'byung la/ lan tsha yang med do/ /bu mo zla ba lnga lon nas bag mar gtong ba sogs du ma bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ bar gyi bskal pa la/ mtshon dang / nad dang / mu ge'i bskal pa rnams kyis mi mthun te/ tshe lo bcu pa na mi rnams phan tshun rngon pas ri dwags mthong ba ltar gnod sems mi zad par gyur te/ gang blangs pa mtshon cha rnon por 'gyur nas gsod res byed la bsad tshad dmyal bar skye'o/ /nad ni mi ma yin rnams kyis yams nad gsor mi rung ba gtong ste/

phal cher 'chi'o/ /mu ge ni nyes pa de dag gis lhas char mi 'bebs pas/ phan tshun 'dus te 'chi ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo'i don du sa bon gab rtse'i nang du 'jog pas gab rtse ba dang / shi ma thag rus gong dkar po bsdus te bskol nas 'thung bas/ rus gong dkar po ba dang / thur mas zas 'gyed pa dang thur mas rtsig khung nas 'bru brus shing chur bskol te 'thung bas thur mas 'tsho ba ste gsum mo/ /gang zhig gis nyi ma 'ga' srog gcod spangs pa dang / dge slong la a ru 'ga' dang bsod snyoms 'ga' gus pas phul ba des mtshon dang nad dang mu ge la mi skye bar bshad do/ /yang de gsum dus ji srid 'byung snyam na/ mtshon zhag bdun dang / nad zhag bdun dang zla ba bdun dang / mu ge de gnyis dang lo bdun tshan re rnams 'byung ste go rim bzhin no/ /de'i tshe shar nub gnyis su gnod sems lhag pa dang / mdog ngan zhing nyam chung ba dang / bkres skom tsam 'byung ngo / /bzhag par/ tshe lo bcu pa gcig la re re las mi 'byung bar bshad cing / de ltar rgyal po sras kyang bzhed do/ /kha cig gcig la mas rim gyis gsum char 'byung zhes so zer ro/ /sar ni/ tshe lo sum cu pa dang / nyi shu pa dang / bcu pa la mas rim gyis 'byung bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa de las 'phros pa'i don ni/ zhar byung sems can gzugs can bzhin/ zhes gong du bshad pa las 'phros nas/ dang po rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus dang / de rjes bod kyi lo rgyus gnyis/ dang po la don gyi khog phub pa dang / tshig gi cha cung zad phral ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgron me'i bskal pa bzang po la/ /sangs rgyas byon dang de chos gsungs/ /bstan pa gnas dang dar rgyas tshul/ /khyad par sprul pa'i lo pan dang / /rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /bod khams bstan pa spel ba'i tshul/ /mdo sde rnams dang dgongs 'grel gyis/ /bstan bcos dag las 'byung zhing bshad/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rgyal rigs dang /

/bram ze'i rigs las gzhan mi srid/ /ston pa rgyal rigs nyi ma'i gnyen/ /bu ram shing pa'i gdung rgyud las/ /'ongs pa shā kya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /rgyal po'i thog ma mang bkur yin/ /mang bkur rgyal po nas bzung ste/ /zas gtsang bar la rgyal rigs ni/ /sa ya gcig dang gcig 'bum dang / nyi khri gcig stong lnga brgya dang / /bcu bzhi rnams ni 'das pa ru/ /'dul ba lung las gsal bar gsungs/ /gdags pa las ni gzhan du bshad/ /mang pos bkur dang 'od mdzes dang / /dge ba dge mchog gso sbyong 'phags/ /sngon gyi rgyal po sde lngar grags/ /nga las nus dang mdzes pa dang / /nye mdzes mdzes can mdzes ldan ni/ /'khor lo sgyur rgyal sde lnga yin/ /mdzes ldan dus su 'khor ba 'jig /tshe lo bzhi brgya pa la byon/ /de nas rgyal po tsan dha yis/ /bar la rgyal rgyud sum brgya 'das/ /kun nas 'od dang tsan dha'i dus/ /gser thub sum khri pa la byon/ /de nas rgyal po sra sri yis/ /bar la rgyal rgyud sum brgya 'das/ /ratna che dang kri kri'i dus/ /'od srung nyi khri pa la byon/ /de nas rgyal po rna ba can/ /bar la rgyal rgyud sum brgya 'das/ /rgyal po rna ba can la ni/ /sras nyid gau'u ta ma dang / /bha ra dha dza zhes pa byung / /gau tam sras la nyi ma'i gnyen/ /bu ram shing pa rnam gnyis byung / /de nas rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /bar la rgyal rgyud brgya 'das so/ /rgyal po 'phags skyes po'i sras/ /rkang thub can nas shāka rigs byung / /de nas shing rta bcu pa yis/ /bar la rgyal rgyud lnga bcu 'das/ /de nas rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyi/ /bar la rgyal rgyud nyer lnga 'das/ /de nas rgyal po mtha' yas skyong / /gzhu brtan dang ni seng ge 'gram/ /zas gtsang ston pa sgra gcan 'dzin/ /de dag dril bas rgyal rgyud ni/ /dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gcig 'das/ /gnyis pa tshig gi cha cung zad 'phral ba ni/ sgron me'i bskal pa bzang po la/

/sangs rgyas byon dang dam chos gsungs/ /bstan pa gnas dang dar rgyas tshul/ /ces pa'i don/ mdo bskal bzang las/ sgron me'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig nas mos pa'i bar thams cad kyang / khyad chos bcu gsum bcu bzhi sgo nas 'byon par gsungs/ de yang ston pa 'di la mtshon te/ yul rigs 'od dang yab yum sras/ /rim gro shes rab rdzu 'phrul 'khor/ /sku tshe sku gdung dam chos gnas/ /bcu gsum dag gis shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ yul grong khyer ser skya/ rigs rgyal rigs/ 'od 'dom gang / yab rgyal po zas gtsang / yum sgyu ma lha mdzes/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ rim gro ba kun dga' bo/ /shes rab can gyi mchog shā ri'i bu/ rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog mau'u 'gal gyi bu/ 'khor gyi thog ma lnga sde bzang po/ sku tshe brgyad cu pa/ sku gdung cha brgyad kyi sgo nas 'gro don mdzad/ dam pa'i chos lo stong du gnas par gsungs so/ /dam pa'i chos dar rgyas byung tshul ni/ ston pa 'di/ me mo yos la lhums su bzhugs/ sa pho 'brug la sku bltams nas/ /nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu gnas/ /lo drug dka' ba spyad nas kyang / /so lnga bzhes tshe chu stag gi /sa ga'i bco lngar mngon byang chub/ /drug pa'i bzhi la chos 'khor skor/ /me phag sa ga'i bco lnga la/ mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul bstan no/ /zhes pa ltar/ chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes bzhi nas yul wa ra na ser/ lnga sde bzang po la bden pa bzhi'i chos gsungs/ bya rgod phung po'i ri sogs su bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos gsungs/ ri bo ma la ya sogs su/ legs par rnam par 'byed pa'i chos 'khor gsungs/ dam pa'i chos dar ba'i tshul ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya lon pa na/ 'phags pa klu sgrub byon te/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pas 'phags pa'i yul du dam chos dar rgyas su mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas byung brgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs las gzhan mi srid/

ston pa rgyal rigs nyi ma'i gnyen/ bu ram shing pa'i gdung rgyud las/ 'ongs pa shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ ces pa'i don cung zad bshad/ rgyal po rna ba can gyi sras gau'u ta ma dang / bha ra dha dza gnyis las/ go'u ta ma rab tu byung ba la mos pas/ yab la zhus pas gnang ste drang srong mdog nag la rab tu byung nas bdag dgon par zas kyis 'tsho bar mi nus kyi grong 'dabs su gnas so/ /des gnang ste lo mas spyil pu brtsigs te gnas so/ /de'i tshe/ g.yo can pad ma'i rtsa lag gis/ smad 'tshong ma bzang mo la dga' mgur spyad pa'i phyir/ gos rgyan byin no/ /skye pa gzhan zhig gi sa na lnga brgya bzang mo la byin nas de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad pa dang / bran mos padma'i rtsa lag gi gam du phyin te/ bzang mo ni khyod kyi gos rgyan brgyan nas gzhan dang dga' mgur spyod do/ /zhes smras pas/ de ma bzod nas khyod song la skyed mos tshal gang dgar shog byos shig ces bsgos so/ /des bzang mo la smras te song ba dang / g.yo can gyis khyod kho bos gos rgyan gyis brgyan nas skyes pa gzhan dang dga' mgur spyod pa rigs sam smras pas/ des bdag gis nongs bgyis bzod par mdzod cig ces smras kyang bzang mo bsad do/ /der bran mos jo mo bsad zhes ku co bton pas/ skye bo kun gyis rgyug pa dang / g.yo can skrag ste/ ral gri khrag can gau'u ta ma'i drung du bzhag nas/ skye bo'i nang du zhugs so/ /skye bo rnams kyis gau'u ta ma mthong nas lag pa phyin ci log tu bcings nas rgyal po la phul te/ 'dis bzang mo dang dga' mgur spyad nas/ bzang mo bkums so zhes smras bas/ rgyal po ni ma brtag par gsal shing la khol gsungs nas de ltar byas so/ /drang srong mdog nag dus dus su gau'u ta ma'i sar 'gro ba las/ skabs der phyin pa las/ gau'u ta ma mthong bas/ gsal shing la skyon pa mthong nas/ bu ci yin las lhags mod/

rma ma byung ngam/ zhes dris pas bus/ lus kyi rma byung ste/ sems kyi rma min no/ /ji ltar bden/ bden pa'i tshig gis bdag gi lus kyi rma byung gi sems kyi rma min na/ mkhan po'i lpags pa'i mdog gser gyi mdog tu gyur cig ces smras ma thag tu gser mdog tu yid ches so/ /de nas drang srong gi mngon shes kyis brtags te/ gau'u ta ma la sras ma byung na/ bha ra dha dza la sras mi 'byung bas rgyal rgyud chad par shes te/ gau'u ta ma la sras kyi sa bon zhog cig ces smras pas/ bdag gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / bud med kyi rgyus kyang ma 'tshal na/ lta ga la mchis/ bu mngon spyod pas yul dran par gyis shig ces gsungs pas/ sna chad pa'i tshor bas nyen nas/ yul dran par ga la 'gyur/ drang srong gi rdzu 'phrul gyis rdzi char chen po phab ste/ char pas thigs pa lus la phog cing / rlung grang mo lus la phog pas sdug bsngal bsal nas/ sngon gyi yul dran par byas te/ 'khrig pa 'dod chags dran nas khu ba khrag dang 'dres pa gnyis lhung ngo / /de gnyis sgo nga gnyis su gyur nas/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis smin nas rdol pa dang / khye'u gnyis byung ste/ de dang nye bar bu ram gyi shing gi gseb tu bzhugs so/ /gau'u ta ma nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis shin tu tsha nas shi'o/ /drang srong 'ongs nas nye 'khor la bltas pas/ sgong skogs mthong nas btsal bas/ bu ram shing gi tshal na khye'u gnyis mthong ste/ de gnyis gau'u tam gyi bur shes te gnas su khrid nas snum rnyed de gsos pas/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis smin parabyas pas nyi ma'i gnyen/ gau'u ta ma'i bu yin pa'i gau'u ta ma/ rings yan lag las skyes pas na yan lag skyes/ bu ram shing gis tshal nas rnyed pas bu ram shing pa zhes btags so/ /dus ji zhig na/ bha ra dha dza bu med par shi nas/ blon po rnams gros byas te/ su rgyal por dbang bskur zer ba la/ ban gau'u ta ma dbang bskur zer drang srong mdog nag gi drung du song ste/

gau'u ta ma ga na mchis zhus pas/ khyed kyis bsad do zer/ bdag cag rnams kyis mthong ba yang mi dran na ji ltar bsad/ des khong skyon med dang khyed kyis bsad pa'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par bshad pa dang / khye'u gnyis kyang phyogs der 'ongs so/ /'di gnyis su'i bu zhes zhus pas/ gau'u ta ma kho na'i bu'o zhes gsungs/ ngo mtshar skyes te de gnyis khrid nas phu bo rgyal srid la dbang bskur ro/ /de'ang bu med par shi nas nu bo rgyal srid la dbang bskur bas/ rgyal po bu ram shing pa zhes bya ste/ de'i rgyal rgyud la bu ram shing pa'i rgyal rgyud du grags so/ /gau'u ta ma las ngan gyi dbang gis ma nyes pa skyon byung tshul khungs su gsungs shing / gau'u ta ma dang bha ra dha dza dpon slob chung nas bral bas/ gcen du ngo ma shes par khrims bcas par mngon no/ /da ni/ shākya'i rigs kyi byung tshul brjod par bya ste/ rgyal po bu ram shing pa nas rgyal rgyud brgya 'das pa na/ yul gru 'dzin du bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po byung / de la bu bzhi ste/ skar mda' gdong / lag rna/ glang chen 'dul/ rkang gdub can no/ /de dus gcig na de'i btsun mo dam pa shi nas yid khung du chud nas 'dug pa la/ blon pos dris pas rgyas par smras pa dang / btsun mo gzhan btsal/ gzhon nu 'di dag rgyal srid 'dod pas sus bu mo ster/ bdag gis btsal lo/ /ji tsam rgyal po gzhan zhig gi bu mo gzugs bzang po zhig mthong nas/ bkra shes par gyur cig ci slong bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po'i btsun mo dam pa gum pas sras mo slong ngo / /rung mod kyi dam zhig bca' ste/ nga'i bu mo la khye'u byung ba rgyal srid du 'jog na sbyin no/ /bgyi'o zhes gsol nas/ bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po la smras pa/ phu bo gzhag nas nu bo rgyal srid du ji ltar bzhag don 'di la nges pa ma mchis te/ bu tsha byung ba'i nges pa'ang med/ byung na'ang bu dang bu mo gang byung gis nges pa'ang ma mchis so/

/zhes smras pas/ de blangs te dga' mgur spyad pas/ bu gcig byung ba skyes pa nas rgyal srid la dga' bas rgyal srid dga' zhes ming btags so/ /de cher skyes pa dang / rgyal srid la ma bzhag pa zhang pos thos nas tshig rtsub po dang bcas bsrings ba/ khyod sngon khas blangs pa bzhin byed na legs/ mi byed na mthu skyed la sdod cig kho bo ni 'ongs la yul 'khor bu ram brlag go zhes bsrings ba dang / 'di la ji ltar rgyal srid dga' rgyal po la dbang bskur mod/ phu bo bzhag nas nu bo dbang bskur ba 'os pa min no/ /rgyal po de ni stobs dang ldan pa'i dbang bskur la gzhon nu rnams bcug tu gsol/ nyes pa med par ji ltar bcug bdag cag ni blon po la sogs pas lha'i don sems zhing nyes pa med pa'ang bcug yod pa'ang 'jog go /cang mi smra ba dang blon po rnams gros byas te/ gzhon nu rnams rgyal pos thugs phyung ba'i thabs byas so/ /ces bgros nas/ skyed mos tshal byi dor byas pa ri mo sna tshogs bris pa zhig tu rtsed chas sna tshogs bzhag ste sgor byung ba dang / gzhon nu rnams kyis bris pa/ sdus tshal lha'i 'o/ /log par rtsom pas zhugs shig de dag skyed mos tshal du rtse ba dang / blon po nas rgyal po spyan drangs te 'ongs pas/ ku co'i sgra thos nas ci yin gzhon nu rnams so/ /gal te de ltar gzhon nu rnams ngas spangs so/ /blon pos smras pa/ lha bzod par mdzod cig gzhon nu rnams spang bar gsol/ de ltar gyis shig zhes gzhon nu rnams bcug par chad pa dang / rgyal po'i rkang pa la gtugs te/ bdag cag 'khor gyi skye bo dang lhan cig mchis na mi dgag par gsol/ gyis shig de nas de rnams la dga' ba'i 'khor gyi skye bo'i tshogs dang lhan gcig chas te/ zhag bdun gru gzings kyi sgo phye nas skye bo'i tshogs song ba dang / blon po'i sgo ma kum na gru gzings stong par 'gyur ro/ /sgo chod cig bcad de/

de nas de rnams rang rang gi sring mo khrid nas/ mthar gyi gangs ri dang nye ba chu bo skal ldan gyi shing rta'i 'gram/ drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang nye ba zhig tu/ lo mas sbyin pu btab ste gnas bcas nas ri dwags gsod cing 'tsho'o/ /de dag dus gsum du ser skya'i bsti gnas su 'gro'o/ /de rnams la 'tsho ba dang 'dod chags kyis nyen nas skyo seng seng bor gyur pa dang / ser skyas dris pas ji ltar yin pa smras pas/ rang rang gi sring mo spongs la/ mas dbon gyi sring mo bsten cig rung ngam rgyal rigs rgyal srid stong pa la rung ngo / /de rnams drang srong gi tshig tshad ma yin snyam nas/ mas dbon gyi sring mo dang lhan cig spyad pas bu dang bu mo mang po btsas te chen por gyur pa dang / bsam gtan gyi tsher ma dgra yin pas/ ser skya'i sems rtse gcig pa ma thob pa dang ser skyas 'gro'o/ ci'i phyir 'di 'ongs/ khyed 'di nyid du bzhugs cig bdag cag gnas gzhan du mchi'o/ /sa phyogs phog cig drang srong des gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te/ chu rgyun gyis grong khyer gyi rnam pa bris nas de rnams kyis grong khyer brtsigs pas ser skya'i gzhis zhes grags so/ /der de rnams 'phel bar gyur nas/ dge pa'i 'phel bar ma gyur pa dang / lhas de rnams kyi sems shes nas/ phyogs gzhan zhig bstan pas der grong khyer brtsigs pas lhas bstan zhes grags so/ /de rnams tshogs nas bdag cag 'chugs pa de rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs pas gyur gyis/ der sus kyang rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blang bar mi bya'o/ /gcig kho nas chog shes par bya'o/ /zhes bcas so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po 'phags skyes po bu rnams dran te/ de rnams gang na 'dug pa rgyas par bshad pas/ gzhon nu rnams sring mo dang lhan cig byed dam rnga thog lags so/ /skye ma gzhan rnams ni phog pa'o/ zhes dbang chen pos bsgrags pas/ phod pa zhes bsgrags te shākya zhes bya'o/

/de nas rgyal po 'phags skyes po shi nas rgyal srid dga' dbang skur/ de'ang bu med par shi nas/ dkar mda' gdong dang / lag rna dang / glang po che 'dul rnams rim bzhin bkod pas kyang bu med par shi nas/ rkang gdub can rgyal por gyur te/ de'i bu gnas 'jog de'i khyim nas rgyud pa lnga khri lnga stong ser skyar byung ngo / /de'i tha ma rgyal po shing rta bcu pa sogs ming smos pa bcu gnyis byung bas tha ma gzhu brtan/ de la bu seng ge 'gram dang / seng ge'i sgra gnyis te/ seng ge'i 'gram la bu bzhi ste/ zas gtsang / zas dkar/ bre bo zas/ tshad med zas so/ /bu mo gtsang ma/ dkar mo/ bre bo ma/ bdud rtsi ma'o/ zas gtsang la bu bcom ldan 'das dang / gcung dga' bo gnyis/ zas dkar la rgyal ba dang / bzang ldan gnyis/ bre bo zas la ming chen dang / ma 'gags pa'o/ /tshad med zas la kun dga' bo dang / lha sbyin no/ /gtsang ma'i bu legs par rab song ngo / /dkar mo'i bu 'phreng ba can/ gre bo ma'i bu bzang len/ bdud rtsi ma'i bu dge 'phel lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sras sgra gcan 'dzin te des ston pa nas rgyud pas bu ram shing pa'i rgyal rgyud rdzogs/ de la zas gtsang yan chad du sa ya gcig 'bum nyi khri gcig stong lnga brgya bcu gnyis rnams byung ngo / /'jig rten gdags pa las ni 'dul ba lung las grangs gzhan du bshad de/ mang bkur nas sgra gcan 'dzin yan chad la rgyal po 'bum phrag gcig lnga khri lnga stong / gcig brgya nga gcig 'das par mngon pa kun btus nas bshad do/ /yang 'jig rten gdags par 'dul ba nas btus pa'i lugs gcig la/ mang pos bkur ba nas sgra gcan 'dzin yan du rgyal po 'bum phrag brgyad/ sum khri bzhi stong lnga brgya sum cu rtsa drug mdor gsungs so// ༈ //da ni bod kyi rgyal po'i lo rgyus brjod par bya ste/ 'di la dang por bod kyi chags tshul/ chags nas rgyal po'i byon tshul/ byon pas rgyal po rnams kyi bstan pa la bya ba byas tshul lo/

/dang po ni spyir bod kyi yul du mi'i 'gro ba byung tshul lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa'i 'grel par/ skyabs seng bu lnga brgya dang / dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis 'thab pa'i dus su/ dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas pa bud med kyi chas su zhugs te/ ri gangs can gyi gseb tu bros pa las 'phel ba yin par shes rab go chas bshad cing / bod kyi gtam rgyud las bya ba byas pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mos mched par 'chad de/ de dag rgyas par gzhan du lta'o/ /gnyis pa chags nas rgyal po'i byon tshul ni/ bod 'dir sngon chad rgyal blon sil ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa byon zer yang / rgyal phran nyid du zad cing / de dag gi rgyal pas bstan pa la bya ba byas pa'i gtam yod pa ma yin no/ /des na bod kyi mkhas pa rnams/ rje gnya' khri btsan po nas bod kyi rgyal rabs brjod par snang la/ de brjod na/ gnam gyi khri bdun/ stod kyi steng gnyis/ sa'i legs drug bar gyi sde brgyad/ 'og gi btsan gsum zhes pa ltar/ dang po gnya' khri btsan po bod lde/ de nas mu khri btsan po/ ding khri btsan po/ so khri btsan po/ mer khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po/ de dag la gnam gyi khri bdun zer/ sras rnams kyis rim bzhin rmu thag la 'jus nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin song yang zer ro/ /khri bdun bang so nam mkha'i dbyings la btab/ /lha'i lus la ro med 'ja' ltar yal/ /ces so/ /de'i sras gri gum btsan po/ spu de gung rgyal gnyis ni/ stod kyi steng gnyis so/ /steng gnyis bang so g.ya' dang gangs la btab/ de yi blon po ru lag skyes kyis byas/ i sho legs/ gong ru legs/ thi sho legs/ a sho legs/ 'brong gzher legs/ de sho legs de dag ni/ sa'i legs drug go /legs drug bang so g.ya' spang mtshams su btab/ /de'ang spang la 'ja' tshon rgyas pa 'dra/ /za nam zin lde/ 'khrul nam gzhung btsan lde/

se nol nam lde/ se nor po lde/ lde nor nam/ lde nol po/ lde rgyal po/ lde sprin btsan/ de dag bar gyi lde brgyad do/ /khri btsan nam/ khri sgra spungs btsan/ khri thog rje thog btsan/ 'di gsum la bod kyi btsan gsum zer/ btsan gsum bang so gangs dkar rtse la btab/ /de'ang g.ya' la na bun chags pa 'dra/ de'i sras lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan/ khri snyan bzung btsan/ 'gro gnyen lde'u/ stag ri gnyan gzigs/ gnam khri srong btsan/ srong btsan sgam po/ gung srong gung btsan/ mang srong mang btsan/ 'dus srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ khri lde gtsug brtan nam me'i ag tshoms/ khri srong lde btsan/ mu ne btsan po/ khri lde stong btsan/ ral pa can/ khri'u 'am dar ma/ de sras gnam lde 'od srung / de'i sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de 'bangs kyi srongs dbus gtsang gi mthil gyi rgyal srid shor nas/ sras kyi rtsegs pa dpal dang / skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis yod pa/ khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gtsang stod bzhugs/ nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su byon/ de la sras gsum ste/ dpal gyi mgon/ bkra shis lde mgon/ lde bcug mgon rnams so/ /che bas mang yul/ bar pas spu rangs/ chung bas zhang zhung ste/ gu ge'i mnga' zhabs na yod pa yin no/ /bkra shis mgon la sras gnyis te/ 'khor de dang srong nge'o/ /srong nge la sras/ na ga ra dza dang / de ba ra dza gnyis so/ /srong nge yab sras gsum rab tu byung nas/ 'khor re la srid gtad/ de'i sras lha lde/ de'i sras 'od ldes srid bzung / gcung po byang chub 'od dang / zhi ba 'od rab tu byung / 'od lde'i sras rtser lde/ de nas bkra shis lde/ bha lde/ na ga lde/ btsan phyug lde/ bkra shis lde/ grags can lde/ grags pa lde/ a sog lde/ de'i sras 'dzi dang smal dang / a nanta smal gnyis/ phyi ma'i sras re'u smal/ de nas sang ga smal/ 'dzi dang smal gyi a 'dzings smal/ de'i sras ka lan sman/ de'i sras bar btab smal/

des mchog gi rgyal rgyud chad/ bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la sras dpal lde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde gsum/ mar pa 'od lde la sras bzhi las gsum pa khri chung / de'i sras 'od kyi 'bar/ de la sras bdun las g.yu btsan/ de'i sras je dga'/ de la sras gsum las/ bar dar ma/ de la sras bzhi la jo bo rnal 'byor/ de la sras gsum las che ba jo 'bag de la sras lnga las/ che ba jo bo shākya mgon po/ de'i sras jo bo shākya bkra shis/ de la sras gnyis las chung ba mnga' bdag grags pa rin chen/ de la sras bzhi las gnyis pa shākya mgon/ des sras chos rje btsan po shākya rin chen lde'o/ /rgyud pa de rnams dar ma ma gtogs srong btsan man thams cad kyis dkon mchog gsum la bla mar mdzad do/ /gsum pa byon pas rgyal po rnams kyis bstan pa la bya ba byas tshul la/ bstan pa snga dar kyi rnam gzhag dang / phyi dar gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni bod kyi rgyal po rnams rgya gar gyi rgyal rgyud gang las byung snyam na/ kha cig ko la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi sras lnga brtsegs ma yin zer ro/ /kha cig gzugs can snying po'i sras lnga brtsegs ma yin zer/ kha cig bod rnams bdud dang / gnod sbyin gyis rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyis sner ba'i dus su/ ga pa la'i rgyal po mig mas 'gebs pa/ sor mo dra bas 'brel ba'i mtshan ldan zhig byung bas skrag ste/ zangs kha sbyor du bcug ste/ gaṅga la bskyur ba zhing pas rnyed de gsos so/ /de cher skyes pa na/ sngar gyi gtam bshad pas yid skyo ste/ gangs ri'i gseb tu bros pa na/ rims gyis lha ri yol ba'i khar byung ste/ btsan thang sgo bzhi'i ri la babs pas/ phyugs skyong ba'i rdzi bo rnams kyis mthong ste/ rtsar byung nas/ gang nas 'ongs dris pas/ gnam mdzub mo ker ba dang / ming ci yin dris pas btsan po yin zer/ 'di ni nam mkha' nas 'ongs pa'i lha'i sras yin par 'dug pas 'u cag rnams kyi rjer bcol lo zer/
