gnya' bar khri byas bteg 'ongs pa na/ rje gnya' khri btsan por grags/ bod kyi rgyal po snga ma yin no/ /rgyal po 'di sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lon pa na byon/ khri thog rje thog btsan gyi sras lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan zhes pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa des/ dgung lo brgyad cu'i bar du rgyal srid bskyangs te/ pho brang yum bu bla khang gi rtse la bzhugs pa las/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od ma'i tshal nas lung bstan pa bzhin/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel la/ nam mkha' nas me tog za ma tog snying po yi ge drug pa/ spang kong phyag rgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa/ tshin dha ma ni/ tsha tsha sko phor/ mu ṭa'i phyag rgya rnams nyi ma'i 'od zer las 'grogs te/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi steng du babs pa las/ khyed nas gdung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes pa'i rgyal po gcig 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes nam mkha' nas lungs bstan/ rgyal pos kyang bsten/ de rnams ngo mtshar che bar ni dgongs/ gang yin ni ma mkhyen te/ gnyen po gsang ba zhes mtshan gsol nas/ rin po che'i khri la bzhag nas mchod pa phul bas/ de'i yon tan gyis rgyal po slar gzhon sha can du gyur nas/ dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu thub te/ sku lus gcig la sku tshe gnyis thub ces grags so/ /nel pa paṇa chen na re/ bon po nam mkha' la dga' bas nam mkha' nas babs zer ba bon gtam yin gyis/ don la paṇḍi ta blo sems mtsho dang / lotstsha li the sems chos de dag khyer 'ongs pa la/ rgyal pos yi ge mi shes shing / don mi go bas/ paṇḍi ta dang lotstsha ba phyir ldog zer ba 'di dag pa 'dra ste/ dus phyis rab gsal snang gis bal por phyin/ mkhan po zhi mtsho dang mjal ba'i tshe/ mkhan po'i gsung la bod kyi btsan po dang / khyed dang nga dang gsum gyis/ 'od srung gi bstan pa la/ bya rdzi ma'i bu gsum du gyur nas bod du bstan pa spel bar smon lam btab pa yin te/

btsan po yang ma skyes/ khyod kyang nar ma son pas/ ngas 'di na bod kyi rgyal rabs dgu'i bar du sgug cing bsdad pa yin gsung pa/ sba bzhed gtsang ma na snang ba'i phyir/ bo dhi sa twa blo sems su li the sems rdur/ mtsho zhes pa zhi ba mtsho dang 'byor pas so/ /shes bya rab gsal na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong song nas/ rje gnya' khri btsan po byon/ nyis stong lnga brgya na lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan byon par gsungs 'dug rje gnya' khri btsan po nas lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan yan la gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun la lo lnga brgya 'dug par nges zer na'ang / chos dang 'brel ba'i rgyal por mi 'dug pas lo rgyus rgyas par ma bkod do/ /rgyal po gnam khri srong btsan dang / 'bri bza' thod dkar gyi sras thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni/ me mo glang gi lo la/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sku bltams te/ sku la sangs rgyas a mi tā bha bzhugs pa phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing du yod pa gcig bltams so/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab ste/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /blon po rnams na re/ 'u cag gi rje 'di ni yon tan du ma dang ldan te/ thugs shin tu sgam mo zhes zer bas/ mtshan srong btsan sgam po zhes grags so/ /de nas rgyal po dgung lo bcu gsum lon dus yab 'das te rgyal sar byon pa yin no/ /chos kyi rgyal po des bod khams su dge ba bcu'i khrims bca' ba'i ched du/ thon mi saṃ bho ṭa rgya gar du mkhas pa li byin la yi ge slob tu btang / thon mis kyang rgyal po'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs te/ bod du log yig ge bslabs/ dus de rtsa na rgyal po la yongs grags kyi blon po sum brgya/ ming can gyi blon po bcu drug

med thabs med kyi blon chen bzhi rnams kyis rgyal pos bka' bstsal ba bzhin dge ba bcu'i khrims bca' ba ste/ bzang pa la bya dga' ster/ ngan pa la chad pa gcod/ mtho ba khrims kyis gnon/ dma' ba thabs kyis skyong / sku gsung sde bzhir byas/ phu chu rdzing du bskyil/ mda' chu yur bar brang / bre srang gtan la phab/ zhing la lhu ru bcad/ mi la yi ge bslabs/ rta la mdongs su bris/ legs pa'i dpe srol btsugs te/ 'thab mo byas pa la chad pa/ bsad pa la che chung gi stong byed pa/ rkus pa la 'jal dngos dang dgu/ byi byas pa la yan lag gi phran bcad nas yul gzhan du bcug pa/ rdzun byas pas lce gcod pa'o/ /gzhan yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song zhing / dad pa dang mos gus che ba/ pha ma la drin du bzo zhing bkur sti bya ba/ mi drin can dang pha khu rgan rgon gyi drin mi brjed cing bzang po'i lan byed pa/ mi ya rabs dang rigs btsun pa la mi rgol zhing dang du len pa/ las dang spyod pa thams cad ya rabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ lha chos dang yi ge la blo 'jug cing don shes par bya ba/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing mi dge ba 'ba' zhig la 'dzem pa/ mdza' bshes dang khyim mtshes la phan 'dogs shing gnod sems mi bya ba/ gzhi drang por byed cing blo sems dpang du 'jog pa/ zas chang la tshod 'dzin cing khrel yod par bya ba/ bu lon dus su 'jal zhing bre srang la g.yo zol mi bya ba/ ma bskos shing ma bcol ba'i bya ba la rtogs 'jug mi bya ba dang / grogs kyi nang du bud med kyi kha la mi nyan zhing rang tshugs 'dzin pa/ yin min gyi ma tshangs na yul lha dpang du btsugs nas mna' byed pa la sogs te/ dge ba bcu la dpe byas nas/ bod khrims nyi shu'i shod sho ma ru gtan la phab nas/ rje blon kun gyis phyag rgyas btab ste/ nyi zla'i 'od lta bur khyab par mdzad do/ /de nas sprul pa'i rgyal po des rgya gar lho phyogs nas tsandan sbrul gyi snying po las rang 'byon du 'khrungs pa'i bcu gcig zhal gdan drangs/

da lta rang 'byung lnga ldan gyi thugs na bzhugs/ de nas rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams kyi nags khrod chen po zhig na/ tsandan ha ri'i sdong po zhig la rang 'byon gyi 'phags pa mched bzhi yod par gzigs te/ 'phags pa wa ti yang yul skyid grong du gdan drangs/ de'i 'og ma gcig 'phags pa u gang nga grong khyer yam bu ya 'gal du gdan drangs/ de'i 'og pa 'phags pa ljam ma la rgya bal gyi mtshams su gdan drangs/ de'i 'og ma 'phags pa lo ki shwa ra rgyal po rang gi yi dam du gdan drangs/ 'phags pa de rnams gdan 'dren pa'i sprul pa'i dge slong rgyal po rang gi smin mtshams su thim par mdzad/ de nas bal po'i yul nas lha mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa bal mo khri btsun khab tu bzhes/ des jo bo mi skyod rdo rje/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsandan gyi sgrol ma rnams gdan drangs/ de nas rgya nag gis yul nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya mo za kong jo khab tu bzhes/ des jo bo shākya mu ne gdan drangs te/ bka' dang bstan bcos du ma bsgyur/ lha khang mang du bzhengs/ chos dge bcu spel zhing / bstan khrims rnam pa lnga bcas/ bshad nyan gyi srol dang chos grwa khang du ma btsugs pas dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod/ phyis gdung rabs lnga nas dam pa'i chos dar ba'i lung bstan no/ /rgyal po des lo dgu bcu rtsa dgu rgyal srid bzung ste/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis la gshegs so/ /de dang mnyam du/ kong jo'i zhal nas/ lha shākya mu ni ra mo che nas gdan drangs la 'phrul snang gi blo 'bur du sbos la/ sgo la zhal zhal gyis la 'jam dbyangs bris shig gsungs te/ khri btsun dang mnyam du gsum ga thugs rje chen po la thim pa'am 'das so/ /blon po rnams kyis kyang lha gnyis brjes te/ zhal chems ltar byas so/ /de nas khri lde gtsug brtan gyi/ sngar gyi lung bstan gyi rgyal po lde'i ming can nga yin mnyam du bsams te/

brag dmar mgrin bzang la sogs pa bzhengs/ chos srol cher mdzad do/ /de sras ljang tsha lha dbon la/ rgya'i rgyal po'i sras kyi ma shang kong jo blangs pas bu shi ste/ mes dang 'dus nas shākya mu ne btsal te mchod pa byas so/ /de la sras mtshan ldan gcig sa pho rta la 'khrungs pa la/ btsun mo che ba sna nam za phrag dog skyes nas/ nga la'ang rgyal po'i gdung rgyud 'khrungs la yod zhes rdzun smras te/ sna nam rgyal mo'i rtsar byung / shin tu blo nye bar ltar byas nas/ rgyal mo'i bu chung 'phrogs te/ nga rang la skyes pa yin zhes bsnyon byas so/ /der rgya mos nu ma bstan/ smre sngags bton/ che nges bos kyang / bu chung ma sprad pas blon po rnams sgrin/ rgyal po la zhus pas/ der sna nam zas kyang rang gi nu ma la rang babs kyi rdzas byugs te/ nu zho yod pa byas nas blon po rnams la bstan pas/ blon po rnams kyang the tshom du gyur nas ma shes so/ /der rgya mos bu chung btsun mo che bas phrogs pas/ byed thabs ma byung pa la/ rgya mos sems la da de bu chung gis nga la phan pa dka'/ bod 'di phung ba'i las cig byed dgos snyam nas/ ri'i dpyad bltas pas/ rgyal po'i dus rabs chad pa'i phyir rje'i bla ri seṅge gnam du mchongs ba 'dra ba'i mgo la/ mngal khrag gis 'khor lo bris nas mchod rten gyis mnan/ blon po rig pa can ma 'ong ba'i phyir/ blon po'i bla ri la khro chu'i sna bcad/ stag seng ri gnyis gzhug ma sbrel ba'ang bcad/ mu ge 'ong ba'i phyir/ yar lung me sna'i ri 'bras kyis ljang pa 'dra ba'i rtsa ba bcad/ bod du mdze 'ong ba'i phyir mang mkhar gyi khyung chen gnam la lting pa 'dra ba'i mchu bcad do/ /de nas sras kyis lo 'khor te zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la/ btsun mo gnyis po'i pha ming brgya dang sna nam nas pos so/ /der sna nam pa rnams kyis bu chung dga' bar byed pa'i yo byad gos dang rgyan dang /

me long gi phreng ba rnams khyer yongs so/ /der rgyal po'i pho brang du rgyal po gser gyi khri'i steng du dgung la bzhugs/ g.yas la sna nam pa rnams kyis bsdad/ g.yon na rgya rnams bsdad/ der yab rgyal pos sras rgyan du mas brgyan te/ gser skyogs 'bras chang gis gang ba rgyal bu'i phyag tu gtad nas yab na re/ ma gnyis las skyes pa'i bu gcig po/ lus chung yang lha yi rnam sprul can/ snod gser skyogs chang gis gang ba 'di/ bu khyed rang gi zhang po'i lag tu gtod/ ma gang yin gyi yid ches de la byed/ gsungs te dmod bor nas/ sras gom pa thub tsam de btang bas/ des sras kyi gom pa bor nas byon pa dang / sna nam za rnams kyis gos dang rgyan dang / me tog gi phreng ba sogs bstan nas bos kyang 'gro ma nyan par/ rgya rnams kyi rtsar byung ste/ gser skyogs rgya la gtad nas/ 'di skad zer ro/ /nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin/ sna nam zhang gi don mi 'tshal/ zer to/ /zhang po rgya'i pang du song ngo / /der yum rgya mo shin tu dga' ste/ tshe sngon ma'i las kyis 'phen pa yis/ nga rgya nag nas 'ongs ba'i bu mo la/ /rje 'gran med rgyal po'i sras gcig 'khrungs/ /las gang yang srid pa'i sngon chad la/ /bu rang la skyes pa gzhan gyis phrogs/ /gtam bden pa'i tshig la ma nyan zhing / /brang nu ma bstan yang ma gtad pas/ /nga rgya mo'i lus sems gzhob tu thal/ /sems khong khro'i na tsha ma bzod par/ yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams su bcug /dus de ring lha yi nyi ma la/ /bu khyod kyis zhang ngo shes pa legs/ /nga a ma'i lus sems mal du bde/ /yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams pa de/ /ri de rnams skyon med bcos su yod/ /zer ro/ /der rgya mo'i sras yin par ngo shes nas/ dga' ston chen po byas so/ /de'i sras dgung lo lnga lon dus yum 'das/ yab rgyal po dgung lo re gsum la gshegs so/ /de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa na rgyal srid bzung /

rgyal po sku nar ma son pa'i dus su ma zhang khron pa skyes la sogs pa blon po chos la mi dga' ba rnams kyis/ chos byar mi gnang ba'i khrims bcas nas lha sa'i jo bo rin po che slar rgya yul du skyel grab byas pas/ mi stong gis kyang ma drangs mkhar brag tu sa thims su bcug pas/ blon po chos la mi dga' ba 'ga' zhig ni smyo 'bog byung nas shi mu ge dang nad yams dang bkra mi shis pa'i ltas mang po byung bas/ ltas mkhan thams cad kha mthun par rgya'i lha bye thims su bcug 'dug pas lan 'dug zer nas/ sa 'og nas bton te/ rgya gar du skyel bar bsams pas/ dre'u gnyis kyis theg nas mang yul du sleb/ de nas lam la ma thar zhes glengs nas jo bos mang yul du lo bcu bzhi bzhugs/ de nas rgyal po sku nar son te/ rje blon rnams chos bya bar blo mthun te/ thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas ma zhang khron pa skyes gson por dur du bcug de nas thams cad la chos bya ba'i bka' gnang nas/ thog mar mang yul nas jo bo shākya gdan drangs so/ /de nas rgyal blon rnams kyis gros bgyis te/ sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi drung du/ khye'u gsum gyis smon lam btab pa'i mthu la brten nas/ spa gsal snang rgya gar du mkhan po bho ti satwa gdan 'dren du btang bas/ gsal snang gis mkhan po gdan drangs pho brang du phebs pa dang / rgyal pos sku rags ma bcings par gser phye bre gang phyag tu bsnams nas/ mkhan po'i bsu ba la byon pas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi dbu la la thod gsol bas stod du rgyal khrims zhwa tsam gcig 'chags/ zhabs la chag gsol bas/ smad du mdo khams lham tsam gcig la khrims shig 'chags/ sku la sku rags ma bcings pas bar 'dir rgyal khrims myur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang rin po che phyag rten du phul bas chos byar btub gsungs so/ /de nas kha che a nandas lo tstsha ba gyis te/

rje blon rnams la chos gsungs pas/ nag phyogs kyi 'dre srin gdug pa can rnams ma dga' nas thog ser dang nad yams byung bas 'dre srin dam la 'dogs pa'i phyir du/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas o rgyan gyi yul nas spyan drangs te/ bod kyi 'dre srin dam la btags te/ rje blon chos byed pa la bar chad med par mdzod do/ /de nas mnga' 'bangs rnams kyi bu blo rno ba bdun bo dhi satwa'i drung du byung ba la sad mi mi bdun du grags so/ /de nas dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de nas rgya gar nas paṇḍita bi ma la mi tra la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang po gdan drangs/ sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba bāai ro na dang / kha che ā nanda dang / rma rin chen mchog dang / ka dbon klu'i dbon dang / ka ba dpal rtsegs dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pas lo tsā byas ste/ sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling du gzhi bzung nas sde snod gsum ka bsgyur/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur dar rgyas su mdzad do/ /de nas mkhan po bo dhi satwa'i zhal nas/ rgyal po khyod kyi bod yul 'di/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis bstan ma bcu gnyis la gtad pas bod du mu stegs pa mi 'byung mod/ 'on kyang rten 'brel 'ga' zhig gi rgyus/ chos lugs gnyis su 'gro bas/ de dus nga'i slob ma mkhas pa chen po ka ma shī la rgya gar nas gdan drongs shig des de sun 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan nas dra ba rgyab ste 'das so/ /de nas lung bstan bzhin/ ha shang gi chos log bstan pa/ ka ma la shī la gdan drangs te/ sun phyung bar mdzad/ khri srong lde btsan ni phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par grags shing / chos rgyal des bstan pa dar rgyas spel ba'i tshul la/ dus phyis dhi paṃ ka ra'i zhal nas/ de dus su bod du bstan pa dar rgyas byung ba tsam rgya gar du yang ma byung 'dug skad/

btsan po de drug cu dgu la 'das/ 'di'i 'khrungs lo dang 'das lo la mi mthun pa mang bar 'dug de'i sras mu ne btsan pos chu pho stag la rgyal srid bzung ste/ bsam yas su mchod pa chen po gcig btsugs te/ bod 'bangs kyi phyug ltogs lan gsum snyoms/ chab srid lo gcig dang zla ba dgu bzung / dgung lo bcu bdun pa la yum gyis dug btang nas 'das skad do/ /sras bar pa mu tig btsan po ni sna nam zas pas grongs zer ro/ /de nas sras chung ba sad na legs 'ching yon la rgyal srid gtad/ des kyang chos srol cher mdzad/ de la sras lnga 'khrungs pas/ sras che ba gtsang ma chos la dga' bas rab tu byung / dar ma sdig pa la dga' ste rje'i 'os min/ bar pa ral pa can la rgyal srid gtad/ sad na legs dgung lo lnga la 'das/ ral pa can de me pho byi ba la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la yab 'das te rgyal sar bton/ bka'i blon po bran kha dpal gyi yon tan gyis byas/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ dge ba bcu'i khrims bzung / rgya gar gyi paṇḍita dzi na mi tra/ shrī land+re bo dho/ dā na shī la la sogs pa spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba ka ba dpal brtsegs dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pas chos bsgyur te/ chos thams cad skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ bka' bcas rnam pa gsum mdzad do/ /tha na bre srang zho la sogs thams cad kyang rgya gar dang bstun/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgom grwa btsugs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gyi bshad sgra btsugs/ chos sde sum cu tham par dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi 'dul grwa btsugs/ rab byung re re'i zhabs tog la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ rgyal po gung la bzhugs/ dbu'i ral pa g.yas g.yon gyi sna la dar yug btags/ dge 'dun bzhugs pa'i gral g.yas g.yon la bting / de'i steng du dge 'dun bzhugs par mos la dbu sde gnyis su grags so/ /thugs dam du/

'u shang mdo dpe med/ bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang sogs bzhengs/ de ltar rgyal po khri lde btsan ral pa can te/ mkhyen pa ni 'phrul gyi tshul chags/ mdzad pa ni lha'i lugs dang mthun/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor ni brgya byin dang mnyam/ dbang dang mthu stobs kyis ni bdud sdig can skrag par byed pa/ mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal te/ 'dzam bu'i gling sum gnyis la dbang mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas blon 'bangs chos la mi dga' ba rnams spyod pa shin tu dog par gyur nas/ nged rang gi spyod pa dog pa 'di sus lan ces gcig gis gcig la smras pa dang / 'dis lan ces btsun pa la mdzub mo gtad/ mig ngan bltas pas/ rgyal pos gsan te/ nga'i rab tu byung ba rnams la/ sdig mdzub gtad nas mig ngan lta ba mi rigs pas/ da phyis sus byas kyang mig phyung la mdzub mo gcod gcig gsungs so/ /de ltar rgyal po chos la shin tu dkar ba de la/ sbas stag rna can la sogs pa sdig blon rnams shin tu ma dga' nas/ chos khrims 'jig pa'i gros byas nas/ rgyal po dgung lo so drug pa lcags mo khyi'i lo la/ rgyal po 'bras chang gsol nas gzims pa la/ sbas stag rna can dang / cog ro lha lod gnyis kyis rgyal po ltag pa bskor nas bkrongs so/ /'di yan la skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum dang / shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs lnga zer ro/ /de nas rgyal po khri glang dar ma dbu dum btsan bdud kyi sprul pa de rgyal por bskos te/ rgyal khams la dbang byas so/ /de nas rgyal po de'i thugs su gdon gsol nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs so/ /rab tu byung ba la la shan pa bcol/ la la rtags dang phral/ la la ri dwags gsod du bcug ma nyan pa rnams bsad/ lha khang 'jig pa'i sngon ma lha sa la bya ste/ jo bo rnam gnyis chu la bskyur gsungs pa chos blon rnams kyis thabs byas te rang rang gi khri'i 'og tu sbas/ byams pa sku ras kyis dril nas 'o thang gi mtsho 'gram du sbas/

nang gi lder sku rnams chu la bskur bar bsams na'ang / phyag na rdo rje'i mgul la thag pa 'dogs mkhan skad cig la khrag skyugs nas shi bas lha khang 'jig 'phro bcad/ lha sa dang bsam yas la sogs pa'i sgo brtsigs/ glegs bam la la chu la bskyur/ la la me la bsregs so/ /chos blon rnams kyis/ mgrin gcig tu rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che smad pa mi rigs/ sngar srol bzang po la dgongs nas yab med kyi yig tshang la gzigs shig ces ngus so/ /dus der chu bo ri'i sgom ra na g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu ne gsum sgom gin yod pa la/ btsun pa cig gi shams thabs brdze lag tu mda' gzhu khyer mgo la bya sgro btsugs nas 'phral du khyi khrid nas ri dwags bshor kyin 'dug pa/ g.yo dge 'byung gis mthong nas/ ban rgan 'khrul lam btsun pa smyo zer/ ci byung dris pas/ ri dwags pa de bstan pas/ khong gnyis na re/ khyed ma 'khrul btsun pa smyo 'dug zer te/ btsun pa de bos nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ khyed cag gsum po rgyal po'i chad pa ma phog pa nyen re che zer nas/ chos bsnubs pa'i lo rgyus bshad pa dang / khong gsum 'jigs te/ 'dul ba'i po ti drel khal gsum khyer te byang lam la phyin khams su bros te/ ngan tig shel gyi brag phug tu bzhugs so/ /de dus lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yer pa'i brag la sgom gyin yod pa la/ nam phyed nas lha sa'i bstan srung dpal ldan lha mo byung nas da lta bod na grub thob khyed las mi 'dug rgyal po glang dar mas sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa la bar chad byas/ rgyal po sdig can gsod ran/ kho mos grogs bya yis sting ma chung zer ro/ /sang nye gnas la dris pas bden par 'dug nas rang gis srog blos btang ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bsam ste/ rta dkar po la sol ba byugs/ ber phyi nag pa nang dkar ba gyon/ mgo la zhwa nag gyon/

gdong la sol snum byugs/ lcag mda' lcags gzhu thogs/ rta nag la zhon te/ bdud nag po skrag med yin no zer te/ lha sar 'ongs so/ /der rgyal pos rdo ring gi yi ge gzigs kyin 'dug pa'i drung du phyin te/ phyag byed pa ltar byas nas/ yi dam la dmod btsugs te/ phu thung nas mda' gzhu bton/ phyag dang po la mtheb sprad/ gnyis pa la mda' bkang / gsum pa la rgyal po'i dpral ba la mda' rgyab nas bros so/ /der rgyal po grongs nas ram mda' bos nas phyogs bzhir rgyugs pas/ la la na re dga' mo gdong bros so zer/ 'ga' zhig gi grib kyi chu 'gram nas bros zer/ la la na re shun gyis 'brang nas sa sros nas ma mthong zer/ la la na re mdong mkhar gdong nas sa sros nas ma mthong zer/ nges pa can du grib kyi mkhar gdong gi chu la lte nyal byas pas/ rta la sol ba byugs pa dag ste dkar por song / zha nag bskyur/ gdong gi dreg snum bkrus/ ber dkar po phyir bstan nas gyon te/ nga ni lha gnam the dkar po yin no zer nas song ngo / /der ram mda' ba so so rnams kyi mdun du sprul pa re byung bas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yin nges zer nas/ yer pa'i brag la 'tshol du btang ngo / /der dpal gyi rdo rjes brag khung der bsam gtan la yod pa'i lugs su byas/ phug ron gcig bzung nas sa la rdul 'bebs su bcug de'i steng du mum ma mang po btang bas de rnams kyis rjes mi mthong ba dang min par shes nas log go /mi rigs pa dang ldan pa gcig nang du 'ongs nas khong gi snying khar lag pa bzhag pa dang / snying 'dar ba shes te/ spyi'i tha ba la sgos su shol mi bcog zer nas log song ngo / /de nas shin tu skrag ste/ khams la bros so/ /der rgyal po bkrongs pa'i rjes su btsun mo chung ba gcig la gdung rgyud sras lto bar gcig byung ba dang / btsun mo che bas bsam pa la/ 'dis bdag gis mnga' thang la gnod nges snyam te lus la gos kyis dkris nas nga la'ang sras lto bar gcig yod do/

/zhes bu chung che rdzun byas so/ /der btsun mo chung ba'i zla dus thim pa dang / gdung rgyud yin nges kyi sras 'khrungs te/ sku shin tu gces pas nyin mo ni mis skor/ mtshan mo ni mar me'i 'od kyis bsrungs bas na/ mnga' bdag 'od srungs zhes zer ro/ /der btsun mo che bas yang sprang po'i bu chung skyes ma khad gcig nyos nas/ nga la'ang 'di skyes pa yin zer bas thams cad the tshom za bar gyur yang / yum btsun mo dbang che bas smra ma nus te/ yum ji ltar gsung ba bzhin brtan du bcug pas/ yum brtan zhes zer ro/ /mnga' bdag 'di gnyis sku nar ma son yang / chos blon rnams kyis zhus te/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang byams mgon rnams sa 'og nas bton te rang rang gi khri la bzhugs nas mchod pa byas/ lha khang zhig pa rnams slar gsos so/ /de nas srid la ma 'chams par/ 'od srungs kyis g.yo ru bzung / yum brtan gyis dbus ru bzung nas 'khrug pa byas so/ /mnga' bdag 'od srungs kyi sras/ rje dpal 'khor can/ de'i chen ma'i sras skyid sde nyi ma mgon/ chen ma'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal/ 'di gnyis kyi srid rnams yum brtan gyis phrogs pas mnga' ris la bros nas mnga' ris rgyal po mdzad pa yin no/ /da ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi tshul bshad par bya ste/ 'di la bstan pa smad nas dar tshul dang / stod nas dar tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyal po sdig can gyis bstan pa bsnubs nas lo du zhig nas bstan pa dar na/ bstan pa med pa'i dus kyi lo grangs la bshad tshul mang mod kyang / bstan pa'i rabs la shin tu mkhas pa 'brom chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ lcags mo bya la bstan pa nub nas bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa sa pho stag la bstan pa byung ba yin gsung / ji ltar byung na/ rgyal po sdig can gyis chos bsnubs nas lo drug cu lon pa na/ 'phan yul zhog na/ rmu gsal shen 'bar bya ba'i bon po'i bu/ rmu za 'phen bya ba'i byis pa cig gis/

snang gsal lha khang gi nang du phyin pas/ rab tu byung ba chos bshad nyan byed pa 'dra ba'i gzugs gyang ris la 'dug pas ci yin dris pas/ de na 'dug pa'i rgan mo cig na re/ rab tu byung ba bya ba'i gzugs yin byas pas/ byis pa de sngon gyi las 'phro'i dbang gis dad pa skyes nas/ rab tu byung ba da lta e yod dris pas/ rgan mo na re/ nga bu mo'i dus na yin te/ rgyal po glang dar mas chos bsnub pa'i dus/ rab tu byung ba rnams rtags dang cha lugs phral/ la la bsad/ la la shi/ da lta dbus gtsang na rab tu byung ba med do/ /chu bo ri dang / yer pa la sogs nas khams su bros pa'i rab tu byung ba mang po khams na yod thag chod 'dug zer bas/ rab tu dga' ste/ lus dang srog la ma ltos par byis pa des khams su phyin pas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dang mjal nas/ rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ ngas rgyal po sdig can bsad pas sdom pa med/ ngas grogs bya yi gsungs nas/ mkhas btsun de rnams dang mjal/ rab tu byung bas/ ming bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal du grags so/ /de ltar khams na bstan pa dar zhing / bod na chos med par mun pa'i smag rum du gyur pa na/ bsam yas kyi mnga' bdag tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag rkyen mdzad nas/ khams su sdom pa len pa'i thog mar/ dbus gtsang gi mi bdun du grags pa ni/ klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bre ye shes yon tan/ tshong ge shes rab seṅge/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug sum pa ye shes blo gros/ rgya blo gros shes rab/ gzhon pan chos mchog dang bdun gyis/ grums ye shes rgyal mtshan la mkhan po zhus/ co ro shes rab byang chub la slob dpon zhus nas bka' drin mnos so/ /de'i rting la phyin pa lnga ni/ mtha' bzhi rgyal 'phags/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba btsun blo gros dbang phyug skyes legs nyang bran chos skyabs/ grum shing shes rab smon lam mo/ /de ltar sngon la sdom pa len du phyin pas mi bdun po des sdom pa blangs nas phyir 'ongs pa dang /

rting la phyin pa lnga po lam la 'phrad de/ gar 'gro dris pas/ khams su sdom pa len du 'gro zer bas sngon ma rnams na re/ nged rnams kyis sdom pa gsum ldan du blangs yod pas nged kyi sdom pa phog pas chog thag ring la 'gro mi dgos zer yang ma nyan par khams su phyin te/ sngar gyi mkhas btsun rnams dang mjal/ sdom pa blangs te/ dbus gtsang du slebs nas/ klu mes la sogs pa rnams kyis dbus gtsang du/ lha khang bsam gyis mi khyab pa brtsigs/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar rgyas su mdzad pa nas/ gong du bshad pa'i khams dbus kyi mkhas btsun rim par byon pa rnams dang / mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan yab sras rnams sku drin shin tu che bar 'dug go /gnyis pa bstan pa stod nas dar tshul ni/ de ltar bstan pa rin po che la bka' drin che ba'i bod rgyal po'i gdung brgyud gong du bshad pa ltar/ rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi chen ma'i sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris kyi rgyal po mdzad/ spu rangs la'ang dbang bsgyur/ de la sras gsum/ che ba dpal gyi mgon gyis mang yul bzung / bar pa bkra shis mgon gyis spu rang bzung / chung ba lde btsun mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / 'di gsum la stod kyi mgon gsum zer/ lde btsun mgon la sras gnyis te/ 'khor re dang / srong nge gnyis/ srong nge'i sku tshe'i stod la btsun mo khab tu bzhes/ sras nā ga ra dza dang / dhe ba ra dza gnyis byung / sku'i smad la rab tu byung nas/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od du mtshan gsol/ mthon mthing dpal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa blo rno ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du chos slob pa la brdzangs/ paṇḍita shrīddha ka ra dang / larma ta gnyis spyan drangs te mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / rgyud sde bzhi po bsgyur cing gtan la phab/

'dul ba stod lugs dar bar mdzad do/ /gcen po 'khor res kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sras lha lde pos/ paṇḍita su bha shid dang / paṇḍita rme ru spyan drangs/ lha lde po la sras gsum/ che ba zhi ba 'od/ 'bring lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ chung ba 'od lde'o/ /'di gsum gyi dus su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas/ rgya gar du paṇḍita gdan 'dren la byon pas/ lam du mu stegs kyis dmag gis bzung / dge phyogs kyis yon tan skyed pa'i rtsa sgo thams cad me btsas bsregs te rmongs par byas so/ /de'i gtam lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis gsan te/ nor dpag med bskur nas blu ru btang bas/ gser dang ljid mnyam pa dgos zer ba dang / yang gser gang yod bskur bas/ rgya ma la bteg dus dbu'i cha tsam gcig gser gyis ma longs pas/ khong na re/ da ni khyed rnams kyis bdag blus kyang yon tan med/ nga'i rtsa sgo me btsas bsregs nas dud 'gro ltar song yod pas/ bdag shi na'ang bla'i/ nga blu ba'i gser rnams khyer la rgya gar na rgyal po dge ba dpal gyi sras/ bi ka ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇḍita lnga brgya rnams kyi nang na gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa/ jo bo rje di paṃ ka ra zhes bya ba bzhugs yod par 'dug de la gser phul bod du gdan drangs la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzod cig gsungs te grongs pa dang / spur yul du spyan drangs nas mchod rten du bzhugs so/ /der lung bstan bzhin jo bo gdan 'dren pa la/ rgya brtson seng la sogs pa la gser bskur nas btang ngo / bod du 'byon pa la thabs du ma'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas/ jo bos kyang bod mnga' rigs kyi gdul bya la dgongs nas/ rje btsun sgrol mas kyang lung bstan pa bzhin bod du byon nas/ slob ma nag tsho dang / khu rngog 'brom gsum/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/

lo chung legs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa mkhas btsun du ma byon te/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu mdzad pa na/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od de bod la bka' drin shin tu che ba lags so/ /yang bod rgyal po'i gdung rgyud rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi chung ma'i sras/ bkra shis brtsegs pa la sras gsum byung ba/ dpal lde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde gsum yin/ 'di gsum la smad kyi lde gsum zer/ dpal lde'i sras ni sngon po btsan por thug te/ khab gung ba/ klu rgyal ba/ spyi pa lha rtse/ glang lung / gtsang 'khor ba rnams te/ las stod yan chad pa rnams yin no/ /'o na bod kyi chos rgyal rim par byon pa de dag shākya chen/ shākya li tsa byi/ shākya ri brag pa po gang gis gdung rgyud yin zhe na/ shākya li tsa byi'i gdung rgyud yin te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ li tsa byi rnams kyi rigs su byung zhes/ gnya' khri btsan po nas 'od srungs kyi bar shin tu gsal bar lung bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /tshul 'di dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par ni yi ge mang pa'i 'jigs pas mdo tsam las ma bkod do// ༈ //gsum pa 'jig skal bye brag tu bshad pa la/ gang gis 'jig pa'i rkyen/ gang gis 'jig pa'i ngo bo/ /'jig pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'jig tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'jig pa la du zhe na/ nyi ma bdun gyi me dang / char pa'i chu dang / rlung rab tu 'khrugs pa rnams kyis 'jig pa dag rnams ni gsum yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gnyis pa dang sogs pa gsum pa dang bzhi pa gsum po ni 'jig pa de dag gi rtse mo ste lhag ma yin te go rims bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni ci'i phyir bsam gtan dang po sogs gsum me chu rlung gsum gyis 'jig ce na/ snod de dang de'i sems can gyi nang gi skyon dang po na rtog dpyod me lta bu dang / gnyis pa na/ dga' bde chu lta bu dang / gsum pa na dbyugs dbyung rngub kyi rlung yod pa dang chos mthun pa'i phyir/

bsam gtan bzhi pa na 'jig pa de gsum med de/ nang gi skyon dang bral bas me chu rlung gsum gyis mi gos pa'i phyir/ 'o na bzhi pa'i snod rtag gam zhe na mi rtag ste/ bzhi pa des gzhal med khang rnams skar ma ltar chad nas ma 'brel bas na sems can dang bcas te 'byung shing 'jig pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni 'jig pa de gsum go rims ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ me yis bar med par bdun no/ /de'i rjes su chus lan gcig go /rim pa de ltar 'byung bas chu bdun thal nas slar yang me yis bdun no/ /sas ni mes gcig tu bshad do/ /de nas ni mjug tu rlung gis 'jig pa gcig yin te/ de ltar mes 'jig pa lnga bcu rtsa drug dang / chus bdun dang / rlung gis gcig ni bskal chen re bzhi ste dge rgyas kyi lha'i tshe tshad do/ /de yang re gsum dang nga brgyad la der nye bas brtags pa ste/ snod 'chag 'jig gis bar bskal gnyis dang / stong pa'i nyi shu de'i tshe tshad du mi rung bas so/ /'od gsal ba'ang bskal chen bdun dang bar bskal nga brgyad la brgyad du btags pa ste/ rgyu mtshan snga ma ltar ro/ /tshangs chen pa'i yang snod 'chag 'jig gi bar bskal gnyis de'i tshe tshad du mi rung bas/ bar bskal nga brgyad la drug cur btags pa'o/ /tshul 'di dag ni/ mngon 'dul gyis mdo bstan bcos rgya dkar nag gi rtsis kyi rgyud la/ zhib tu sbyangs shing / kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi legs bshad kyis rgyan te/ gnas 'dul ba 'dzin pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gyis gnas gsum pa 'jig rten bstan pa'i mdzod kyi rgya cher 'grel du sbyar ro/ dge'o// ༈ //bzhi pa las bstan pa'i gnas la/ thams cad las las byung tshul gyis mdor bstan/ las nyid gtan la phab pa'i rgyas par bshad/ chos gzhan gyi rnam grangs bstan pas sgo nas don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gong du snod bcud kyi 'jig rten sna tshogs gsungs pa de dag rgyu gang las byung zhe na/

byed pa po gzhan med kyis/ las las 'jig rten bzang ngan 'dres ma sna tshogs skyes so/ /gnyis pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ las de ci zhig ce na/ las de ni mdo las/ sems pa'i las dang des byas pa bsam pa'i las gnyis su gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ las ngos bzung / las kyi rnam gzhag las mdo las byung ba'i don no/ /dang po ni/ de gnyis sgo gsum gyi las yin la/ de la sems pa ni/ yid kyi las yin/ sems de dag bskyed pa bsam pa'i las ni/ lus dang ngag gi las so/ /'di la bye brag smra ba de gsum rim pas kun slong dang / rten dang ngo bo las su 'jog ste/ yid kyis kun nas bslangs pa dang / lus la brten pa dag gis lus ngag nyid las yin pas so/ /zhes so/ /mdo sde pa ni/ las ni sems pa nyid de/ des yid 'jug par byed pa'am yid dang mtshungs par ldan pa ni yid kyi las dang / lus ngag 'jug par byed pa ni bsam pa'i las su 'jug go /de dang 'dra bar las sgrub par rigs par yang bshad nas/ gzugs can ni ji ltar brtags kyang las su mi 'gyur shing dge ba gzugs can du 'dod pa ni shākya'i sras min no/ /zhes so/ /kun btus su/ sems pa dang bsam pa gnyis la sgo gsum gyi las bshad pas/ de gnyis kyi khyad par rgyu dang dus kyi kun slong gis sems pa la bzhag dgos la/ gnyis po la'ang lus ngag gi dngos kyi kun slong dang yid kyis ni lhan cig pa'i sems dpar 'gyur ro/ /lus ngag snga phyi dang yid kyi lhan cig pas bshad pas so/ /des na sems pa'i las ni/ rgyu'i kun slong yin no/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lus ngag gi las kyi rang bzhin/ las gsum spyi yi ngo bo/ bye brag rig byed min pa'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la gnyis te/ dbye ba dang / so so'i ngo bo'o/ /dang po ni/ lus ngag gi las de dag la ni/ so sor rnam rig dang rnam rig min pa gnyis gnyis su dbye'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/

rig byed bshad/ rig byed ma yin pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ lus kyi rig byed dang / ngag gi rig byed do/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ngos bzung zhing de gzhan du 'gro ba dgag pa/ dbyibs rdzas su 'dod pa dgag ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lus kyi rnam par rig byed ni/ sems kyi dbang gis lus de lta de ltar gnas pa'i/ dbyibs rdzas su yod pa zhig la bye brag smra bar 'dod de/ de yang rnam smin dang rgyas byung ma yin gyis 'phral gsar du skye bas rgyu mthun las skyes so/ /'on kyang rnam smin gyi lus gseb tu zhugs pas lus che ru mi 'gyur zhing / phra bas lus lci shing mkhregs par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /gnas ma bu'i blo dang sgra dang glog sogs skad cig mar 'dod kyang / 'dus byas phal cher skad cig mar mi 'dod pas 'dir lus kyi rig byed kyang yul gang du skyes pa de nyid ma zhig par yul gzhan du 'pho ba'i 'gro ba yin te/ lus g.yo ba nyid lus kyi las yin pas so/ /zhes zer ro/ /de ni rigs pa ma yin te/ gang gis phyir na/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma yin pa'i gang du skye ba de nyid du 'jig gi ma zhig par yul gzhan du mi 'pho bas so/ /'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma grub na de ltar yin mod 'di ma grub bo zhe na/ grub ste 'dus byas rnams nges par phyis rgyu gzhan med par 'jig pa'i phyir blo bzhin no/ /gal te 'jig pa rgyu gzhan dang ldan na skye ba rgyu la ltos pa bzhin du rgyu gzhan med pa las chos 'ga' yang 'jig par mi 'gyur ba zhig na sgra blo rgyu gzhan med par 'jig pa mthong bas 'jig pa rgyu gzhan la ltos pa mi 'gal te 'jig pa la rgyu gzhan nges par dgos na dngos po rnams ni/ khyed phyis rgyu med pa la 'ga' yang 'jig par mi 'gyur bar thal/ khyed 'jig pa phyis rgyu la nges par ltos dgos pa'i phyir 'dod mi nus te/ sgra blo sogs phyis rgyu med par 'jig pa tshad ma'i mthong ngo /

/gal te shing sogs 'jig pa me'i rgyu las byung na/ skyed byed kyi rgyu nyid yang phyis 'jig pa pa'i rgyur thal bar 'gyur te/ mes rdza tshos pas ser po dang / ches tshos pas dmar po dang / ches cher tshos pas sngon po sogs skyed pa na sngar skyed pa'i ser po sogs ni dmar po dmar po sogs kyi tshe 'jig pa'i so/ /'dir 'jig pa rgyu med ces pa ni/ rgyu ye med pa min gyis/ rgyu phyis 'byung don gzhan med pa'o/ /gzhan dbang shing sogs rang rgyu la skyes te/ phyis me sogs kyi rgyu byas te 'jig par 'dod pa 'gog pas so/ /des na dngos po rnams skye ba'i rgyu nyid las 'jig pa'i ngang can du skyes pas skad gcig mar grub pa'i phyir 'gro ba med pa/ yul gzhan du 'dab chags su 'byung ba la/ 'gro bar mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed par zad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo sde pa na re/ dbyibs rdzas su med de/ kha dog gi gnas tshul la 'dogs pas so/ /gal te yod na dbyibs ni mig dang lus kyis dbang po gnyis kyis bzung bar thal bar 'gyur te/ mthong ba dang reg pa gnyis ka las ring po'o snyam du shes pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ skyed byed gcig dbang po gzugs can gnyis kyis 'dzin pa mi srid pas so/ /yang de ni thogs bcas rdzas grub tu med de/ rdul phra rab la med pas so/ /khyab ste thogs bcas rdzas grub ni rdul phra rab la yod pas khyab pas so/ /des nas lus kyis rig byed kyang kha dog gi bkod pa la btags pa'i lus kyi dbyibs so/ /gong ma pa ltar na 'gro 'ong sogs lus kyi bya ba de las dmigs pa'i sems pa'i rgyu can lus kyi rgyun 'gro ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba sogs de lta de ltar g.yo bas dbyibs te/ des skyes bu 'di ni 'gro snyam pa'i blo skyes pa can yin te/ 'gro ba'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir zhes sogs kun slong gis sems reg par byed de/ rgyud gzhan grub par rang lus blo sngon du 'gro ba yis/

bya ba mthong na gzhan la de 'jig gal te blo zhes 'gyur/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngag gi rnam par rig byed ni ngag gi rang bzhin gyi sgra ste/ rang kun nas slong ba'i sems rig par byed pas de skad do/ /zhes pa sgar ba'o/ /gsum pa rig byed min pa bshad pa la bzhi ste/ rdzas su yod pa'i sgrub byed dang / rgyu'i dus dang sa'i khyad par/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ rgyu'i khyad par gzhan no/ /dang po ni rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i ngo bo ni bshad zin cing / mdo sde pa ni/ de dag rdzas su med de/ sdig pa spong bar khas blangs nas de mi byed pa tsam gyi phyir dang / 'das pa'i 'byung ba rdzas su med pa la brten nas 'dogs pa'i phyir dang / gzugs kyi mtshan nyid med pa'i phyir zhes so/ /bye brag tu smra ba ni rdzas su yod de/ mdo las bstan yod thogs bcas dang bstan med thogs bcas bstan med thogs med de gzugs rnam pa gsum gsungs pas gsum pa ni/ 'di ma yin pa med pa dang / dri med kyi gzugs gsungs pa ni/ zag med kyi sdom pa kho na yin pa dang / rdzas dang rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams ni yid gzhan dang ldan yang 'phel bar gsungs pa'ang 'di yin te/ rig byed dang sems pa ni rgyun du mi 'byung bas dang / srog gcod sogs rang gis ma byas par gzhan byed du bcug nas srog bcad pa'i tshe rang la las lam gyi dngos gzhi 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir 'di yin te/ de'i tshe rang gis rig byed dang sems pa ni dge bar yod srid pas so/ /gzhan yang sogs pas bsdus pa 'di min pa chos kyi skye mched gzugs can med pas de gzugs can min pa kho nar ston par 'gyur ba la/ skye mched bcu gzugs dang yid gzugs min par bstan nas de gzugs can min par ma bstan pas dang / mnyam bzhag tu rig byed mi 'byung bas yang dag pa'i ngag sogs gsum med par 'gyur ba las lam gyi yan lag brgyad ldan par bshad pa dang /

yid nyon mongs dang ldan pa'i tshe dge ba med pas/ so thar gyi sdom pa med par 'gyur bas dang / /spong ba ni 'chal tshul gyis gegs byed pas chu lon du gsungs na med pa ni chu lon du mi 'os pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de brgyad kyi lan la bde sogs la rten nas 'debs te/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yul gyi gzugs te/ lnga pa chos kyi skye mched gzugs min par mi ston pa'i rgyu'ang de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ zag med kyi ting nge 'dzin ni yul gyi gzugs te/ sa sder/ dbang 'byor bas gzugs zhes bshad do/ /yang na dgra bcom pa'i gzugs so/ /gsum pa ni/ de'i rgyud la phyis 'bras bu skyed nus pas sa bon 'phel ba dang / bzhi pa'ang lus ngag gis sbyor ba la sbyor ba po la phyis 'bras bu skyed nus pa'i rgyud 'gyur ba skye ba dang / drug pa ni/ mnyam bzhag na ngag sogs rjes thob na 'byung bas/ nus pa thob pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan pa'i phyir 'jog pa dang / bdun pa ni/ sdom pa goms pas dran pa'i stobs kyis de mngon du 'gyur ba dang / brgyad pa'ang ngo tsha shes pa'i dam bca' dran nas 'chal tshul mi byed pa'i skyon med de/ gzhan du na brjed pa'i tshe'ang ltung ba mi 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de'i gegs chu lon lta bu'i rig byed ma yin pa yod pas so/ /gnyis pa ni rig byed ma yin pa ni rig byed pas phra bas de'i rgyu las gzhan pa'i 'byung bas skyed la/ dus ni 'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam rig byed min ni skad cig ma dang po'i sdom pa sogs nod pa'i tshe bzhi'i 'byung ba da ltar ba las skye la/ de phyin chad ni 'jug cing 'phen pa'i rgyu gzhi'i 'byung ba 'das pa re dang rjes su 'jug cing rten pa'i rgyu da ltar ba'i 'byung ba dang gnyis las skyed de/ dang po 'khor lo 'phul byed lag pa dang / gnyis pa rten pa gzhi lta bu'o/ /gzugs can gzhan ni gzhi'i 'byung ba da lta ba kho na la skyed par 'dod do/

/sa ni zag bcas kyis lus dang ngag gi las ni 'dod pa nas bzhi pa'i bar dang / rang rang gi sa pa'i 'byung ba rnams rgyur byas nas skye la/ zag med kyi sdom pa ni rten pa gang du skyes pa'i lus de'i 'byung ba las skyes te/ khams gsum ma gtogs pas lam nges pa med la/ rang gi 'byung ba med cing 'bras gzugs yin pas 'byung ba'i stobs kyis skye bas so/ /gsum pa ni/ rnam pa rig byed min pa ni nang gi lus can min pas ma zin pa dang / dge mi dger nges shing / rdul bsags pa min pas/ rnam smin dang rgyas byung min gyi rgyu mthun las byung ba dang / sems can gyi rgyud du gtogs pa'i sems can du ston pa'o/ /lus kyis rig byed ni lus kyi 'byung ba dang tha mi dad par/ 'jug pas zin pa ste/ ngag gis ni de dang tha dad par 'jug pas ma zin pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'dod pa'i rig byed min pa ni/ rgyu mthun las byung ba dang zin pa dag gi 'byung ba las skyes pas/ rgyas byung dang rnam smin gyi 'byung ba las min la/ so thar gyi spong ba re re'ang 'byung ba bzhi tshan tha dad las skye'o/ /ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa bsam gtan dang zag med kyis sdom pa dag gi rgyu 'byung ba'ang sems kyis rjes 'brang yin pas ma zin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyas pa las 'byung ba ste/ de dag gi spong ba bdun ni 'byung ba bzhi tshan tha dad min pa gcig las skye'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ spyi'i ngo bo/ dngos/ de'i kun slong bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dge sogs kyi khyad par/ khams gsum kyi khyad par/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam rig byed min la dge mi dge min pa lung ma bstan med de/ de stobs chung bas rang 'gags kyang rgyun 'byung ba'i las kyang stobs ldan 'phen mi nus pas so/ /de las gzhan rig byed dang sems pa la ni/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum mo/

/gnyis pa ni/ mi dge ba'i las ni 'dod khams kho nar yod la/ gong ma gnyis na med de/ mi dge ba'i rtsa ba ngo tsha med pa dang / khrel med pa gnyis spangs pas so/ /kun las btus su ni/ de gnyis nyon mongs kun dang ldan par bshad pas gong ma gnyis na'ang yod par mngon no/ /gzugs khams na dge ba'i mngon par rig byed min pa yod de/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa ldan pas so/ /'ang gis sgras 'dod pa na dge ba'i rig byed min pa yod la/ gzugs med na ni gzugs med pas lus ngag gi sdom pa mngon 'gyur med do/ /rnam par rig byed ni/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po dag kho na la yod de/ kun slong rtog dpyod la ltos pas so/ /'dod khams na sgrib pa'i rig byed med de/ yang ni gnyis pa sogs na rig byed med par ma zad pa'o/ gang gis phyir na/ kun slong med pa'i phyir te/ gnyis pa sogs na rtog dpyod med la/ 'dod pa na sgom spang kyi sgribs la lung ma bstan gyi sems med pas so/ /'dod pa'i lta ba gnyis ni/ mthong spangs kha nang bltas yin pas/ rig byed kun slong du mi rung la/ g.yo ni mi dge ba yin pas des bslangs na mi dge bar 'gyur bas so/ /des na sgrib pa'i rig byed ni/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten kho na ste/ tshangs chen la g.yos kun nas bslangs ba'i ngag gi las yod pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ ci kun slong kho na las dge mi dge yin nam zhe na/ min gyi/ bzhi bzhir yod de/ re zhig dge ba bzhi las thar pa myang 'das ni sdug kun zhi bas mchog tu bde ba'i phyir/ dam pa'i don du dge ba ste/ nad med pa bzhin no/ /gong mar ni de bzhin du bshad do/ /dge rtsa gsum dang ngo tsha khrel yod ni/ skyes tsam nyid nas dge rtsar nges pa'i bdag nyid de ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba ste/ 'phrod pa'i sman bzhin no/ /dad sogs bcu gcig du'ang / ngo bos dge ba de dang mtshungs ldan rnams ni de dang mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba ste/

sman dang sbyar ba'i btung ba bzhin no/ /de dag gis bslangs ba'i lus ngag gi bya ba dang / sogs pas skye sogs dang thob pa dang snyoms 'jug gnyis ni kun nas slong ba'i dge ba ste/ btung ba de las byung ba'i 'o ma bzhin no/ /'gog pa ni nyer ba zhi'i dge bar yang ngo / /de rnams las bzlog pa bzhi ni mi dge ba'i dbye ba ste/ 'khor ba dang dug gsum ngo tsha khrel med dang bcas pa dang de dang mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa dang / des bslangs ba'i lus ngag gi las skye sogs thob pa dang bcas pa rim pa bzhin te nad dang mi 'phrod pa'i sman sogs dper bya'o/ /thob pa ni/ rjes su 'brel ba'i dge mi dger yang ngo / /'on kyang 'khor ba ni dge sogs kyang yod mod kyi mchog tu mi bde bas de dang der bzhag pa tsam ste/ gzhan ni mtshan nyid par 'dod do/ /mdo sde pa ltar na/ dang mtha' gnyis ka dge mi dger ma nges so/ /don dam par na lung ma bstan pa nam mkha' dang brtags min gyi 'gog pa dag ste/ dbye ba gzhan gsum ni yod kyang ma bshad do/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dbye ba/ byed las/ ngo bo'o/ /dang po ni/ mthong spangs ni rig byed min na thub pas log lta la log par rtog pa dang ngag dang las kyi mtha' 'byung bar gsungs pa ji ltar zhe na/ mi 'gal te 'di ltar kun slong ni rnam pa gnyis te/ rgyu'i kun slong dang / de dus kyi kun slong ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ de gnyis las dang po ni/ 'phen par byed pa'i rab tu ste/ dang por 'jug par byed pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ rjes su ste byas ba'i dus su bya ba dang rjes su mthun par 'jug byed yin no/ /gsum pa la mu bzhi ste/ rab tu 'jug byed/ gnyis ka rjes su 'jug byed khyad bcas gnyis min no/ /dang po ni/ mthong bas spang ba'i rnam shes 'khor bcas ni rtog bcas su nges pas rab tu 'jug byed yin la/ kha nang du ltas pas rjes su 'jug byed ni ma yin no/ /des ni mdor na rgyu'i kun slong la dgongs la 'dir 'dod pa na sgribs pas dus kyi kun slong med par bshad pa yin pas mi 'gal lo/

/gnyis pa ni/ yid kyi rnam shes sgom spangs 'khor bcas ni rtog bcas kyang yod do/ /kha phyir bltas kyang yod pas kun slong gnyis ka yod pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes 'khor bcas ni rtog med phyi bltas su nges pas rjes su 'jug byed kho na'o/ /de yang rab tu 'jug byed dge legs gsum re re la rjes su 'jug byed dge sogs rnam pa gsum gsum du 'gyur ba'i dgu phrug ste/ dper na so thar gyi sdom pa rgyu'i kun slong nges 'byung gi bsam pa dge ba la/ dus kyi kun slong cho ga'i tshe'ang de dang ldan pa dang / zhe sdang dang bcas pa dang / spyod lam pa'i sems sngon du gyur pa na sdom pa thob pa sogs lta bu'o/ /'o na kun slong dang po gtso na 'dod pa na sgrib pa'i rig byed yod pa 'gyur te/ rgyu'i kun slong lta ba yod pas so/ /gnyis pa gtso na so thar gyi sdom pa mi dge bar yang 'gyur te/ dus kyi kun slong mi dge ba ldan pa yod pas so/ /zhe na/ kun slong de gnyis kyang spang bya rigs tha dad pas ma chod na dang po gtso la/ chod na gnyis pa gtso bas skyon gnyis ka med do/ /thub pa'i 'jug tshul ni/ 'jug byed gnyis ka dge ba las dge ba dang lung ma bstan las lung ma bstan du 'dra ba'am/ rab 'jug lung ma bstan las rjes 'jug dge bar 'gyur gyis zlog par ni mi 'gyur te/ de'i stobs dman par mi 'gyur bas so/ /sde pa gzhan ni/ sangs rgyas la thugs lung ma bstan med de/ mdor/ glang chen gshegs na'ang mnyam par bzhag ces sogs gsungs pas so/ /zhes zer te/ theg chen dang mthun no/ /bye brag smra ba ni/ de mi bzhed bzhin du gzhan du mi 'gro ba la dgongs kyis rnam smin pa dang spyod lam pa dang sprul sems lung ma bstan mnga' 'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rnam smin las skyes pa'i sems ni sgom spangs yin yang 'jug byed gnyis ka min te 'bad med du 'jug pas so/

/ye shes zag med kyang gnyis ka ma yin te/ rtog med kha nang bltas su nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa rig byed min pa'i rnam gzhag la gnyis te/ dbye ba mdor bstan/ rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa rnam par rig byed ma yin pa rnam pa gsum du shes par bya ste/ 'chal tshul gyi rgyun sdom pas sdom pa dang / de'i 'gal zla lus ngag gi nyes spyod chen po sdom pa min pa dang / de gnyis las gzhan phan gnod phyogs re ba bar ma'o/ /de la sdom pa ni 'dul bar/ spong ba'i sems yod ba de la gang dbang byed pa'i dbang po lnga dang ldan pa gang de sdom pa'o/ /de'ang dbye bshad du/ so thar ni cho gas blangs shing lus ngag gi las bkag pa'i sdom pa sems pa des/ phyis rang 'dra 'byung ba'i sa bon kun gzhi la bzhag ste/ de nas nga srog gcod sogs spangs pa'o/ /zhes khas blangs pa dran pas 'dzem zhing bslab pa mi 'dral ba'o/ /bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa ni/ rjes thob tu'ang mi dge ba spong zhing dge ba la 'jug pa'i bsam pa dang gnas pa thob pa'i sems pa'o/ /sdom min yang gnod par sbyor ba'i sems pa dang khas len pa'i sems pa ste/ de mngon 'gyur med kyang sdom min mi gtong ste/ gnod par bya ba'i bsam pa ma log pa'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis ste/ sdom pa khyad par du bshad pa dang / thams cad thun mong du bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ bstan bshad gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ sdom pa gsum ste/ chos 'di pa dag gis 'dod pa na spyod pa'i tshul khrims so sor thar pa dang / de bzhin du zag med kyi tshul khrims zag med dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i tshul khrims/ bsam gtan las skyes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ so thar/ bsam gtan zag med/ zhar la yid dang dbang sdom bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ dbye bsdu/ mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ nges tshig gang zag go /dang po ni/ so so thar pa zhes bya ba ris rnam pa brgyad de/ dge slong pha ma/

dge slob ma/ dge tshul pha ma/ dge bsnyen pha ma/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa'o/ /de dag kyang ming gi sgo nas phye'i mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i rdzas su rnam pa bzhi yin te/ pha'i sdom pa gsum las ma'i gsum gzhan min zhing / dge slong ma'i sdom pa'ang / rtsa ba'i chos drug dang / nye ba'i chos drug spong ba'i khyad par du byas pas dge tshul ma'i sdom pa der 'dus pa'o/ /ji ltar shes zhe na/ pho mo'i mtshan phan tshun 'gyur ba las/ dge slong ni dge slong ma zhes sogs ming tsam 'pho'i sdom pa'i ngo bo gtong thob med pas mi 'pho ba'i phyir/ gang gis sdom gsum rim gyis blangs na spong ba 'phel ba'am/ thams cad tha dad cha gsum skye zhe na/ srog gcod spong ba gsum sogs tha dad cha gsum skye ste de gsum char yang ma 'dres pa lhan cig par 'gyur gyi phyi ma blangs pas snga ma mi gtong ste sdom pa de rnams 'gal ba med pas so/ /'o na de dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul du'ang 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'gyur mod yon tan gtso bo'i sgo nas dge slong zhes brjod cing / der 'dzin pa'i bsam pas kun slong gi rig byed ni dge slong gi kho na yod la/ rig byed min pa ni so sor yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de yang rang rang gi sdom pa la gnas pa'i ched du lus ngag gis spang bya/ srog gcod sogs lnga dang brgyad dang bcu dang thams cad spong ba mnos pa las rim pa bzhin dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas dang dge tshul dang dge slong nyid du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi bslab pa nyis brgya nga gsum ni/ pham pa bzhi/ lhag ma bcu gsum/ ma nges pa gnyis/ spang ltung sum cu/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu/ so sor bshags pa bzhi/ nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis te/ ltung ba sde lnga'i gnyen po la phye ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'chal tshul gyis gdung ba las bsil ba'i gnas yin pas tshul khrims dang / mkhas pas bsngags pa'i legs spyad dang / bya ba'i rang bzhin yin pas las dang /

lus ngag sdom pas sdom pa zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sdom pa thob ma thag gi skad cig dang po'i rnam par rig byed dang rig byed min pa dag ni sdig pa las dang por thar bas so sor thar pa dang / sdom pa gnyis ka bya ba las lam gyi dngos gzhi yin la/ de phyin chad ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa kho na la 'jug pa yin gyi so sor thar pa dang / las lam dngos ni ma yin no/ /'di pra ti mokṣa zhes pa'i pra ti dang por bshad pa'o/ /bam po lnga bcu par/ tshul khrims bsrung ba'i gang zag so sor thar gyis gzhan min par so sor thar pa dang / thar pa'i thabs yin pa'i thar pa'i thabs kyi sdom pa zhes bya ste/ pra ti so so dang thabs su bshad pas so/ /lnga pa ni/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni/ dge slong nas bsnyen gnas kyi bar brgyad do/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gang la ldan pa/ sems kyis rjes 'brang / spong ba'i sdom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsam gtan las skyes pa'i sdom pa dang ni bsam gtan de nyer sdogs dang bcas pa ldan pa'i gang zag la nges par ldan no/ /zag med kyi sdom pa dang ni ldan pa 'phags pa'i sems can slob mi slob pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar sdom pa gnyis sems kyis rjes su 'brang bar bshad pa de gang zhe na/ sdom pa gsum gyi grangs tha ma 'di gnyis ni sems gyi rjes su 'brang ngo / /so thar ni sems med kyang 'jug pa'i de min no/ /gsum pa ni/ bar chad med lam dgu rnams su skyes pa'i bsam gtan dang zag med de gnyis ni sa mi lcogs med la brten pa na spong ba'i sdom pa zhes bya ste/ 'chal tshul dang de kun slong gi nyon mongs dngos su spong ba'o/ /sa lam gzhan la brten pa la ni/ rgyu mtshan de med pas spong sdom zhes mi bya ste/ des na de gnyis dang spong sdom la mu bzhi sbyar ro/ /gsum pa zhar byung ni/ 'o na/ yid kyi sdom pa legs pa de/ zhes dang / mig gi dbang po sdom pas bsdams ste/

zhes gsungs pas/ de gnyis gang yin zhe na/ bya ba dang mi bya ba shes pa'i shes bzhin dang / de ma brjed pa'i dran pa dag gis mi mthun phyogs sdom pa ni/ yid kyis sdom pa dang dbang po'i sdom pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ thams cad thun mong du bshad pas bzhi ste/ dus ji srid ldan/ tshul ji ltar thob/ rgyu gang gis gtong / rten gang la ldan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rig byed min pa'i ldan tshul/ rig byed kyi ldan tshul/ de dag gi mu bzhi'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ so sor dang sdom min ldan tshul/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i ldan tshul/ bar ma ldan tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ so sor thar pa la gnas pa'i gang zag de sdom pa ma btang ba'i bar du rtag par da ltar gyi rnam rig min pa dang ldan zhing / skad cig dang po phyin chad ma btang gi bar du 'das pa dang yang ldan no/ /sdom min la gnas pa'i gang zag la'ang ldan tshul de dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i skye 'phags ni ma btang gi bar du rtag tu 'das ma 'ongs gnyis dang ldan te/ skad cig dang po la'ang sngon btang ba'i 'das pa thob bo/ /'phags pa ni zag med skad cig dang po'i tshe ma skyes pas 'das pa dang ldan pa ma yin zhing / de phyin chad 'das ma 'ongs dang ldan no/ /'jig rten pa'i mnyam bzhag dang 'phags lam la snyoms par zhugs pa'i gnas pa'i tshe ni sdom pa/ de gnyis da lta ba dang yang ldan pas dus gsum char dang ldan pa/ langs pa dag ni da ltar gyi dang mi ldan te de gnyis sems kyi rjes su 'jug pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ sdom pa dang sdom min gnyis ka med pa'i bar mar gnas pa'i gang zag la bar ma'i rig byed min pa gal te yod na skad cig dang po bar da ltar gyi kho na dang ldan zhing / de phyin chad 'das dang da ltar gyi dus gnyis dang ldan no/ /der ma zad sdom min la gnas pa'ang mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba sogs byed na bar ma'i dge ba rig byed min pa dang ldan la/

sdom pa la gnas pa'ang / ra bsod ba sogs byed na bar ma'i mi dge ba'i rnam rig byed min ldan te/ de yang rim pa bzhin/ ji srid du rab tu dwang ba dang / nyon mongs kyi shugs ldan pa de srid kyi bar du rtag tu da ltar dang / dang po phyin chad 'das pa dang yang ldan no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / zhar la sdom min gyi rnam grangs so/ /dang po ni/ rnam par rig byed ni sdom pa sdom min bar ma thams cad la ji srid rig byed byed pa rnams la da lta ba ldan la/ 'di'ang skad cig ma dang po phyin chad ji srid ma btang bar du 'das pa dang yang ldan gyis ma 'ongs pa'i rig byed dang ldan pa med de/ sems kyi rjes su mi 'jug pas so/ /de'ang dge mi dge'i dbang du byas kyi bsgribs pa dang ma bsgribs pa'i dbang du byas pa'i rig byed dag ni 'das pa dang yang ldan pa med de/ chos nyams chung bas thob pa'ang nyams chung bas so/ /des na thams cad du da ltar ba kho na dang ldan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom pa min pa zhes pa ci zhe na/ lus ngag mi sdom pas sdom pa min pa dang / dam pas smad cing 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong pas nyes spyod dang / tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs yin pas 'chal ba'i tshul khrims dang / lus ngag gi las yin pas las dang las dngos gzhis bsdus pas de'i ste las lam zhes so/ /gsum pa ni rnam rig dang rnam rig min pa dang ldan pa mu bzhi las bar ma la gnas pas/ sems zhan pa'i dge mi dge byed na rnam rig min pa dang mi ldan pa'o/ /rdzas las byung ba dang las lam ni ma gtogs so/ /tshe 'phos te tshe snga mas rnam rig btang ba dang / tshe 'di'i rnam rig ma skyes pa'am nyams pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag gi ni zag med kyi rnam rig min pa dang ldan gyi rnam rig dang mi ldan pa'o/ /de 'dra'i gzugs kyi so skye'ang srid do/ /gnyis yin ni bar ma la gnas pas sems drag pos dge mi dge byed pa sogs so/

/gnyis min ni gzugs med kyi skye bo sogs so/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sdom pa/ sdom min/ bar ma'i thob tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ thob tshul dngos/ gang las thob pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bsam gtan/ zag med/ so thar thob tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ yang sdom pa de rnams ji ltar thob ce na/ bsam gtan las skyes pa'i sdom pa ni zag bcas kyi bsam gtan gyi nyer sdogs sam/ dngos gzhi'i sa thob pa nyid kyis 'thob ste/ bsam gtan gyi sems dang lhan cig 'byung bas so/ /zag med kyi sdom pa ni 'phags pas te zag med kyis bsam gtan sa drug gis sems kyis 'thob bo/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ thob tshul thun mong du bstan/ khyad par bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ so sor thar pa zhes pa'i sdom pa ni gzhan dge 'dun nam gang zag gi sdom pa sbyin pa go bar byed pa'i rnam par rig byed kyi 'thob pa'o/ /sogs pa'i sgra ni bye brag tu smra ba/ 'dul ba rnams pa bcu'i bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /zhes zer ba bsdu ba ste/ sangs rgyas sogs rig byed pa la mi ltos pas so/ /bcu 'grel par 'byung ba lung ma mo ltar te/ lung gcig las 'phros pa las ni bzang sde dor nas gsol bas sngon chog grangs so/ /phrin ni da ltar gyi cho ga ste/ deng sang yang byar rung ba bshad de ma bris so/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dus kyi khyad par/ bsnyen gnas kyi khyad par/ dge bsnyen gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sdom pa dang / zhar la sdom min gyi dus so/ /dang po ni/ so thar du ji srid kyi bar du blang zhe na/ sdom pa ni/ ris bdun ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dang / bsnyen gnas nyin zhag gcig tu yang dag par blang bar bya ste/ dus kyi mtha' ni srog dang nyin zhag gi mtha' yin pa dang / ston pas gzhan ma bstan pas so/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon ni dang po'i rigs te/ tshe phyi ma'i sdom pa da ltar blangs kyang mi skye ste/ tshe 'di dang lus skal ba mi 'dra bas dang /

mi 'dra ba'i lus des kyang da ltar blangs pa der sbyor ba ma byas pas dang / blangs pa mi dran pas so/ gnyis pa ni/ mi rigs te/ ston pas ma bstan pa dbang po 'dul dka' ba la dgongs kyi mi skye nas min pas zhag lnga la sogs pa skye ba la rigs pas mi gnod par bzhed de/ 'dul ba dang yang mthun no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom min gyi dus nges pa gang zhe na/ de ni las smad pas len pa med kyang gtan du log par zhugs pa'i rgyu'i 'thob pas ji srid 'tsho ba yin la/ nyin zhag pa'i sdom min med de/ sdom min de bsnyen gnas de ltar nyin zhag gcig tu nod pa med cing / tshe'i dus las gzhan du log par zhugs pas sdom min mi thob pas so/ /grag ces pa zur za ba ste/ dus re zhig pa'ang yod par ston pa'o/ /mdo sde pa ni/ sdom min yang sdig pa bya ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa ste/ shan pa sogs sems dge ba la'ang sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa de ma spangs pas ldan par 'dod de theg chen dang mthun no/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ ji ltar nod pa'i tshul/ yan lag gis grangs nges/ rten gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ bsnyen gnas zhag tu nod na ji ltar nod par bya zhe na/ nad pa min pas dma' bar tsog bur thal mo sbyar nas 'dug cing 'bogs pa pos smras pa'i rjes su bzlas pas rgyan nar ma las gzhan pas mi brgyan par bsrung dus sang nam langs shing nyi ma shar gyi bar du dgra bcom pa dang nye bar gnas pas bsnyen gnas te/ de'i yan lag brgyad tshang bar len dus nang par snga dro za ma zos pa'i tshe/ yul gzhan las nod par bya'o/ /gang gi tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen gnas bsrung pas nges pa byas pa des ni zas zos kyang gzhan las nod par bya ste/ rkyen yod kyang mi 'da' ba'i dgos pa yod pas so/ /gnas 'jog gis zhus par/ dge slong ngam bram ze shes pa gcig gis gan du song ste/ ces pa dang / 'dul ba lung du khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi mgron po la bsnyen gnas phog par bshad pas/

dge bsnyen las yang blang du rung la/ dge bsnyen kyang dge bsnyen sdom brgyad du dge bsnyen las kyang blang bar bshad do/ /'di ni dge bsnyen gyi dge ba gsos 'debs pa'i gso sbyong ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ yan lag brgyad ni/ srog gcod ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun te rtsa ba bzhi dang / chang 'thung ba gar sogs 'phreng sogs/ mal chen mtho/ phyi dro'i kha zas te yan lag bzhi spong ba'o/ /ci'i phyir yan lag brgyad nod ce na/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba spong ba tshul khrims kyi yan lag dang / bag yod pa'i yan lag dang / brtul zhugs kyi yan lag ste/ dang po bzhi dang / lnga pa gcig dang / phyi ma gsum ste/ brgyad po rim bzhin no/ ci bag yod dang brtul zhugs kyi yan lag ma nod na cir 'gyur zhe na/ chang 'thungs pas dran pa nyams pa dang / gar sogs gsum gyis dregs par 'gyur la/ de ltar na 'chal tshul thag mi ring bas so/ /gar sogs phreng sogs rab byung gi tshul dang mi mthun pas/ dge tshul la gnyis su bcas shing / khyim pa de lta min pas gcig tu'o/ /gser dngul len pa la bcas pa ni 'dod pa gsog 'jog gi gtso bo dang rtsa ba yin pas so/ gsum pa ni/ ci bsnyen gnas 'di dge bsnyen las gzhan la yod dam med ce na/ dge bsnyen las gzhan pa'i khyim pa la'ang yod mod kyis/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su ma song ba la med do/ /ma gus pa min kyang 'bogs pa po'am nod pa po brjed pa dang ma byang bas skyabs su ma song ba ni ma gtogs so/ /gsum pa la lnga ste/ lung gi don bshad pas dge bsnyen thams cad sdom ldan du bstan/ de la nang 'gal spong ba/ zhar la sdom pa che chung gi khyad par/ skyabs gnas kyi khyad par/ yan lag gi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ mdo las/ ming chen 'di ltar gos dkar po gyon pa/ skyes pa pho'i dbang po dang ldan pa zhig sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro zhing /

bdag la dge bsnyen du bzung du gsol/ zhes tshig tu smra na/ 'di tsam gyis dge bsnyen du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa de/ ci skyabs 'gro kho nas dge bsnyen du 'gyur ram zhe na/ nyi 'og pa 'gyur zhes zer ro/ /kha che ba sdom pa med par der mi 'gyur te/ lung gi don ni/ dge bsnyen nyid du gsol/ deng phan chad nas 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod spong ngo / /zhes khas blangs pa kho na las 'di'i sdom pa skye'o/ /'on kyang bslab pa'i gzhi bstan pa ni/ de shes pa'i ched du ste/ dper na dge slong dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob zin yang / shes pa'i ched du bslab pa'i gzhi brjod pa bzhin no zhe'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gal te dge bsnyen thams cad sdom pa ste sdom pa la gnas pa yin na/ ston pas bslab pa bzhi las gcig bsrung ba sna gcig spyod pa dang / sogs pas gnyis bsrung ba phyogs gcig spyod pa dang / gsum mam bzhi bsrungs ba phal cher spyod pa/ lnga char bsrungs na yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen zhes gsungs pa ci lta bu zhe na/ de ni dang po yongs su rdzogs par blangs nas/ phyis yan lag gcig nyams kyang lhag ma de dang / de bsrung ba las de spyod par gsungs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /grag ni mdo las 'das par ston pa ste/ srog gcod spong ngo / /zhes ni gang du'ang mi 'byung zhing / nyams na sna gcig spyod pa sogs zhu ba nyid kyang mi 'thad na lan lta ci smos/ des na dang po nyid du bslab gzhi de dang de blangs te bsrung ba rnams sna gcig spyod pa sogs so/ /zhes nyi 'og pa sogs 'dod do/ /spyir gsung rab tu dge bsnyen bdun 'byung ste/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa/ sna gcig spyod pa/ phyogs gcig spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa/ yongs rdzogs/ tshangs spyod/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du blangs te bsrung ba go ma'i dge bsnyen no/ /de la dang po lnga ming chen gyi mdo dang / drug pa lung rnam 'byed dang /

bdun pa kun tu rgyu sen rings gi zhus par/ des de 'dra ba'i sdom pa sangs rgyas la blangs par gsungs la/ dge bsnyen sdom brgyad kyi 'grel pa sogs su bshad do/ /kha che ba ni lnga drug gnyis min pas mi 'dod la/ 'di ni yongs rdzogs kyi dbang du byas so/ /gsum pa ni/ sdom pa che chung sogs ji ltar zhe na/ sdom pa chung ngu dang / sogs pas 'bring dang chen po gyur pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni dad sogs che chung dang ldan pa'i yid ji bzhin gi dbang gis te/ de na dgra bcom la chung la/ so skye la che ba'ang yod/ bzhi pa ni 'o na skyabs su ji ltar 'gro zhe na/ skyabs 'gro ni/ blang ba thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bas gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul sangs rgyas ni/ gang mnyes pas sangs rgyas su 'jog par byed pa'i chos mi slob pa'i lam chos sku dang / dge 'dun ni gang thob pas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun du 'jog par byed pa'i chos sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i slob mi slob gnyis ka'i lam bden dang / chos ni mya ngan sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las 'das pa'i so sor brtags 'gog go /sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun gyi rten gzugs sku ni zag bcas yin pas skyabs gnas min zhe'o/ /slob dpon de lta na 'jig rten pa'i sems la gnas pa na sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom pa yang min par 'gyur la/ dge slong du byed pa'i tshul khrims kho na dge slong du 'gyur ro/ /zhes te/ chos 'dra zhing / gzhan gnyis rten yang de dag tu bzhed do/ /skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo ni/ yul dam pa la brten par khas len cing blo gtod pa ste/ 'grel par ngag gi rig byed du bshad pa ni nod pa'i dus kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /skyabs kyi don ni/ de la brten nas sdug bsngal kun las nges par thar bar 'gyur ba'o/ /lnga pa la gsum ste/ log g.yem/ rdzun/ chang spong ba yan lag tu bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ sdom pa gzhan la mi gtsang spyod spong ba bslab pa'i gzhir bzhag la/

dge bsnyen la 'dod log spong ba ci zhe na/ log g.yem ni/ gzhan gyi chung ma sun 'byin cing ngan song gi rgyu yin pas shin tu smad pa'i phyir dang / khyim pa'i sdom sla ba'i phyir dang / 'phags pas tshe gzhan du'ang mi byed pa'i sdom pa thob cing mi tshangs spyod ni de lta bu ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dge bsnyen gyi chung ma len na sdom pa mi nyams sam zhe na/ mi nyams te/ sdom pa ni ji ltar khas blangs pa bzhin 'thob pas 'dod log spong bar khas len gyi rgyud 'di la mi tshangs spyod spangs ngo zhes ni min pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngag gi bzhi las rdzun spong ba kho na yan lag tu bzhag pa ci zhe na/ smad pa sogs gsum dang / yang bslab pa thams cad las 'das par gyur na 'das sam dris pa na/ bdag gis ma byas zhes rdzun du thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir spang ste 'das na bshags pa'i don du'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba 'di'i bslab gzhir mi 'jog pa ci zhe na/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba myos 'gyur bzhag go /de kho na 'jog pa ci zhe na/ de las yan lag gzhan yang bsrung ba'i ched du'o/ /chang 'thung ba ni nyan thos 'dul ba pa rang bzhin gyi dang / mngon pa ba bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba'ang 'dod de/ 'gal la 'grel par lta'o/ /de gnyis kyis khyad par slob dpon ni sems nyon mongs can kho nas spyod pa dang / nyon mongs can min pa'i sems kyis kyang spyad par nus shing nyes pa gzhan spang ba'i ched du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis spyad pa la bzhed do/ /'di la yan lag lnga par bzhag pa ni dri za'i bu la bslab pa bcas pa bzhin gdul bya skrag pa spangs ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ don du na 'dis kyang mi dge ba bcu char spang dgos te/ dge bsnyen sdom brgyad du/ gang phyir lus ngag mi dge las/ /zlog pa nyid kyis dge ba'i las/ /de phyir brnab sems gnod pa'i sems/ /lta las log rnams grub pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gang las thob pa la gnyis te/

sdom pa gsum gyi khyad par/ de'i nang gses kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ ci sdom pa gsum rnams gzhi gang las gcig thob pa de las lhag ma dag 'thob bam zhe na/ min te/ 'dod gtogs so thar ni/ spang bya'i sbyor dngos mjug gsum thams cad las dang / sems can du ston mi ston nam bcas rang bzhin gnyis ka las dang / da ltar gyi phung khams skye mched rnams las/ spang bya de dang de'i gnyen po de dang de thob par 'gyur gyis/ 'das ma 'ongs las ni min te da lta sems can du mi 'brang bas so/ /bsam gtan dang zag med kyis sdom pa dag ni chos nyid kyis thob pas las kyi las lam dngos gzhi kho na las dang sems kyi rjes 'brang yin pas/ dus gsum po thams cad las 'thob kyi sbyor mjug dang bcas pa las ni min no/ /des na sdom pa dang po'i bzhi dang / phyi ma gnyis kyi bzhi la mu bzhi ste/ dang po ni/ da ltar gyi bcas pa dang sbyor mjug go /gnyis pa ni 'das ma 'ongs kyi dngos gzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ da ltar gyis dngos gzhi'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi bcas pa dang sbyor mjug go /slob dpon ni/ spang bya 'das da ltar ni skyes zin pas sdom mi nus pas ma 'ongs pa'i sdom par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ci sdom pa dang sdom min dag sems can thams cad dang / yan lag thams cad dang / rgyu thams cad la thob pa'am/ 'on te dbye ba yod ce na/ sdom pa ni sems can thams cad la 'thob ste gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pas so/ /yan lag las kyi lam la ni dbye ba yod de/ dge slong gi spong bdun dang dge tshul la sogs kyi spong bzhi yin pas so/ /rgyu la dbye ba yod de/ dge rtsa gsum rgyur 'dod na thams cad las dang / sems che 'bring chung gsum rgyur 'dod na de gsum cig char mi 'byung bas re re las thob bo/ /gnyis pa sdom min thob tshul la gnyis te/ gang las thob/ ji ltar thob pa'o/ /dang po ni/

sdom pa min pa sems can thams cad dang yan lag las lam kun las thob ste/ sgo thams cad nas gnod pa la zhugs pas so/ /rgyu ni thams cad las thob pa min te/ dge gsum mam sems chung ngu sogs gang du 'dod kyang cig char mi 'byung bas so/ /zhe'o/ /slob dpon ni/ de ltar na shan pa sogs la'ang sdom min med par 'gyur te/ rang gi pha ma sogs gsad 'dod med pas so/ /ci ste de dag lug sogs su gyur pa na gsad 'dod byung ngo zhe na/ 'o na lug sogs kyang pha mar gyur pa na gsad 'dod med pas de la sdom min mi thob par 'gyur ro/ /shan pa ma byin len sogs mi byed pa'ang yod pas/ ji ltar yan lag kun la sdom min thob/ ces 'gog go /bye brag tu smra ba ni sdom pa'ang nges pa lnga dang ma bral na sdig pa'i sems dang ma bral bas mi skye zhing / sdom min la'ang ma tshang ba dang / nyi tshe ba med pa'i shan pas bslab pa gnyis sam gsum zhig blangs kyang de la sdom pa med par smra'o/ /mdo sde pa ni/ ji ltar khas blangs pa bzhin sdom min thob la/ ris brgyad ma gtogs pa'i sdom pa'ang ma tshang ba dang / nyi tshe ba yod de/ tshul khrims dang 'chal tshul de tsam gyis gegs byed pa'i phyir zhes zer ro/ /'dul bar yang / mi dge ba bcu phyogs gcig spong ba bcu dang / nyin zhag nas lo'i bar yun thung spong ba bcu dang / lo phan chad yun ring du spong ba bcu dang / ji srid 'tsho'i bar du spong ba bcu dang / rang nyid spong ba bcu dang / gzhan spong du 'jug pa bcu dang / spong ba mthong na dga' zhing yid rang ba bcu ste/ sdom par gtogs pa brgya bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom pa min pa ni/ de'i rigs su skye ba rnams gsod pa sogs kyi bya ba'am gzhan gyi rigs su skye ba rnams 'tsho ba 'dis 'tsho bar bya'o/ /zhes khas len pa las thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ sdom pa dang sdom min gyi lhag ma bar ma'i rnam rig byed min ni/

rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams lta bu zhing dang / sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal te/ za ba sogs yid dam bcas pas len pa las dang 'di skye bar 'gyur bas gus par byed pas dge mi dge'i bya ba rtsom pa las 'thob bo/ /gsum pa gtong rgyu la'ang bzhi ste/ sdom pa/ sdom min/ bar ma/ de gsum las gzhan pa'i gtong rgyu'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ so thar/ bsam gtan/ zag med kyi gtong rgyu'o/ /dang po ni/ mi brda 'phrod pa'i drung du bslab pa bsam pa thag pas phul ba dang / shi 'phos pa dang / pho mo'i mtshan gnyis cig char byung ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba chad pas so sor thar pa'i dbang po 'dul bar byed pa gtong la/ de bzhi dang / mtshan mo 'das pas bsnyen gnas gtong ste rim pa bzhin du blangs pa dang 'gal ba'i rnam rig skyes pa dang / rten bor zhing 'phangs pa rdzogs pa dang / rten nyams pa dang / gzhi chad pa dang / de srid du 'phangs pa'o/ /bsdu bar/ rab byung gi ni rtsa ltung byung ba dang / dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas kyi ni sems mi mthun pa skyes pas kyang gtong bar bshad do/ /snga rabs pa kha cig rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'gyur ba bzhi gang rung byung ba las kyang thams cad gtong ste/ rigs pa ni/ rgyu ngo tsha med pa dang / khrel med pa chen pos gang bas so/ lung ni/ zhu ba la bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa la dge 'dun lhag ma 'byung bar 'gyur lags sam/ bka' bstsal pa/ de bzhin te bslab pa byin pa la 'gyur ro zhes dang / phran tshegs las/ bslab pa byin pa'i bslab pa ni/ dge slong dang 'dra ba yin no zhes te ma btang na dge slong dngos yin pas de skad mi gsungs pas dang / lung gzhi las/ de byas na byas ma thag tu dge slong du mi rung bar 'gyur zhes pas so/ /tshul 'chal dge slong ma la chos ston na ltung byed dag pa la skur pa 'debs na lhag mar bshad pa ni nyes byas la dgongs pa ste/ so sor thar par/ dge slong dag pa ltung ba med pa la zhes pas so/

/gcig la pham pa bzhi 'byung bar bshad pa ni las lam bzhi cig char rdzogs pa la dgongs la/ bslab byin gyis dgra bcom thob pa na sngon gyi gral du 'dug par bshad pa ni gzengs bstod pa'i go 'phang yin pas nyes pa med do/ /gzhan rnams ni dam chos nub pa las gtong ste/ bslab pa'i mtshams dang las kyi mtha' rnams med pas so/ /zhes smra'o/ /sku mched ni/ de'i tshe sngon med gsar du mi 'thob thob zin mi gtong zhes so/ /kha che ba rnams ni/ rtsa ltung byung ba la'ang sdom pa mi gtong ste bu lon yang chags la nor yang yod pa'i mi bzhin du tshul ldan dang tshul 'chal gnyis su 'dod cing / bu lon 'jal na nor ldan yin gyi bu lon can min pa bzhin du ltung ba de bshags na tshul ldan yin gyi tshul 'chal ma yin la/ rigs pa ni/ phyogs gcig nyams pas kun gtong ba mi rigs te/ rigs na gcig blangs pas kyang kun blangs par ha cang thal lo/ /lung ni rnam 'byed las/ dge slong mar chos bstan na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas rang rgyud la ltung byed skyes pa ste/ sdom med la ltung ba med pas so/ /de dang zhu bar/ rtsa ltung dang po las ma byung pa la/ dge slong gzhan gyi rtsa ltung gzhan gsum gyi skur ba 'debs na/ dge slong gzhan de la lhag ma byung bar bshad pas sde/ sdom med la skur pa btab kyang lhag ma mi 'byung bas so/ /zhu bar gcig la pham pa zhes 'byung bar bshad pa ste/ pham pa snga mas sdom pa btang nas pham pa phyi ma mi 'byung bas so/ /phran tshegs las/ zag pa zad pa de'i tshe sngon gyi gral du 'dug par bya'o/ /zhes pa ste/ bslab sbyin la sdom pa med na sngon gyi bslab gral thob par mi rigs pas so/ /rtsod spang ni/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs ces pa ni byin len stob pa dang / nub lhag sogs kyi cha nas ma rdzogs pa dang 'dra bas der brtags la/ dge slong dang 'dra zhes pa ni/ blang dor dgos pa'i cha nas dge slong rnam dag dang 'dra ba'o/

/dge slong du mi rung zhes pa ni/ don dam pa'i dge slong min pa'am/ dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba'o/ /ltung byed lhag ma nyes byas 'chad pa ni rang dgar sgro btags pa ste/ dge slong dag pa zhes pa'am/ skur gzhi de dag pa la lung de dag nyid du bshad do/ /las lam bzhi cig char rdzogs zhes pa'ang pham pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i mthar thug bde ba nyams myong gi rtog pa dang thob blo'i rtog pa gnyis cig char mi skye bas dka'o zhe na/ mi dka' te ma byin len ni gzhan byed du bcugs pas kyang las lam du 'gyur bas so/ /gzengs bstod ces pa mi 'thad de/ dge slong rnam dag gis dgra bcom thob kyang / bslab bral byed na ma dag par ji ltar gzengs bstod/ ces so/ /mdo sde pa ni/ pham pa byung na gcig gis kyang kun gtong ste/ lung rigs snga rabs pa bzhin no/ rtsa ltung byung yang 'chab sems ma skyes na phas pham pa min pa'i dge slong yin te/ dge slong dga' ba can bzhin no/ /de ltar phran tshegs su/ dge slong dag dge slong dga' ba can gyi spyad bya min pa spyad kyang sems gcig gis kyang ma bcabs pas 'di pham par mi 'gyur gyi ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bslab pa sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes pas so/ /des sdom pa btang na phyis bcos su mi rung ste/ des dge sbyong gi tshul phyir blang du med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas so/ /rtsod spong ni/ sngonam̐ gyi dam pa'i dge slong min/ zhes thugs thub ches te/ sngar dam pa'i dge slong du gyur nas phyis de min par mi 'gyur bas so/ /des na gsol bzhi'i las kyi dge slong gi dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /rigs pa'i lan yang / ston pa nyid kyis shing ta la'i mgo bo bcad na zhes dper mdzad de btab bo/ /de ston pas dge slong gi longs spyod kun las dgar te/ dge slong min pa dge slong du/ /smra ba sre da bsal bar gyis/ /shing rul dag ni spang bar gyis/ /snying po med pa dor bar gyis/

/zhes bka' bstsal pas/ de 'dra'i dge slong ji ci 'dra yin/ 'o na dge slong bzhi ste lnga pa med/ /lam gyi rgyal dang lam ston dang / /lam gyi mtsho dang lam sun 'byin/ /zhes bka' bstsal pa'i tha ma ji ltar zhe na/ shing tshig pa dang mi shi ba ltar/ sha tshugs tsam lus pas so/ /'o na dge slong min na cis kyang rab tu mi 'byin zhe na/ rgyud khrel med pa chen pos nyams pas sdom pa skye ba'i skal ba med pa yin gyi/ dge slong yin pas ni min te de bslab pa phul yang rab tu mi 'byin ngo / /'o na lung rnam 'byed du/ skyong mas chom rkun drug cu 'chi bar byas te/ 'chab sems ye med kyang pham par bshad pa ci zhe na/ sdom pa ni ngo tsha khrel ldan la yod la/ de ni de las zlog pas so/ /zhes dang / lung ma mor/ pham pa byung ba/ bslab pa sbyin pa zhes pa ci zhe na/ pham pa'i sde tshan du gtogs pa'am/ de'i sgra 'jug pa la dgongs pa'o zhes brjod du rung ngo / /de ltar gsum ka'ang 'chab sems ma skyes na/ bslab pa byin pa dang pham pa 'chab bcas byung ni/ skyer mi rung bar 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan du gtogs pa'i dge ba gzugs can yin min kun ni sa gong ma 'og tu 'phos pa dang / snyoms 'jug las nyams pa ste rgyu gnyis kas gtong la/ de bzhin du gzugs med du gtogs pa'ang sa 'phos nyams pa dag gis gtong ngo / /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa ste/ zag med kyi lam ni/ 'bras bu thob pas zhugs pa dang dbang po sbyang pas rtul po dang lam nyams pa las phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu sogs gtong ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ sdom min ni sdom pa dang po gnyis gang rung thob pa dang / shi ba dang / mtshan gnyis cig char byung ba las gtong la/ sdom min min bya bar bsam pa thag pas dam bcas kyang sdom pa med par mi gtong ste/ nad kyi gzhi spangs kyang sman med par nad rnying mi zlog pa bzhin/ zhe'o/ /'o na des bsnyen gnas bsrungs te/ sang nyin de rdzogs pa na sdom min du 'gyur ram/

bar mar 'gyur zhe na/ kha cig gtan du gtong sems med pas sdom min du 'gyur te/ lcags gong 'bar yang sngon por 'gyur ba ltar smra'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bar ma ni 'phen byed dad pa'am nyon mongs kyi shugs chad pa dang / des chog ces blangs pa dor te chad pa dang / blangs pa bzhin ma byas pas bya ba chad pa dang / mchod rten dang rgya sogs don chad pa dang / tshe chad pas gtong la/ dge ba ni dge rtsa ba chad pa las kyang ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ 'dod gtogs dge ba gzugs can min pa ni dge rtsa chad pa dang khams gong du skyes pa las gtong la yid mi bde dge ba bsam gtan dang po thob pa las gtong ba lta bu chags bral las gtong ba yang yod do/ /nyon mongs can gzugs can min pa khams gsum pa thams cad ni/ rang rang gi gnyen po spong lam skyes pas rnam par nyams shing gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /mdo sde pa sogs ni las thams cad sems par 'dod pas gtong rgyu zur pa 'di 'dra mi bzhed do/ /bzhi pa rten gang la ldan tshul ni/ sdom pa dang sdom min sems can gang la yod zhe na/ dang po nas mtshan gang yang med pa'i za ma dang / yod kyang dga' ba'i don byed mi nus pa ma ning dang / mtshan gnyis pa dang / sgra mi snyan ma gtogs pa'i gling gsum gyi mi skyes pa dang bud med rnams la sdom min med do/ /sdom pa'ang de bzhin gyi mi la dang lha la'ang yod do/ /gzhan la med pa ni/ 'dul bar/ de lta bu gsal bar gsungs pa dang / za ma sogs ni so sor brtags pa mi bzod pa dang / rten gnyis kas nyon mongs shas che ba dang / ngo tsha khrel yod shas chung ba dang / sgra mi snyan pa la len pa dang / ting nge 'dzin med pa dang / ngan song la ngo tsha khrel yod med pas sdom pa med do/ /sdom min med pa ni/ sdig pa la'ang blo mi rten pa dang / sgra mi snyan pa la sdig pa bya ba'i bsam pa med pa dang / ngan song la ngo tsha khrel yod 'jigs rgyu med pas dang / gang la sdom pa yod pa gcig la sdom min yang yod pas so/

/klu la bsnyen gnas yod par bshad pa ni/ legs spyad tsam yod/ zhes so/ /bsdu bar ni/ bsam pa ma nyams na bsnyen gnas skye bar bshad pas klu la'ang skye la/ za ma sogs kyang dge bsnyen bsrung na bsod nams 'dra bar bshad cing / ye shes bshes gnyen yang / skyabs 'gro'i dge bsnyen ma bkag ces 'chad do/ /de la'ang / mi rnams la'ang so thar sogs sdom pa gsum mo/ /'dod lha la yod du rung ba dang gzugs khams su skyes pa'i lha rnams la yod nges pa'i sgo nas bsam gtan las skyes pa'i sdom pa yod kyi gong na ni med do/ /zag med kyi sdom pa ni bsam gtan khyad par can du skyes pa'i tshangs chen dang / 'du shes med pa'i sems can du skye ba ma gtogs pa'i 'dod gzugs kyi lha la yod cing / gzugs med na'ang 'phags pa la ldan pa'i sgo nas yod do/ /'dod gzugs kyi'ang gnas gtsang ma la yod nges dang / gzhan ni yod rung tsam mo/ /gsum pa las mdo nas byung ba'i don la gnyis te/ las thun mong du dang / so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rgyu 'bras kyi sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ las gsum dang / bzhir gsungs pa'i don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dge sogs kyi bsod nams sogs dang / myong 'gyur sogs kyi ni/ phan yon sogs kyi don/ dang po ni/ las gang 'bras bu bde ba ste mtho ris dang thar pa can dang / rnam smin mi bde ba can dang de gnyis las/ gzhan pa btang snyoms can ni rim pa bzhin dge ba dang mi dge ba dang gzhan te lung ma bstan gyi las so/ /gnyis pa la/ bstan bshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ yang las bsod nams dang bsod nams min pa dang / mi g.yo ba gsum dang bde ba myong 'gyur dang sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong 'gyur dang / btang snyoms myong 'gyur gsum mo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bsod nams sogs dang / bde ba myong 'gyur sogs so/
