zag med la sems gang gis dmigs pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ chos gsum la dang / chos gnyis la sems gang gis dmigs pa'o/ /'dir dngos po gang la phra rgyas du zhig dmigs nas rgyas tshul tshig nyung ngu'i ston pa ste/ de la yul chos thams cad bsdus na khams gsum na spang bya ris lnga lnga dang zag med de bcu drug dang / yul can sems kyang de ltar bcu drug go /de dag las sdug bsngal dang / rgyu kun 'byung mthong spang dang sgom pa'i spang bya ste/ chos gsum po 'dod khams las skyes pa ni yul can 'dod pa rang gi sems de gsum dang / gzugs kyi sgom spang du rtogs pa dge ba'i sems gcig dang / dri med chos shes phyogs dang mthun pa'i rnam shes te lnga'i spyod yul lo/ /de gsum la 'dod pa'i 'gog lam mthong spang gi sems kyis mi dmigs pa ni/ de dag zag med la dmigs na 'gog lam la dmigs la/ zag bcas la dmigs na'ang 'gog lam mthong spang tsam la dmigs pas so/ /gong sa'i nyon mongs kyi'ang yul min te/ de 'og sa mi dmigs pas so/ /gzugs med kyi dge ba'i 'ang min te/ ring ba bzhi'i ring ba 'o/ /chos kyi ris de gsum gzugs khams las skyes pa ni/ yul can gzugs rang gi sems gsum dang / 'og 'dod pa'i skal ba mi mnyam pa'i kun 'gro ris gnyis dang sgom spang dge ba ste gsum dang / gong gzugs med kyi sgom spang nam mkha'i nyer bsdogs gi sems gcig dang / dri med rjes shes phyogs gcig dang mthun pa'i sems te brgyad kyi yul lo/ /chos de gsum gzugs med la skyes pa ni/ khams gsum du gtogs pa'i sems gsum gsum po de rnams dang / zag med rjes shes phyogs dang mthun pa'i sems te bcu'i spyod yul lo/ gnyis pa ni/ 'gog pa dang lam mthong bas spang bya'i chos khams gsum pa kun gyi yul sngar gyis sems de rnams kyi steng du rang rang gi ris kyi sems re res lhag pas spyod yul lo/

/gnyis pa ni/ zag med kyi chos ni yul can khams gsum gyi sems lnga lnga'i mtha' ma 'gog lam mthong spang dang sgom spang ste gsum gsum dang zag med kyis sems de bcu'i spyod yul lo/ /gsum pa sems phra rgyas bcas pa'i dbye ba ni/ sems nyon mongs can phra rgyas dang bcas pa ni rnam pa gnyis kyis te/ de dang mtshungs ldan dang / de la dmigs pa ma spangs pa'i rgyas 'gyur dang / de dang mtshungs ldan spangs pa rgyas par mi 'gyur yang lhan cig pa tsam gyis bcas par 'jog pa'o/ /sems nyon mongs pa can min pa ni/ de la dmigs pa ma spangs pa rgyas 'gyur kho na'i phra rgyas dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa skye tshul la gnyis te/ skye ba'i rim pa/ skye rgyu'o/ /dang po phra rgyas bcu po 'di rnams ji ltar 'jug ce na/ dang por bden pa la rmongs pa las bden pa las the tshom skye la/ the tshom de las log pa'i thos bsam las sdug bsngal med ces sogs log lta skye zhing / de las 'jig lta 'jug ste/ sdug bsngal sogs phung po la dmigs pa bdag tu zhen pa'o/ /de las bdag rtag pa'am chad pa'i mthar 'dzin pa dang / de las gang mthar bzung ba de'i 'dag par yid ches pa'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang / de las lta ba mchog 'dzin dang / de las rang gi lta bas khengs pa'i nga rgyal dang / de la chags pa dang / de nas rang gis dgra bo gzhan gyi lta ba la zhe sdang 'jug ste/ de ltar phra rgyas bcu 'jug pa'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phra rgyas skye ba na rgyu gsum ste/ de thob pa chad pa'am sa bon zad pa'i sgo nas spangs pa ma yin pa rgyu stobs dang / phra rgyas skye ba dang mthun pa'i yul nye bar gnas pa yul stobs dang / yul de la'ang tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa sbyor ba'i stobs las nyon mongs skye ste/ de rgyu tshang ba yin la/ re 'ga' rgyu stobs med par yul stobs las kyang skye ste/ dgra bcom nyams pa'i chos can bzhin zhe'o/

/gong ma pa ni de gsum tshang bas skye bar bzhed do/ /gsum pa phra rgyas kyi grangs la gsum ste/ rnam grangs dngos/ de rnams gang dang mtshungs par ldan/ sgrib pa lnga 'dod khams par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bzhir bstan/ lngar bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dngos dang / nges tshig go dang po la gsum ste/ zag pa/ chu sbyor/ nyer len no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'dod zag srid pa/ ma rig pa'i zag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phra rgyas nyid zag bcas gsum du gsungs pa la 'dod pa na spyod pa'i gti mug ris lnga ma gtogs pa nyon mongs pa phra rgyas so gcig kun nas bkris pa bcu dang bcas pa zhe gcig ni 'dod pa'i zag pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzugs dang gzugs med na spyod pa'i ma rig pa lnga lnga dor ba'i phra rgyas nyer drug ste nga gnyis kho na srid pa'i zag pa'o/ /kun dkris 'ga' zhig yod kyang rang dbang can min pas ma smos so/ /cis gong ma gnyis kyi gcig tu bsdus zhe na/ gong ma de gnyis kyi phra rgyas rnams lung ma bstan dang kha nang du bltas te 'jug pa dang / mnyam bzhag gi sa pa yin pa'i phyir zag pa gcig tu byas la/ srid zag tu 'jog pa srid pa'i 'dod chags bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ khams gsum gyi ma rig pa rdzas bco lnga ni ma rig pa'i zag pa ste/ zag pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa yin pas na de logs shig tu zag par bstan to/ /gnyis pa la/ dngos dang / rtsod spong gnyis kyi dngos ni/ mdo las/ chu bo bzhi dang sbyor ba bzhi gsungs pa'ang zag par bshad pa de bzhin du rig pa bya'o/ /khyad par ni/ khams gsum gyi lta ba rnams shes rab yin pas gsal ba'i phyir chu sbyor gyi nang du logs shin tu bstan no/ /gdul bya'i dbang du tsam gyis bstan par zad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ cis zag par lta ba logs su ma bstan zhe na/ zag par lta ba logs su ma yin te/ grogs med pa'i lta ba 'ba' zhig gis sa rnams ni zag pa'i nges tshig 'jog pa'i rjes su mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/

/des na lta ba min pa 'dod zag nyer dgu ni 'dod pa'i chu sbyor dang / nyer brgyad ni srid pa'i chu sbyor dang / khams gsum na mthong spang ris bzhi'i lta ba bcu gnyis re ste so drug ni lta ba'i chu sbyor re ste/ so drug ni lta ba'i chu sbyor dang / khams gsum gyi ma rig pa bco lnga ni ma rig pa chu sbyor ro/ /lo na ma rangs pa'o/ /gsum pa la dngos dang / rtsod pa spang pa gnyis/ dngos ni/ mdo las nyer len bzhi gsungs pa la ji skad pa'i 'dod sbyor nyid ma rig pa dang bcas pa so bzhi ni/ 'dod pa nye bar len pa dang srid sbyor ma rig pa dang bcas pa so brgyad ni bdag tu smra bar nye bar len pa rnam pa gnyis dang / lta ba'i dbye ba las gnyis te/ khams gsum gyi lta ba dang po'i bzhi/ dril ba sum cu ni lta ba nye bar len pa dang / lta ba lnga dril ba drug ni tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs sogs kyi nye bar len pa'i ste/ de zur du byung ba ni lam gyi dgrar gyur pa dang / khyim pa dang rab tu byung gnyis ka bslu bas so/ /de ltar nyer len bzhi rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ cis ma rig pa nyer len du bsres te bshad kyi logs su ma bshad ce na/ ma rig pa ni mi gsal bas de rkyang pas 'dzin par byed pa min la/ gzhan dang 'dres pa na 'dzin pa'i phyir nyon mongs gzhan dang bsres so/ /sku mched ni/ 'dod pa sogs bzhi la 'dun cing / chags pa nyer len bzhir bzhed do/ /gnyis pa nges tshig la gnyis te/ phra rgyas dang / zag sogs kyi nges tshig go /dang po ni/ phra rgyas nas nyer len gyi bar gyi sgra'i don gang zhe na/ gang gi phyir nyon mongs pa de rnams rtogs dka' ba'i 'jug pa phra ba dang thob pa dang rjes su 'brel ba dang / dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gnyis kyi rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / bzlog kyang yang yang rjes su 'brang zhing mngon du 'gyur ba de'i phyir phra rgyas rnams su bshad pa yin no/ /des na bye brag tu smra ba de mngon du 'gyur la 'dod la/

mdo sde pa dang gong ma pa ni de'i sgra a nu sha sa yam̐ ces pa'i nges tshig ni nyon mongs mngon du ma byung ste bag chags kyi tshul du nyal bas na bag la nyal zhes 'chad la/ gnas ma'i bu sa thob pa la 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ni 'khor bar 'jog par byed pa dang / skye mched drug gis rma nas zag cing 'bo bar byed pas dang / 'gro ba'am yul gzhan du 'khyer bar byed pas dang / de dag tu 'byar bar byed pas dang / yang srid dam 'dod pa sogs bzhi por nye bar 'dzin pa'i phyir rim pa'i zug pa dang / sogs pa'i chu bo dang sbyor ba dang / nyer len du bzhag pa'i phra rgyas de rnams kyis nges tshig yin no/ /gnyis pa la bstan bshad gnyis las dang po ni/ phra rgyas de dag nyid kun du sbyor ba dang sogs pas 'ching ba dang / phra rgyas dang nye nyon dang / kun dkris kyi dbye bas lngar bshad do/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ kun sbyor/ 'ching ba/ nye nyon/ kun dkris so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ kun sbyor dgu dang / lngar bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ lta ba gsum gnyis dang / phra dog ser sna kun sbyor du bzhag pa'i rgyu'o/ /dang po ni/ kun sbyor dgu ste/ rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro dang / nga rgyal dang / ma rig pa dang / lta ba dang / mchog tu 'dzin dang / the tshom dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna'i kun sbyor ro/ /cis lta ba gsum dang gnyis kun sbyor tha dad du bshad ce na/ de dag khams gsum na rdzas bco brgyad re 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma 'di gnyis mchog tu 'dzin par 'dra ba'i phyir yang lta ba phyi ma gnyis mchog tu 'dzin pa'i kun tu sbyor ba zhes gzhan du bshad do/ /dbus mthar rim pas 'gog lam gnyis shes pa la sgrib pas tha dad du bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ kun dkris las phrag dog dang ser sna gnyis kun sbyor du bshad la gzhan min pa ci zhe na/ gang gi phyir de gnyis ka mtha' gcig tu mi dge ba dang rang dbang can yin pa de'i phyir/

phrag dog dang ser sna gnyis kun dkris de rnams las logs shig tu kun sbyor gnyis su bshad la/ ngo tsha med pa sogs ni chags sogs dang ldan pas rang dbang can min la/ 'gyod pa ni ma rig pa tsam dang ldan pas rang dbang can yin yang gcig tu mi dge ba min no/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ tha ma dang / gong ma'i cha mthun lnga'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo byed las dang bcas pa/ kun spyod gsum gyi rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ yang thub pas tha ma'i cha 'dod khams dang mthun pa'i kun sbyor rnam pa lnga gsungs te/ 'jig lta dang / brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang / the tshom dang / 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod sems so/ /ji ltar mthun zhe na phyi ma gnyis kyis 'dod khams las mi 'da' la snga ma gsum po yis ni 'das kyang phyir zlog par byed pas so/ /sems tsam pa ni snga ma gsum gyis sems can gyi tha ma so skye dang / phyi ma gnyis kyis khams tha ma 'dod khams las mi 'da' bas so/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mthar lta sogs gsum yang spangs pa la kun sbyor snga ma gsum kho na spangs pas rgyun zhugs su gsungs pa ci zhe na/ mthong spangs ris dang po'i sgo 'jig lta dang / ris snga phyi gnyis kyi sgo tshul zhugs dang / ris bzhi char gyi sgo the tshom gyis bsdus pas dang / rim gyis mthar lta dang lta ba mchog 'dzin dang log lta'i rtsa ba de gsum gyis bsdus pas de gsum spangs pa na mthar lta sogs spang bya spangs par go ba'i phyir de gsum bstan no/ /slob dpon gyis 'jig ltas thar pa la skrag pas 'gro mi 'dod pa dang / tshul zhugs kyis lam gzhan la brten pas nor ba dang / the tshom gyis lam la the tshom za bas gsum po de snyed gcig thar pa bgrod pa la gegs byed pa de'i phyir na/ thub pas rgyun zhugs kyis gsum spangs par bstan no/ /zhes te/ 'phags pas gsum po rim pas shes bya dang lta ba dang gnyen po log par rtog pas kyang de ltar rten par bzhed do/

/gnyis pa ni/ yang thub pas gong ma'i tha dang mthun pa'i kun sbyor lnga nyid gsungs te/ ji ltar zhe na/ gzugs dang gzugs med las skyes pa'i 'dod chags gnyis dang / rgod pa dang / nga rgyal dang / rmongs pa'o/ /de rnams ma spangs par khams gong ma las mi 'da' bas so/ /yang 'dod chags gnyis kyis khams gong ma nye bar len cing phyi ma gsum gyis blangs pa mi gtong ba yin pas 'phags par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa'i 'ching ba ni/ tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum gyi dbang gis 'ching ba 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs rnams ni sems nye bar nyon mongs par byed pa'i nye nyon yang yin la nyon mongs las gzhan pa'i chos nyon mongs can sems byung 'du byed kyi phung po zhes pas bsdus pa/ gang de ni nye ba'i nyon mongs pa ste/ de rnams nye nyon kho na yin gyi nyon mongs zhes ni mi bya'o/ /de yang gzhi phran tshegs las byung ba'i mi dga' ba dang / glal sogs 'khrug pa'i bar dang / 'dir 'chad pa'i kun dkris bcu dri ma drug sogs so/ /bzhi pa kun dkris la gsum ste/ dngos dang / zhar la dri ma bshad pa/ de dag gi khyad par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ kun dkris kyi dbye ba dang / de nye nyon du bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni mdo las/ nyon mongs kyang der bshad la/ bstan bcos rab tu byed pa las ni/ ngo tsha med pa dang / khrel med pa dang / gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa la sems khong nas 'khrug pa'i phrag dog dang / chos dang zang zing dang bzo sbyin pa dang 'gal ba can sems kyi 'dzin pa ser sna dang sems rnam par ma zhi ba rgod pa dang / rmugs pa dang / lus yang dag par 'dzin mi nus pas sems mngon par sdud pa gnyid dang kun nas dkris pa brgyad 'byung ngo / /bye brag smra ba ni/ gnod sems dang rnam 'tshe min pa'i kun nas mnar sems pa khro ba dang / kha na ma tho ba 'khyud pa 'chab pa gnyis bsnan nas bcu'o zhes so/

/'gyod gnyid ni dge ba dang mi dge ba'i cha dor ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dod chags kyi ngo tsha med/ rgod ser sna gsum bslangs shing / 'chab pa la/ kha cig sred pa'i rgyu mthun gzhan dag ma rig pa'i las la/ gnyis ka'i zhes rtsod do/ /ma rig pa las byung ba'i rgyu mthun rmugs dang gnyid dang khrel med do/ /the tshom las nyon mongs can gyi 'gyod pa'o/ /khro ba dang phrag dog gnyis ni/ khong khro'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dri ma'i dbye ba/ de nye nyon du bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhan yang lus las dri ma 'byung ba bzhin nyon mongs las sgyu sogs dri ma drug 'byung ste/ 'di ltar sgyu ste/ gzhan 'drid pa dang / g.yo ni sems gya gyu ba ste/ gang gis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin mi 'chags par gtam rlung la bskur ba'am mi gsal bar byed pa'i rgyags pa dang / de bzhin du kha na ma tho ba dam du 'dzin zhing ci rigs par gdams pa mi len par 'tshig pa dang / kun nas mnar sems lan mang du byed pa 'khon 'dzin pa dang / rnam par mtho 'tshams par rnams 'tshe'i/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgyu dang rgyags pa dag 'dod chags las skye la/ 'khon 'dzin dang rnam 'tshe khong khro las skyes/ 'tshig pa lta ba mchog 'dzin la skyes la/ gya gyu ci yin sdig lta can zhes 'byung bas g.yo ni lta bas kun nas bslangs so/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ mthong spang dang sgom spang gi khyad par/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi khyad par/ khams dang sa'i khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ 'di rnams ci zhig gis spang byar yin zhe na/ kun dkris bcu po de la ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med pa dang rmugs gnyid dang / rgod pa rnams ni mthong spang sgom spang rnam pa gnyis yin la/ de las gzhan phrag dog ser sna 'gyod pa khro ba 'chab pa lnga ni sgom pas spang bya kho na dang / ma rig pa tsam dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i rang dbang can yang yin no/ /de bzhin du dri ma drug kyang sgom spang kho na dang /

chags sogs kyi gzhan dbang can min gyi rang dbang can no/ /gnyis pa ni/ nye nyon rnams 'dod khams na yod pa ni mi dge ba yin la/ 'on kyang rmugs rgod gnyid de gsum la mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan rnam pa gnyis so/ /de yan chad gong ma gnyis na ji snyed pa ni lung ma bstan kho na'o/ /gsum pa ni/ g.yo sgyu gnyis 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po kho na la yod la/ dang po na sgyu ji ltar yod ce na/ 'phags pa rta thul gyis tshangs pa chen po la 'byung ba bzhi po gang du 'gag dris pa na/ tshangs pas mi shes bzhin du kho bo ni tshangs pa'o/ /tshangs pa ni chen po'o/ /zhes sogs kyis gtam rlung la bskur te rta thul la 'drid pa'i phyir ro/ /rmugs rgod rgyags pa gsum khams gsum na yod cing / gzhan nye nyon bcu gcig rnams 'dod khams las skyes pa kho na'o/ /gnyis pa de rnams gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa la gnyis te/ sa pa gnyis su dbye ba/ tshor ba gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa'o/ /dang po ni phra rgyas de rnams las yid kyi sa pa du/ tshogs drug gi sa pa du zhe na/ mthong spang thams cad dang / sgom spang yin pa gnyid dang nga rgyal du bcas pa thams cad ni/ yid kyis rnam shes kyi sa pa nyid yin la/ der ma zad nye ba'i nyon mongs rang dbang can bcu gcig kyang yid kyi sa pa'o/ /gzhan sgom spang gi dug gsum ngo tsha khrel med smugs rgod dang le lo bag med ni rnam shes drug char gyi rten can no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtsa nyon gang dang / nye nyon tshogs pa gang dang ldan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ 'dod pa dang / gong ma'i ldan tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ so so dang / kun gang ldan pa'o/ /dang po ni rtsa nyon nam nye nyon de rnams tshor ba gang dang mtshungs par ldan zhe na/ 'dod chags ni bde ba yid bde dag dang mtshungs par ldan shing zhe sdang zlog ste/ zhe sdang yid mi bde dag dang ldan pa'o/ /ma rig pa ni/ tshor ba lnga po thams cad dang ldan la/

med lta sdig las can rang gi sdig pa'i 'bras bu med par mthong bas yid bde dang bsod nams kyi las can bsod nams kyi dbang po don med par mthong bas yid kyi sdug bsngal dang ldan zhing the tshom zos pa nges pa don du gnyer ba yid mi bde ba dang ldan no/ /gzhan lta ba bzhi dang nga rgyal ni yid bde dang ldan te/ dag pa'i rnam par 'jug pa'i yid kyi sa pa yin pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ btang snyoms ni phra rgyas kun ldan te/ 'gag khar je zhan du 'gyur bas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa gong ma rnams ji lta bu zhe na/ sa gong ma'i phra rgyas rnams/ sa gang na tshor ba gang yod pa ji lta ba bzhin du rang rang gi tshor ba dang mtshungs par ldan no/ gnyis pa la gsum te/ so so'i dang / kun gyi dang / sa mang bzhi'i ldan tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'gyod pa nas 'tshig pa'i par drug ni/ yid mi bde dang ldan te skyo ba'i rnam par 'jug pa dang / yid kyi sa pa yin pas so/ /ser sna nyid ni zlog te/ yid bde dang ldan te chags pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i dga' ba'i rnam par 'jug pa'o/ /g.yo sgyu 'chab gnyid bzhi ni/ yid bde mi bde gnyis ka dang ldan la/ bde ba dag dang rgyags pa ni bsam bstan gsum pa na bde ba dang / de man chad na yid bde dag dang ldan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ btang snyoms ni/ nye nyen kun dang mtshungs ldan du 'gro'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhan ngo tsha med khrel med rmugs rgod bzhi ni/ tshor ba lnga rnams dang mtshungs par ldan no/ /gsum pa la dngos dang / grangs nges gnyis kyi dngos ni/ mdo las/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod sems dang / rmugs pa dang / gnyid dang / rgod pa dang / 'gyod pa dang / the tshom ste lnga gsungs pa la/ rmugs rgod the tshom gsum/ khams gsum pa'am/ 'dod khams pa kho na bzung zhe na/ gcig tu mi dge bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod khams na sgrib pa de lnga yod kyi khams gzhan na med do/ /ci'i phyir rmugs gnyid sgrib pa gcig dang rgod 'gyod gcig tu bshad ce na/

mi mthun pa snang ba'i 'du shes dang / zhi gnas dang / zas myang ba sogs dang / nye du'i rnam rtog sogs dang / bya ba sems zhum pa dang / sems mi zhum par byed pa gcig pa'i phyir gnyis gnyis gcig tu bshad do/ /so sor sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs pa thams cad sgrib pa yin na/ 'di lnga kho na bshad pa ci zhe na/ dang po gnyis kyi tshul khrims dang / rmugs gnyid kyis shes rab dang / rgod 'gyod kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po la gnod pa byed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab med na bden pa la the tshom za ba'i phyir na lnga nyid du bshad do/ /sku mched ni/ rmugs gnyid kyis ting nge 'dzin dang / rgod 'gyod kyis shes rab la gnod par bzhed la/ sngon gyi slob dpon dag rim pas ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi zhi lhag dang / rjes langs te chos la nges par rtogs pa'i tshe bar chad byed par bzhed de/ dang po dag gcig tu bya'o/ /spyi'i gnyis pa de gnyen po gang gis spong tshul la gnyis te/ ji ltar spong tshul/ spong byed gnyen po'i dbye ba/ gang las phye nas spong tshul/ spangs pa gang gis thag sring tshul/ spangs pa'i thob pa yang dang yang du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mthong spang dang sgom spang spong tshul lo/ /dang po ni ris dang po gnyis rang sa la dmigs pa dang / 'gog lam mthong spang zag med la dmigs pa rnams dmigs pa bden bzhi'i rang mtshan shes pa nyid kyis spong ste/ tho yor du shes pa nyid kyis mir 'dzin pa zlog pa bzhin no/ /'dod pa'i kun 'gro'i gong du dmigs pa dgu ni/ gong ma'i bden pa ma shes kyang de rnams la dmigs pa'i rang sa'i skal ba mnyam pa'i kun 'gro rnams yang dag par zad pas spong ba dang / 'gog lam mthong spang zag bcas la dmigs pa rnams ni rang gi dmigs pa zag med kyi yul can gyi phra rgyas rnams spangs pas spong ste/ yul med pa na de rnams kyang mi 'byung bas so/

/spong tshul de gsum yang snga phyi rim pa ni min gyi dus gcig la ldog pa tha dad pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnyen po chung 'bring dgu rim gyis skyes pas sgom spang che 'bring dgu rnams zad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnyen po du yod ce na/ rnam pa bzhi ste/ spong ba'i gnyen po bar chad med lam dang / gzhi gnyen po de yan chad kyis lam spangs pa'i thob pa kun tu 'dzin pa dang / thag ring ba'i gnyen po rnam grol lam yan chad dam/ gzhan dag de yang yin zer ro/ /rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po khams de la skyon du mthong nas sun 'byin pa'o/ /des na spong gnyen sdug kun la dmigs pa'ang sun 'byin pa yin te/ slob dpon gyis sdug kun la dmigs pa'i sbyor lam sun 'byin dang / gzhan gsum bar chad med lam dang rnam grol dang / khyad par gyi lam du bzhed la/ gong ma pa ni zag bcas la nyes dmigs su lta ba sun 'byin dang / sbyor lam dang bar chad med lam spong gnyen te gnyis slob dpon bzhin bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs pa spong ba na gang las spong bar bya zhe na/ mtshungs ldan las dbye mi nus pas dmigs pa las phye nas/ nyon mongs pa spang bar 'dod la/ de yang rang rgyud kyis thob pa chad pas dang / gzhan rgyud kyis ni de'i yul rang rgyud la yod ba spangs ba'i spong ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ thag sring ba'i ngo bo la du yod ce na/ bzhi ste/ tshogs pa gcig yang mtshan nyid mi mthun pas dang mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen pos dang / yul rnam par chad pas dang / dus kyis ring ba ste rim pas 'byung bzhi dang tshul khrims dang 'chal tshul dang / phyogs shar nub kyi rgya mtsho dang / dus 'das ma 'ongs gnyis ring ba lta bu'o/ /lnga pa ni/ ci lam ltar spangs pa yang khyad par du 'gyur ram zhe na/ min te/ nyon mongs pa thams cad ni rang gi spong lam kho nas lan cig tu spangs te zad par byed la/ de rnams kyi bral ba'i thob pa yang dang yang du khyad par du 'gyur ro/

/dus du zhig tu zhe na/ rang rang gi gnyen po rnam grol lam skyes pa dang rgyun zhugs sogs 'bras bu bzhi thob pas ste lnga dang / dbang po rtul po nas rnon por 'phel ba ste/ 'pho ba dang drug rnams su ci rigs par 'thob bo/ /spyi'i gsum pa la lnga ste/ dbye ba/ gang gis 'bras bu gang yin pa/ grangs nges/ ldan tshul thob gtong ngo / /dang po la gnyis te/ mthong lam gyi drug dang / sgom lam gyi gsum du dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yongs shes gnyis te/ ye shes kyi yongs shes zag med kyi shes pa dang / spangs pa'i yongs shes spangs pa nyid de/ 'thob byed rgyu'i ming gis btags pa'o/ /'dir ni gnyis pa'o/ /ci spangs pa thams cad yongs shes gcig kho na yin nam zhe na min te/ yongs su shes pa dgu ste/ 'dod pa na mthong spangs dang po gnyis zad pa la yongs shes gcig dang sa der 'gog lam mthong spang gnyis zad pa ni yongs shes de gnyis so/ /'dod pa'i gsum yin pa de bzhin du khams gong ma gnyis sdom pa'i mthong spangs spangs pa'i yongs shes de'ang gsum nyid de gong ma'i sdug bsngal mthong spangs spangs pa'i gcig dang / 'gog lam mthong spangs spangs pa'i gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ yongs su shes pa de drug las gzhan gsum ni/ tha ma'i cha dang mthun pa spangs pa dang / gzugs kyi zag pa kun zad pa dang / zag pa kun zad pa ste/ rim pa bzhin 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang gzugs med kyi sgom spang zad pa'i yongs shes gsum mo/ /'dir gong ma gnyis kyi tha dad du byed pa ni/ sgom spang gi gnyen po mi 'dra bas yin la/ gong ma gnyis kyi mthong spang gi gnyen po rjes bzod sogs su 'dra bas gcig tu byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ mthong sgom dang sa dang / lam dang / shes pa gang gis 'bras bu yin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ snga ma drug bzod pa'i 'bras bu ste/ bzod pa ni shes pa'i 'khor can yin pas 'bras bu la der btags so/

/lhag ma gsum rnams ni shes pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mi lcogs pa med pa'i 'bras bu yongs shes thams cad do/ /bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi rnams kyi 'bras bu bye brag smra ba ltar na/ lnga ste/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas phyir mi 'ong chags bral sngon 'gro'i mthong lam skyed pa na/ gong ma gnyis kyi mthong spang spangs pa gsum dang / sgom lam skyed pa na gzugs kyi 'dod chags zad pa dang / zag pa kun zad pa'i yongs shes te lnga 'thob pa'o/ /'dod pa'i yongs shes bzhi ni dngos gzhi'i 'bras bu min te mi lcogs med kyi 'bras bu yin pas so/ /zhes so/ /btsun pa dbyangs sgrog ni brgyad de/ de'i tshe 'jig rten pas sngon 'dod pa'i mthong spang spangs pa gsum gyi bral thob zag med kyang rnyed pa'o/ /tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa ni/ dngos su mi lcogs med kyi 'bras bu ste/ de'i tshe bral thob rnyed kyang gong ma'i mthong spangs spangs pa dang / sdom nas yongs shes gcig tu bzhag go /zhes so/ /nam mkha'i nyer bsdogs kyi 'bras bu gzugs kyi 'dod chags zad pa'i yongs shes gcig pu yin cing / gzugs med dngos gzhi dang po gsum gyi yang / 'bras bu zag pa kun zad gcig pu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yongs shes dgu po thams cad 'phags pa'i lam zag med kyi 'bras bu yin la/ 'phags lam pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi 'bras bu yin na/ tha ma'i cha mthun dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags zad pa'i yongs shes gnyis so/ /bzhi pa ni/ sgom lam rjes shes kyi 'bras bu yang yongs shes tha ma gnyis dang / sgom lam chos shes pa'i 'bras bu tha ma gsum yin no/ /shes pa de'i phyogs mthun kyi 'bras bu drug dang lnga ste/ chos bzod chos shes dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu gong ma'i mthong spang spangs pa'i gsum dor ba drug go /rjes bzod rjes shes dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu gong ma gnyis kyi yongs shes lnga'o/ /gsum pa ni/

sdug bsngal mthong spang nas srid rtse'i chung ngu'i chung ngu spangs pa'i bar du spangs pa re re yongs shes su mi bzhag pa ci zhe na/ bzod pa'i 'bras bu bral ba ni/ bral thob zag med rnyed pa dang / srid rtse'i phyogs nyams par byas pa dang / kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis ris dang po gnyis/ kun tu bcom pa dang gsum tshang ba'i phyir yongs shes su 'jog pa la/ sdug bsngal mthong spang ma spangs bar du de gsum ma tshang bas sdom zhing / 'gog lam mthong spang spangs pa ni re re la tshang bas so so la byas so/ /shes pa'i 'bras bu spangs pa ni rgyud de gsum dang khams re re'i spang bya mtha' dag las 'das pa las yongs shes su 'jog pa'i sgom spang spangs pa re re ma bzhag go /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mi ldan pa'i dang / ldan pa'i gang zag go /dang po ni/ gang zag gang yongs shes du dang ldan zhe na/ so so skye bo ni yongs shes dang yang ldan pa min te/ bral thob zag med dang / srid rtse'i phyogs nyams pa med pas so/ /gnyis pa la dngos dang / rtsod spong gnyis kyi dngos la gnyis te/ mthong lam pa dang / sgom lam pa la du ldan no/ /dang po ni/ mthong lam la gnas pa ni/ skad cig gsum pa'i tshe bral thob yod kyang srid rtse'i nyams pa med la/ lnga pa'i tshe de gnyis yod kyang rgyu gnyis bcom pa med pas mi ldan la/ kun 'byung la chos shes gcig dang / rjes shes gnyis dang / 'gog pa la chos shes gsum dang / rjes shes bzhi dang / lam la chos shes lnga'i bar dang yang dag ldan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgom lam la gnas pa ni/ chags bcas yin na dang po drug gam/ phyir mi 'ong gzugs khams las ma grol na/ tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa gcig gam yang de gzugs las grol na de dang / gzugs kyi 'dod chags zad pa gnyis dang ldan la/ dgra bcom pa ni tha ma gcig pu dang ldan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyir mi 'ong gzugs las ma grol ba dang / dgra bcom gyi yongs shes re re bzhag pa ci zhe na/

khams las 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'bras bu thob pa ste/ rgyu gnyis bsdoms pa na spangs pa rnams kyis bral thob pa so so btang nas gcig rnyed pa'i phyir spangs pa de rnams bsdoms te yongs shes gcig tu 'jog la/ rgyu de gnyis ka gang zag de gnyis la srid pas so/ /gang zag gang gi yongs shes du gtong ngam 'thob ce na/ phyir mi 'ong gzugs las ma grol ba'am/ dgra bcom pa nyams pa la gcig gtong ste/ des spangs pa sdom pa'i gcig las mi ldan pas so/ /phyir mi 'ong gzugs las grol ba/ 'dod pa'i chags bral las nyams na sngar ldan pa gnyis gtong ngo / /phyir mi 'ong chags bral sngon 'gro lam la rjes shes la gnas pa ni/ bdun po thob pa na snga ma lnga gtong la/ mthar gyi pas phyir mi 'ong thob pa na snga ma drug gtong ste/ 'thob pa ni lnga min zhes pas/ phyir mi 'ong gzugs las nyams na gcig dang / gzugs med las nyams na gnyis dang / 'dod pa'i chags bral las nyams na drug 'thob bo/ /chos mngon pa mdzod las/ phra rgyas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i gnas lnga pa'i 'grel pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa nyams len spyod pa lam dang gang zag bstan pa'i mdzod la/ lam gyi rnam gzhag gang zag gi rnam gzhag lam gyi khyad par gzhan bshad pa'i dang po la/ lam gyi ngo bo/ lam gyi dmigs pa/ lam sgom pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bden pa mngon du mngon pa'i mthong spangs dang / bsgoms pa las nyon mongs spang pa zhes bshad pa'i/ mthong lam dang sgom lam ji lta bu zhe na/ sgom lam la rnam pa gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam dang / 'jig rten las las 'das pa'i sgom lam gnyis/ 'jig rten pa'i sgom lam ni/ 'dod pa la chags par byed pa'i gong sa'i nyer bsdogs zhi rags can gyi rnam pa can dang / des thob pa'i dngos po dag pas so/ /mthong lam la 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbye ba med de/ mthong lam mtha' dag zag med mthong lam du nges pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa lam gyi dmigs pa la/ bden pa bzhi bshad pa dang / bden pa gnyis bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bden pa bzhi yod de/ sdug bsngal/ kun 'byung / 'gog pa/ lam gyi bden pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ 'di dag gi go rim ni gdul bya lam sgom pa la 'jug pa'i mngon rtogs kyi go rim yin te/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gi dang por sdug bsngal shes par byed/ de'i rjes su kun 'byung la spong 'dod kyi blo skye/ de'i rjes su sdug bsngal kun 'byung spangs pa'i 'gog pa la don gnyer gyi blo skye/ de nas lam rgyud la bsten byar shes par byed pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ khams gsum sdug bsngal du shes par byed pa'i mi 'thad de/ khams gsum sdug bsngal min pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ khams la sdug bsngal zhes bya ste/ yid du 'ong ba'i zag bcas la dmigs nas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ yid du mi 'ong la dmigs nas sdug bsngal kyi sdug bsngal de las gzhan pa'i zag bcas la dmigs nas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa bden pa gnyis bshad pa ni/ bum pa dang bum nang gi chu bzhin/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin par mtshon te/ 'joms byed tho ba la sogs pas bcom pa'am/ blos bsal zhing zhig pa na/ de 'dzin gyi blo 'dor ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /gzugs kyi rdul gzhan 'dzin/ don dam bden pa yin par mtshon te bcom pa'am blos zhig pa na der 'dzin gyi blo mi 'dor bar mdzad do/ gsum pa la/ lam la 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang / lam sgom tshul gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag lam sgom pa la 'jug pa la/ khyad chos bzhi dang ldan dgos te/ nges 'byung gis tshul khrims la gnas pa/ gsung rab mang du thos pa/ de'i don la rigs pa bzhi'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsam pa dang ldan pa/ de nyid la zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sgom pa la sogs pa'i khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa dgos pa'i phyir/

'o na thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab/ bsam byung gis shes rab/ sgom byung gis shes rab gsum gyi khyad par gang la byed ce na/ bye brag tu smra ba phal che ba rnams/ ming la dmigs pa'i shes rab/ ming don gnyis ka la dmigs pa'i shes rab/ don la dmigs pa'i shes rab dang gsum la rim bzhin du 'jog zer/ slob dpon rang gi lugs la/ thos pa bsam pa sgom pa las 'byung ba'i shes rab gsum la rim bzhin du bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la/ lam sgom pa po'i gang zag dang / sgom pa'i tshul gnyis/ 'dod pa che shing chog mi shes pa ni lam sgom pa po min no/ /'dod pa che ba dang chog mi shes pa'i khyad par gang la byed ce na/ bye brag tu smra ba phal che ba na re/ sngar rnyed pa'i zas gos la sred pa yang dang yang du skye ba ni chog shes pa dang / de nyid ma rnyed pa la don gnyer gyi 'dod pa ldan pa ni 'dod pa che ba'o/ /slob dpon rang gi lugs la/ rnyed pa chung ngu dang nyung ngu rnyed pa la yid mi bde ba ni chog mi shes pa yin/ gya nom pa rnyed pa la phyis don gnyer dang ldan pa ni 'dod pa che ba'o/ /gnyis po de la ldan pa'i yon tan ni de las zlog pa/ 'dod pa chung shing chog shes pa ni/ 'dod pa che zhing chog mi shes pa'i gnyen po yin/ de la dbye na bzhi ste/ khams gsum gyi sar gtogs gsum dang / dri med kyi 'dod pa chung shing chog shes dang bzhi'o/ /gsum pa la rigs kyi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ byed las/ grangs nges dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ srid pa dang srid pa'i yo byad la ma chags pa'i 'dod pa chung shing chog shes pa'i sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbye na bzhi ste/ chos gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa/ bsod snyoms ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa/ gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa/ spong ba dang sgom pa la rab tu dga' ba'i 'phags pa'i rigs dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dang po gsum gyis rigs kyis tshul bstan/

phyi mas rigs kyi byed las bstan no/ /bzhi pa ni/ sred pa bzhi'i gnyen por rigs rnam pa bzhi bstan te/ sred pa la chos gos la sred pa/ zas la sred pa/ gnas mal la sred pa/ rang rgyud kyi phung po la sred pa bzhi yod cing / rigs bzhi po des rim pa ltar sred pa bzhi 'joms pa'i phyir/ ji ltar 'joms na rigs dang po gsum gyis bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bdag gir 'dzin pa re zhig zhi bar byed/ phyi mas bdag gir 'dzin pa dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa gnyis ka gtan nas zhi ba ste slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byed do/ /gnyis pa la sgom tshul dngos la/ zhi gnas sgom tshul dang / lhag mthong sgom tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ zhi gnas sgom pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ mi sdug pa sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dbugs dbyung rngub dran pa sgom tshul gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de yang 'dod chags lhag par rgyas pa na/ mi sdug pa sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya ba yin te/ de'i 'dod chags 'joms par byed par byed pa'i phyir/ sems phyi rol du 'phro ba/ dbugs dbyung rngub dran pa bsgom dgos te/ des de 'joms pa'i phyir/ de yang sa gzhi keng rus kyis khyab pa la sogs pa la sogs pa'i mi sdug pa sgom pa ni/ 'dod chags thams cad kyi gnyen po yin te/ dang po la/ las dang po pa'i/ cung zad sbyang ba byas pa'i/ yid la byed pa'i rdzogs pa'i sgom tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ las dang po pas/ rang gis smin mtshams su rnag 'bur gcig sgoms la/ de nyid la rnag chu byung ste/ sha dang khrag zad nas rus par skya thal le bsgom/ de je cher song ste smin mtshams yan chad/ de nas mgrin pa yan chad/ de nas snying kha yan chad/ de nas gzugs po gang yod/ de nas 'khor dang yo byad sogs de nas bcud kyi sems can/ des mtshon pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad rus pa skya thal le yid du mi 'ong ba shin tu mi sdug par sgom pa ni/

rus pa rgya mtsho bar du spro ba'i tshul lo/ /sdud pa'i tshul ni gzhan rnams btang snyoms su bzhag rang gi lus mi sdug pa rus skya khrol bar sgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ cung zad sbyang ba byas pa'i gang zag gis/ spro ba sngar dang 'dra zhing / sdud pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying kha man chad sngar ltar sgom pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ shin tu sbyang ba byas pa'i gang zag gis spro ba sngar dang 'dra zhing / sdud pa ni/ gzhan rnams btang snyoms su bzhag nas smin ma'i bar du rus pa mthe bong tsam gcig tu dmigs te/ sems bzung nas spro shing sdud bar byed/ gnyis pa khyad chos ni/ mi sdug pa sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ma chags pa'i sems byung gcig la 'jog cing / sems kyi rten sa bcu'o/ /sa bcu ni/ 'dod sems bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs bzhi/ dngos gzhi bsam gtan dang po ba dang / khyad par can gnyis/ dngos gzhi lhag ma gsum ste bcu la byed/ de yang 'dod pa la dmigs shing mi'i rten la skyed par byed do/ /gnyis pa dbugs dbyung rngub dran pa sgom pa la yun gyi khyad par/ sgom tshul gyi khyad par/ yul gyi khyad par dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dbugs dbyung rngub dran pa'i ngo bo ni shes rab yin/ /sems rten sa lnga la rten/ sa lnga ni/ 'dod sems/ bsam gtan dang po gsum gyi nyer bsdogs gsum/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi khyad par can dang lnga'o/ /spyod yul ni rlung la dmigs shing 'dod pa'i rten yin/ 'di phyi rol pa la med de/ de'i man ngag med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bgrang ba la sogs pa rnam pa drug gis sgom par byed/ drug ni bgrang dang rjes 'gro 'jog pa dang / rtog dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / yongs su dag pa drug yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bgrang ba ni/ dbugs phyir rgyu ba/ nang du rngub pa/ gnas pa gsum la yid gtad de/ sgom par byed/ rjes su 'gro ba ni/ dbugs phyi nang du gnas pa'i yun tshad la yid gtad de/

sgom par byed/ 'jog pa ni/ lus la rlung myu gu'i ba thag ltar gnas pa la yid gtad de bsgom par byed/ rtog pa ni 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung so sor brtags ste sgom par byed/ yongs su sgyur ba ni/ snga ma rnams tshogs lam du sgom tshul yin zhing sbyor lam gyi gnas skabs su sngar gyi de dag bsgyur nas bsgom pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dbugs dbyung rngub de lus rten gang du skyes pa'i sa der gtogs la sems can gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa/ zin ma zin gnyis kyi nang nas ma zin pa'o/ /'byung ba gsum gyi nang nas rgyu mthun las byung / btsun pa dbyangs sgrog na re/ 'og ma'i yid kyis gong ma'i de 'dzin pa'i sems gnyis ka mi rtogs so zhes bzhed/ gnyis pa lhag mthong sgom pa'i tshul la/ dran pa nyer bzhag drod sogs bzhi/ bden pa mngon rtogs bcu drug sgom tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang / chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ zhi gnas grub pa'i gang zag gis lhag mthong dran pa nyer bzhag sgom par bya ste/ zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi shes rab kyis nyon mongs spong bar byed pa'i phyir/ de'i dmigs pa la/ lus/ tshor/ sems/ chos bzhi yod/ de dag rang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis gnyis yongs su brtags ste/ sgom par byed/ de la dbye na gsum ste/ rang bzhin 'brel pa/ dmigs pa/ dran par nyer bzhag go /dang po ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag tu gyur pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dag mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ de dag dmigs pa/ lus/ tshor/ sems/ chos bzhi'o/ /skye ba'i rim pa ni/ dang por/ lus dran pa nyer bzhag de nas tshor ba/ sems/ chos dran pa nyer bzhag sgom par bya ste/ snga ma snga ma skye sla ba'i phyir/ dgongs pa ni/ phyin ci log bzhi'i gnyen por bsgom ste/ lus la gtsang ba/ tshor ba la bde ba/ sems la rtag pa/

chos la bdag tu 'dzin pa la sogs phyin ci log bzhi rim bzhin 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chos dran pa nyer bzhag ni/ lus tshor/ sems la sogs pa thun mong ba la gnas te/ rnam pa ni mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ bdag med pa'i rnam par lta'o/ /gnyis pa drod sogs bzhi la/ go rim/ khyad chos/ zhar la theg gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ tshogs lam gyi dran pa nyer bzhag las sbyor lam dro bar 'gyur ba 'byung zhing / de ni bde ba'i spyod yul can/ mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can no/ /de las rtse mo 'byung zhing / de yang dmigs rnam snga ma dang 'dra ba'o/ /gnyis ka yang chos dran pa nyer bzhag gi ngo bor ldan zhing / lus dran pa nyer bzhag sogs gsum po dag gis kyang gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i grogs byed/ de las bzod pa chung ngu dang 'bring skye zhing / snga ma bzhin du/ dmigs pa/ rnam pa/ chos dran pa nyer bzhag gi ngo bo/ /gzhan rnams kyi 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /de nas bzod pa chen po 'byung zhing / skad cig ma gcig kho na yin/ de bzhin du chos mchog kyang 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs pa skad gcig ma gcig kho na yin/ sbyor lam gyi thob pa ni sbyor lam du ma gtogs te/ 'phags pa'i rgyud la sbyor lam gyi thob pa ldan pa yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar na nges 'byed cha mthun rnam pa bzhi yod de/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa khyad chos la/ ngo bo/ /rten gyi khyad par/ bral thob kyi khyad par/ de la ldan pa'i yon tan/ lam gzhan du 'jug tshul dang lnga/ dang po ni/ tshogs lam du thos bsam byas pa'i don sbyor lam du sgom par byed pas na sgom byung ngo / /gnyis pa la/ sems rten dang / lus rten gnyis/ dang po bsam gtan dang po'i nyer sdogs mi lcogs med/ de'i dngos gzhi tsam khyad gnyis/ bsam gtan lhag ma gsum ste/ bsam gtan sa drug go

/btsun pa dbyangs sgrog na re/ sbyor lam dang po gnyis ni/ 'og sa 'dod sems la rten pa yang yod pas sa bdun pa can du 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyor lam bzhi char yang 'dod pa'i rten can yin/ chos mchog bud med kyi rten la thob pa gnyis ka'i rten la thob ces bya'o/ /de'i don ni 'ga' zhig chos mchog thob ma thag skyes par mtshan 'gyur ba yin zhes bzhed/ gzhan ni/ bud med kyi rten la chos mchog thob pa na/ de ma thag mtshan 'gyur ba yin gyis/ de nas skye ba len pa na bud med du skye ba len par byed/ gsum pa bral thob kyi khyad par ni/ sbyor lam gyi thob pa 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod na/ de gtong tshul ji lta bu yin nam zhe na/ 'phags pas sa bor nas te/ sa 'phos pa'i dbang gis gtong / 'phags pa min pa rnams 'chi 'phos pa'i dbang gis gtong / de la yang gtong tshul gnyis te/ yongs nyams dang rnam nyams so/ /dang po ni/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis thob pa'i gtong pa la byed/ de yang nyer bsdogs la rten pa rnams la yin gyis/ dngos gzhi la brten nas sbyor lam thob pa la ni/ yongs nyams med de/ rten de nyid la bden pa mngon rtogs thob par 'gyur bas so/ /rnam par nyams pa ni/ shi 'phos pa'i dbang gis thob pa btang ste sngon med pa'i thob pa ldan pa'o/ /dper na bzod pa 'bring po la gnas pa'i gang zag shi 'phos pa'i tshe/ che 'bring chung gsum dang / rtse mo chung ngu'i thob pa btang nas/ rtse mo chen po'i thob pa mngon du byed pa bzhin no/ /des na nyams pa gnyis ni thob pa mi ldan pa'o/ /bzhi pa de la ldan pa'i yon tan ni/ rtse mo thob nas dge rtsa rgyun mi chad pa'o/ /'o na gong du sbyor lam dang po gnyis la yongs nyams bshad pa dang 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/ snga ma ni lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dge rtsa yin la 'di ni rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs su gyur pa'i dge rtsa'o/ /bzod pa thob nas ngan song du 'gro ba med do/

/lnga pa ni/ drod rtse gnyis thob nas slob pa nyan thos kyi rigs las ldog nas theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs te/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yod do/ /bzod pa 'bring thob nas rang rgyal lam du 'jug pa yod kyis/ bzod pa thob nas theg chen lam du 'jug pa ni med de/ theg chen gyi gang zag gzhan don du ngan 'gror skye ba len/ bzod pa thob nas ngan 'gror skye ba med pa'i phyir/ bzod pa chen po thob nas lam gzhan du 'jug pa med de/ bzod chen dang / chos mchog gnyis ka skad cig ma re re yin pas de ma thag 'phags lam du 'jug de nas lam gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa theg pa gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul ni/ ston pa byang chub sems dpa' nges 'byed cha mthun gyi snga rol du thar pa cha mthun skyed de/ der bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ drod nas zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub kyi bar stan thog gcig la mngon du byed/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyang / dang por thar pa cha mthun skyed der bskal pa brgyad tshogs bsags/ de nas drod nas zad mi skye shes pa'i bar stan thog gcig la mngon du byed par nus so/ /nyan thos dbang po shin tu myur bas srid pa gsum gyi mthar rang gi byang chub mngon du byed par nus de yang tshogs lam tshe gcig 'phags lam tshe gcig la bgrod par nus so/ /nges 'byed cha mthun gyi gong du thar pa cha mthun skyed na/ thar pa cha mthun gyi ngo bo gang la byed snyam na/ ngo bo ni/ thos pa dang / bsam pa las byung ba yin zhing / dbye na lus ngag yid gsum gyi las gsum yod do/ /de yang mi'i nang nas 'phen par byed pa ste mi'i rten la skye ba yin no/ /gsum pa bden pa mngon par rtogs pa bcu drug gi sgom tshul la/ gong rim/ sa'i khyad par/ shes bzod kyi khyad par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i chos mchog las chos kyi bzod pa 'byung zhing /

de nas sa gnyis pa'i ye shes ma skyes gong gi zag med kyi ye shes la mthong lam du 'jog 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal las dmigs pas chos bzod/ de las dmigs pa'i chos shes de 'byung shing / de bzhin du sdug bsngal lhag ma khams gong ma'i sdug bsngal la dmigs pas sdug bsngal rjes bzod 'byung / de nas khams gong gi de la dmigs pa'i rjes shes de byung / de bzhin du bden pa lhag ma de ji lta ba bzhin 'byung ngo / /de ltar na bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i sems bcu drug yod de/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i yul ni chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes dang bzhi/ kun 'byung bden pa'i yul ni de bzhi/ lam bden gyi yul ni de bzhi ste bcu drug tu yod pa'i phyir/ de la mngon par rtogs pa'i rigs gsum ste/ mthong ba mngon rtogs/ dmigs pa mngon rtogs/ bya ba mngon rtogs gsum du yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ bden bzhi'i yul gyi zag med kyi ye shes bcu drug go /gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa la sogs bcu drug go /gsum pa ni/ ye shes de dag gis sdug bsngal shes byar/ kun 'byung spang bya/ 'gog pa mngon du bya/ lam rgyud la bsten byar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa bcu drug po de ni chos mchog dang sa mtshungs te/ sdug bsngal chos bzod ni/ chos mchog la brten nas de dang sa mtshungs la/ sdug bsngal chos bzod nas bzung ste/ mngon rtogs bcu drug po de bar ma chad par skye ba'i sa 'pho ba'i skabs mi srid pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bar chad med lam rnams la bzod pa dang / rnam grol lam rnams la shes par 'jog go /'o na skad cig bcu drug pa de dag mthong lam yin nam sgom lam yin zhe na/ skad cig ma dang po bco lnga po mthong lam yin te/ sngar ma mthong ba'i gnas lugs kyi don gsar du mthong ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ skad cig ma bcu drug pa de sgom lam yin te/

gnas lugs kyi don mthong zin sgom par byed pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gang zag sa'i rnam gzhag la/ zhugs 'bras kyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ nang tshan gyi sgo nas bdun du dbye/ gang zag gi sgo nas rigs drug tu bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ rgyun zhugs dang chags bral sngon song gi rnam gzhag dang / 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs cung zad kyang ma spangs pa'am/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs lnga pa'i bar ci rigs su gyur pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs skad cig bco lnga la gnas pa'i nyan thos la/ dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang / dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis su yod cing / de rgyun zhugs zhugs pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad pa ni/ dbang po rno rtul de dag tu/ zhes pa nas rnam lnga'i bar bcom ces pa'i bar ro/ /des lam rjes shes kyi rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas su 'jog zhes 'chad pa ni/ gang zhig gang la zhugs pa ni/ bcu drug la ni de'i 'bras gnas/ zhes pas ston/ dbang rnon mthong bas thob pa dang / dbang rtul dad pa'i mos pa gnyis yod/ zhes 'chad pa ni/ de'i tshe zhes sogs tshig gnyis kyis bstan/ des phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson par mi byed pa'i phyir 'ong zhugs par mi 'jog go /zhes 'chad pa ni/ 'bras thob 'bras bu'i zhes sogs tshig bzhis bstan/ sbyor ba rim bzhin du 'dod nyon drug pa ma spangs pa'i mthong lam skad cig bco lnga gang rung la gnas pa'i nyan thos chen po/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa yin te/ 'dod nyon drug pa ma spangs shing mthong lam skad cig bco lnga gang rung la gnas pa dang / rang gi 'bras gnas su gyur pa'i rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i phyir du brtson pa'i gzhi mthun du gyur pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis su yod de/ khyod la dbye na dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang /

dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gang zhig chos sogs tshig gnyis la 'dod nyon drug pa ma spangs pa'i drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i nyan thos chos can/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas yin te/ 'dod nyon drug pa ma spangs shing / bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ de tshe zhes sogs tshig gnyis la/ yang de chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis su yod de/ khyed la dbye na/ dbang rtul dad pa'i mos pa dang / dbang rnon mthong ba'i thob pa gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras thob ces sogs tshig bzhi la/ yang de chos can/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa min te rang gis 'bras gnas su gyur pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi rtogs pa thob phyir du brtson pa'i nyan thos ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'dod nyon drug pa spangs dgu pa ma spangs pa'i mthong lam skad cig bco lnga la gnas pa'i nyan thos de la/ dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang / dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis yod cing / de nyid la chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs par 'jog go /zhes ston pa ni/ dbang po rno rtul de dag tu/ dad dang chos kyi rjes 'brang ba/ gnyis pa la/ dgu pa tshun chad zad pa yin/ zhes pas bstan no/ /de bcu drug pa lam rjes shes kyi rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong 'bras gnas su 'jog go /ces ston pa ni/ gang zhig zhes sogs tshig gnyis so/ /de la dbye na dbang rtul dad pa'i mos pa dang / dbang rnon mthong ba'i thob pa gnyis su yod/ ces 'chad pa ni/ de tshe zhes sogs tshig gnyis po/ de nyid phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob phyir du mi brtson pas phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa min te/ 'dod nyon drug pa spangs dgu pa ma spangs shing mthong lam skad cig bco lnga gang rung la gnas pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis su yod de/

khyod la dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang / dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ gang zhig ces sogs tshig gnyis la/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i 'dod nyon drug pa spangs dgu pa ma spangs pa'i nyan thos chos can/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong 'bras gnas yin te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ de tshe zhes sogs tshig gnyis la yang / de chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ khyod la dbang rtul dad pa'i mos pa dang / dbang rnon mthong ba'i thob pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras thob ces sogs tshig bzhi la yang / de chos can phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa yin te phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson pa'i lam rang rgyud la ma thob pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs shing / srid nyon ma spangs pa'i mthong lam skad cig bco lnga la gnas pa'i nyan thos de la dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang / dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis su yod cing / chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad pa ni/ dbang po rno rtul de dag tu/ /dad dang chos kyi rjes 'brang ba/ /'dod pa'am yang na gong ma las/ /chags bral gsum po la zhugs pa/ /zhes pas bstan/ de bcu drug pa lam rjes shes kyis rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas su 'jog zhes 'chad pa ni/ gang zhig ces sogs tshig gnyis kyis bstan/ de la dbye na/ dad mos/ mthong thob gnyis su yod/ ces 'chad pa ni/ de tshe zhes sogs tshig gnyis kyis bstan/ de nyid dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du mi brtson pas na/ dgra bcom zhugs pa min zhes ston pa ni/ 'bras thob ces sogs tshig bzhis bstan no/ /de la sbyor ba bkod ni/ sngar ltar go rim bzhin du 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs/ srid nyon ma spangs pa'i mthong lam skad cig bco lnga la gnas pa'i nyan thos chos can/

chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa yin te/ rang gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye ba gnyis te/ dad pa dang / chos kyi rjes su 'brang bas so/ /'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i nyan thos chos can/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas yin te/ chos can de'i phyir/ de la dbye na gnyis te/ dad mos/ mthong thob gnyis so/ /yang de chos can/ dgra bcom zhugs pa chen po yin te/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du mi brtson pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la spang bya spong tshul dang / zhugs gnas kyi rnam gzhag dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa dang / zhes sogs la/ spang bya spong tshul gyi rnam gzhag 'jog na/ spang bya spong tshul ji lta bu yin zhe na/ spyir 'khor ba'i sa de la rnam pa dgu yod de/ 'dod khams sa gcig bsam gtan gyi sa bzhi/ gzugs med sa bzhi ste dgur yod pa'i phyir/ des na dgu po de dag gi bsdus pa'i nyes pa rnam pa dgu dgu ste/ sgom spang brgyad cu rtsa gcig dang / de'i gnyen po yon tan brgyad cu rtsa gcig spang gnyen du ldan pa'i sgo nas rim pa bzhin du spong bar byed sgom spang sa dgus bsdus pa'i sgom spang nyon mongs dgu/ de re re la rtsa ba'i sgo nas chung ngu gnyis pa la rgyun zhugs zhugs gnas phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong / dgra bcom zhugs gnas te bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po bshad zin/ gnyis pa la/ tsam khyad gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyun chags srid pa lan bdun pa chos can/ khyod la/ spangs pa/ rtogs pa/ skye ba len tshul gyi khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ spangs pa'i khyad par/ mthong spang nyon mongs zad par spangs shing / sgom spang nyon mongs cung zad kyang ma spangs pa/ rtogs pa'i khyad par lam rjes shes pa/

skye ba len tshul gyi khyad par/ 'dod khams su rigs mthun kyi skye ba bdun len par nges pa'i khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod nyon gsum pa spangs lnga pa ma spangs pa'i rgyun zhugs rigs gnas pa'i rigs skyes chos can/ khyod la spangs pa/ rtogs pa/ skye ba len tshul gyi khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ spangs pa'i khyad par 'dod nyon gsum pa spangs/ lnga pa ma spangs/ rtogs pa'i khyad par 'dod nyon gsum pa spangs pa'i lam zag med kyi dbang po thob pa/ skye ba len tshul gyi khyad par/ 'dod par rigs mthun gyi skye srid gnyis len par nges pa'i khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa phyir 'ong zhugs gnas la/ zhugs pa dang / 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pa'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i nyan thos chos can/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa yin te/ rigs 'bras gnas su gyur pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi rtogs pa thob phyir du brtson pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ tsam/ khyad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rnam pa zhes sogs la/ 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam la gnas bzhin pa'i nyan thos chos can/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po ba yin te/ chos can de'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyes cha bdun nam zhes sogs la/ phyir 'ong tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa chos can/ khyod spangs rtogs skye ba len tshul/ khyad chos gsum dang ldan te/ 'dod nyon bdun pa spangs shing dgu pa ma spangs pa dang / 'dod nyon bdun pa spangs pa'i lam zag med kyi dbang po thob pa dang / 'dod khams su skye srid gcig len par nges pa'i khyad chos gsum ldan yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phyir mi 'ong zhugs 'bras la zhugs pa dang / 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po ni 'dod nyon dgu pa spong ba'i bar chad med lam la gnas bzhin pa'i nyan thos chos can/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa yin te/ rigs 'bras gnas su gyur pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras kyi rtogs pa thob phyir du brtson pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i nyan thos sgom lam pa chos can/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas yin te/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i nyan thos slob pa 'bras gnas yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gzugs su nyer 'gro/ gzugs med du nyer 'gro/ mthong thob zhi tshe/ tshe yongs gyur/ lus mngon byed dang lnga/ dang po la/ rtsa ba'i sgo nas lngar dbye/ yan lag gi sgo nas dgur dbye/ de dag gi khyad par/ skyes bu dam pa'i 'gro ba yongs su bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de ni bar skyes zhes sogs tshig drug la/ gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong lnga ste/ 'da' ba bzhi/ gong 'pho gcig dang lngar yod pa'i phyir/ 'da' ba la bzhi yod de/ bar 'da' ba/ skyes tsam nas 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed dang bcas pa/ mngon par 'du byed med par mya ngan las 'da' ba dang bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ gong 'pho la yang gnyis te/ bsam gtan spel sgom gyi 'og min mthar thug 'gro dang / srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro ba gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ 'og min mthar thug 'gro ba gsum ste/ 'phar ba/ phyed 'phar/ gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba gsum du yod pa'i phyir/ tshangs chen dang gnas gtsang ma lnga ma gtogs gzugs gzugs med kyi gnas rnams rim gyis 'gro ste/ srid rtse'i rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong chos can/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro ba yin te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gsum la yang / zhes sogs tshig gnyis la/ gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong la/ yan lag gi sgo nas dbye na dgu yod de/ bar 'da' ba la/ myur ba 'da'/ myur ba ma yin par 'da' ba/ dus ring mo zhig nas 'da' ba/ skyes 'da' ba la skyes tsam nas 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed med par 'da' ba/ de dang bcas te 'da' ba/ gong 'pho ba la 'phar ba/ phyed 'phar/ gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba dang dgur yod pa'i phyir/

gsum pa de dag gi khyad par la/ bar 'da' ba/ skyes 'da' ba/ gong 'pho gsum pa ste/ las kyi khyad par dang ldan te/ bar 'da' ba gzugs mngon par 'grub pa'i las can/ skyes 'da' ba gzugs kyi skye gnas myong 'gyur gyi las can/ gong 'pho gzugs kyi lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las can yin pa'i phyir/ de gsum dbang po'i rim bzhin du dbang po rno ba/ 'bring ba rtul ba yin pa'i phyir/ bar 'da' ba/ skyes 'da' ba/ gong 'pho gsum/ nyon mongs kyi khyad par dang ldan te/ nyon mongs phra ba/ 'bring ba/ che ba gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ skyes bu dam pa'i 'gro ba la bdun du yod de/ bar 'da' ba/ skyes 'da' ba gsum/ gong 'pho la so sor ma phye bar gcig ste bdun du yod pa'i phyir/ dam pa ni/ dge ba/ dam min mi dge ba/ des na dge ba la 'jug mi dge ba la mi 'jug pas na dam pa'o/ /'gro ba ni gzugs su nye bar 'gro ba ste/ des na dam pa yin na dam pa'i 'gro ba yin pas khyab ste/ 'di'i 'gro ba ni gzugs su nye bar 'gro bar yin par rang 'grel du bshad pa'i phyir/ de yang dam pa'i 'gro ba de/ da lta 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs shing / dge ba la 'jug cing mi dge ba la mi 'jug pas na/ de la nyon mongs mi srid pa yin la/ de'i phyir son pa phyir mi 'ong zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa gzugs med nyer 'gro ni/ gzhan gyi gzugs med 'gro rnams bzhi/ zhes pa ni/ gzugs med du nyer 'gro bzhi ste/ skyes 'da' ba gsum/ gong 'pho'i ming can dang bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mthong chos bzhi ni/ gzhan ni 'di la mya ngan 'da'/ zhes pas bstan zhing / mthong lam thob pa'i tshe 'di nyid la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i phyir mi 'ong ba la/ mthong chos bzhi zhes bshad do/ /bzhi pa tshe yongs gyur phyir mi 'ong la dngos dang / zhar byung bsam gtan spel sgom bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod par tshe yongs gyur gyi phyir mi 'ong khams gzhan du 'gro ba med par/

'dod pa'i rten la mya ngan 'das mngon du byed/ gzugs kyi tshe yongs gyur gyi phyir mi 'ong khams gzhan du 'gro ba med de/ srid pa'i mthar thug 'gro yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi tshe yongs gyur ni/ khams gzhan du 'gro ba med/ des na tshe yongs gyur gyi phyir mi 'ong la gsum ste/ 'dod gzugs/ gzugs med kyi tshe yongs gyur gyi phyir mi 'ong dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ des na 'dod pa'i tshe yongs gyur gyi phyir mi 'ong dang / khams gong ma'i tshe yongs gyur gyi 'bras bu las nyams pa med cing / dbang po 'pho ba med pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ spel sgom byed pa'i tshul/ spel ba grub pa'i tshad/ byas pa'i dgos pa/ spel sgom gyi 'bras bu dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dang por bsam gtan bzhi pa'i spel sgom byed de/ de zhig cha mnyam pas spel sla ba'i phyir/ de yang spel sgom gyi sbyor ba dang / spel sgom dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ chung ngu gsum spel/ 'bring drug spel ba dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ zag med skad cig ma gnyis bar du zag bcas skad cig ma gcig spel nas sgom/ 'bring drug spel ba ni/ zag med skad cig ma bzhi'i bar du zag bcas skad cig ma gnyis spel nas sgom/ dngos gzhi la chen po dgu'i spel/ shin tu chen po bcu gnyis spel/ shin tu ches chen po bco lnga spel ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ zag med skad cig ma drug gi bar du zag bcas skad cig ma gsum spel te sgom/ gnyis pa ni/ zag med skad cig ma brgyad kyi bar du zag bcas skad cig ma bzhi spel te sgom/ gsum pa ni/ zag med skad cig ma bcu gnyis bar du zag bcas skad cig ma lnga spel te sgom/ gnyis pa grub tshad ni/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma gcig la zag med skad cig ma bcu dang / zag bcas skad cig ma lnga spel te sgom nus pa ni/ grub pa'i tshad yin/ zhes bye brag smra ba spyi pa 'dod/ slob dpon ni de ltar ma nges te/

de 'dra'i nus pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa la med pa'i phyir/ zag med rgyun ldan pa lnga spel nas/ sbyor ba thun gcig gi nang du bar ma chad du sgom nus pa ni/ shin tu ches chen po bco lnga spel ba grub pa'i tshad/ gsum pa ni phyir mi 'ong rnams gnas gtsang mar skye ba len pa'i phyir du spel sgom byed/ dgra bcom pa dbang po rnon po rnams mthong chos la bder gnas las mi nyams pa'i phyir du sgom par byed/ dbang rtul rnams nyon mongs pa'i 'jigs pa brgyad ring du bya ba'i phyir du sgom par byed/ bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ spel sgom lnga'i 'bras bu rim bzhin gnas gtsang ma lngar skyes pa yin/ lnga pa lus mngon byed ni/ 'gog snyoms thob pa'i phyir mi 'ong chos can/ phyir mi 'ong lus mngon byed yin te/ sems med pa'i lus kyis 'gog snyoms mngon sum du byas pa'i phyir mi 'ong yin pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyis lus kyi 'gog snyoms mngon du byed pas na/ lus mngon byed ces bshad do/ /bzhi pa dgra bcom zhugs gnas la zhugs pa dang / 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po ni/ srid nyon brgyad man chad zad dgu spong ba'i bar chad med lam la gnas bzhin pa'i phyir mi 'ong chos can/ dgra bcom zhugs pa yin te/ rang gi 'bras gnas su gyur pa'i dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi rtogs pa thob phyir du brtson pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ bar chad med lam de la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste/ phra rgyas nyon mongs pa mtha' dag spong ba'i nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa/ khyad chos rgyas par bshad pa/ 'bras gnas kyi dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ srid nyon dgu pa zad pa'i bral thob dang zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa thob pa de'i tshe/ mi slob pa dgra bcom par 'jog gnyis pa la chags bral gyi rnam gzhag dang / dge sbyong tshul 'bras kyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ lam gang gis chags pa dang bral ba/

bral thob skye ba'i tshul/ sa gang gis chags pa dang bral ba/ lam gyi dmigs rnam dang bzhi/ dang po ni 'jig rten 'das kyis zhes sogs la chags bral gyi stobs kyis bral thob 'jog na/ lam gang gis gang la chags pa dang bral ba yin zhe na/ srid rtse las 'das lam kho na'i chags bral byed dgos te/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis de la chags bral byed pa med pa'i phyir/ srid rtse la chags bral byed pa'i gong sa'i nyer bsdogs dag pa ba med pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan ci yang med man chad la/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis kas chags bral byed pa yod de/ gong sa'i nyer bsdogs dag pa pas/ 'og ma la chags bral byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten pa yis zhes sogs la/ lam gang gis chags bral byas pa'i stobs kyis bral thob gang skye ba yin snyam na/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi chags bral byas pa'i tshe/ bral thob zag bcas zag med gnyis ka skye ba yod/ 'phags lam zag med kyis chags bral byas pa'i bral thob zag med kho na skye ba yin/ de la mngon pa ba kha cig 'jig rten las 'das lam gyis chags bral byas pa'i tshe bral thob zag bcas skye ba yod de/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i phyir mi 'ong dbang rtul dbang rnon du 'phos pa'i tshe bral thob zag bcas dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ de'i tshe dbang po 'phos pa dang / dbang rtul gyis bsdus pa'i bral thob zag med btang la/ 'dod nyon dgu pa mi ldan pa'i phyir snyam na/ de 'gog pa ni/ srid rtse'i zhes sogs la srid nyon brgyad pa spangs pa'i phyir mi 'ong dbang rtul dbang rnon du 'phos pa'i tshe/ bral thob zag bcas dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i dbang po 'phos pas bral thob zag med btang / srid nyon brgyad pa dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / 'dod pa'i rten gyis phyir mi 'ong bsam gtan dang por skyes pa'i tshe/ bral thob zag bcas dang ldan par 'gyur te/

de'i tshe bral thob zag med btang / 'dod nyon dgu pa mi ldan pa'i phyir/ sa gang gis chags pa dang bral ba ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med zag med kyi gong sa 'og sa thams cad la chags bral byed par de'i shugs las nyer bsdogs dag pa bas 'og sa la chags bral byed kyis gong sa la chags bral mi nus so/ /'o na nyer bsdogs kyis chags bral byas ma thag dngos gzhi mngon du 'gyur ram snyam na/ 'dod pa bsam gtan dang po/ bsam gtan gnyis pas te/ sa gsum las rgyal te/ chags bral byas pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi de ma thag bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi mngon du gyur pa yod cing / nyer bsdogs dang rnam grol gyi gzhi mthun yang yod de/ de gsum gyi nyer bsdogs ni tshor ba btang snyoms dang mtshungs par ldan zhing / dngos gzhi dga' bde ci rigs pa dang ldan par yod pas tshor ba 'pho ma thub pa srid la/ de las gong ma bsam gtan bzhi pa yan chad kyi nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi ni/ tshor ba btang snyoms dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi de ma thag dngos gzhi mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /'o na nyer bsdogs kho na'i chags bral byed pa yin nam zhe na/ ma nges te zag med kyis dngos gzhi brgyad kyis rang sa gong sa la chags bral byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ dngos gzhi brgyad ni bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam khyad gnyis/ bsam gtan phyi ma gsum gzugs med dang po gsum gyi dngos gzhi brgyad la byed do/ /bzhi pa dmigs rnam la/ dngos dang dkyus ma gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa yi zhes sogs la/ 'og sa la chags pa dang bral zin pa'i snyoms 'jug dag pa rnams ni 'jig rten pa'i rnam grol lam/ de la chags bral byed bzhin pa'i snyoms 'jug dag pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i bar chad med lam yin la/ dang po ni/ gong sa dmigs nas zhi ba'i rnam pa can/ gnyis pa ni/ 'og sa la dmigs nas rags pa'i rnam pa can yin/ gnyis pa ni/

dgra bcom pa rnams kyis khyad chos gsum ste/ zad pa shes pa/ mi skye ba shes pa/ mi slob pa yang dag pa'i lta ba gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i shes rab/ gnyis pa ni/ de las nyams pa mi srid pa'i shes rab/ de yang dgra bcom pa dbang rnon mi g.yo ba rnams ni/ gnyis ka dang ldan/ dbang rtul rnams ni dang po ldan/ dgra bcom pa thams cad kyang / zad pa shes pa dang / mi slob pa yang dag pa'i lta ba gnyis dang ldan no/ /gnyis pa dge sbyong tshul 'bras kyi rnam gzhag la/ ngo bo dbye ba dang bcas pa/ dogs dpyod/ 'grub tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dge sbyong gi tshul ni zag med bar ched med lam mo/ /de'i 'bras bu la rtsa ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ 'dus byas rnam grol lam dang / 'dus ma byas 'gog pa'i bden pa gnyis/ yan lag gi sgo nas dbye na/ brgyad bcu rtsa dgu yod de/ spang bya de la mthong spang brgyad/ sgom spang brgyad cu rtsa gcig ste/ brgyad cu rtsa dgur yod/ de la grol ba'i rnam grol lam la brgyad cu rtsa dgu/ de spangs pa'i 'gog bden yang brgyad cu rtsa dgur yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de mi 'thad de mdo las/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong / phyir mi 'ong / dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu dang bzhir bshad pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon de med de/ mdo las 'bras bu la bzhir bzhag pa ni/ khyad chos lnga ldan gyi dbang du byas pa'i phyir/ khyad chos lnga ni/ zhugs lam sngon du song ba/ 'bras gnas kyi rtogs pa thob pa/ mthong spang nyon mongs pa zad par spangs pa/ mthong lam chos shes/ rjes shes la sogs pa'i shes pa brgyad tshan thob pa/ bden bzhi mi rtag pa la sogs pa bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa slob pa'o/ /kho na re/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong gi rgyud la bral thob zag med kyi thob pa 'dzin pa'i phyir/

dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu de nyid la/ tshangs tshul zhes kyang bya/ tshangs pa'i 'khor lo zhes kyang bya ste/ tshangs pa dang tshul mtshungs pa'i ston pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba las byung ba'i phyir/ des na bye brag tu smra ba spyi'i lugs la/ mthong lam la chos 'khor zhes bya ste/ rgyal po 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ rgyal po'i 'khor lo de yul gzhan du myur du 'gro bar byed/ mnga' 'bangs ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba dang / rgyal ba gong 'phel du byed/ yul mtho ba las 'phar/ dma' las 'bab par byed pa bzhin du/ mthong lam skad cig bco lnga bar ma chad du skye ba dang / mthong spang nyon mongs pa gsar pa rnams spong ba dang / spangs pa'i rtogs pa gong 'phel du byed/ khams gong ma la dmigs nas 'phar/ 'og ma la dmigs nas 'bab bar byed pa'i phyir/ btsun pa dbyangs sgrog na re/ mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'phags lam brgyad pa la chos 'khor zhes bya ste/ rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rgyal pos 'khor lo rin po che la brten par byed pa'i lte ba/ sdud par byed pa'i mu khyud/ gcod par byed pa'i rtsibs gsum dang ldan pa bzhin du/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po de yang bsdu na/ bslab pa gsum du 'du zhing / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni/ brten par byed pa'i lte ba dang chos mtshungs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa ni/ sdud par byed pa'i mu khyud dang chos mtshungs/ shes rab kyi bslab pa ni gcod par byed pa'i rtsibs dang tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa thob tshul ni/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong / phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu ni/ sngar med gsar du skye bar 'dod pa'i rten la thob/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu sngar med gsar du thob par 'dod pa'i rten la 'dod/ dgra bcom 'bras bu ni/ sngar med gsar du skye ba khams gsum ka'i rten la thob pa yin te/

dang po gsum ni/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rten la thob dgos/ bar pa gnyis/ mthong lam la lam rjes bzod la brten nas thob dgos/ de 'dod pa'i rten can du nges/ phyi ma ni/ 'dod pa gzugs/ gzugs med gsum gyi rten la thob pa'i phyir/ mthong lam la lam rjes bzod rten du nges te/ khams gong gi rten la de skye ba med pa'i phyir te/ khams gong du snyoms 'jug gi bde ba la chags nas 'phags lam rten par byed pa'i yid skyo shas drag po ldan pa de med pa'i phyir/ des na phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu sngar med gsar thob 'dod pa'i rten la nges kyis/ thob zin gnas pa khams gong gi rten la yang yod de/ mdo las/ bar ma do yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba nas gong du 'pho bas bar lnga ni 'dod pa'i khams 'dir rtsoms shig khams gong mar de mthar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi dbye ba la/ mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas drug tu dbye/ 'bras bu las nyams pa yod med dpyad/ dbang po 'pho ba'i tshul/ dgra bcom pa dgur yod tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas la drug ste/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can/ 'chi bar sems pa'i chos can/ rjes su bsrung ba'i chos can/ gnas pa las gzhan du mi bskyod pa dang / rtogs pa'i skal ba can dang / mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ dang po lnga la/ dad pas mos pa las skye ba zhes bya ste/ dbang rtul yin pa'i phyir/ de dag la dus sbyor gyi dgra bcom pa zhes bya ste/ rnam grol gyi ting nge 'dzin gong nas gong du 'phel ba/ nad med pa sogs kyi dus la ltos pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can la mi g.yo ba zhes bya ste/ 'gal rkyen gyis rigs 'bras bu la g.yo bar mi nus pa'i phyir/ dus sbyor zhes kyang bya ste/ rnam grol gyi ting nge 'dzin ni mngon du byed pa nad med pa sogs kyis dus la mi ltos pa'i phyir/

mthong thob kyi rgyu las byung ba zhes bya ste/ dbang rnon kho na la yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na dgra bcom pa drug po 'di dag dang po nyid ni rigs so sor nges pa yin nam/ dbang po sbyangs pa las rigs so sor nges pa yin snyam na/ kha cig dang po nyid nas dgra bcom pa drug po de'i rigs so sor nges te/ slob pa la de drug gi rigs can drug 'phags pa ma yin pa'i so so skye bo la yang de'i rigs can du so sor nges pa'i phyir/ kha cig dbang po sbyangs pa las de drug gi rigs can du 'gyur ba yod de/ sgom pa'i dbang po sbyangs pa las de drug gi rigs can gong nas gong du 'pho ba yod/ so so skye bo la yang 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi ngang nas dbang po'i pho ba ni med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgra bcom pa bar pa bzhi ni rang gi rigs las nyams pa yod de/ rang gi rigs las nyams nas 'og ma 'og mar 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ dang po lnga ni/ 'bras bu las nyams pa yod de/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu las nyams nas phyir mi 'ong du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu las nyams pa med de/ de 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis kyis brtan par byas pa'i phyir/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can la ni rigs las nyams pa med de/ de las rigs dma' ba'i dgra bcom pa med pa'i phyir/ nyams pa'i tshul la/ thob pa las nyams pa/ ma thob pa las nyams pa/ nyer spyad las nyams pa/ nyams pa gsum yod cing / ston pa sangs rgyas ni/ nyer spyad las nyams pa zhes bya ste/ slob lam rnams thob byar mngon du mi byed pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can ni/ nyer spyad dang ma thob pa gnyis las nyams/ dang po yin te/ gong de'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ rang rgyud la ma thob pa'i mngon du bya rgyu'i yon tan du ma yod pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom pa bar pa bzhi ni/ rnam pa gsum ka las nyams pa yin no/ /dgra bcom pa bzhi ni/

dang po gnyis yin te/ gong gi de'i phyir/ thob pa las nyams pa yod pa yin te/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu las nyams nas phyir mi 'ong du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na dgra bcom pa 'khor bar skye ba len pa yod par thal/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu la nyams pa yod pa'i phyir zhe na skyon med de/ de ni 'bras bu la nyams pa sor ma chud bar du 'chi ba med pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu dang 'gal ba'i bya ba ma yin pa'i spyod pa mi byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dbang po 'pho ba'i tshul ni/ dgra bcom pa 'og ma rnams mi g.yo ba'i chos can du 'pho ba'i tshe/ bar chad med lam dgu dang / rnam grol lam dgu la brten nas 'pho ste/ de 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis bsten bya'i 'pho dka' ba'i phyir/ 'di'i bar chad med lam ni/ dbang po 'pho phyir du sbyor ba'i brtson pa byed pa dang / rnam grol lam ni/ de mi byed pa la bzhag na legs gsung ngo / /dad mos mthong thob tu 'pho ba'i tshe/ bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam re re la brten nas 'pho/ 'di'i lam ni zag med yin cing / dbang po 'pho ba de yang mi'i nang du 'pho bar byed/ dgra bcom pa 'pho ba'i tshe/ zag med sa dgu pa la brten nas 'pho/ slob pa 'pho ba'i tshe/ brtan pa drug la brten nas so/ /dbang po 'pho ba'i tshul de yang dbang rtul gyis bsdus pa'i 'bras bu khyad par can btang ste/ dbang rnon gyis bsdus pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni dgra bcom pa dbang po'i sgo nas dgur yod de/ rang sangs rgyas dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ gnyis dang / nyan thos bdun te dgur yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ sngar bshad pa'i dgra bcom 'bras gnas dang po lnga dang / mi g.yo ba'i chos can la dbang po 'pho ba'i mi g.yo ba'i chos can dang / dang po nyid nas rigs nges pa'i de gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gang zag gi sgo nas bdun du dbye ba ni/

gang zag gi sgo nas bdun du yod de/ sbyor ba'i sgo nas dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang / chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis yod/ dbang po'i sgo nas dad mos mthong thob gnyis/ snyoms 'jug gi sgo nas lus mngon byed rnam grol gyi sgo nas shes rab rkyang pa'i cha las rnam grol ba/ gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba'i dgra bcom dang bdun yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gang zag gi rigs drug tu bsdu ba ni/ gang zag gi de dag kyang bsdu na drug tu bsdus te/ de dag bsdus na/ mthong lam pa/ sgom lam pa/ mi slob lam pa gsum du yod cing / dang po thams cad dad pa dang chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis su bsdus/ gnyis pa thams cad dad mos mthong thob gnyis su bsdus/ gsum pa thams cad dus sbyor dus mi sbyor gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir/ 'o na gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba dang / shes rab rkyang pa'i cha las rnam par grol ba gnyis khyad par gang yin zhe na/ 'gog snyoms thob pa'i dgra bcom pa ni/ gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba dang gcig shos de ma thag pa ni/ shes rab rkyang pa'i cha las rnam par grol ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom du 'jog go /zhar la yan lag gi rdzogs tshul ni/ 'gog snyoms thob pa'i phyir mi 'ong ni snyoms 'jug gis sgo nas rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ de las lhag pa'i snyoms 'jug med pa'i phyir/ phyir mi 'ong mthong thob rnams ni dbang po'i sgo nas rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ de ni dbang po rno shos yin pa'i phyir/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas ni 'bras bu'i sgo nas rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ de las lhag pa'i slob pa'i 'bras gnas med pa'i phyir/ mi slob pa ni yan lag gnyis kyis rdzogs te dbang po dang snyoms 'jug gnyis kyis sgo nas rdzogs pa'i phyir/ de'i sgrub byed ni/ snga ma'i dpags te shes so/ /mi slob pa la 'bras bu'i sgo nas rdzogs pa med de/ de thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par mtshungs pa'i phyir/

gsum pa lam gyi khyad par gyis chos gzhan bshad pa la/ lam gyi dbye ba spyir bstan/ byang chub phyogs mthun bye brag tu bshad/ lam gyis thob pa'i rnam grol ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lam de yang yon tan mngon du byed tshul gyi sgo nas bsdu na bzhir yod de/ khyad par gyi lam de'i sngon du 'gro ba bar chad med pa'i lam/ de'i sngon du 'gro ba sbyor ba'i lam dang bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ de yang bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten pa'i lam la lam sla ba ces bya ste/ zhi lhag cha mnyam pa'i lam sgrub sla ba'i phyir/ de'i nyer bsdogs la rten pa'i lam la lam dka' ba zhes bya ste/ lhag mthong shas che ba'i lam bsgrub dka' ba'i phyir/ de yang dbang rtul gyi rgyud kyi lam la mngon shes bul ba'i lam/ dbang rnon gyi rgyud kyi lam la mngon shes myur ba'i lam zhes bya ste/ snga mas gzhan sems shes bul phyi mas de myur ba'i phyir/ de dag la mu bzhi ste/ de'ang nyer bsdogs la rten pa'i lam la lam dka' ba zhes bya ste/ lhag mthong shas che ba'i lam sgrub dka' ba'i phyir/ de yang dbang rtul gyi rgyud kyis lam la mngon shes bul ba'i lam sla ba la mngon shes myur bul gnyis/ lam dka' ba la yang de myur bul gnyis te bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi'i mtshan gzhi ni rim bzhin bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten pa'i dbang rnon gyi lam/ de la rten pa'i dbang rtul gyi lam/ bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs la rten pa'i dbang rnon gyi lam/ de la rten pa'i dbang rtul gyi lam mo/ /gnyis pa la sgra bshad kyi dbye ba dang bcas pa/ lam gang du thob pa/ sa gang la brten nas thob pa/ shes rab nas dad pa thob pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa ni byang chub yin la/ de'i rgyur mthun pas na/ sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di dag la byang chub phyogs mthun zhes bya'o/ /de dag gi ming gi sgo nas dbye na sum cu rtsa bdun du yod de/

dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga/ byang chub yan lag bdun/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ rdzas kyi sgo nas bsdu na bcur 'dus ste/ dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ shes rab/ ting nge 'dzin/ dga' ba/ rtog pa/ tshul khrims/ shin sbyangs dang bcur 'dus pa'i phyir te/ 'phags lam gyi yan lag gi lta ba ni 'di'i shes rab tu 'dus/ rtog pa ni 'dir dngos su smos/ ngag las kyi mtha'/ 'tsho ba gsum ni/ 'di'i tshul khrims su 'dus/ rtsol ba ni/ 'di'i brtson 'grus su/ dran pa ni/ 'di'i dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'di'i ting nge 'dzin du 'dus/ dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga ni 'di'i dad pa/ brtson 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab lnga ru rim bzhin bsdus/ dran pa nyer bzhag ni 'di'i shes rab/ yang dag spong ba ni/ 'di'i brtson 'grus/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'di'i ting nge 'dzin du 'dus pa'i phyir/ phyi ma gsum la de dag gis khyab pa yin dam zhe na/ ma khyab ste de dag gtso bo yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi 'dir smos pa tsam yin gyis/ de dang der ma khyab ste/ sbyor byung gis/ yon tan de dag mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung kun yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sde tshan bdun ni go rims bzhin du lam bdun gyi gnas skabs su thob te/ dran pa nyer bzhag ni/ las dang pos te/ tshogs lam du thob/ yang dag spong ba/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa/ dbang po/ stobs dang bzhi ni/ go rim bzhin du nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi'i gnas skabs thob/ byang chub yan lag ni sgom lam/ 'phags lam yan lag ni mthong lam du thob pa'i phyir/ de yang byang chub yan lag dang / 'phags lam yan lag ni/ zag med dang gzhan rnams la zag bcas zag med gnyis ka'i cha yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ byang phyogs so bdun po thams cad bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhir skyes pa yod/ dga' ba ma gtogs mi lcogs med ngo bor skye ba yod/

rtog pa ma gtogs pa bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi'i ngo bor skye ba yod/ byang chub yan lag dang 'phags lam yan lag ma gtogs pa 'dod sems rtse gcig pa dang / srid rtse'i dngos gzhi'i ngo bor skye ba srid/ bzhi pa shes nas dad pa thob pa ni/ shes nas dad pa thob pa bzhi yod de/ tshul khrims la shes nas dad pa thob pa/ chos la shes nas sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun la shes nas dad pa thob pa dang bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ de yang bden pa dang po gsum gyis gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong nas tshul khrims la shes nas dad pa thob pa dang / chos la shes nas dad pa thob pa grogs gnyis thob/ lam gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs nas sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun la shes nas dad pa thob pa/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa dge ba'i tshul khrims la byed/ phyi ma gsum ni dkon mchog gsum po de la bdud las kyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa la byed/ 'o na chos la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i chos de gang la zhe na de ni bden pa dang po gsum dang / rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyis lam rnams yin no/ /de yang rdzas kyi sgo nas bsdu na gnyis su 'dus te/ dad pa dang tshul khrims gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ tshul khrims/ phyi ma gsum ni dad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam gyis thob pa'i rnam grol la/ rnam grol gyi dbye ba spyir bstan/ rnam grol thob tshul/ 'dus ma byas rnam grol bye brag tu bshad/ yid 'byung dang chags bral gyi khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po ni mdo las/ rnam grol la gnyis su gsungs shing / de slob pa'i lam gyi yan lag tu ma bshad/ de gnyis 'dir 'chad pa ni/ slob pa'i lam gyi yan lag tu rnam grol ma bshad de/ slob pa ni sems rgyud nyon mongs pas bcings pa'i phyir/ rnam grol la gnyis yod de/ 'dus byas rnam grol dang / 'dus ma byas de gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas rnam grol ni/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa zad par spangs pa'i 'dus ma byas rnam grol yin zhing /

'dus byas rnam grol ni mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi mos pa la bya zhing / de nyid mi slob pa'i lam gyi yan lag yin gyi gcig shos ni ma yin te/ 'dus ma byas la yan lag gi don ma tshang ba'i phyir/ 'dus byas rnam grol la gnyis te/ sems rnam grol dang shes rab rnam grol gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ mdo las/ yang dag pa'i shes pa bshad pa gang yin zhe na/ gong du byang chub kyi mtshan gzhir ji ltar bshad pa'i zad pa shes pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la sems gang rnam par grol ba dang / lam gang gis stobs kyis rnam par grol ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mi slob sems ni skye 'gyur ma 'ongs pa sgrib pa la rnam par grol bar byed dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na nyan thos kyi sgom lam skad cig tha ma la zag med kyi rgyud la 'byung rung gi mi slob lam skad cig ma dang po sgrib pa las grol bar byed dgos kyi mi slob pa'i rgyud la skyes zin lam rnams de ltar mi dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'gag 'gyur da ltar ba'i lam gyis sgrib pa spong bar byed de/ nyan thos sgom lam skad cig tha ma la gnas pa'i bar chad med lam gyis de'i rgyud la 'byung rung gi mi slob lam skad cig ma dang po thob pa'i gegs su 'gyur ba'i sgrib pa spong bar byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'dus ma byas rnam grol bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ de la bzhi yod de/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khams/ spangs pa'i khams/ 'gog pa'i khams dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa zad par spangs pa'i spangs pa la 'jog gnyis pa ni/ khams gsum gyi 'dod chags spangs pa'i spangs pa/ gsum pa ni/ 'dod chags ma gtogs pa'i nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i spangs pa yin/ bzhi pa ni/ nyon mongs pa ma gtogs khams gsum gyi zag bcas spangs pa'i spangs pa la 'jog bzhi pa ni/ sdug kun la dmigs pa'i lam ni/ yid 'byung ba'i lam yin te/
