yid 'byung bar bya ba sdug kun gnyis la dmigs pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ ris ngos skal gyi spang bya dngos su spong bzhin pa'i lam rnams ni/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i lam yin te/ spang bya dngos su spong bar byed bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis la mu bzhir yod de sdug bsngal chos shes dang / rjes shes/ kun 'byung chos shes dang rjes shes rnams ni/ yid 'byung ba'i lam yin la/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i lam yin pa'i mu/ sdug kun gyi bzod pa bzhi ni/ gnyis ka yin pa'i mu/ 'gog lam gyi bzod pa bzhi ni/ chags bral gyi lam yin la yid 'byung ba'i lam min pa'i mu/ 'gog lam gyi shes pa bzhi ni/ gnyis ka min pa'i mu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ lam dang gang zag bstan pa'i mdzod bstan zin to// ༈ //gsum pa thob bya'i 'bras bu la/ ye shes bstan pa'i mdzod dang / snyoms 'jug bstan pa'i mdzod gnyis/ dang po la/ ye shes kyis rang bzhin gtan la phab pa ldan pa'i tshul/ thob pa'i tshul/ khyad par gyi chos dang bzhi/ dang po la/ bzod shes lta ba'i khyad par/ shes pa bcu ngos bzung ba/ de dag gi khyad par gyi chos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dri ma med pa'i mthong lam bzod pa rnams 'di bstan shes pa bcu'i nang tshan yin te/ chos shes rjes shes kun rdzob kyi shes pa dang gsum po gang rung min pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ 'dir bstan shes pa bcu po gang rung yin na/ de gsum po gang rung yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i rtags grub ste/ bzod pa yin pa'i phyir/ mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i blo ni lta ba min te/ rtog cing tshol bar byed pa min pa'i phyir/ de dag las gzhan pa'i 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi shes pa rnams ni/ 'dir bstan shes pa dang lta ba gnyis ka yin/ 'phags pa las gzhan so so skye bo'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa can gyi lta ba lnga dang /

yang dag pa'i lta ba dang drug ni lta ba yin/ der ma zad 'dir bstan shes pa yin/ gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir shes pa la bcur yod cing / bcu ni kun rdzob shes pa chos shes rjes shes/ sdug bsngal shes pa/ 'gog pa shes pa/ kun 'byung shes pa/ lam shes pa/ pha rol sems shes pa/ zad pa shes pa/ mi skye ba shes pa te bcur yod/ de dag kyang bsdu na/ zag bcas zag med gnyis su/ kun rdzob shes pa mtha' dag gcig tu zag bcas/ pha rol sems shes pa la zag bcas zag med gnyis ka'i cha yod/ lhag ma rnams zag med kho na yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun rdzob shes pa ni zag bcas zhes bya'o/ /zag med kyis shes pa la rnam pa gnyis te/ chos shes dang rjes shes gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob kyi shes pa ni/ chos thams cad la dmigs pa yin/ chos shes ni 'dod pa'i bden pa bzhi la dmigs/ rjes shes ni khams gong ma sdug bsngal sogs bden pa bzhi la dmigs/ chos shes dang rjes shes de la mthong lam dang sgom lam gyi cha gnyis yod cing / mthong lam du gyur pa'i chos shes pa la yang chos shes pa bden pa bzhi yod la dmigs pa'i chos shes bzhi/ rjes shes bzhi ste brgyad yod kyang / bden pa bzhi'i bye brag gis sdug bsngal shes pa/ kun 'byung shes pa/ 'gog pa shes pa/ lam gyi shes pa bzhir yod/ bden pa bzhi shes pa'i mi slob pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi shes pa la mi skye ba shes pa dang zad pa shes pa gnyis su yod/ mi slob pa'i rgyud kyis zad pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa skad cig dang po ni/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung la dmigs te srid rtse'i de gnyis la dmigs pa'i phyir/ des na de gnyis la rjes shes su 'jog pha rol sems shes la bzhi las/ sdug bsngal kun 'byung lam bden/ so so skye bo'i rgyud kyis sems byung rig pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ pha rol sems shes bye brag tu bshad pa dang / zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ pha rol sems shes de la yang mang du yod cing / nyer bsdogs la brten pa'i pha rol sems kyis 'das pa/ dngos gzhi la brten pa'i sems mi rig bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi la rten pa'i pha rol sems kyi bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhir la rten pa'i sems mi shes/ dbang po 'das pa dbang rtul gyi rgyud kyi pha rol sems shes kyis dbang rnon gyi rgyud kyi sems mi rig gang zag 'das pa/ phyir mi 'ong gi rgyud kyi pha rol sems kyi dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi sems mi rig zhig pa 'das pa'i sems mi rig ma skyes pa ma 'ong pa'i sems mi rig des na rang dang rgyud tshod mnyam pa yan chad kyi sems rig pa gtso bo yin no/ /chos shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i pha rol sems shes kyis rjes shes phyogs mthun dang bcas pa mi rig rjes shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i pha rol sems shes kyi rjes shes phyogs mthun dang bcas pa mi rig nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi pha rol sems shes kyi mthong lam skad cig ma gnyis rig gi de las gzhan mi rig bse ru lta bu rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyis pha rol sems shes kyi mthong lam skad cig ma gsum rig de yang dang por chos shes rjes shes gnyis rig de nas sbyor ba byas te/ brgyad pa kun 'byung rjes shes dang bco lnga pa lam rjes bzod gang rung rig pa rang 'grel du bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kyis sbyor ba la ltos med du mthong lam kun rig pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ zad pa shes pa ni/ mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal shes/ kun 'byung spangs/ 'gog pa mngon du byas/ lam rgyud la bsten par shes pa la 'jog mi skye ba shes pa ni/ mi skye ba'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal shes par bya rgyu gzhan med/ kun 'byung spangs zin/ spang bar bya rgyu gzhan med/

'gog pa mngon du byas/ mngon du bya rgyu gzhan med/ lam rgyud la bsten zin/ bsten par bya rgyu gzhan med par rtogs pa'i thob pa nyams mi srid pa'i blo la 'dod do/ /gsum pa khyad chos/ shes pa bcur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gnyen po'i khyad par/ rnam pa'i khyad par dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'di bstan shes pa la bcur 'jog ste ji snyed pa'i chos rnams kyi rang bzhin shes pa'i sgo nas kun rdzob shes pa 'dod pa'i bden bzhi la dmigs shing de'i gnyen po byed nus pa'i cha nas chos shes bzhag khams gong ma'i bden bzhi las dmigs shing / de'i gnyen po byad nus pa'i cha nas rjes shes/ dmigs pa gcig la rnam pa tha dad pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal shes pa dang / kun 'byung shes pa gnyis bzhag rnam pa dang / dmigs pa gnyis ka tha dad pa'i cha nas lam shes pa dang 'gog pa shes pa gnyis bzhag sbyor ba byed tshul gyi sgo nas pha rol sems shes bzhag khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spong ba'i bya ba byas pa'i cha nas zad pa shes pa de bzhag lam gyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu rgyas par bya ba'i cha nas mi skye ba shes pa de bzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgom lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i chos shes kyis khams gsum ka'i gnyen po byed/ yang de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rjes shes kyis 'dod pa'i gnyen po mi byed de 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ shes pa so so'i rnam pa/ rnam pa'i ngo bo/ /de dag gi khyad chos gzhan bshad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ chos shes dang rjes shes gnyis/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug bcu drug ldan/ kun rdzob shes pa'ang snga ma de bzhin du shes pa bcu drug ldan/ sdug bsngal shes pa/ kun 'byung shes pa/ 'gog pa shes pa/ lam shes pa bzhi ni/ rang rang gi bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi ldan/ pha rol sems shes la dri med dang / dri bcas gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lam shes pa de bzhin du lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi dri ma dang bcas pa ni/

shes pa rang gi mtshan nyid sems gcig kho na'i rnam pa dang ldan/ kho na re ma nges te/ gtso bo sems dang sems byung gnyis ka'i rnam pa ldan pa'i phyir snyam na min te/ de gnyis rdzas tha dad yin pas gang rung re re dmigs yul du byed kyis/ gtso bo sems la dmigs pa'i pha rol sems kyis sems byung la ma dmigs/ sems byung la dmigs pa'i des sems la ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ lhag ma zad pa shes pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa gnyis rnam pa bcu bzhi can yin gyi/ stong bdag med kyi rnam pa ni/ de sgom par byed pa'i rnam pa can yin/ zad mi skye shes pas de dag sgom par mi byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kha che bye brag du smra ba rnams dri med kyi rnam pa bcu drug tu yod kyis de las gzhan med ces zer/ gzhan nyi 'og pa rang mtshan gyi rnam pa'ang yod par 'dod de/ bstan bcos rnam shes kyi tshogs las/ 'di ni gnas yod do/ /'di ni gzhi yod do/ /ces bya bar shes par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i gnas ni mtshan nyid dang / gzhi ni rgyu yin pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ yul la dmigs pa'i shes rab la 'jog shes rab dang bcas pa'i yul la dmigs pa'am yul gyi rnam pa dang bcas par 'dzin par byed/ kho na re/ shes rab de rnam bcas min par 'gyur te/ kho bo rang dang bcas pa min pa'i phyir/ zhe na skyon med de/ spyir shes rab dang bcas pa la grogs kyi stobs kyis bcas pa dang / ngo bo'i sgo nas bcas pa gnyis las shes rab ni ngo bo'i sgo nas bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i yod pa thams cad gzung byar bya ste/ thams cad la dmigs pa yin/ bzhi pa la/ ngo bo/ /rten gyi khyad par/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi dmigs pa'i khyad par bzhi las/ dang po ni/ kun rdzob shes pa la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ka yod/ gzhan rnams mtha' gcig tu dge ba yin/ gnyis pa la/ sems kyi rten dang / lus kyi rten gnyis/ dang po kun rdzob shes pa ni/

sa dgu po thams cad la rten/ chos shes kyis bsam gtan sa drug la rten/ rjes shes ni zag med sa dgu la rten/ de bzhin du bden pa bzhi shes dang zad pa shes pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa dang / yang zag med sa dgu la rten/ de las gzhan pha rol sems shes bsam gtan bzhi la rten/ gnyis pa ni/ pha rol sems shes ni 'dod pa'i rten can/ kun rdzob shes pa ni gzugs kyi rten can/ chos shes 'dod pa'i rten can/ de las gzhan pa rnams ni khams gsum gyi rten can/ gsum pa ni/ 'gog pa shes pa ni/ chos dran pa nyer bzhag gcig po'i ngo bor skyes/ pha rol sems shes ni/ lus dran pa nyer bzhag ma gtogs pa lhag ma rnams ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ka'i ngo bor skyes srid do/ /bzhi pa la shes pa nang phan tshun yul du gyur pa'i tshul/ chos bcu dang yul yul can du sbyar ba/ chos gang rig pa'i tshul dang rnam pa gsum/ dang po ni/ chos shes kyis ni rjes shes ma gtogs pa'i shes pa dgu yul du byed/ rjes shes kyis kyang chos shes ma gtogs pa'i shes pa dgu yul du byed/ sdug bsngal shes pa dang / kun 'byung shes pa'i kun rdzob shes pa dang gzhan sems shes pas zag bcas gnyis yul du byed/ kun rdzob shes pa pha rol sems shes/ zad pa shes pa mi skye ba shes pa bzhis chos bcu yul du byed pa yin/ 'gog pa shes pas 'gog pa kho na yul du byed kyi gzhan yul du mi byed/ gnyis pa ni/ chos bcu ni/ khams gsum gyi zag bcas la mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis te drug dri med la mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis te brgyad/ 'dus ma byas la don dam pa'i dge ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis te bcur yod/ kun rdzob kyi shes pas chos thams cad yul du byed de/ khams gsum gyi zag bcas yin min gnyis gnyis te thams cad yul du byed pa'i phyir/ chos shes kyis chos lnga yul du byed de/ 'dod pa'i mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis/ dri med kyi mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis/

'dus ma byas dang dge bas te lnga yul du byed pa'i phyir/ rjes shes kyis chos bdun yul du byed de/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis gnyis te bzhi/ dri med kyi mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis/ 'dus ma byas dang dge bas te bdun yul du byed pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal shes pa dang kun 'byung shes pa gnyis kyis chos drug drug yul du byed de/ khams gsum gyi mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis te drug drug yul du byed pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa shes pas 'dus ma byas dge ba gcig pu yul du byed do/ /lam shes pas dri med mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis yul du byed/ pha rol sems shes kyis 'dod gzugs dri med dang gsum gyis mtshungs ldan gsum yul du byed/ zad mi skye shes pas 'dus ma byas lung ma bstan ma gtogs dgu yul du byed/ bzhi pa ni/ kun rdzob shes pa gcig pus rang gi tshogs las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad/ bdag med par rig par 'gyur/ rang nyid tshogs mi rig ste/ rang nyid rang la byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ldan tshul ni/ so so skye bo rnams la kun rdzob kyi shes pa gcig ldan/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral te bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob na/ pha rol sems shes te gnyis dang ldan/ zag med 'phags lam skad cig ma dang po sdug bsngal chos bzod tshogs bcas kyi skabs su kun rdzob gcig pu dang ldan/ de skad cig ma gnyis pa sdug bsngal chos shes kyi gnas skabs su gsum dang ldan te/ kun rdzob shes pa sdug bsngal shes pa/ chos shes te gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de yan chad kyi bzhi'i gnas skabs su shes pa re re 'phel ba yin te/ sdug bsngal rjes shes kyi gnas skabs su rjes shes dang ldan/ kun 'byung chos shes la sngar gyi steng du kun 'byung shes pa/ 'gog pa chos shes la 'gog pa shes pa/ lam chos shes la lam shes pa ste/ re re 'phel ba'i tshul du ldan/

mthong lam du thob tshul la/ /mthong lam du thob tshul/ lam gzhan du thob tshul/ shes pa gzhan gyis thob tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mthong lam bzod pa brgyad shes pa bdun te bco lnga la rang dus su skyes pa'i thob pa da ltar ba dang / de dang rigs 'dra ba'i thob pa ma 'ongs pa gnyis ldan/ rjes shes gsum gyi mjug tu kun rdzob shes pa re re thob te gsum gyi mjug tu byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa de la mngon par rtogs pa'i mtha' zhes kyang bya ste/ bden pa re re rtogs pa'i mjug tu byung pa'i phyir/ mi skye ba'i chos can zhes bya te/ de rgyun ldan gyi 'phags pa med pa'i phyir/ des rang rang gi sa dang 'og sa'i kun rdzob shes pa gnyis gnyis skyed par byed de/ dper na sdug bsngal rjes shes kyi mjug tu byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa skyed pa de la yang sdug bsngal rjes shes bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i ngo bor skyes pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan dang po'i kun rdzob shes pa dang / 'og sa 'dod pa'i kun rdzob shes pa gnyis skyed/ sdug bsngal rjes shes de bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i ngo bor skyes pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i kun rdzob shes pa nas/ 'dod pa'i kun rdzob shes pa'i bar lnga skyed pa yin no/ /'gog pa rjes shes kyi mjug tu byung ba'i kun rdzob shes pa ni/ mthar chos dran pa nyer bzhag gi ngo bor skyes pa yod/ dmigs pa ni/ rang rang gi bden pa la dmigs/ rnam pa ni/ de dang de'i rnam pa dang ldan pa yin/ de yang sbyor lam 'bad pa'i sgo nas thob/ gnyis pa la/ sgom lam du thob tshul dang / mi slob lam du thob tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba ste/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi ma thob na shes pa drug ldan te/ chos shes/ rjes shes/ bden pa bzhi shes ste drug ldan pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral na pha rol sems shes te bdun dang ldan/

de'i gong ma sgom lam che 'bring chung gsum gyi gnas su bdun ldan te/ kun rdzob shes pa/ chos shes/ rjes shes/ bden pa bzhi shes bzhi ste bdun ldan pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral na pha rol sems shes te brgyad ldan/ sa bdun ni/ bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med dang po gsum ste bdun la rgyal bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam/ mngon shes thob par byed pa'i bar chad med lam/ dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can thob par byed pa'i bar chad med lam/ gong ma srid rtse'i nyon mongs pa brgyad las grol bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam gyi gnas skabs su shes pa bdun te/ gong gis pha rol sems shes ma gtogs pa'i bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ slob pa dbang rtul dbang rnon sbyong bar byed pa'i rnam grol lam gyi gnas skabs su shes pa drug dang ldan te/ chos shes/ rjes shes/ bden pa bzhi shes te drug ldan pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob na/ pha rol sems shes te bdun dang ldan/ de bar chad med lam gyi gnas skabs su pha rol sems shes ma gtogs pa gong ma drug po de dang ldan/ srid rtse las rgyal ba ste srid rtse'i nyon mongs spong ba'i bar chad med lam la shes pa drug dang ldan te/ bshad ma thag pa'i drug po de dang ldan pa'i phyir/ mi slob lam pa dbang rtul gyi rgyud la skad cig dang po'i gnas skabs su zad pa shes pa la sogs pa chos dgu dang ldan pa'i mi skye ba'i shes pa mi thob/ dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyis ni/ shes pa bcu ka thob/ dgra bcom pa dbang rtul mi g.yo ba'i chos can du 'pho ba la rnam grol lam dgu yod pa'i tha ma dgu pa de'i shes pa bcu ka thob/ sngar bshad pa las lhag ma bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med dang po gsum rgyal ba'i rnam grol lam mngon shes thob pa'i rnam grol lam/ mi skye ba'i chos can thob par byed pa'i rnam grol lam/ bsam gtan spel sgom thob par byed pa'i rnam grol lam/

srid rtse'i nyon mongs pa dang po brgyad las grol bar byed pa'i rnam grol lam gyi gnas skabs su shes pa brgyad thob ste/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa gnyis ma gtogs pa'i shes pa brgyad thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa shes pa gzhan gyis thob tshul la/ sa gong ma la chags bral bya ba'i phyir du/ de la brtson par byas pas de'i chags bral gyi lam thob pa'i tshe/ sa 'og ma la chags bral thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ sa kun la chags bral gyi yon tan thob pa de yang / sngon med gsar du rnyed pa la 'jog gi de rgyun ldan du yod pa de rnyed pas de'i yon tan thob par mi 'jog go /thob pa la yang dbye ba bzhi yod de/ rnyed pa'i/ bsten pa'i/ gnyen po'i/ thag sring ba'i gnyen po'i thob pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de yang dang po ni sngar med gsar du skye ba la 'jog go /gnyis pa ni/ de skad cig gnyis pa man chad du ldan pa la 'jog go /gsum pa ni/ spang bya spong bzhin pa'i gnas skabs kyi thob pa la 'jog bzhi pa ni/ spang bya las grol ba'i gnas skabs kyi thob pa la 'jog go /de gnyis ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas rtsi'o/ /bzhi pa khyad par gyi chos la thun mong min pa'i yon tan bshad pa dang / thun mong ba'i yon tan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad yod de/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum/ thugs rje chen po dang bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / sku'i stobs gnyis/ dang po la so so'i ngo bo/ /gang la brten nas thob pa'i tshul/ sgra bshad dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gnas dang gnas min la mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ shes pa bcu ka'i ngo bor skyes pa yod/ las kyi rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/

'gog lam shes pa ma gtogs pa brgyad kyi ngo bor skyes pa yod/ bsam gtan gzugs med sogs mkhyen pa dang / dbang po dang / mos pa dang / khams mkhyen pa'i stobs rnams la/ 'gog pa shes pa ma gtogs pa shes pa dgu yod/ lam mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ khams rang gi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i dbang du byas na/ shes pa drug gi ngo bor skyes pa yod de/ chos shes/ rjes shes gnyis/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes gnyis/ lam shes pa pha rol sems shes te drug gi ngo bor skyes pa yod pa'i phyir/ lam 'bras 'khor bcas rig pa'i dbang du byas na/ shes pa bcu ka'i ngo bor skyes pa yod/ sngon gnas mkhyen pa'i dang / 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ kun rdzob shes pa kho na'i ngo bor skye/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs la/ zag pa zad pa rang gi ngo bo mkhyen pa la byed na/ shes pa drug gi ngo bor skyes te/ chos shes/ rjes shes gnyis/ zad pa dang mi skye shes pa gnyis/ 'gog pa shes pa/ kun rdzob shes pa ste/ drug gi ngo bor skye ba yod/ de'i thabs shes pa'i dbang du byas na shes pa bcu ka'i ngo bor skyes pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon gnas mkhyen pa dang / 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba mkhyen pa ni/ bsam gtan gyis dngos gzhi la rten cing / lhag ma rnams ni sa kun la rten du rung / gsum pa ni/ chos thams cad la blos thags thogs pa med pas na stobs zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa sku'i stobs ni/ mkhyen pa'i stobs de ltar yin na/ sku'i stobs ji tsam yod snyam na/ bye byag tu smra ba rnams sku la sred med kyi bu'i stobs dang ldan zer/ kha cig sku'i stobs mtha' yas pas bzung bar mi nus zer/ mdo sde pa rnams sku'i tshigs re re la glang po che sa bsrungs kyi bu'i stobs re re yod/ glang po che de la stobs ji tsam yod snyam na/ spos tshan rab gnon yan lag stobs shes pa ltar/ glang po che phal pa spos kyi glang po che tshan po che'i glang po che/

rab gzhon yan lag mchog stobs mchog bdun pa sa bsrungs kyi bu rnams bcu 'gyur gyis stobs che ba yod do/ /sku'i stobs kyis ngo bo ni/ reg bya'i skye mched do/ /gnyis pa mi 'jigs pa bzhi ni/ mi 'jigs pa la bzhi yod de/ rang don rtogs pa phun sum tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa dang / rang don spangs pa phun sum tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa/ gzhan don bar chad kyi chos dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa/ gzhan don nges 'byung gi lam dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ de yang rang don rtogs pa phun sum tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ dang po gnas dang gnas min pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang tshul 'dra bar shes pa bcu ka'i ngo bor skyes pa yin/ gnyis pa rang don spangs pa phun sum tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ shes pa bcu pa zag pa zad pa'i stobs dang tshul 'dra bar zag pa zad pa 'phags pa rang gi ngo bo rig pa'i dbang du byas na/ shes pa drug gi ngo bor skyes pa yin/ 'khor bcas rig pa'i dbang du byas na/ shes pa bcu ka'i dbang du skyes pa yin/ gsum pa gzhan don bar chad kyi chos dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ gnyis pa las kyi rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 'dra bar 'gog lam ma gtogs pa shes pa brgyad kyis ngo bor skyes pa yin/ gzhan don nges 'byung gi lam dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ bdun pa lam mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 'dra bar rang gi ngo bor rig pa'i tshe/ shes pa drug gi ngo bor skyes/ lam 'khor bcas rig pa'i dbang du byas na shes pa bcu ka'i dbang du skyes pa yin/ dran pa nyer bzhag pa gsum gyi ngo bo dran pa dang shes bzhin yin/ dbye na gsum ste/ chos la gus pas nyan pa la 'dod chags kyis dbye ba/ chos la gus pas nyan pa la zhe sdang gi dbye ba/ gus ma gus gnyis kas nyan pa la chags sdang gnyis ka'i dbye ba gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa thugs rje chen po ni/ ngo bo kun rdzob kyi shes pa yin no/ /che ba la lnga ste/ tshogs che ba/ rnam pa che ba/ spyod yul che ba/ mnyam pa che ba/ ches che ba dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na snying rje chen po dang khyad par ci yod snyam na/ khyad par yod de/ tha dad du bya ba rnam pa brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ brgyad ni ngo bo dmigs rnam sa dang rgyud/ thob don las dang rnam pa brgyad/ ces pa ltar/ dmigs pa/ rnam pa/ ngo bo/ /sa gang la rten pa/ gang zag gang gis rgyud la yod pa/ thob pa/ las/ don dang brgyad du yod cing / thugs rje chen po/ ngo bo dug gsum du med pa/ dmigs pa khams kyi sems can la dmigs/ rnam pa sdug bsngal gsum ka dang bral ba'i rnam pa can/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la rten pa/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud la yod pa/ srid rtse la chags bral byas pa'i tshul gyis thob pa/ khams gsum gyi sems can skyob par byed pa'i don can/ phrin las khams gsum sems can thams cad la 'jug pa'i don can/ snying rje chen po ni/ ngo bo zhe sdang med pa'i chags gtogs/ rnam par mi 'tshe/ dmigs pa ni 'dod pa khams pa'i sems can tsam la dmigs/ rnam pa ni/ gdul bya'i sdug bsngal tsam dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can dang bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi la rten pa/ nyan rang la sogs pa'i rgyud la yod pa/ 'dod pa la chags bral byas pa'i stobs kyis thob pa/ 'dod khams pa'i sems can tsam skyob par byed pa'i don can/ phrin las 'dod khams pa'i sems can la 'jug pa yin no/ /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mnyam pa nyid gsum dang ldan te/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags par mnyam/ rang don chos sku thob par mnyam/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don byed par mnyam pa'i phyir/ sku tshe dang rigs dang / sku bongs tshod la sogs pa mnyam pa min te/ sku tshe la ring thung / rigs la bram ze dang rgyal po'i rigs sku bongs che chung la sogs pa yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa thun mong ba'i yon tan bshad pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob pa 'phags pa'i gang zag la ni/ thun mong ba'i yon tan du ma yod de/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon nas 'dzin pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ so so yang dag par rig pa sogs yod pa'i phyir/ so so skye bo dang thun mong ba'i yon tan yod de/ mngon shes dang po lnga/ bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ byams sogs tshad med bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'phags pa dang thun mong ba'i yon tan bshad pa dang / so so skye bo dang thun mong ba'i yon tan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon nas mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ so sor yang dag par rig pa/ zhar byung bsam gtan gyis rab mtha' ngos bzung ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de kun rdzob shes pa'i ngo bor skye ba/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la rten pa/ dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can kho na'i rgyud la yod/ mi'i rten la skye bar byed cing / dmigs pa ni/ 'dod pa'i sar gtogs pa'i nyon mongs pa ma skyes pa ste/ skye rung ma skyes pa'i chos can gzhir bcas la dmigs pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ smon nas shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin de'ang nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dmigs pa ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mtshungs shing / 'di'i dmigs pa ni chos thams cad la dmigs so/ /gsum pa so so yang dag par rig pa ni/ snga ma bzhin du bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la rten pa/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi rgyud la yod la/ mi'i rten la skyed par byed pa yin/ de la dbye na bzhi ste/ chos so sor yang dag par rig pa/ don/ nges pa'i tshig spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de yang dang po gsum ni/ rim pa bzhin du/ ming dang / don dang / ngag la dmigs pa yin no/

/bzhi pa ni/ rigs pa'i chos thags thogs med par mngon par brjod pa'i ngag dang / lam la dbang ba yin cing / dmigs pa yang de gnyis la dmigs pa yin no/ /de yang 'gog shes ma gtogs shes pa dgu'i ngo bor skye/ rten ni sa thams cad la rten pa yin/ don so sor yang dag par rig pa ni/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 'dra bar don gyi gtso bo nyan nas ngo bo rig pa'i cha nas shes pa drug gi ngo bor skye/ 'khor bcas rig pa'i dbang du byas na shes pa bcu ka'i ngo bor skye/ rten ni sa kun la rten du rung / chos so sor yang dag par rig pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi shes pa 'dod pa dang bsam gtan gyi sems la rten pa yin no/ /nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa ni/ 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po'i sems la rten pa yin cing / ngo bo kun rdzob shes pa yin te/ so sor yang dag par rig pa de dag kyang thob pa'i tshe/ tshang bar thob pa yin gyi gang rung gcig thob nas lhag ma rnams ma thob pa ni med do/ /de nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon nas med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ so sor yang dag par rig pa ni nges pa'i tshig so sor yang dag pa ma gtogs pa lhag ma gsum dang / zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes rnams ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la rten pa yin/ bzhi pa bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' ngos bzung ba ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' de shes pa drug gi ngo bor skye zhing / de yang 'dod sems rtse gcig pa nas srid rtse'i bar la/ yar 'ong lugs mthun dang / mar 'ong lugs mi mthun gyi tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag cing / slar yang bsam gtan bzhi pa'i bar du lugs mthun du mnyam par bzhag ste/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la che 'bring chung gsum du 'phel ba'i rab tu phyin pas te/ chen po de bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' 'jog go /de yang sangs rgyas kyis 'bad med du thob cing de las gzhan pa rnams ni sbyor ba 'bad pa dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis thob/

gsum pa so so skye bo dang thun mong ba'i yon tan bshad pa la/ mngon shes drug gi ngo bo dang / khyad par gyi chos gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon shes la drug yod de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ de dag ni rang thob par byed pa'i gegs las rnam par grol ba'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gcig gis steng du 'jog go /de yang gsum pa dang drug pa ma gtogs pa bzhi ni/ kun rdzob kyi shes pa yin zhing / gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes ni/ chos shes/ rjes shes/ lam shes pa/ kun rdzob shes pa/ pha rol sems shes dang lnga'i ngo bor skyes/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni/ rang gis rang ngo shes pa'i dbang du byas na shes pa drug 'khor bcas rig pa'i dbang du byas na/ shes pa bcu ka'i ngo bor skye ba ni/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sa'i khyad par/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi khyad par/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ tshul khrims gsum gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ mngon shes dang po lnga ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi tsam la brten cing / drug pa ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten no/ /dmigs pa ni/ rang sa dang 'og sa'i chos rnams la dmigs pa ste/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas thob pa'i tshe/ rang sa bsam gtan dang po dang / 'og sa 'dod pa la dmigs/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten pa'i tshe/ rang sa bsam gtan bzhi pa dang / 'og sa bsam gtan gnyis pa sogs la dmigs pa yin/ thob pa'i tshe skye ba snga ma la 'dres par byas na 'bad med du thob/ de ma byas na chags bral 'bad pa dang bcas te thob bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsum pa gzhan sems shes pa ni/ lus dran pa nyer bzhag ma gtogs/

dran pa nyer bzhag gsum gyi ngo bor skye/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba dang mig gi mngon par shes pa rnams/ dang po lus dran pa nyer bzhag gi ngo bor skye/ de dag gis shugs la sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes dang / mngon shes drug pa ni dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ka'i ngo bor skye ba yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ lha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni mtha' gcig tu lung ma bstan yin/ lhag ma rnams ni dge ba yin no/ /bzhi pa rig pa'i khyad par ni/ sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes sogs phyi ma gsum ni/ go rim bzhin/ sngon gyi mtha'/ phyi ma'i mtha'/ da ltar gyi mtha' gsum/ rig pa yin cing / dgra bcom pa'i de gsum la rig pa zhes bya ste/ dus gsum gyi mtha' la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa zlog pa'i mngon shes yin pas so/ /dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi mngon shes drug pa de ni/ mi slob pa'i lam yang yin la mngon shes kyang yin/ mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi sngon gnas rjes su rig pa'i mngon shes dang / lha'i mig gi mngon shes gnyis ni mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi mngon shes zhes bya ste/ mi slob pa'i rgyud la yod pas so/ /mi slob pa'i lam ni min no/ /slob pa'i rgyud la mngon shes drug ka yod kyang / rig pa zhes ma bshad de/ sems rgyud ma rig pas bcings pa'i mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa cho 'phrul gsum gyi khyad par ni/ cho 'phrul de la rnam pa gsum ste/ sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul lo/ /gsung kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /thugs rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de yang rdzu 'phrul kyi mngon shes ni/ dang po yin cing / gsum pa gzhan sems yin pa'i mngon shes ni gnyis pa/ drug pa zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni gsum pa thugs rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul yin no/ /de yang thugs rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul ni cho 'phrul gyi mchog yin/

sgrib gnyis spong ba'i tshul la/ ma 'khrul ba dang / sems can la phan pa sgrub pa dang / gdul bya yid 'ong gi 'bras bu la sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa/ so sor bshad pa la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes bshad pa/ lha'i mig dang rna ba bshad pa/ skyes thob sogs kyi khyad par dang gsum/ dang po rdzu 'phrul gyi ngo bo 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ sprul sems yul dang bcas pa/ sprul pa byed tshul zhar byung dang bcas pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi dbye ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sprul pa dang 'gro ba sna tshogs 'byor bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa la 'jog par byed/ de las ni/ lus sprul pa dang 'gro ba gsum gyi bya ba byed/ 'gro ba gsum ni yid mgyogs kyi 'gro ba/ phyin byed kyi 'gro ba/ mos pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gang du 'gro ba'i gnas de yid la bsam pa tsam gyis der 'gro nus pa la byed/ gnyis pa ni bya 'phur ba ltar myur du bgrod nus pa la byed/ gsum pa ni thag ring po'i gnas kyang thag thung ngur mos pa byas pa'i sgo nas myur du bgrod nus pa la byed/ dang po de ston pa sangs rgyas kho na la yod/ phyi ma gnyis ni/ nyan thos sogs la yod/ sprul pa la gnyis yod de/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i sprul pa dang gzugs su gtogs pa'i sprul pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i sprul pa la sgra ma gtogs pa'i phyi'i skye mched bzhir yod/ de re re la rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa dang / gzhan rgyud kyis bsdus pa gnyis gnyis yod/ yang na sems kyis zin ma zin gnyis gnyis yod/ gzugs kyi sas bsdus pa'i sprul pa'i yul la gzugs dang reg bya gnyis/ de re la rang rgyud kyis zin ma zin gnyis yod do/ /de dag la sprul sems kyi sna tshogs su sprul par byed pa'i sprul sems de dag kyang ni bcu bzhi yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i 'bras bu gyur pa'i sprul sems la gnyis yod pa nas/

bsam gtan bzhi pa'i de'i 'bras bu gyur ba de la lnga'i bar du yod pa'i phyir te/ dang po la rang sa bsam gtan dang pos bsdus pa'i sprul sems dang / 'og sa 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i sprul sems gnyis/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i snyoms 'jug gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i sprul sems la yang / rang sas bsdus pa'i/ 'og sa bsam gtan dang pos bsdus pa'i/ 'dod pas bsdus pa'i sprul sems gsum du yod/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i de'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i rang sa man chad bzhis bsdus pa'i sprul sems bzhi yod/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i sprul sems de la/ bsam gtan bzhi 'dod pa dang lngas bsdus pa'i sprul sems lngar yod pa'i phyir/ des na 'og sa'i snyoms 'jug gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i gong sa'i sprul sems ni med do/ /sprul sems ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhin du 'og sa chags bral byas pas thob/ sprul sems de yang dang por dngos gzhi dag pa la skye/ skad cig gnyis pa phan chad rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma las 'byung / sprul sems de las kyang 'bras bu gnyis 'byung ba yod de/ rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma dang / snyoms 'jug dag pa gnyis 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sprul sems de dag gis kyang / rang sa'i sprul gzhi la sprul bar byed kyi/ gong sa'i yul la sprul bar mi byed/ sprul pa de smra ru 'jug pa'i tshe/ 'og sa'i sems kyi kun slong byas nas kyang smra ba yod de/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sprul sa'i smra ba'i tshe/ bsam gtan dang po'i sas bsdus kyis rtog dpyod gnyis kyis kun slong byas nas smra ba yin pa'i phyir/ de yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ rang gis ma smras pa/ sprul pas smra ba nus la/ de las gzhan pa rnams kyis sprul pa pos smras pa'i sgo nas sprul pas kyang smra bar byed pa yin gyis/ snga ma ltar mi nus so/

/de yang sprul pa de'i sprul pa'i sems kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgo nas smra bar 'jug pa la sogs pa byed do/ /gson po 'ba' zhig la byin gyis brlabs pa yod dam zhe na/ shi ba la yang byin gyis rlob pa yod cing / de yang mi brtan pa sha dang khrag la sogs pa la byin gyis brlabs pa med/ brtan pa rus pa la byin gyis brlabs par byed de/ bye brag tu smra ba rnams nyan thos 'od srungs chen po'i rus pa sprul sems kyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ da lta yang ri bo bya rkang na yod ces zer/ sde pa gzhan dag sprul sems kyis byin gyis brlabs pa min gyi/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs nas gnas par byed pa yin zer ro/ /sprul pa'i tshul ni/ dang por sprul sems rgyun gcig tu gyur pa'i skad cig snga phyi du mas gcig sprul par byed/ phyis byang bar gyur nas sprul sems gcig gis sprul pa du ma sprul bar byed/ bzhi pa rdzu 'phrul gyi dbye ba ni/ sgom pa las skyes pa'i rdzu 'phrul ni/ mtha' gcig tu lung ma bstan/ skyes stobs kyi rdzu 'phrul la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod de/ mi ma yin gyis gzhan la gnod par byed pa'i rdzu 'phrul ni mi dge ba/ des gzhan la phan par byed pa'i de ni dge ba/ phan gnod gang yang mi byed pa'i rdzu 'phrul ni lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzu 'phrul la dbye na lnga ste/ sngags la rten pa'i/ sman la rten pa'i/ ting nge 'dzin la rten pa'i/ las la rten pa'i/ skyes thob kyi rdzu 'phrul dang lngar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lha'i mig dang rna ba bshad pa ni/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes dang / lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes kyi bdag rkyen du gyur ba'i/ mig dbang / rna dbang ste/ lha'i mig dang rna ba dngos btags gang yin zhe na/ de dag mtshan nyid pa yin zhing / khyad par gyi chos lnga dang ldan te/ bsam gtan gyis sas bsdus pa/

nang gis gzugs dwang ba rtag tu rnam par shes pa'i rten byed pa/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag dbang po ma tshang ba med pa/ thag ring ba'i gzugs dang sgra phra rags mthong zhing thos pa'o/ /de yang nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyis lha'i mig dbang gis stong gnyis/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi lha'i mig dbang gis stong gsum tshun chad kyi phra rags thams cad mthong / ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lha'i mig dbang gis stong gsum grangs med kyi phra rags thams cad mthong ba yin/ de bzhin du lha'i rna dbang la yang sbyar ro/ /bzhi pa skyes thob sogs kyi khyad par bshad pa ni/ skyes thos kyi lha'i mig gis srid pa bar ma mi mthong / bsam gtan la rten pa'i lha'i mig dbang gis bar srid mthong ba yin no/ /gzhan sems shes pa tsam la dbye na gsum ste/ las la brten nas gzhan sems shes pa/ rtog ge la brten nas/ rigs sngags la rten nas gzhan sems shes pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sogs la yod/ gnyis pa ni/ da ltar gyi skye bo 'ga' zhig gis phyi lus ngag gi rig byed la brten nas gzhan gyi sems shes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rigs sngags 'ga' zhig gis bzlas pa las gzhan gyi sems shes pa lta bu'o/ /dang por dmyal bar skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag gi skyes thob kyis sngon gnas rjes su dran pa yod kyis/ skad cig gnyis pa phan chad la med de/ sdug bsngal gyi mnar bas de dran pa'i skabs med pa'i phyir/ mi rnams la skyes thob kyis sngon gnas rjes su dran pa med de/ de yod na mi thams cad la yod dgos pa las de med pa'i phyir/ des na mi 'ga' zhig las la brten nas thob pa'i sngon gnas rjes su dran pa yod do/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa las/ ye shes bstan pa zhes bya ba ste gnas bdun pa bshad zin to// ༈ //gnyis pa yon tan de dag gi rten snyoms 'jug bstan pa'i mdzod bshad pa la/

snyoms 'jug gi rang bzhin gtan la phab pa/ de'i khyad par gyi chos/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba/ de la rten pa'i yon tan bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la snyoms 'jug gnyis so sor bshad pa/ thun mong du bshad pa/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag bye brag tu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la bsam gtan gyis snyoms 'jug dang / gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gnyis/ dang po la dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang / rgyu snyoms 'jug bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan la gnyis te/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan dang / 'bras bu skyes thob kyi bsam gtan gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ de re re la yang bzhi bzhi ste/ bsam gtan bzhi'i rgyu snyoms 'jug bzhi dang / 'bras bu skyes thob bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu skyes thob kyi bsam gtan ni/ 'dir rgyas par ma bshad de gong du 'jig rten bstan pa'i mdzod du/ gong ma'i gnas dag bcu bdun ni/ zhes sogs su bshad zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan kyi snyoms 'jug ni/ dge sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa la 'jog rjes 'brang bcas na phung po lnga yod de/ bsam gtan gyis sdom pa de ldan gyis rjes 'brang dang gzugs kyi phung po'i gzhi'i yin pa'i phyir/ de dag la dbye na/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos bzhi'i snyoms 'jug nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug gi bar bzhir yod cing / dang po ni/ dpyod pa gnyen po'i yan lag tu ldan pa'i bsam gtan kyi dngos gzhi snyoms 'jug la 'jog go /gnyis pa ni/ dpyod pa spangs nas dga' ba gnyen po'i yan lag tu ldan pa la 'jog gsum pa ni/ dga' ba spangs shing bde ba gnyen po'i yan lag tu ldan pa la 'jog bzhi pa ni bde ba spangs shing sten gnyen po'i yan lag tu ldan pa'i bsam gtan kyi dngos gzhi'i sku mdog gcig la 'jog go /gnyis pa la/ ngo bo/ thob tshul/ dmigs pa'i khyad par/ dbye ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug de bzhin du/

gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug kyang de dag sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gcig la 'jog go /de yang rjes 'brang dang bcas na/ phung po bzhi yod/ gnyis pa ni/ 'og ma sa las dben las te/ 'og sa la chags bral byas pa'i tshul gyis thob dgos pa yin/ gsum pa ni/ nyer bsdogs gong ma gsum dang / dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug rnams ni/ gzugs kyi 'du shes bshig pa yin te/ 'og sa'i gzugs la dmigs shing / gzugs med khams la gzugs med pa'i phyir/ 'o na gzugs med khams nas shi 'phos nas 'dod khams su skyes ma thag pa'i gzugs dang po de'i nyer len gang yin zhe na/ de'i gzugs ni nyer len sems las skye bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /dang po de ni gzugs la dmigs pa yin te/ gzugs la chags bral byed bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ gzugs med la dbye na/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa'i/ 'du shes med min gyi skye mched dang bzhi las/ dang po gsum ni rim bzhin du sbyor ba'i dus su chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas so snyam pa dang / rnam shes ltar mtha' yas so snyam pa dang / gzung bya'i chos ci yang med do snyam du sgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa yin/ bzhi pa ni/ spyir 'du shes gtan med pa min te/ 'du shes dman sman pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ 'du shes rags pa med pa dang / 'du shes phra ba med pa min no snyam du sgom pa las thob pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thun mong du bshad pa ni/ spyir dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi rdzas la rnam pa brgyad yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi'i snyoms 'jug bzhi ste brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ de yang snyoms 'jug dang po bdun re re la dbye na gsum gsum yod de/ ro myang mtshungs ldan/ dag pa ba/ zag med dang gsum gsum du yod pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa la dbye na gnyis te/ ro myang mtshungs ldan te nyon mongs can dang /

dag pa ba gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ de yang dag pa ba ni/ 'jig rten pa'i dge rtsa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i snyoms 'jug la 'jog de ni nyon mongs can gyi ro myang bya yang yin no/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyi ngo bor gyur ba'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug la zag med ces bya'o/ /gsum pa yan lag bye brag tu bshad pa la/ yan lag gi dbye ba/ bsdu ba/ nyon mongs can la yan lag ldan tshul/ zhar byung dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi la yan lag lnga ldan te/ gnyen po'i yan lag rtog dpyod gnyis/ phan yon gyi yan lag dga' bde gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag dang lnga ldan pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i snyoms 'jug la yan lag bzhi ste/ gnyen po'i yan lag rab tu dang ba/ phan yon gyi yan lag dga' bde gnyis/ gnas kyi yan lag sems rtse cig pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa la yan lag lnga ldan te/ gnyen po'i yan lag dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum/ phan yon gyi yan lag sems bde/ ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la yan lag bzhi ldan te/ gnyen po'i yan lag dran pa yongs dag dang / btang snyoms yongs dag gnyis/ bde min sdug min gyi tshor ba phan yon gyi yan lag ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag te bzhi ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsdu ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag la ming gis sgo nas bco brgyad du yod kyang / rdzas su bsdu na rdzas rigs bcu gcig du 'dus te/ bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag rtog dpyod gnyis/ dga' bde gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin dang lnga/ gnyis pa'i yan lag nang rab tu dwang ba dang / gsum pa'i yan lag dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum bde ba dang bzhi/ bzhi pa'i yan lag btang snyoms te bcu gcig tu 'du ba'i phyir/ gsum pa'i yan lag bde ba ste dang po gnyis kyis bde bar 'dus sam snyam na/ min te/ dang po gnyis kyis bde ba ni dge ba bcu'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i shin sbyangs kyi bde ba yin pa'i phyir/

bsam gtan gsum pa'i bde ba tshor ba bde ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na gnyis pa'i nang rab tu dang ba/ gsum pa'i dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum du 'dus pa min nam zhe na/ nang rab tu dang ba ni/ bsam gtan las nges par rab tu byung ba'i yid ches pa'i dad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa'i bde ba ni/ dang po gnyis kyi bde bar 'dus te/ yid bde ru rigs gcig pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i bde ba ni/ yid bde min te/ lung rnam gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir/ lung gnyis ni/ rnam 'gyur gyi mdo las bsam gtan gsum pa bka' bstsal pa na/ 'dir yid bde'i dbang po ma lus pa 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sher phyin gyi mdo las/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i skabs su dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral zhes dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa'i skabs su yid bde ba dang mi bde ba sngar nas kyang nub pas/ zhes gsungs pas/ bsam gtan gsum par yid bde dang bral ba lta bur gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs can la bsam gtan gyi yan lag dngos mi ldan/ des na bsam gtan dang po'i nyon mongs can la ming rigs mthun pa'i dbang du byas na dga' bde gnyis mi ldan/ rtog dpyod gnyis dang ting nge 'dzin ldan/ gnyis pa'i nyon mongs can la ting nge 'dzin ldan gyi gzhan mi ldan/ gsum pa'i nyon mongs pa can la ting nge 'dzin ldan gyi gzhan mi ldan/ bzhi pa'i nyon mongs can la btang snyoms dang ting nge 'dzin ldan gyi gzhan mi ldan/ des na bsam tan bzhi'i nyon mongs can bzhi la/ dang po'i dga' bde/ gnyis pa'i rab tu dang ba/ gsum pa'i dran shes bzhin bzhi pa'i btang snyoms yongs dag dang / dran pa yongs dag pa med do/ /kha che 'dus pa bzang po la sogs pa kha cig shin tu sbyangs dang btang snyoms dang mi ldan te/ de gnyis dge ba'i sa pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa zhar byung la/ bsam gtan bzhi pa mi g.yo ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'bras bu skye bas thob pa'i bsam gtan la tshor ba'i ldan tshul/

bsam gtan gnyis par 'og ma'i sems sngon du byed tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug la g.yo ba med pa zhes bya ste/ bsam gtan gyi skyon brgyad las grol ba'i phyir/ skyon brgyad ni/ rtog dpyod nyon mongs can/ dbugs 'byung rngub pa nyon mongs can/ bde ba sdug bsngal/ yid bde yid mi bde brgyad la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i 'bras bu skye bas thob pa'i bsam gtan la yid shes 'khor du byung ba'i yid bde/ dbang shes 'khor du byung ba'i bde ba/ btang snyoms gsum dang ldan/ gnyis pa'i 'bras bu skye thob kyis bsam gtan la btang snyoms dang yid bde gnyis ldan/ gsum pa de la bde ba dang btang snyoms gnyis ldan/ bzhi pa yan chad tshor ba btang snyoms kho na ldan/ gsum pa ni/ 'o na bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gang zag gi mig gis gzugs mthong ba mi srid par thal/ de la rten bcas kyi mig dbang mi ldan pa'i phyir te/ de'i sas bsdus kyi mig gi rnam par shes pa med pa'i phyir ce na/ skyon med de/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gang zag gis bsam gtan dang po'i mig shes mngon du byas pa'i sgo nas mig gis gzugs mthong ba'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gang zag ngag smra brjod byed pa med par thal/ de'i ngag smra brjod kyi kun slong rtog dpyod med pa'i phyir te/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sas bsdus kyi rtog dpyod med pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ gnyis pa'i gang zag gis bsam gtan dang po'i sas bsdus kyi rtog dpyod mngon du byas pa'i sgo nas ngag smra brjod byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na gnyis pa'i lus rnam shes mig gi rnam shes/ rna ba'i rnam shes gsum po ni/ bsgribs lung ma bstan dang / nyon mongs can min zhing / ma bsgribs lung ma bstan yin no/ /gnyis pa de dag gi khyad chos la/ thob tshul/ thob zin mngon du byed pa'i tshul/ dmigs pa'i khyad par/

spang bya spong tshul nyer bsdogs dang bcas pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ snyoms 'jug dag pa ba de dang mi ldan zhing / sngar med gsar du thob pa la/ 'og sa la chags bral byas pa'i tshul gyis thob dgos te/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug dag pa ba sngar med gsar du thob pa la/ 'dod pa la chags bral byas pa'i sgo nas thob dgos pa'i phyir/ zag med gsar du thob pa ni/ rang sa 'og sa/ gong sa gsum ka la chags bral byas pa'i tshul gyis thob pa yod/ nyon mongs can rnams ni/ dag pa ba la nyams nas skye ba yin/ gnyis pa snyoms 'jug gang gi mjug tu snyoms 'jug du 'byung zhe na/ bsam gtan dang po'i snyoms 'jug zag med kyi mjug thogs su snyoms 'jug drug skye ba yod de/ dang po nas brtsams te bsam gtan gsum pa'i bar gyi snyoms 'jug dag pa ba gsum/ zag med gsum ste drug skye ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug skye ba med de/ shin tu thag ring bas phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i snyoms 'jug zag med kyi mjug thogs su brgyad skye ba yod de/ rang sa bsam gtan gnyis pa/ gong sa bsam gtan gsum pa/ bzhi pa 'og sa bsam gtan dang po dang bzhi/ snyoms 'jug zag med dag pa ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i snyoms 'jug zag med kyi mjug tu bcu skye ba yod de/ rang sa bsam gtan gsum pa/ gong sa bsam gtan bzhi pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ 'og sa bsam gtan gnyis pa/ bsam gtan dang po ste/ lnga'i snyoms 'jug dag pa ba dang zag med gnyis te/ bcu skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du bsam gtan bzhi pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas gnyis kyi mjug tu yang bcu bcu skye ba yin/ rnam shes mtha' yas kyi mjug tu dgu skye/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi mjug tu bdun skye ba 'byung ste/ rang sa'i gnyis/ gong sa srid rtse'i dag pa ba/ 'og sa rnam shes mtha' yas dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas gnyis kyi dag pa dang /

zag med gnyis gnyis te bdun skye ba'i phyir/ srid rtse'i zag bcas kyi mjug tu lnga ste/ rang sa'i dag pa ba/ 'og sa ci yang med/ rnam shes mtha' yas gnyis kyi dag pa ba dang / snyoms 'jug zag med gnyis gnyis te lnga skye ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du dag pa ba'i mjug tu yang / sngar ji lta ba bzhin du skye zhing / rang sa'i nyon mongs can kyang skye/ nyon mongs can gyi mjug tu/ rang sa'i dag pa ba dang nyon mongs can gnyis skye zhing / 'og ma'i dag pa ba gcig kyang skye/ 'chi 'pho ka'i dus su dag pa ba'i mjug tu sa kun gyi nyon mongs can skye ba yod/ nyon mongs can gyi mjug tu gong ma'i dag pa ba skye ba med/ gsum pa sa'i dbye ba la/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug dag pa ba de la dbye na rnam pa bzhi yod de/ nyams pa cha mthun/ gnas pa cha mthun/ khyad par cha mthun/ nges 'byed cha mthun te/ bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhi ni go rim bzhin du/ rang sa'i mjug thogs de ma thag tu nyon mongs can skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ rang sa'i dag pa ba skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ gong sa'i dag pa ba skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ zag med skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa la 'jog ste/ des na nyams pa cha mthun gyi rjes su de bzhi'i nang nas rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma dang gnas pa cha mthun gnyis 'byung gis gzhan 'byung ba med/ gnas pa cha mthun gyi 'jug tu gsum skye ba yod de/ rtogs pa gnyis pa nyams pa'i tshe/ nyams pa cha mthun 'phel ba'i tshe khyad par cha mthun/ rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma 'byung gi nges 'byed cha mthun 'byung ba med/ khyad par cha mthun gyi mjug tu gsum 'byung ba yod de/ rtogs pa 'phel ba'i tshe nges 'byed cha mthun/ nyams pa'i tshe khyad par cha mthun/ rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma 'byung gi gzhan 'byung ba med/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mjug tu rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma 'byung gi gzhan gong ma gsum 'byung ba med do/

/bzhi pa zhar byung thod rgal gyi rnam gzhag la/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ ring sbyor dang nye sbyor gnyis/ dang po la zag bcas ring sbyor dang / zag med ring sbyor gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med bzhi'i snyoms 'jug brgyad la lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun du 'jug pa la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ snyoms 'jug zag med brgyad lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa la byed/ gnyis pa nye sbyor la/ zag bcas nye sbyor dang / zag med nye sbyor gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang po dang / gsum pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa bzhi'i snyoms 'jug zag bcas bzhi la lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po/ bsam gtan gsum pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ ci yang med dang bzhi/ dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug zag med bzhi la lugs mthun lugs mi mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jog gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni bsam gtan dang po zag bcas/ gsum pa zag med/ nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi snyoms 'jug zag bcas/ ci yang med kyi snyoms 'jug zag med dang bzhi la lugs mthun lugs mi mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug tu 'jog gnyis pa thob zin mngon du byed pa'i tshul ni/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug rnams/ rang sa dang 'og sa'i rten la mngon du byed kyis/ gong sa'i rten la mngon du mi byed de/ dper na bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug de dang / rang sa bsam gtan dang po dang / 'og sa 'dod pa'i rten la mngon du byed kyis/ gong sa bsam gtan gnyis pa'i rten la mngon du mi byed de/ de'i rten la de mngon du byas pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i rten la bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi las lhag pa'i rang sa'i snyoms 'jug yod pa'i phyir/

zhes spyir bstan nas/ dmigs bsal du srid rtse'i rten la ci yang med kyi snyoms 'jug mngon du byed pa yod de/ srid rtse la chags bral byed pa la 'phags lam zag med kyis byed dgos shing / srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug dang / zag med kyis gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ sred bcas nyon mongs can rnams kyis rang sa'i phung po la dmigs pa yin zhing / bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug dge ba ste/ dag pa ba dang / zag med kyi yul kun la dmigs te/ sa dgus bsdus pa'i yul la dmigs pa'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i dge ba rnams ni/ rang sa dang gong sa'i zag bcas la dmigs kyis/ 'og sa'i zag bcas la dmigs pa ma yin no/ /bzhi pa spang bya spong tshul nyer bsdogs dang bcas pa la spang bya spong tshul/ nyer bsdogs kyi dbye ba/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug khyad par can ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ zag med kyi nyer bsdogs rnams kyis nyon mongs pa spong ba yod de/ 'og sa gong sas spong ba yod pa'i phyir/ nyer bsdogs dag pa bas kyang nyon mongs spong ba yod de/ 'og sa'i nyon mongs spong ba yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni nyer bsdogs la brgyad yod de/ bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs bzhi/ gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ nyer bsdogs rnams ni/ spyir bstan du ngo bo dag pa ba/ grogs bde min sdug min gyi tshor ba btang snyoms dang mtshungs ldan yin no/ /bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la 'phags pa zag med kyang yod/ kha che 'dus pa bzang po la sogs te/ kho na re/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs la dag pa ba/ nyon mongs can/ zag med gsum ka yod de/ dngos gzhi de la de gsum yod cing / nyer bsdogs gzhi ni/ dngos gzhi la 'gran sdo ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rtog pa yan lag tu med pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi rnams la bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi khyad par can zhes 'jog

de la ming tsam mthun pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyon mongs can/ dag pa/ zag med dang gsum mo/ /bde min sdug min gyi btang snyoms dang mtshungs ldan yin cing / de ni tshangs chen gyi 'bras bu can yin te/ dngos gzhi/ chung ngu / 'bring / chen po gsum gyi nang nang nas chen pos bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba la/ gsum du dbye ba dang / bzhir dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ sa'i sgo nas dbye/ lam gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ rtog pa med la dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum gsungs pa gang la byed snyam na/ go rim bzhin du dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po ba/ gnyis pa ni/ de'i dngos gzhi khyad par can/ gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan gsum pa yan chad kyi dngos gzhi la byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum gsungs pa gang la byed snyam na/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'gog bden la dmigs pa'i zhi ba'i rnam pa can yin/ gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa stong bdag med la dmigs nas de nyid du 'jug pa'i rnam pa can/ gsum pa ni/ de las gzhan pa'i sdug kun gyi rnam pa drug dang lam bden la dmigs nas yid 'byung ba'i rnam pa can yin/ des na 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum ni/ dag pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ting nge 'dzin de gsum ni/ dri med kyi ting nge 'dzin yin cing / dri med kyi de gsum la rnam thar sgo gsum du 'jog gsum pa ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ smon pa med pa smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzi/ mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi khyad par ni/

dang po gnyis ni/ mi slob pa'i 'gog bden la dmigs shing stong pa'i rnam pa can dang / mi rtag pa'i rnam pa can no/ /gsum pa mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa la dmigs nas zhi ba'i rnam pa can yin no/ /de dag kyang ngo bo zag bcas dang / mi'i nang du skyed cing / rten gyi gang zag mi g.yo ba'i rgyud la yod do/ /de yang nyer bsdogs bdun ma gtogs sa bcu gcig gi ngo bor skye ba yod do/ /sa bcu gcig ni/ 'dod sems rtse gcig pa/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i tsam khyad gnyis/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi phyi ma gsum/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi bzhi ste bcu gcig go /gnyis pa bzhir dbye ba ni/ mdo las/ bde ba myong 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin/ shes pa mthong 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin/ blo rnam par dbye ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ zag pa zad par gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi gsungs pa gang la byed snyam na/ dge ba'i ngo bor gyur ba'i bsam gtan dngos gzhi dag pa dang / zag med gnyis ni/ bde ba myong 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin/ zhes bya ste/ dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa'i phyir/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes la/ shes pa mthong 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste/ shes pa cha 'dra ba'i bar srid kyi lus mthong ba'i phyir/ sbyor ba sgom pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la blo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la rten pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ zag pa zad par 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa de la rten pa'i yon tan la tshad med/ rnam thar/ zil non/ zad par/ de dag thob pa'i tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ tshad med la bzhi yod de/ byams pa tshad med/ snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/ btang snyoms tshad med bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ ci'i phyir bzhir nges zhe na/

gnod sems dang sogs pas rnam 'tshe dang gzhan bde ba la mi dga' ba dang / 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang gnod sems te bzhi yod pa'i gnyen por bzhir nges pa'i phyir/ de yang dang po gnyis ni/ zhe sdang med pa'i dge ba rnam par mi 'tshe ba yin zhing / dga' ba tshad med ni/ yid bde mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ btang snyoms tshad med ni sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin can yin no/ /rnam pa ni/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can/ gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can/ gsum pa ni/ bde ba dang mi bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can/ bzhi pa ni/ sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa snyoms pa can yin no/ /spyod yul ni/ bzhi kas kyang 'dod pa'i spyod yul la dmigs pa yin no/ /dga' ba tshad med ni/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis kyi dngos gzhi'i ngo bor skye ba yod/ phyi ma gzhan gsum ni/ bsam gtan sa drug gi ngo bor skye ba yod/ kha cig nyer bsdogs ma gtogs bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi lnga'i ngo bor skye ba yod/ byams pa tshad med ni/ spang bya mi spong ste/ bdag 'dzin dang 'dzin stangs mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ sngar med gsar du skye ba mi dag gi nang du skyed cing / dga' ba tshad med ma gtogs gzhan gsum phan tshun nges ldan yin te/ gcig ldan na gzhan gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam thar de la brgyad yod de/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ khyad par sdug pa'i rnam thar/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar dang brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po gnyis ni/ ngo bo mi sdug pa/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis kyi dngos gzhi la brten pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten pa sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin can no/ /gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi ni/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i sa pa dge ba'o/ /'gog pa'i rnam thar ni/

'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug go /de thob pa'i tshul ni/ sems phra ba srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug de yang shin tu phra ba srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug gi mjug thogs su 'byung zhing / ldang ba'i tshe rang sa'i dag pa ba dang / 'phags rgyud kyi 'og ma'i dngos gzhi'i ngo bor ldan/ dang po gnyis ni 'dod pa'i spyod yul la dmigs so/ /rnam thar gzugs can min par bzhi po de rnams kyi spyod yul ni/ gong sa dang rang sa'i sdug bsngal sogs bden pa dang po gsum dang / rjes shes kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i lam gong 'og rang sa thams cad dang / mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa yin pa srid pa'i brtags min dang / gzugs med dang po yul 'dus ma byas nam mkha' dang bzhi po yang nyer bsdogs gong ma bdun ma gtogs sa bcu par yod pa kha skong zhes so/ /ci'i phyir bsam gtan bzhi dang brgyad pa kho na la mdo las/ lus kyis mngon sum du byas te/ rdzogs par byas nas zhes bshad ce na/ de gnyis kyis rim pa ltar gzugs dang gzugs med kyi rnam thar gyis sgrib pa kun spangs pas gtso bo yin pas dang / gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams dang po'i mtha' na gnas pas so/ sar des 'phya ba rnams shas che bar gnas pas yin par bshad do/ /dbyibs zil gnon dang po gnyis ni/ rnam thar dang po dang 'dra bar ngo bo mi sdug pa/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis kyi dngos gzhi la rten pa/ dbyibs zil gnon gyi phyi ma gnyis ni/ rnam thar gnyis pa bzhin du/ ngo bo mi sdug pa bsam gtan dang po gnyis kyi dngos gzhi la rten pa/ rang la gzugs kyi 'du shes ma shes par 'dod pa'i sems can la dmigs pa/ lhag ma rnams ni/ khyad par sdug pa'i rnam thar bzhin du bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la rten pa/ sems byung ma chags pa'o/ /zad par ni/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin la dbye na bcu yod de/ zad par sa'i/ chu'i/ me'i/ rlung gi ting nge 'dzin/ sngon po/ ser po/ dmar po/

dkar po/ nam mkha'/ rnam shes kyi skye mched dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ de yang dang po/ brgyad ni sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten pa spyod yul 'dod pa la dmigs pa yin/ phyi ma zad par nam mkha' dang / rnam shes kyi skye mched gnyis ni gzugs med dag pa ba'i rang bzhin yin la/ spyod yul rang sa'i phung po bzhi la dmigs te/ dang pos nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi ming bzhi'i phung po la dmigs/ gnyis pa'i rnams shes mtha' yas kyi ming bzhi'i phung po la dmigs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa thob tshul ni/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar ni gong du bshad zin cing / lhag ma rnams ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sgo nas 'bad med lhun grub tu thob cing / de las gzhan pa'i gang zag rnams kyis sbyor ba 'bad pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas thob bo/ /de yang gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi dang / zad par nam mkha' dang rnam shes kyi skye mched gnyis te drug ni khams gsum ka'i rten la thob cing / lhag ma rnams ni sngar med gsar du skye ba mi'i rten la thob/ 'o na khams gong ma gnyis kyi snyoms 'jug rnams gong ma'i rigs rten la rgyu du'i stobs kyis skye ba yin zhe na/ khams gong ma gnyis su gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug rnams rgyu'i stobs dang / las kyi stobs kyi skye ba yin/ gzugs kyi khams su bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug rnams rgyu gnyis po de dag dang chos nyid kyi stobs kyi skye ba yang yod do/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyis 'grel pa las snyoms 'jug bstan pa zhes bya ba gnas brgyad pa bstan zin to/ /gsum pa bshad pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la/ bstan pa'i gnas tshad nongs pa bzod par gsol ba/ thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis bag yod bsten rigs pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ spyir/ ston pa'i dam chos ni rnam pa gnyis te/ lung gi dam chos dang / rtogs pa'i dam chos gnyis kyis bdag nyid can yin no/

/de 'dzin par byed pa de srid du bstan pa gnas te/ lung gi dam chos ni/ thos bsam gyis sgo nas gnas par byed pa yod pa de srid du gnas shing / rtogs pa'i dam chos ni/ sgrub pa bsam gtan gyi sgo nas sgrub par byed pa yod pa de srid du gnas pa kho na yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen bdag gi mngon pa mdzod kyi chos 'di phal che ba ni/ kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i tshul du grub cing / de dang mthun par bshad do/ /de dag la nyes pas zin pa gang yin pa de ni/ skabs 'dir nyes pa yin cing / nyes pa de yang dam pa'i chos kyi tshul la tshad mar gyur pa/ thub pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bzod par gsol lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten kun mkhyen gyi mig tu gyur pa ni zum pa lta bur gyur cing dbang du gyur pa'i skye bo thogs med dang / klu sgrub la sogs pa phal cher zad pas na de nyid mngon sum du ma mthong ba'i ngan rtog gi skye bo rnams kyis bstan pa 'di dkrugs so/ /des na thar pa 'dod pa'i gdul bya dag gis bag yod bsten rigs te/ thub pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni lkog mar srog phyin pa dang 'dra bar yun ring du mi gnas pa'i dri ma rnams stobs dang ldan pa'i dus su gyur pa'i phyir/ rang byung gi bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa rnams mchog tu zhi bar gshegs pas 'gro ba rnams mgon med par gyur la 'doms pa med pa'i yon tan rnams 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/ 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams deng sang 'jig rten kyi khams 'di na dga' mgur spyod pa mthong ba'i phyir/ gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa yin no/ /'di'i sgyur byed ni/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /

zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi rnam bshad tshig don rab tu gsal ba zhes pa 'di ni/ sde snod 'dzin pa 'ga' dang 'gas bskul ba'i ngor gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gyis/ mngon 'dul gyi mdo bstan bcos/ rgya dkar nag gi rtsis kyi rgyud/ tha snyad kyi gtsug lag khang tshad ldan rnams dpang du bzung / kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi gsung gis legs pa'i bshad pa'i brgyan te/ me mo byi ba'i lo/ nyin mo'i dbang phyug bu mo'i khyim du rtse dgar rol ba'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen po la 'dabs 'byor ba/ chos 'khor lhun po'i chos grwar sbyar ba 'dis/ bstan pa rin po che sgo mtha' dag nas 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur gcig kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel byed cing / /mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje/ /kun dga'i nyi ma'i blo gros tsha zer gyis/ /dam chos mngon pa'i pad tshal phye ba las/ /byung ba'i legs bshad bzang po'i rtsi bcud 'di/ /don gnyer bung ba yongs kyi dpal du sbyin/ /dge bas thub bstan pad tshal brgyas pa dang / /rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i snyoms las pa/ /siddhi'i ming can bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas rjes su 'dzin gyur cing / /rje dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres gyur te/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nas/ /lung rtogs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed shog/ //maṅgalaṃ/ bha wantu/ dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 gzhung brgya ba dngos grub dpal 'bar/ mdzod kyi rnam bshad tshig don rab gsal/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
